TEST_Legendary_Power1.desc:
This is the descriptive text for the Legendary Power 1 affix.

Dash no longer costs Energy but instead has a [Affix_Value_1||] second cooldown. In addition, enemies hit by Dash deal {c_number}[Affix_Value_2|%|]{/c} less damage to you for 7 seconds.

TEST_Legendary_Power2.desc: This is the descriptive text for the Legendary Power 2 affix

TEST_Unique_Power1.desc:
This is the descriptive text for the Unique Power 1 affix.

{c_gold}Lucky Hit:{/c} Your ranged attacks have up to a 30% chance to deal {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} additional damage and knock the target back.

unique_attack_speed_test_item_TEMP.desc: Test item that increases attack speed by {c_number}100%{/c}.

legendary_barb_011.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damaging an enemy with a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill has up to a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to extend the duration of {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} by {c_number}[Affix_Value_2||]{/c} seconds. Double this duration if it was a Critical Strike.

legendary_barb_026.desc: {c_important}Leap{/c} creates an {c_important}Earthquake{/c} that deals {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_2||]{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}[4*(1+Power_Duration_Bonus_Pct(1031902))||]{/c} seconds. While standing in {c_important}Earthquakes{/c} and for {c_number}4{/c} seconds afterwards, you gain {c_number}30%{/c} increased Damage Reduction.

legendary_generic_109.desc: You have {c_random}[0.5*Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance against {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} enemies. While you are {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}, you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} increased Crowd Control Duration.

legendary_barb_001.desc: While {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}, your direct damage inflicts {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} bonus Bleeding damage over {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

legendary_barb_022.desc: You gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} Fury per second while {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}.

legendary_generic_009.desc: {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills grant {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

legendary_barb_006.desc: Gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds after swapping weapons {c_number}8{/c} times.

legendary_barb_018.desc: Enemies damaged by {c_important}Kick{/c} or {c_important}Charge{/c} will explode if they are killed within the next {c_number}2{/c} seconds, dealing {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_1||]{/c} damage to surrounding enemies.

legendary_barb_017.desc: Generating {c_number}100{/c} Fury while at Maximum Fury grants {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|2|]%{/c} of your Maximum Life.

2HMace_Unique_Barb_100.desc: {c_important}Death Blow{/c} creates a shockwave, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of its Base damage to enemies. Enemies who die to this effect also reset {c_important}Death Blow’s{/c} Cooldown.

legendary_barb_050.desc: {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} Pulls enemies to you every {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.

legendary_barb_025.desc: {c_important}Whirlwind's{/c} Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage are increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} for each second it is channeled, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix_Value_2|%x|]{/c}.

legendary_barb_100.desc: Damaging an enemy with {c_important}Kick{/c} or {c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} resets {c_important}Leap's{/c} Cooldown.

Legendary_Barb_108.desc: While {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}, you deal {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_1||]{/c} Fire damage every second to surrounding enemies.

legendary_barb_040.desc: Each time a {c_important}Brawling{/c} Skill deals direct damage to an enemy, your {c_important}Charge{/c}, {c_important}Leap{/c}, or {c_important}Kick{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}5{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*Affix_Value_2|%x|]{/c}.

1HSword_Unique_Barb_101.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Skills deal {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|2%x|]{/c} increased damage per point of Fury you have, but {c_number}7%{/c} Fury Drains per second while in combat.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

legendary_barb_021.desc: Gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased Fury Generation and {c_number}15%{/c} reduced Fury cost while all damage bonuses from the {c_important}Walking Arsenal{/c} Key Passive are active.

legendary_barb_005.desc: Gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1/5|1%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for each Nearby Bleeding enemy up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} maximum.

Gloves_Unique_Barb_001.desc: {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} explodes every {c_number}3{/c} seconds dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} increased damage as Fire. {c_important}Critical Strikes{/c} with {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} reduce the time until the next explosion by {c_number}0.4{/c} seconds down to {c_number}1{/c} second.

legendary_barb_020.desc: After spending {c_number}100{/c} Fury, you deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased {c_important}Brawling{/c} Skill damage for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

legendary_barb_003.desc: {c_important}{u}Incapacitating{/u}{/c} a Bleeding enemy deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of their total Bleeding amount as Physical damage.

Legendary_Barb_110.desc: Each point of Fury you generate increases your damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|2%x|]{/c}, up to {c_number}350{/c} Fury. This bonus is lost after {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

legendary_barb_027.desc: Casting {c_important}Double Swing{/c} creates a {c_important}Dust Devil{/c} that deals {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_1||]{/c} damage to enemies in its path.

legendary_barb_013.desc: Killing an enemy with a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill refunds {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} of its base cost. Can only happen once per Skill cast.

legendary_barb_002.desc:
{c_important}Ground Stomp{/c} creates an {c_important}Earthquake{/c} damaging enemies for {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_2||]{/c} Physical damage over {c_number}[4*(1+Power_Duration_Bonus_Pct(1031902))||]{/c} seconds. While standing in {c_important}Earthquakes{/c} and for {c_number}4{/c} seconds afterwards, you deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

Your {c_important}Earthquakes{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} increased damage.

legendary_barb_014.desc:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Leap{/c}, {c_important}Upheaval{/c}, and {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} have up to a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to Summon an Ancient to perform the same Skill. Can only occur once every {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

Your {c_important}Summons{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|%|]{/c} increased damage.

2HBow_Unique_Rogue_001.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Every consecutive Cast of {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} increases the amount of arrows it fires by {c_number}2{/c}, up to {c_number}6{/c}. {c_important}Rapid Fire{/c} deals {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

Pants_Unique_Generic_100.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Effects that Heal you beyond {c_number}100%{/c} Life grant you {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} equal to {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of the overhealed amount that lasts for {c_number}8{/c} seconds. 

You may now drink your Healing Potion while at full Life.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

2HStaff_Unique_Generic_100.desc: Gain a random Shrine effect for {c_number}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} seconds after killing an Elite enemy. Can only occur once every {c_number}30{/c} seconds.

Legendary_Generic_110.desc: Critical Strikes with {c_important}Core{/c} Skills increase your Attack Speed by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%+|]{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

1HAxe_Unique_Druid_100.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Shred{/c} deals {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} more damage, and {c_important}Shred{/c} has a {c_number}33%{/c} chance to land an additional strike, up to {c_number}4{/c} times.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

legendary_generic_038.desc:
Distant enemies have a {c_number}10%{/c} chance to be Stunned for {c_number}2{/c} seconds when they hit you. 

You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage to Stunned or Knocked Down enemies.

Legendary_Druid_115.desc: {c_important}{u}Dancing Bolt{/u}{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and moves {c_number}50%{/c} faster.

legendary_druid_028.desc: Your direct Lightning damage makes your {c_important}Storm{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|2%x|]{/c} more damage to the enemy, up to {c_random}[50*Affix_Value_1*100|2%x|]{/c}. At maximum stacks, the target becomes {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.

Legendary_Druid_116.desc: {c_important}Grizzly Rage{/c{} is now a {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skill and Shapeshifts you into a Dire Werewolf. Dire Werewolves gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} Movement Speed and Spirit Cost Reduction instead of Damage Reduction. In addition, kills Heal you for {c_number}10%{/c} of your Maximum Life.

legendary_generic_036.desc: Your Damage over Time grants you {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}2{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}30{/c} times.

legendary_druid_049.desc:
{c_important}Trample{/c} now sunders the earth, forming {c_number}6{/c} {c_important}Landslide{/c} pillars that deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of normal damage. 

{c_important}Trample{/c} is now also a {c_important}Nature Magic{/c} and {c_important}Earth{/c} Skill.

legendary_druid_111.desc: {c_important}{u}Tectonic Spikes{/u}{/c} gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage, and its Size is increased by {c_number}50%{/c}.

Chest_Unique_Druid_002.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Lacerate{/c} has no Cooldown, costs {c_number}100{/c} Spirit to cast and deals {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage but no longer grants {c_important}{u}Immunity{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Lacerate{/c} is also a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

legendary_druid_005.desc: While Shapeshifted, you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%+|]{/c} increased Spirit Generation.

legendary_druid_010.desc:
{c_important}Wind Shear{/c} now deals {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_2||]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Wind Shear{/c} has up to a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%|]{/c} chance to restore {c_number}100{/c} Spirit.

legendary_druid_029.desc:
Casting a {c_important}Storm{/c} Skill grants your {c_important}Earth{/c} Skills {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

Casting a {c_important}Earth{/c} Skill increases the Critical Strike Chance of {c_important}Storm{/c} Skills by {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|1%+|]{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

1HAxe_Unique_Generic_001.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your attacks Critically Strike {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} Enemies. Killing Elites Fears and Slows nearby enemies by {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

Boots_Unique_Generic_001.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}You are permanently {u}{c_important}Unhindered{/c}{/u} and leave behind a trail of frost that {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} enemies. 

Your {u}{c_important}Chill{/c}{/u} effects cause enemies to take {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage from you.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

legendary_generic_065.desc: You have {c_number}8%{/c} increased Dodge Chance. Successful Dodges restore {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

legendary_generic_016.desc: Critical Strikes grant {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%+|]{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}1{/c} second, up to {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

Gloves_Unique_Generic_002.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your attacks randomly deal {c_number}[Affix_Value_2|%|]{/c} to {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of their normal damage.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

Gloves_Unique_Generic_003.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to {u}{c_important}Freeze{/c}{/u} enemies for {c_number}1{/c} second.

You deal {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage to {u}{c_important}Frozen{/c}{/u} enemies.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

Helm_Unique_Generic_001.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to trigger a poison nova that deals {c_number}[Affix_Value_2|%|]{/c} of the damage dealt over {c_number}5{/c} seconds to enemies in the area.

legendary_generic_006.desc: Every {c_number}10%{/c} of your Life that you Heal grants you {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Primary Resource Cost Reduction for {c_number}2{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

legendary_generic_011.desc: Damaging an Elite enemy grants you a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[Affix_Value_2*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}10{/c} seconds. This effect can only happen once every {c_number}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} seconds.

legendary_generic_027.desc: Deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage while you have a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} active.

1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to deal {c_number}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*(1+Main_Hand_Damage_Percent_Bonus)*Affix_Value_2||]{/c} Shadow damage to surrounding enemies and reduce their damage dealt by {c_number}25%{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

2HSword_Unique_Generic_001.desc: Increases your Critical Strike Damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c}.

legendary_rogue_020.desc: When casting an {c_important}Imbuement{/c} Skill you trigger an explosion around yourself, applying the {c_important}Imbuement{/c} effects at {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased potency and dealing {c_number}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*1.1||]{/c} damage of the same type.

legendary_rogue_013.desc:
{c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} deals {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage per Skill Rank of the Imbued Skill. 
Every {c_number}10{/c} seconds, when your Imbued Skill hits an enemy you trigger a large explosion that deals {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_1||]{/c} Shadow damage and applies {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} to each enemy it hits.

legendary_rogue_024.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Shadow damage has up to a {c_number}75%{/c} chance to release an explosion that deals {c_number}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Cold damage to the target and surrounding enemies, {c_important}{u}Chilling{/u}{/c} for {c_number}25%{/c} and {c_important}{u}Weakening{/u}{/c} them for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.

legendary_rogue_004.desc:
Using a {c_important}Healing Potion{/c} increases your Resistance to All Elements by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|+%|]{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds.

You may now drink your {c_important}Healing Potion{/c} while at full Life.

1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}5{/c} seconds when Consuming {c_number}3{/c} {c_important}Combo Points{/c}. Casting {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills always generates {c_number}3{/c} {c_important}Combo Points{/c}.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

Generating {c_important}Combo Points{/c} allows you to generate the same amount of {c_important}Combo Points{/c} for {c_number}1.5{/c} seconds when you spend them.

legendary_generic_067.desc: {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills grant {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}4{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}10{/c} times.

Helm_Unique_Rogue_002.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Flurry{/c} gains the Transporter Variant for free. You can now overexert yourself while Casting {c_important}Flurry{/c}, spending {c_number}3%{/c} life when you don't have enough Energy. Spending life to Cast {c_important}Flurry{/c} increases its damage by {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} and your Attack Speed by {c_number}50%{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

legendary_rogue_011.desc: {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased damage. This bonus increases to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*1.2727|x%|]{/c} against {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c} enemies.

1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_002.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Hits with this weapon increase your Attack Speed by {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*0.3*100|1%+|]{/c} and damage by {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds, up to {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*0.3*3*100|1%+|]{/c} and {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*3*100|1%x|]{/c} respectively.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

legendary_rogue_028.desc: Every time you create an {c_important}{u}Arrow Storm{/u}{/c}, their damage is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1x%|]{/c}, up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*4|1x%|]{/c}, for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

legendary_generic_063.desc: Skills deal up to {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage based on your available Primary Resource when cast, receiving the maximum benefit while you have full Primary Resource.

legendary_rogue_021.desc: {c_important}Twisting Blades{/c} orbit for a short time after they return to you, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of {c_important}Twisting Blades'{/c} return damage per hit.

legendary_rogue_026.desc: {c_important}Dash{/c} Summons a {c_important}Shadow Clone{/c} that also casts {c_important}Dash{/c}, dealing {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} of the Base damage.

legendary_rogue_014.desc:
Damaging an enemy with a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill generates {c_number}9{/c} Energy. 

Gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} Energy after killing an Elite enemy.

legendary_rogue_003.desc:
Your {c_important}Shadow Clones{/c} and {c_important}Shades{/c} also mimic the {c_important}Imbuements{/c} applied to your Skills. 
Casting an {c_important}Imbuement{/c} Skill increases your Non-physical damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}9{/c} seconds.

legendary_rogue_023.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Shadow damage has up to a {c_number}75%{/c} chance to create a toxic explosion that applies {c_number}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*0.5||]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}5{/c} seconds to the target and surrounding enemies. You deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|x%|]{/c} increased Non-Physical damage to enemies affected by this Poison.

Pants_Unique_Rogue_004.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_important}Death Trap{/c} deals {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage and will rearm itself after activating, once every {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

legendary_rogue_018.desc:
When you {c_important}Evade{/c} or {c_important}Shadow Step{/c}, you drop a cluster of exploding {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} that deal {c_random}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_1||]{/c} total Physical damage and Stun enemies for {c_number}1.00{/c} second.

Your {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|x%|]{/c} increased damage.

legendary_rogue_029.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Poison Imbued{/c} Skills have up to a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to deploy a {c_important}Poison Trap{/c} while you have {c_important}Poison Trap{/c} equipped.

legendary_rogue_019.desc:

Enemies become {c_important}Fossilized{/c} at {c_number}[Affix_Value_2||]{/c} stacks, {c_important}Petrifying{/c} them for {c_number}3{/c} seconds. {c_important}Petrified{/c} enemies are Stunned and take {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} bonus Critical Strike Damage.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid02_02.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Fossilizing{/c} enemies grants {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}[Affix_Value_2||]{/c} seconds.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid02_03.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Petrified{/c} enemies absorb your damage dealt and will explode for {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of the amount absorbed when {c_important}Petrify{/c} expires or if the absorbed damage exceeds the target's remaining Life.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid03_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Dealing damage in Werebear form grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}Stoicism{/c}, ({c_number}2{/c} while {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}) which increases your damage by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c}. Stacks up to {c_number}[Affix_Value_2||]{/c} times and you lose a stack when taking direct damage.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid03_02.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Increases your Damage Reduction while in Werebear form by {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} and an additional {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|+%|]{/c} while {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid03_03.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} At {c_number}20{/c} stacks of {c_important}Stoicism{/c}, you explode in a feral {c_important}Rampage{/c} until you fall below {c_number}15{/c} stacks. While {c_important}Rampaging{/c}, you grow larger allowing your {c_important}Werebear{/c} Skills to deal {c_number}225%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} bonus damage. In addition, {c_important}Rampaging{/c} allows you to move {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} through enemies Knocking them Down.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid04_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} While in Werewolf form, you periodically smell dread in enemies, marking them. Your {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skills deal {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} bonus damage. Attacking a marked enemy grants you {c_number}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} seconds of {c_important}Blood Hunt{/c}, increasing your Movement Speed and Attack Speed by {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|x%|]{/c}. Killing a marked enemy instead grants {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*2||]{/c} seconds.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid04_02.desc:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Gain {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} Damage Reduction while in Werewolf form. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} You heal for {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|%|]{/c} of any damage taken over {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid04_03.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} When {c_important}Blood Hunt{/c} exceeds {c_number}[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} seconds, you explode in a {c_important}Feral Rage{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, increasing your Movement Speed and Cast Speed by {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} and allowing all of your {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skills to dash you towards your target and dealing {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage. Killing enemies extends the duration of {c_important}Feral Rage{/c} by {c_number}1{/c} second.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid05_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Summon a {c_important}Bear Companion{/c} that attacks enemies for {c_number}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_1||]{/c} damage and may cast {c_important}Battle Roar{/c} increasing the damage of all Companions by {c_number}90%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds. ({c_number}5{/c} second cooldown)

Talisman_SetPower_Druid05_02.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} of the damage you take is split between you and your {c_important}Bear Companion{/c}. When you or your Bear Companion becomes {c_important}{u}Injured{/u}{/c}, your {c_important}Bear Companion{/c} casts {c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} on enemies and fully heals.

Talisman_SetPower_Druid05_03.desc:

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue01_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} When you Cast a {c_important}Marksman Basic{/c} Skill, you gain a stack of Vengeance, which grants {c_number}3%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} increased Movement Speed and {c_number}15%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for your {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skills. Talisman_SetPower_Rogue01_02.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} While you have Vengeance, you gain {c_number}1{/c} {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} shadow every {c_number}2{/c} seconds, {c_number}30%{/c} Damage Reduction whenever you have at least {c_number}1{/c} shadow, and Knockback Close enemies when you lose a shadow.

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue01_03.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} While you have Vengeance, your {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skills deal {c_number}200%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage and you trigger the last {c_important}Marksman Basic{/c} Skill you used {c_number}3{/c} times whenever you Cast a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill at a targeted enemy.

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue02_01.desc:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skills deal {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Stabbing an enemy in the back with a {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skill deals {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage.

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue02_02.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Casting an {c_important}Agility{/c} Skill grants you {c_number}30%{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}8{/c} seconds and Slows Nearby enemy Small Missiles by {c_number}80%{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue02_03.desc:
{icon:bullet,1.2} After stabbing an enemy in the back or Critically Striking an enemy, your senses heighten, allowing all your hits to count as backstabs and granting {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased Cast Speed and {c_number}250%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue03_01.desc:

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue03_02.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Gain {c_number}5%{/c} Damage Reduction for every {c_important}Grenade{/c} or {c_important}Trap{/c} Skill Casted within the last {c_number}12{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}30%{/c}.

Talisman_SetPower_Rogue04_01.desc:

Talisman_SetPower_Necro04_03.desc:

Talisman_SetPower_Pala01_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Enemies cower before you, becoming Feared and Immobilized for {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds when they first see you or when you Block them.

Talisman_SetPower_Pala01_02.desc:

Talisman_SetPower_Pala01_03.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} When you try to Crowd Control a worthy enemy, one that can't be Crowd Controlled, you rise to the occasion gaining {c_number}500%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for {c_number}15{/c} seconds.

Talisman_SetPower_Pala02_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Casting Zealot Skills grants Do or Die on hit, increasing your Critical Strike damage by {c_number}2.5%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} and Cast Speed by {c_number}0.4%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}25{/c} times.

Talisman_SetPower_Pala02_03.desc:

{icon:bullet,1.2} Every {c_number}5{/c} Stacks of Do or Die stores a {c_important}Zealot{/c} Afterimage. Moving periodically spawns your stored Afterimages.

Talisman_SetPower_Pala03_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} now spreads to targets that don't have it and {c_important}{u}Judging{/u}{/c} enemies grants Judgement Day, increasing your damage by {c_number}12.5%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}5{/c} times.

Talisman_SetPower_Pala04_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skills reduce the Cooldown of {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} by {c_number}0.1{/c} seconds when they deal damage, or by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds if they have a Cooldown.

Talisman_SetPower_Pala05_02.desc:

Talisman_SetPower_Pala05_03.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Gain {c_important}Conviction Aura{/c}, increasing the damage Nearby enemies take from all sources by {c_number}0.5%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} per Skill Rank you have in all your {c_important}Aura{/c} Skills.

Talisman_SetPower_Warlock01_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} Gain Sadism for {c_number}20{/c} seconds as your demons take damage or die, increasing the damage your demons take by {c_number}2%{/c} per stack. Talisman_SetPower_Warlock02_01.desc: {icon:bullet,1.2} While in {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} quickly gain Infernal Hunger stacks, each increasing the damage you take by {c_number}0.5%{/c}. Runeword_Enigma.desc: {if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Your {c_important}Evade{/c} is now Sorcerer's {c_important}Teleport{/c} and costs {c_number}33{/c} Primary Resource.{/u}{/c}

OPAL_Amulet_Unique_Generic_100.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}30%{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Moo{/u}{/c} when hitting an enemy.

{c_label}Lucky Moo:{/c} Up to a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to summon a Cow that explodes for {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)*Affix_Value_1||]{/c} Fire damage. This damage is increased by {c_number}50%{/c} on Tuesdays. {if:IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}

Runeword_HolyThunder.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}You emit {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c}. 
Enemies damaged by {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/u}{/c} take {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*100|0%x|]{/c} increased Holy, Fire, Lightning, and Physical damage from you for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{/c_mythic}

Runeword_Rain.desc:
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Attacks have up to a {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} chance to unleash a Rank {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_2||]{/c} Druid {c_important}Tornado{/c}.
{if:IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}{c_number}50%{/c} Chance to unleash a Rank {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_2||]{/c} Druid {c_important}Cyclone Armor{/c} whenever you Dodge.{/c}

Runeword_CalltoArms.desc:

• {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}+[Affix_Value_1||]{/c} Ranks to all Skills
• {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}+[Affix_Value_2*100|0%+|]{/c} Maximum Life
• {if:IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}+[Affix_Value_2*100|0%x|]{/c} Maximum Primary Resource{/c_mythic}

S15_GodlyPlateOfTheWhale.desc: Increases Fishing yields by {c_number}100%{/c}. Does not apply to enemies caught by fishing.

HellfireTorch_Druid_02.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Song of the Old Mountain{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Druid_03.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Might of the Den Mother{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Druid_04.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Rush of the Red Wolf Moon{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Rogue_02.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Way of the Blurring Blade{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Rogue_05.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Legacy of the Sightless{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Sorc_02.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Breath of the Frozen Sea{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Sorc_04.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Tal Rasha's Threefold Way{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Spirit_05.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Bliss of the Multitude{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Necro_02.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Art of the Bone Weaver{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Necro_03.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Word of the Blood Binder{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Necro_04.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Peace of the Black Shroud{/c}.

HellfireTorch_Warlock_04.desc: +1 Set count to {c_set}Rite of the Nameless{/c}.

Runeword_Grief.desc: Your direct damage inflicts {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%|]{/c} bonus Poisoning damage over {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

Wedding_Ring.name: Reyna's Wedding Ring
Wedding_Ring.flavor: "To Reyna. My love for you is like this ring. It has no end. - Donnell"

Gloves_Unique_Generic_002.name: Fists of Fate
Gloves_Unique_Generic_002.flavor:
"Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life."
- Zurke

Gloves_Unique_Sorc_002.name: Gloves of the Illuminator
Gloves_Unique_Sorc_002.flavor: After Inarius returned to Sanctuary, he sought a way back to the High Heavens. His first step was to reignite the religion he had abandoned millennia before: the Cathedral of Light.

Boots_Unique_Generic_001.name: Penitent Greaves
Boots_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Remorseful devotees of the Cathedral of Light must undertake a grueling pilgrimage, journeying across the frigid glacier known as the Serac Rapture. Only then may their gravest sins be forgiven.

TEST_Quest_Mountain_Marowen_02_CursedAmu.name: Amulet of Talomon
TEST_Quest_Mountain_Marowen_02_CursedAmu.flavor: A blood-splattered silver circle inset with five fiery rubies. It remains hot to the touch.

1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: Doombringer
1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Whenever this ancient sword has reappeared throughout history, it portends a time of great strife, as well as a devastating loss of life.

2HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: The Grandfather
2HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.

1HAxe_Unique_Generic_001.name: The Butcher's Cleaver
1HAxe_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: A nightmarish amalgam of blood, bone and steel, this axe is as horrific, and as deadly, as its creator.

2HMace_Unique_Generic_001.name: The Furnace
2HMace_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: "What plague has befouled, let fire make clean. What agony these good people have suffered, let it settle quietly in the dust." -General Arenton

2HBow_Unique_Rogue_006.name: Windforce
2HBow_Unique_Rogue_006.flavor:
"There have been numerous world-shaping conflicts throughout history. This bow has been found on the battlefield of every one, and always in the hands of the victors."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

Helm_Unique_Generic_001.name: Andariel's Visage
Helm_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: The horrific whispers of the Maiden of Anguish flicker through your mind, pushing you ever closer to madness...

Gloves_Unique_Generic_003.name: Frostburn
Gloves_Unique_Generic_003.flavor: A touch so frigid it stops the heart and chills the very soul.

Gem_Ruby_01.name: Crude Ruby
Gem_Ruby_01.flavor: Born anew from a fickle flame.

socketedEffects.label: x[{value}*100|%|] Fire and Holy Damage Multiplier

Gem_Topaz_01.name: Crude Topaz
Gem_Topaz_01.flavor: A spark of genius waits to be ignited.

2HSword_Unique_Barb_002.name: Fields of Crimson
2HSword_Unique_Barb_002.flavor: "We've been fighting these flesh-eaters for so long, been soaked in so much blood, that after a while it's difficult to tell what side you're truly on." -Daelyr, Crane Tribe warrior

Boots_Unique_Generic_002.name: Flickerstep
Boots_Unique_Generic_002.flavor:
"Considered a failure by their creator, it wasn't until the assassination of an "untouchable" Caldeum noble that these boots' true power was understood."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

Gloves_Unique_Barb_001.name: Gohr's Devastating Grips
Gloves_Unique_Barb_001.flavor: "The brutish construction of these gloves belies the strength they bestow. Gohr was clearly no craftsman, but it would be foolish to ignore the triumph of his work." -Barrett's Book of Implements

DO_NOT_USE_Crafting_Magic_01.name: Arcane Dust
DO_NOT_USE_Crafting_Magic_01.desc: Obtained by using the Blacksmith to salvage {c_magic}magic{/c} weapons and armor.

DO_NOT_USE_Crafting_Elite_01.name: {c_specialcraftingmat}Fragment of Hatred{/c}
DO_NOT_USE_Crafting_Elite_01.desc: Obtained by slaying the strongest monsters in Sanctuary.

Gem_Amethyst_03.name: Chipped Amethyst
Gem_Amethyst_03.flavor: The last remnant of a wicked vessel.

Gem_Amethyst_05.name: Flawless Amethyst
Gem_Amethyst_05.flavor: Light seems to bend away from this curio.

Gem_Amethyst_06.name: Royal Amethyst
Gem_Amethyst_06.flavor: Within its shadow lies a thousand sorrows.

Gem_Emerald_03.name: Chipped Emerald
Gem_Emerald_03.flavor: A vestige of the wilds beyond.

Gem_Emerald_04.name: Emerald
Gem_Emerald_04.flavor: The light upon its surface stalks you.

Gem_Emerald_05.name: Flawless Emerald
Gem_Emerald_05.flavor: Off the beaten path lies the beast within.

Gem_Emerald_06.name: Royal Emerald
Gem_Emerald_06.flavor: It yearns to join you on the hunt.

socketedEffects.label: x[{value}*100|%|] Fire and Holy Damage Multiplier

Gem_Ruby_03.name: Chipped Ruby
Gem_Ruby_03.flavor: Born anew from a fickle flame.

socketedEffects.label: x[{value}*100|%|] Fire and Holy Damage Multiplier

Gem_Ruby_04.name: Ruby
Gem_Ruby_04.flavor: Capable of withstanding both fire and fury.

x[{value}*100|%|] Fire and Holy Damage Multiplier

x[{value}*100|%|] Fire and Holy Damage Multiplier

Gem_Sapphire_03.name: Chipped Sapphire
Gem_Sapphire_03.flavor: No beauty escapes the menace of time.

Gem_Sapphire_04.name: Sapphire
Gem_Sapphire_04.flavor: A broken spirit can return stronger than before.

Gem_Sapphire_05.name: Flawless Sapphire
Gem_Sapphire_05.flavor: It harbors a light both wise and elegant.

Gem_Topaz_03.name: Chipped Topaz
Gem_Topaz_03.flavor: A spark of genius waits to be ignited.

Gem_Topaz_04.name: Topaz
Gem_Topaz_04.flavor: One glimpse sends your mind racing.

Gem_Topaz_05.name: Flawless Topaz
Gem_Topaz_05.flavor: Within its depths lies splendorous ambition.

Gem_Topaz_06.name: Royal Topaz
Gem_Topaz_06.flavor: Plans within plans unfold within its fractal gleam.

QST_KV_VampireRemains.name: Remains of a Bound Vampire
QST_KV_VampireRemains.desc: A blood-soaked heart is all that remains of a vampire bound eternally to its partner. It is long cold, but still beats.

QST_Scos_CeremonialHorn.name: Ceremonial Horn
QST_Scos_CeremonialHorn.desc: The hallowed out horn of a ram, covered with intricate carvings.

QST_Scos_CeremonialDagger.name: Ceremonial Dagger
QST_Scos_CeremonialDagger.desc: An old, dull dagger, etches with druidic runes.

2HMace_Unique_Barb_001.name: Hellhammer
2HMace_Unique_Barb_001.flavor: The demon prince Ikonoth slew hundreds of the Heavenly Host with this infernal hammer before falling to none other than the Archangel Imperius himself.

2HStaff_Unique_Druid_001.name: Greatstaff of the Crone
2HStaff_Unique_Druid_001.flavor: "She has existed in Scosglen since before Fiacla-Géar walked the land. Her purpose is a mystery to us all. However, approach her with deference; she may grant you her counsel."-Airidah, to Donan

2HAxe_Unique_Barb_001.name: Ancients' Oath
2HAxe_Unique_Barb_001.flavor: "Weapons wielded by the fiercest warriors often catch the eye of the Ancient spirits. If the wielder is worthy, the spirits may bless the steel with their strength." -Gerti, Oxen Tribe Forgemaster

Chest_Unique_Druid_002.name: Mad Wolf's Glee
Chest_Unique_Druid_002.flavor:
"He was not a victim of the curse. He sought it out. As his muscles grew and body changed from man to beast, his laughter never ceased." 
– Tale of the Mad Nobleman

DO_NOT_USE_Crafting_Legendary_01.name: Forgotten Soul
DO_NOT_USE_Crafting_Legendary_01.desc: Obtained by using the Blacksmith to salvage {c_legendary}legendary{/c} weapons and armor.

2HStaff_Unique_Generic_100.name: Ahavarion, Spear of Lycander
2HStaff_Unique_Generic_100.flavor:
"The angel Lycander left us a portion of her power in this spear. It is all the proof I need that she watches over us still."
- Oracle Argoysni

1HSword_Unique_Generic_100.name: Azurewrath
1HSword_Unique_Generic_100.flavor: The ancient runeblade of the angel Izual, Azurewrath was miraculously spared the corruption that consumed its master.

2HBow_Unique_Rogue_001.name: Skyhunter
2HBow_Unique_Rogue_001.flavor:
"Genai took up her bow and aimed at the sun itself. The light burned her eyes, but her arrow flew true. Wounded, the sun hid, and brought forth the first night."
- Fable of the Great Sky-Hunt

Test_JJary_Quest_AbigailHair.name: Lock of Abigail's Hair
Test_JJary_Quest_AbigailHair.desc: A trimming of braided hair from the remains of Abigail.

QST_Scos_KaylasDagger.name: Kayla's Dagger
QST_Scos_KaylasDagger.desc: An old dagger with some etchings on the side.

JoeTest_UnmarkedCoffin_01.name: Major Ley Essence
JoeTest_UnmarkedCoffin_01.desc: Bound and to be delivered to the Unformed Lands

1HMace_Unique_Druid_001.name: Fleshrender
1HMace_Unique_Druid_001.flavor:
"This weapon is a reminder of the unbridled savagery of our druidic ancestors, the wisdom of which I see more clearly with every day that passes."
- Moreg, Druidic Scholar

CraftingMaterial_Herb_Common.name: Bundled Herbs
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Common.flavor: Considered foundational to the study of alchemy, herbs serve to bond and enhance other elixirs.

CraftingMaterial_Herb_Rare.name: Angelbreath
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Rare.flavor: A precious and rare strain of lily-of-the-valley. Considered an alchemical catalyst of few peers.

JoeTest_HideCommon.name: Scrap Leather
JoeTest_HideCommon.desc: A material used in the crafting of new items.

JoeTest_HideRare.name: Full Grain Leather
JoeTest_HideRare.desc: A material used in the crafting of new items.

Elixir_CritChance.name: Elixir of Cruelty
Elixir_CritChance.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_CritChance.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_CritDamage.name: Elixir of Savagery
Elixir_CritDamage.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_CritDamage.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_Family_Undead.name: Elixir of Undead-slaying
Elixir_Family_Undead.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_Family_Undead.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_Family_Demons.name: Elixir of Demon-slaying
Elixir_Family_Demons.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_Family_Demons.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_Family_Beasts.name: Elixir of Beast-slaying
Elixir_Family_Beasts.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_Family_Beasts.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_Family_Humans.name: Elixir of Man-slaying
Elixir_Family_Humans.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_Family_Humans.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_MaxLife.name: Elixir of Fortitude
Elixir_MaxLife.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_MaxLife.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Chest_Unique_Sorc_002.name: Raiment of the Infinite
Chest_Unique_Sorc_002.flavor: The power you have is never enough.

CursedScroll_Hatestalker.name: Cursed Scroll of Hatestalker
CursedScroll_Hatestalker.desc:
Reveals nearby hostile players and elite monsters on the minimap for {c_yellow}15{/c} seconds, but slows user's movement speed by {c_yellow}15%.{/c} 

{c_red}Only works in Fields of Hatred.{/c}

mnt_amor01_horse.name: Sturdy Saddle
mnt_amor01_horse.desc: A leather seat to improve comfort for mount and rider.

mnt_amor02_horse.name: Brigandine Barding
mnt_amor02_horse.desc: Fairly lightweight iron-and-leather defensive tack for one's mount.

CraftingMaterial_Ore_Common.name: Iron Chunk
CraftingMaterial_Ore_Common.flavor: A common, dark ore that while heavy results in clean, useful metal and used by artisans throughout Sanctuary.

CraftingMaterial_Ore_Rare.name: Silver Ore
CraftingMaterial_Ore_Rare.desc: Rare metal used for improving weapons and jewelry. Found in veins nearly everywhere.
CraftingMaterial_Ore_Rare.flavor: Silver is prized by artisans for both its beauty and potency against dangerous creatures throughout Sanctuary.

CraftingMaterial_Leather_Common.name: Rawhide
CraftingMaterial_Leather_Common.flavor: Coarse, rugged leather used for garments, tools, and toys for the hounds of Sanctuary.

CraftingMaterial_Leather_Rare.name: Superior Leather
CraftingMaterial_Leather_Rare.desc: Rare leather used for improving armor. Can be obtained from the various wildlife and beasts.
CraftingMaterial_Leather_Rare.flavor: Supple, rugged leather used for fine garments and even finer armor.

CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Rare.name: Veiled Crystal
CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Rare.flavor: Occultists and enchanters commonly use these crystals to reorient or redirect magical energy. The process renders them inert, so many are needed.

CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Legendary_Weapo.name: Baleful Fragment
CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Legendary_Weapo.flavor: Shards from storied items with truly unusual properties.

CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Legendary_Armor.name: Coiling Ward
CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Legendary_Armor.flavor: Fragments from storied armor with truly unusual properties.

CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Legendary_Jewel.name: Abstruse Sigil
CraftingMaterial_Salvage_Legendary_Jewel.flavor: Fragments from storied relics and talismans with truly unusual properties.

MountReins_DarkHorse.name: Reins of the Seal Brown Steed
MountReins_DarkHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Seal Brown Steed to your stable.

MountReins_WhiteHorse.name: Reins of the Grey Steed
MountReins_WhiteHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Grey Steed to your stable.

1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.name: Condemnation
1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.flavor:
"I've never seen such ruthless butchery. He deserves to be shipped off to die in the swamps with the rest of the godless murderers."
- Witness to the murder of Sergeant Walcot

Helm_Unique_Rogue_002.name: Deathmask of Nirmitruq
Helm_Unique_Rogue_002.flavor: Beware, for the serpent's spirit lingers. Those who don the Nirmitruq's visage may find their hearts entwined with the viper's wrath.

CraftingMaterial_Herb_Drysteppes.name: Reddamine
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Drysteppes.desc: A fungus used in the crafting of potions, elixirs & incense. Found in Dry Steppes.
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Drysteppes.flavor: A curiosity among fungi, coveted by alchemists for its stimulating and energizing properties.

1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_002.name: Asheara's Khanjar
1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_002.flavor: When Caldeum's gates closed, Asheara led her Iron Wolves out of the city knowing full well they would never return. Instead they roamed Kehjistan pledging their blades to any who were in need.

Pants_Unique_Rogue_004.name: Eyes in the Dark
Pants_Unique_Rogue_004.flavor:
"And so, when the sun dipped behind the hills each night, he knew that Ashen Jack would soon be near. Watching, and waiting."
- Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 2: "Each Long Night"

MountTrophy_HeadSeaHag_Sorc.name: Drowned Seahag's Head
MountTrophy_HeadSeaHag_Sorc.desc:
Enables Dismount Skill {c_white}Ice Dash (Rank 2){/c}.

{c_white}Ice Dash{/c}: Dashing off the mount at target location, {c_important}{u}Freezing enemies{/u}{/c_important} caught in the way.

Lorebook_Item_Template.name: [PH]Lorebook
Lorebook_Item_Template.flavor: [PH]This is a placeholder Lorebook entry. This conversation should be duplicated and used to populate other lorebooks. Create and attach NPC Speaker. Lorebooks should be 3-4 sentences.

Helm_Unique_Rogue_001.name: Cowl of the Nameless
Helm_Unique_Rogue_001.flavor:
"He is banished from the Guild, his name stricken from the Book. His punishment is to never have been." 
- Excerpt from a burned parchment

Lorebook_Item_OrbeiJournal_01.name: The Birth of Hell
Lorebook_Item_OrbeiJournal_01.desc: Written by the abbot of the Orbei Monastery, in a thin hand.

QA_Barrier_Ring.name: QA Barrier Ring
QA_Barrier_Ring.flavor: Test item used for checking barrier related state transitions

mnt_uniq01_trophy.name: Decaying Shaman's Skull
mnt_uniq01_trophy.desc: This decaying Fallen Shaman's skull is a grisly token of your hard-won victory.

mnt_uniq02_trophy.name: Triune Blood Font
mnt_uniq02_trophy.desc: A desecrated vessel used by the Triune as part of their rituals.

mnt_uniq03_trophy.name: Iron Reliquary
mnt_uniq03_trophy.desc: This small cage contains the skull of someone who ran afoul of the cannibal tribes in the Dry Steppes.

mnt_uniq04_trophy.name: Gruesome Banner
mnt_uniq04_trophy.desc: This banner was earned through bloody conflict against other would-be heroes in the Dry Steppes.

Lorebook_Item_DS1.name: Formal Request
Lorebook_Item_DS1.flavor: A guard petitions her captain to join the fight to save their capital city.

TEST_Cache_Unique.name: Something Super Cool
TEST_Cache_Unique.desc: TBD Cache Reward - Can you find all 50?

CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Wildlife_Bo.name: Lair Key
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Wildlife_Bo.desc: Found by killing beasts and animals, as well as werecreatures.
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Wildlife_Bo.flavor: Within the bones of wild creatures dwells a raw potency used by alchemists to enhance physical properties.

MountReins_SpectralHorse.name: Ghastly Reins
MountReins_SpectralHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Spectral Charger to your stable.

Lorebook_Item_FP1.name: Vani's Journal
Lorebook_Item_FP1.flavor: Our work in the old ruins is done. We have reached into Hell itself and grasped power, just as Mother showed us. We will offer tribute in thanks. Tonight and ever after, we will honor her.

Lorebook_Item_FP2.name: Specimen Notes
Lorebook_Item_FP2.flavor: Short fangs. Young. Freshly turned. An easy kill. Further south than the others. They are spreading.

Elixir_RCR.name: Expertise Elixir
Elixir_RCR.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_RCR.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Human_Tongu.name: Paletongue
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Human_Tongu.desc: Found in the mouths of evil humans.
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Human_Tongu.flavor: The lies spouted by particularly black-hearted humans rarely manifest in turning their tongues a milky white.

CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Demon_Heart.name: Demon's Heart
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Demon_Heart.desc: Found in the bodies of demons.
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Demon_Heart.flavor: Each Demon still carries a withered, beating heart that propels it forward. Rarely they are left in fine enough condition after the Demon is slain to use for other means.

CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Undead_Dust.name: Grave Dust
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Undead_Dust.desc: Found in the bodies, bones, or cerements of the undead.
CraftingMaterial_MonsterDrop_Undead_Dust.flavor: Long exposure to the walking dead imbues this dust with their inverse vitality, used in necromantic alchemies.

DGN_Hawe_IronHold_Key.name: Jailer's Key
DGN_Hawe_IronHold_Key.flavor: This key keeps traitors of the faith and demon worshipers locked away to rot in their cells.

FTR_Cache_Elixir.name: Elixir Cache
FTR_Cache_Elixir.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains an assortment of Elixirs.
FTR_Cache_Elixir.flavor: One of the oldest forms of magic is the brewing of potions. By far the most common of these are healing potions, but more exotic Elixirs exist.

FTR_Cache_Weapon.name: Weapon Cache
FTR_Cache_Weapon.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains an assortment of Weapons.
FTR_Cache_Weapon.flavor: Weapons of all types, from the humble club to the magical staff have been lost throughout the violent history of Sanctuary. Pray they serve you better than their previous owners.

FTR_Cache_Armor.name: Armor Cache
FTR_Cache_Armor.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains an assortment of Armor.
FTR_Cache_Armor.flavor: Even the finest weapon and the most violent attack halt before the mightiest armor.

FTR_Cache_Jewelry.name: Jewelry Cache
FTR_Cache_Jewelry.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains an assortment of Jewelry.
FTR_Cache_Jewelry.flavor: Before gold coins were accepted as the universal currency, the wealthy fashioned gemstones and precious metals into jewelry. Court mages discovered these adornments could be enchanted magically.

FTR_Cache_Materials.name: Material Cache
FTR_Cache_Materials.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains an assortment of Crafting Materials.
FTR_Cache_Materials.flavor: Adventurers that want to survive need to adapt. Creating value out of scraps is key to that.

FTR_Cache_Gold.name: Gold Cache
FTR_Cache_Gold.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains Gold.
FTR_Cache_Gold.flavor: Gold has long served as the monetary means of trade in the world of Sanctuary. It is melted into small gold slugs that are flattened and stamped with the heraldry of the kingdom that created it.

FTR_Cache_Scroll.name: Scroll Cache
FTR_Cache_Scroll.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains an assortment of Scrolls.
FTR_Cache_Scroll.flavor: Over the centuries, many magical scrolls have been created which provide the reader with impossible abilities.

FTR_Cache_Gem.name: Gem Cache
FTR_Cache_Gem.desc: A cache of items found inside Dungeons. Contains an assortment of Gems.
FTR_Cache_Gem.flavor: Precious gems embody innate magical abilities. When set into a socketed item these gems can add powerful magic effects. Higher grades of gems have stronger effects.

DGN_Step_CharnelHouse_Key.name: Feeding Pit Key
DGN_Step_CharnelHouse_Key.flavor: The best meat is kept above while the scraps are sent into the Feeding Pit.

DGN_Scos_CalibelsMine_Key.name: Ancient Miner's Key
DGN_Scos_CalibelsMine_Key.flavor: The tunnels beyond this gate were locked away as a safety precaution.

mnt_amor03_horse.name: Scosglen Tack
mnt_amor03_horse.desc: Conventional tack for a rider from Scosglen.

LE_RewardCache_Large.name: Large Event Reward Cache
LE_RewardCache_Large.flavor: Reward for completing an event and its optional objective

mnt_amor07_horse.name: Steppe Tack
mnt_amor07_horse.desc: A light saddle and assorted tack for riders in arid regions.

mnt_amor04_horse.name: Scosglen Barding
mnt_amor04_horse.desc: Barding suitable for the warrior riding in Scosglen.

mnt_uniq09_trophy.name: Witch's Travel-Totem
mnt_uniq09_trophy.desc: A grim fetish of bone, horn, and charms.

mnt_amor08_horse.name: Steppe Barding
mnt_amor08_horse.desc: A fur-lined saddle and armor of leather and iron plates - good protection for an arid region.

QST_Frac_Vault_Spellbook.name: Death Harnessed: Theories of Rathma
QST_Frac_Vault_Spellbook.flavor: Bound in black leather, necromantic runes run along the spine of the grim tome.

mnt_amor09_horse.name: Kehjistani Tack
mnt_amor09_horse.desc: A higher saddle and light blanket, ideal for a hot, dusty region.

mnt_amor06_horse.name: Pale Barding
mnt_amor06_horse.desc: A heavy blanket and plated barding, ideal for a cavalier campaigning in winter.

mnt_uniq08_trophy.name: Signal Horn
mnt_uniq08_trophy.desc: Sound carries well in the desert, allowing horns like this to be heard from far and away indeed.

mnt_amor11_horse.name: Hawezar Tack
mnt_amor11_horse.desc: A good saddle for marsh riding, and a specialized blanket to help protect your mount from biting flies.

mnt_amor12_horse.name: Hawezar Barding
mnt_amor12_horse.desc: A good saddle for marsh riding, a specialized blanket to help protect your mount from biting flies, and light plate barding for the other things that bite.

Scroll_Of_Amnesia.name: Scroll of Amnesia
Scroll_Of_Amnesia.desc: Refunds all of your allocated Skill Points and Paragon Points.

Lorebook_Item_QaraYisu_01.name: Watchman's Log
Lorebook_Item_QaraYisu_01.desc: Written by a watcher of Qara-Yisu
Lorebook_Item_QaraYisu_01.flavor: The cannibals took twelve more of us this week, but Elder Davan has finally gone to the mines. He will free the Ancient Spirit and we will claim its power. No one will threaten Qara Yisu again.

BountyMeta_Cache_ArmorAndWeapons.name: Cache of Victory
BountyMeta_Cache_ArmorAndWeapons.desc: A cache of items as a reward for your efforts. Contains an assortment of Armor and Weapons.

BountyMeta_Cache_Avarice.name: Cache of Avarice
BountyMeta_Cache_Avarice.desc: A cache of items as a reward for your efforts. Contains an assortment of Gold and Materials.

BountyMeta_Cache_Ornaments.name: Cache of Ornaments
BountyMeta_Cache_Ornaments.desc: A cache of items as a reward for your efforts. Contains an assortment of Jewelry and Gems.

BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos.name: Collection of Chaos
BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos.desc: A collection of items as a reward for your efforts. Contains a random assortment and amount of items from all the other available collections.
BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos.flavor: The Tree leaves no debt unsettled. Some of the items inside smell faintly of decay, but the whispers assure you their value is undiminished.

Scroll_Of_Escape.name: Scroll of Escape
Scroll_Of_Escape.desc: Teleports you to a place of safety.

PvP_OpenWorld_Ear.name: {c_red}Ear{/c}
PvP_OpenWorld_Ear.desc: Ear of an unfortunate adventurer crossed your path.

Helm_Unique_Generic_002.name: Harlequin Crest
Helm_Unique_Generic_002.flavor:
"This headdress was once worn by an assassin disguised as a court mage. Her treachery was unveiled, but not before she used its magic to curse the king's entire lineage."
- The Fall of House Aston

BountyReward_SocketableCache_T1.name: [ph] Small Pouch of Socketables
BountyReward_SocketableCache_T1.desc: Contains an assortment of Runes and Gems.

BountyReward_SocketableCache_T2.name: [ph] Large Pouch of Socketables
BountyReward_SocketableCache_T2.desc: Contains an assortment of Runes and Gems.

mnt_amor10_horse.name: Kehjistani Barding
mnt_amor10_horse.desc: A higher saddle and scalloped barding with scaled veil, ideal for a dusty, arid region.

mnt_amor05_horse.name: Pale Tack
mnt_amor05_horse.desc: A heavy blanket and structured saddle, ideal for the Fractured Peaks' colder regions.

PvP_OpenWorld_Ear_Temp.name: {c_red}Smashfist’s Ear{/c}
PvP_OpenWorld_Ear_Temp.desc: Ear of an unfortunate adventurer crossed your path.

mnt_amor19_horse.name: Traveling Merchant's Tack
mnt_amor19_horse.desc: Suitable enough for very long voyages, and cheap enough to replace.

mnt_uniq05_trophy.name: Beast's Skull Trophy
mnt_uniq05_trophy.desc: The bleached remains of a beast's skull capped with iron.

mnt_uniq07_trophy.name: Steppe Fetish Mask
mnt_uniq07_trophy.desc: Not suitable for wearing, but excellent for display. Believed to be a ward against ill spirits and ill omens alike.

Lorebook_Item_KeironsPyre.name: Eriman's Plea
Lorebook_Item_KeironsPyre.desc: A few scraps of parchment, charred around the edges

MountReins_ExecutionerHorse.name: Reins of the Executioner's Steed
MountReins_ExecutionerHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Executioner's Steed to your stable.

QST_Template_DeliverItem.name: Horadric Amulet
QST_Template_DeliverItem.flavor: The ancient symbol of the Horadrim, made of hammered copper

QST_Template_Item_Unique.name: Icy Rib
QST_Template_Item_Unique.flavor: The chill of death still lingers.

QST_Template_BranchingChoice.name: Worn Ring
QST_Template_BranchingChoice.flavor: A scuffed and tarnished bronze loop

QST_Template_BranchingChoice_Reward.name: Bede's Worn Ring
QST_Template_BranchingChoice_Reward.flavor: A scuffed and tarnished bronze loop

MountReins_TrapperHorse.name: Reins of the Trapper's Steed
MountReins_TrapperHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Trapper's Steed to your stable.

MountReins_OldNellHorse.name: Reins of the Old Nell Steed
MountReins_OldNellHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Old Nell Steed to your stable.

MountReins_MottledHorse.name: Reins of the Mottled Steed
MountReins_MottledHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Mottled Steed to your stable.

MountReins_CaldeumHorse.name: Reins of the Caldeum Steed
MountReins_CaldeumHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Caldeum Steed to your stable.

MountReins_BloodyHorse.name: Reins of the Bloody Steed
MountReins_BloodyHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Bloody Steed to your stable.

MountReins_GraveRobberHorse.name: Reins of the Brigand's Steed
MountReins_GraveRobberHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Brigand's Steed to your stable.

QST_Template_Item_Unique_Chest.name: Rusty Heirloom Dagger
QST_Template_Item_Unique_Chest.flavor: Mottled with corrosion, this blade holds only sentimental value.

MountReins_CavalierKnightHorse.name: Reins of the Cavalier's Steed
MountReins_CavalierKnightHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Cavalier's Steed to your stable.

Gem_Diamond_03.name: Chipped Diamond
Gem_Diamond_03.flavor: Its presence ushers a sense of harmony.

Gem_Diamond_04.name: Diamond
Gem_Diamond_04.flavor: Everything seems more clear within its light.

Gem_Diamond_05.name: Flawless Diamond
Gem_Diamond_05.flavor: Courage washes over you in its presence.

Gem_Skull_03.name: Chipped Skull
Gem_Skull_03.flavor: Fragments of a fallen child. You monster.

Gem_Skull_04.name: Skull
Gem_Skull_04.flavor: Fractured and shamed, and yet, useful still.

Gem_Skull_05.name: Flawless Skull
Gem_Skull_05.flavor: It stares back with an insidious indifference.

CraftingMaterial_Herb_Scosglen.name: Howler Moss
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Scosglen.desc: An herb used in the crafting of potions, elixirs & incense. Found in Scosglen.
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Scosglen.flavor: A hoary moss with a pungent, musky aroma, prized by alchemists for its vital and physical qualities.

CraftingMaterial_Herb_FracturedPeaks.name: Biteberry
CraftingMaterial_Herb_FracturedPeaks.desc: An herb used in the crafting of potions, elixirs & incense. Found in Fractured Peaks.
CraftingMaterial_Herb_FracturedPeaks.flavor: A hard, bitter berry prized by alchemists for its use as both an enduring raisin and its vital and defensive qualities.

CraftingMaterial_Herb_Hawezar.name: Blightshade
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Hawezar.desc: An herb used in the crafting of potions, elixirs & incense. Found in Hawezar.
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Hawezar.flavor: A toxic swamp lily, prized by alchemists for its foul and aggressive qualities.

CraftingMaterial_Herb_Kehjistan.name: Lifesbane
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Kehjistan.desc: An herb used in the crafting of potions, elixirs & incense. Found in Kehjistan.
CraftingMaterial_Herb_Kehjistan.flavor: A native Kehjistani berry with an eerie face, prized by alchemists for its potent toxins and soporific effects.

mnt_uniq06_trophy.name: Dark Banner
mnt_uniq06_trophy.desc: A banner tainted by blood, revering a fell order.

TEST_QST_Rmaille_Grid_CannibalCampNote.name: Dun furget
TEST_QST_Rmaille_Grid_CannibalCampNote.desc: A poorly written note carved into what looks like human skin
TEST_QST_Rmaille_Grid_CannibalCampNote.flavor: "Muvd camp to ded end canyun nere carvan stop"

TEST_QST_Rmaille_Grid_CannibalChestNote.name: Note From Grognok
TEST_QST_Rmaille_Grid_CannibalChestNote.desc: A poorly written note carved into what looks like human skin
TEST_QST_Rmaille_Grid_CannibalChestNote.flavor: "Gon ta bury tresur ner old towr"

TEST_QST_Mnolin_Item.name: Iron Wedding Ring
TEST_QST_Mnolin_Item.desc: A simple iron ring set with three small opals. The inscription reads "In sickness and in health".

QA_DoT_Ring.name: QA DoT Ring
QA_DoT_Ring.flavor: Test item used for checking DoT on the player

TEST_QST_Item_Tome.name: Mordreth's Grimoire
TEST_QST_Item_Tome.desc: A book of spells, hexes and potions

QST_Step_PoundofFlesh_GibbetKey.name: Gibbet Key
QST_Step_PoundofFlesh_GibbetKey.flavor: An old brass key, worn from years of use.

DruidPassive_ReputationItem.name: Druidic Spirit Offering
DruidPassive_ReputationItem.desc: Bring Spirit Offerings to the four Druid Spirits in Túr Dúlra to garner favor and receive powerful Boons in return.

QST_Frac_DeadPilgrim_Journal.name: Pilgrim's Journal
QST_Frac_DeadPilgrim_Journal.flavor: Looking forward to my studies at the Cathedral. I hope I'll find peace there. Perhaps Priest Malone back in Margrave will see me as an equal now? Doubtful, but I should at least earn his respect...

QST_Scos_TendingNature_Herb.name: Bitterleaf Root
QST_Scos_TendingNature_Herb.flavor: The gangly root of a bitterleaf plant often used in remedies.

QST_Scos_TendingNature_Bark.name: Woodwraith Bark
QST_Scos_TendingNature_Bark.flavor: Moss-covered bark from a mature woodwraith.

QST_Frac_PaleKnightsKin_Journal_01.name: Archivist's Journal I
QST_Frac_PaleKnightsKin_Journal_01.flavor: A journal entry detailing the Light's Watch archivist's impressions of Knight Soliana Coste. This confirms that Zalan's mother was indeed stationed here.

QST_Frac_PaleKnightsKin_Journal_02.name: Archivist's Journal II
QST_Frac_PaleKnightsKin_Journal_02.flavor: A journal entry detailing the Light's Watch archivist's concerns with an impending mission. It seems the faithful had no illusions about their fate.

QST_Frac_PaleKnightsKin_Journal_03.name: Archivist's Journal III
QST_Frac_PaleKnightsKin_Journal_03.flavor: A journal entry detailing the Light's Watch archivist's futile attempt at convincing Soliana to flee the Knights Penitent to be with her son. Soliana's conviction was strong. Her mind was made.

QST_Scos_BrinyFate_BenenLetter.name: Rolled Letter
QST_Scos_BrinyFate_BenenLetter.flavor: A letter written to Fergus from Benen, telling him that he departed for distant shores to leave him behind. Benen speaks of the reality of their poor relationship.

Elixir_HitEffect.name: Elixir of Combatant Fortune
Elixir_HitEffect.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_HitEffect.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_MaxResource.name: Elixir of Resourcefulness
Elixir_MaxResource.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_MaxResource.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_MagicResist.name: Elixir of Magic Resist
Elixir_MagicResist.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_MagicResist.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

Elixir_Armor.name: Iron Skin Elixir
Elixir_Armor.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
Elixir_Armor.flavor: You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

QST_Hawe_Marsh_TempleLeftEye.name: Serpent's Left Eye
QST_Hawe_Marsh_TempleLeftEye.flavor: A palm-sized red gemstone removed from the engraved stone door in Yngovani. It glows with a fiery light.

QST_Hawe_Marsh_TempleRightEye.name: Serpent's Right Eye
QST_Hawe_Marsh_TempleRightEye.flavor: A palm-sized yellow gemstone removed from the engraved stone door in Yngovani. It glows with a sickly light.

NightmareDungeon_Cache_Normal.name: (PH)Purified Sigil
NightmareDungeon_Cache_Normal.desc: (PH)The Nightmare has been purged. Activate this Sigil to reveal a host of valuable items.

QST_Scos_TendingNature_Essense.name: Spectral essence
QST_Scos_TendingNature_Essense.flavor: The distilled matter of a ghost, now twice dead.

QST_Step_DemonLedger_DebtBook.name: Scorched Debt Ledger
QST_Step_DemonLedger_DebtBook.flavor: A leather-bound ledger that is singed on the edges. Each page is filled with debts, however most of the names are scorched and illegible. The most recent name reads: Andreea of Lakren's Overlook

QST_Scos_TheDiviner_RuneStone.name: Túr Dúlra Runestone
QST_Scos_TheDiviner_RuneStone.flavor: A powerful druidic focus, able to draw out the natural magic of Scosglen and channel it where it is needed. This may be the only one that survived the Days of Ash.

CraftingMaterial_Herb_SuperRare.name: Fiend Rose
CraftingMaterial_Herb_SuperRare.desc: A rare herb used in the crafting of elixirs. Can be found in Nightmare Dungeons and The Pit.
CraftingMaterial_Herb_SuperRare.flavor: Only mostly toxic in spite of its beauty, but still regarded a peerless catalyst by alchemists.

QST_Step_DemonLedger_DebtBook_A.name: Scorched Debt Ledger
QST_Step_DemonLedger_DebtBook_A.flavor: A leather-bound ledger that is singed on the edges. Each page is filled with debts, however most of the names are scorched and illegible. The next readable entry reads: Lyruk of Ked Bardu

QST_Scos_TendingNature_Medicine.name: Bear Medicine
QST_Scos_TendingNature_Medicine.flavor: A mixture of rare ingredients combined into a potion.

QST_Hawe_Marsh_Incense.name: Mystic Incense
QST_Hawe_Marsh_Incense.flavor: A bundle of dried incense. The strong, earthy scent clings to the back of your throat and makes your head swim.

Incense_I_00.name: Storm of the Wilds
Incense_I_00.desc:
For the next {c_number}30{/c} minutes:
{icon:bullet} Increases Lightning, Cold and Poison Resistances by {c_yellow}+7%{/c} for all nearby players.
{icon:bullet} Increases Experience by {c_yellow}5%{/c} ({c_number}0.5%{/c} at level 70).
Incense_I_00.flavor: This is a Resistance Incense. Only one Resistance Incense may be active at a time. Experience Bonus does not stack with other Incenses.

QA_XP_Ring.name: QA XP Ring
QA_XP_Ring.flavor: Testing Item used for EXP gains

QST_Scos_SignoftheTimes_ListofLastDeeds.name: Tavish's List of Last Deeds
QST_Scos_SignoftheTimes_ListofLastDeeds.flavor:
- Nick the sign from Under the Fat Goose
- Stare down the gateway statue of Maddux Watch
- Climb the old crane atop the waterfall in Old Heimberg
- Claim and cozy up in a Highland bear’s den

QST_Scos_SignoftheTimes_TavishDaggers.name: Bloodstained Mementos
QST_Scos_SignoftheTimes_TavishDaggers.flavor: Nairne used to play tavern games of courage with Tavish with these daggers. A piece of bloodstained cloth from Tavish's remains is tied around each of the hilts. A last memento to a departed friend.

QST_Scos_SignoftheTimes_GooseSign.name: Under the Fat Goose Inn Sign
QST_Scos_SignoftheTimes_GooseSign.flavor: A welcome sight to weary souls venturing through Scosglen, Under the Fat Goose Inn provides warmth when all else is extinguished.

Incense_I_01.desc: This incense has no power left but has a high sell value.

Lorebook_Item_OrbeiNote2.name: The Orbei Monastery, Part 1
Lorebook_Item_OrbeiNote2.desc: Written by the Abbot of Orbei Monastery, in a steady, practiced hand.

Lorebook_Item_ZakFortKeep_Paladin_Lord.name: Old book
Lorebook_Item_ZakFortKeep_Paladin_Lord.desc: A small moldy tome with a ribbon marking the final journal entry.
Lorebook_Item_ZakFortKeep_Paladin_Lord.flavor: I will become maggot food if I don't-

CraftingMaterial_Rare_ScatteredPrism.name: Scattered Prism
CraftingMaterial_Rare_ScatteredPrism.flavor: Rare and hoarded by their previous owners, these prisms are often guarded jealously.

Lorebook_Item_ZakFortKeep_Paladin_Orders.name: Paladin Squire's Journal, Part Two
Lorebook_Item_ZakFortKeep_Paladin_Orders.flavor: A squire of Paladin Marshal Carthas recounts their tribulations in Hawezar.

Lorebook_Item_OrbeiNote3.name: The Orbei Monastery, Part 2
Lorebook_Item_OrbeiNote3.desc: Written by the Abbot of Orbei Monastery, in a steady, practiced hand.

CursedScroll_Tranquility.name: Cursed Scroll of Tranquility
CursedScroll_Tranquility.desc:
Decreases damage taken from players by {c_yellow}30%{/c}, but increases damage taken from monsters by the same amount. Lasts for {c_yellow}20{/c} seconds.

{c_red}Only works in Fields of Hatred.{/c}

CursedScroll_Chaos.name: Cursed Scroll of Chaos
CursedScroll_Chaos.desc:
Teleport to a random location in the region.

{c_red}Only works in Fields of Hatred.{/c}

CursedScroll_Recklessness.name: Cursed Scroll of Recklessness
CursedScroll_Recklessness.desc:
Increases movement speed by {c_yellow}40%{/c} for {c_yellow}15{/c} seconds, but deals {c_yellow}2%{/c} of your Maximum Life as bleed damage per second.

{c_red}Only works in Fields of Hatred.{/c}
