QST_Step_Coast_Motes_Undead_DeathMote.desc: Collect spirit energy to empower necromantic magic.

QST_Step_Coast_DropGift_PriestErol01.name: Old Zakarum Prayerbook
QST_Step_Coast_DropGift_PriestErol01.desc: A battered book that has seen better days.
QST_Step_Coast_DropGift_PriestErol01.flavor: A well worn book of Zakarum prayers and hymns. Show this to a priest.

QST_Step_CentralCanyon_RareHarvest_Ore.name: Strange Ore Sample
QST_Step_CentralCanyon_RareHarvest_Ore.flavor: A small, unusual piece of ore found while mining in the Dry Steppes.

QST_Step_Grassland_RareHarvest_Herb.name: Dust Daisy
QST_Step_Grassland_RareHarvest_Herb.flavor: A bright yellow flower found while harvesting herbs in the Dry Steppes.

QST_Kehj_LowDesert_Motes_Goatmen_CacheIn.name: Sealed Khazra Offering
QST_Kehj_LowDesert_Motes_Goatmen_CacheIn.flavor: Sealed by khazra magic. It hungers for sacrificial essence.

QST_Kehj_LowDesert_Motes_Goatmen_CacheLo.name: Glowing Khazra Offering
QST_Kehj_LowDesert_Motes_Goatmen_CacheLo.flavor: The secret compartment in this offering can be opened.

QST_Kehj_LowDesert_Motes_Goatmen_DeathMo.name: Death Mote
QST_Kehj_LowDesert_Motes_Goatmen_DeathMo.desc: Collect Death Motes to empower necromantic magic.

QA_Attack_Speed_Debug.name: QA Attack Speed Debug Ring
QA_Attack_Speed_Debug.flavor: Test item used for debugging power attack speed.

QST_Kehj_Ridge_Motes_Cultists_CacheInert.name: Ravenous Necrolyte's Cache
QST_Kehj_Ridge_Motes_Cultists_CacheInert.flavor: Sealed by necromancy. Its lock hungers for the essence of death.

QST_Kehj_Ridge_Motes_Cultists_CacheLoot.name: Sated Necrolyte's Cache
QST_Kehj_Ridge_Motes_Cultists_CacheLoot.flavor: Its thirst for death slaked, the magic seal appears to have faded.

QST_Kehj_Ridge_Motes_Cultists_DeathMote.name: Death Mote
QST_Kehj_Ridge_Motes_Cultists_DeathMote.desc: Collect Death Motes to empower necromantic magic.

QST_Kehj_LowDesert_DropGift_Innkeeper01.name: Battered Shipment
QST_Kehj_LowDesert_DropGift_Innkeeper01.flavor: A lost shipment originally destined for Aih'Setal, the Gea Kul innkeeper.

QST_Kehj_Oasis_DropGift_Innkeeper02.name: Waterstained Letter
QST_Kehj_Oasis_DropGift_Innkeeper02.flavor: A letter that has been handled carelessly, stained with salt and smeared ink. It is addressed to Aih'Setal of Gea Kul.

QST_Kehj_Oasis_FetchMinor_02_Seaweed.name: Digested Gutweed
QST_Kehj_Oasis_FetchMinor_02_Seaweed.flavor: This alga flourishes in the warm waters of Kehjistan. This particular gutweed has been rotting inside Drowned intestines. The smell is nauseating.

QST_Kehj_Oasis_RareHarvest_Ore.name: Unusual Ore
QST_Kehj_Oasis_RareHarvest_Ore.flavor: An unexpected type of ore found while mining in Kehjistan.

QST_Kehj_LowDesert_RareHarvest_Herb.name: Spotted Mushroom
QST_Kehj_LowDesert_RareHarvest_Herb.flavor: An unusual mushroom picked while harvesting herbs in Kehjistan.

QST_Kehj_Caldeum_DropGift_Barez01.name: Iron Wolf Sword
QST_Kehj_Caldeum_DropGift_Barez01.flavor: A well-maintained sword taken as a trophy by a Triune cultist. Barez will want to see it.

QST_Kehj_Caldeum_DropGift_Barez02.name: Iron Wolf Armor
QST_Kehj_Caldeum_DropGift_Barez02.flavor: It is tradition among the Iron Wolves to reclaim the armor of their fallen so it may continue to serve. Barez will want to see this.

QST_Kehj_GeaKul_FetchMinor_06_Trinkets.name: Khazra Glands
QST_Kehj_GeaKul_FetchMinor_06_Trinkets.flavor: These scent glands were harvested from the Khazra’s abdomen. In this fresh state, they ooze a liquid that is noticeably pungent and musky.

QST_Kehj_GeaKul_FetchMinor_07_Journal.name: Old Journal
QST_Kehj_GeaKul_FetchMinor_07_Journal.flavor: A treasure goblin dropped this worn journal. Much of the scribbles are illegible, but there are some notes tracking the goblin's movements. A name is written on the inside cover: Ostaf.

QST_Hawe_Arc_Reward.name: Staff of Whispers
QST_Hawe_Arc_Reward.flavor: Upon pledging their life to serving the Tree of Whispers, witches of the swamp are gifted a root or branch to signify their accord.

QST_Step_NameofLove_Cleaver.name: Cleaver of Undying Love
QST_Step_NameofLove_Cleaver.flavor: A cleaver once used by the butcher, Khaliun, recovered by the mages of Whispering Vault, following her death. It remains disturbingly sharp, despite years of disuse.

QST_Step_QaraYisu_FetchMinor_04_Bones.name: Khazra Bones
QST_Step_QaraYisu_FetchMinor_04_Bones.flavor: Artisans carve these bones into intricate beads for jewelry, clothing, hair, and décor. Khazra bones are thought to ward off curses and evil spirits. Whether true or not, it eases anxious souls.

QST_Hawe_Vyeresz_FetchMinor_02_Trinkets.name: Zakarum Prayer Amulet
QST_Hawe_Vyeresz_FetchMinor_02_Trinkets.flavor: The charms lining the amulet represent the prophet Akarat’s virtues. Each Crusader is granted one upon initiation into the order.

QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_01_Corpse.name: Samil's Corpse
QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_01_Corpse.flavor: This graverobber’s corpse lacks warmth and has not yet been infected by flies. Despite the body’s stiffening, it manages to fit in your bag.

Amulet_Unique_Generic_100.name: Melted Heart of Selig
Amulet_Unique_Generic_100.flavor:
"Do not allow your passions to become obsessions. Fuel the fire that burns within you, but it is madness to allow yourself to become ash to please an uncaring universe."
- Last words of Master Selig

QST_Hawe_S05_AldaraJournal.name: Aldara's Journal
QST_Hawe_S05_AldaraJournal.flavor: Aldara's journal is mostly a tally of names and payments.

QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_02_Flesh.name: Uncorrupted Flesh
QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_02_Flesh.flavor: This sample of flesh was collected from one of Zurke’s experiments. It displays normal symptoms of decay.

QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_03_Fungus.name: Blood Fungus
QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_03_Fungus.flavor: This parasitic fungus is native to the Hawezar marshland and requires blood supply to sustain itself. While the fungus cap is safe to handle, inhaled spores root themselves into the lungs.

QST_ITM_Step_AuguryofBones_BoneDust.name: Bone Dust
QST_ITM_Step_AuguryofBones_BoneDust.flavor: Powdered remains from the ancient dead of the Valley of the Strayed.

QST_Kehj_Penitent_02_Item.name: Inquisitor's Insignia
QST_Kehj_Penitent_02_Item.flavor: A small, ornate trinket used by the Knights Penitent to identify informants and other civilian allies.

QST_ITM_Step_HubrisSmilesBack_JawOfferin.name: Baneful Oblation
QST_ITM_Step_HubrisSmilesBack_JawOfferin.flavor: An ornamented jawbone offering. The sound of distant laughter seems to emanate from the bone itself.

QST_Prologue_Act_Boots.name: Intrepid Reckoning
QST_Prologue_Act_Boots.flavor: Wearer be blessed. Keep steady feet and a true heart.

QST_Step_Act_Pants.name: Breeches of the Primus
QST_Step_Act_Pants.flavor: Resplendent regalia tainted with the power of the corrupt which permeates the very fibers of its fabric and thread. These serve as an integral part of the ceremonial dress of the Primus.

QST_Convergence_Act_Amulet.name: The Nexus Star
QST_Convergence_Act_Amulet.flavor: The Star beguiles. The threads of fate converge, but its story is not done.

QST_Hawe_Act_Helm.name: Crown of Whispers
QST_Hawe_Act_Helm.flavor: Worn by a king, a usurper, a thief? A macabre trophy. A gift from the tree.

QST_Hell_Act_Chest.name: Cuirass of the Prime Evils
QST_Hell_Act_Chest.flavor: Terror begets Hate and Hate begets Destruction, Destruction begets Terror..

Amulet_Magic_QST_Scos_Coast_ThreadsofEnv.name: Roina's Heirloom Amulet
Amulet_Magic_QST_Scos_Coast_ThreadsofEnv.flavor: A druid charm made by Roina's mother to keep her strong during any hardship

CMP_Step_OnyxWatchtower_Key.name: Storeroom Key
CMP_Step_OnyxWatchtower_Key.flavor: A rusted old key. Must open something nearby.

QST_Class_Sorc_Item_Paper.name: Codex Page
QST_Class_Sorc_Item_Paper.flavor: A random page of the Forgotten Codex, scribbled with cramped lines of obscure runes.

QST_Scos_Blycroft_WardstoneCollection_it.name: Druid Wardstones
QST_Scos_Blycroft_WardstoneCollection_it.flavor: Several stones carved with druid runes that hum with quiet power.

Chest_Unique_Barb_100.name: Rage of Harrogath
Chest_Unique_Barb_100.flavor: Harrogath, the final bastion of resistance against Baal's assault on Mt. Arreat was destroyed along with the Worldstone. The survivors never forgave the betrayal that led to the loss of their home.

1HSword_Unique_Barb_101.name: Ramaladni's Magnum Opus
1HSword_Unique_Barb_101.flavor:
"Without him the wine is less sweet, the hearth less warm, and our blades less keen. Our blood brother is gone, but Bul-Kathos willing, we will meet again one day."
- Sorrowsong for Ramaladni

Amulet_Unique_Barb_100.name: Battle Trance
Amulet_Unique_Barb_100.flavor:
"The change that overtook my brother in battle was terrifying. His eyes turned hard like diamonds, and the way he moved... it was like he was dancing to music only he could hear."
- Captain Dervin

Helm_Unique_Druid_100.name: Tempest Roar
Helm_Unique_Druid_100.flavor:
"Listen, child, to the music of the storm. It has its own rhythm. Its own melody. Hear how beautifully it sings, and perhaps one day you will be able to join in its harmony."
– Airidah

Helm_Unique_Druid_101.name: Vasily's Prayer
Helm_Unique_Druid_101.flavor:
"Roots from the Great Oak growing at the seaward statue of Vasily will, on rare occasions, be found twisted back upon themselves, suffused with ferocious magic."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

1HAxe_Unique_Druid_100.name: Waxing Gibbous
1HAxe_Unique_Druid_100.flavor: The nights preceding the full moon are sometimes far more dangerous than the event itself. The frenzy has begun to rise, yet the night is just dark enough to obscure a hunter from their prey's sight.

Chest_Unique_Necro_101.name: Blood Artisan's Cuirass
Chest_Unique_Necro_101.flavor: "The infamous Necromancer Gaza-Thul's mastery over blood magic was indisputable. Many suspect that upon his death, his skin was used to fashion this eldritch armor." -Barrett's Book of Implements

1HScythe_Unique_Necro_100.name: Black River
1HScythe_Unique_Necro_100.flavor: "The scrolls describe a river of tar that separated the living from the land of the dead. Any unfortunate soul who tried to cross would be dragged down into oblivion." -Notes of Scholar Kamien

Gloves_Unique_Rogue_100.name: Grasp of Shadow
Gloves_Unique_Rogue_100.flavor: Dark wisps creep hungrily across these gloves, like an assassin's blade seeking a life to steal on a moonless night.

Amulet_Unique_Rogue_100.name: Word of Hakan
Amulet_Unique_Rogue_100.flavor:
"Let the great gates of Caldeum be sealed. Let its proud walls stand fiercely defended. The rest of Kehjistan may suffer this plague, but my city, and my people, will not."
- Proclamation of Hakan II

Pants_Unique_Sorc_100.name: Iceheart Brais
Pants_Unique_Sorc_100.flavor: The mad artisan saw his fingers turn black from frostbite as he worked the cloth, but refused to stay the needle and thread for even a moment.

Boots_Unique_Sorc_100.name: Esu's Heirloom
Boots_Unique_Sorc_100.flavor:
"While scholars have proven these boots were not created by Esu herself, it is noteworthy that they have been passed down since the formation of the Mage Clans."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

2HStaff_Unique_Sorc_100.name: Staff of Lam Esen
2HStaff_Unique_Sorc_100.flavor:
"Also known as the Greatstaff of the Old Religion, this powerful relic is one of only a small handful of Skatsimi artifacts that have survived to this day."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

Pants_Unique_Generic_100.name: Temerity
Pants_Unique_Generic_100.flavor:
"The revelation that master tailor Callas was in fact a witch only served to further fuel the desire for her uniquely enchanted legwraps."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

Ring_Unique_Generic_101.name: Ring of Starless Skies
Ring_Unique_Generic_101.flavor:
"Yours is the power to pluck the stars from the heavens with the ease of a child gathering fruit from the bough."
- Unknown

QST_Gcarlson_Liber_Sanguinis.name: Liber Sanguinis
QST_Gcarlson_Liber_Sanguinis.desc: A strange surgeon's handbook filled with occult rituals
QST_Gcarlson_Liber_Sanguinis.flavor: This bizarre text appears to be the mad ravings of some long dead surgeon. They describe a ritual intended to rebalance a piece of land's humors by drawing fourth blood from the earth and sky.

Amulet_Legendary_QST_Act1_Reward.name: Vigo's Protecting Amulet
Amulet_Legendary_QST_Act1_Reward.flavor:
"Through penance alone do we let the Father's light enter our sinful souls. Lay down your life for his purpose, and you shall shine brilliantly with his glory."
- Holy Words of the Father, Book VIII

QST_Kehj_Oasis_GeaKulRefugees_Supplies.name: Lost Supplies
QST_Kehj_Oasis_GeaKulRefugees_Supplies.flavor: A quaint burlap sack filled with dense, coarse bread, dried meats, and ragged clothing.

QST_Step_FateRetreat_FetchMinor_07_Ring_.name: Activated Ring
QST_Step_FateRetreat_FetchMinor_07_Ring_.flavor: This unknown ring’s enchantment has been reactivated. Energy radiates from the gem and gives off faint heat.

ChestArmor_QST_Kehj_TriuneRitualMain_Rew.name: Hellfire Hauberk
ChestArmor_QST_Kehj_TriuneRitualMain_Rew.flavor: A stygian suit of armor bearing the smoldering name of a "faithful" soul on every scale and plate. While worn, a chorus of barely audible screams can always be heard.

Chest_QST_Hawe_Wetlands_FailedCrusader_0.name: Johanna's Namesake
Chest_QST_Hawe_Wetlands_FailedCrusader_0.flavor: A set of fine crusader’s armor ravaged by time. The outside bears numerous small, weathered parchment scrolls scribed with mighty and holy deeds performed by the armor’s previous keepers.

1HDagger_QST_Hawe_Bog_Kres_03_Reward.name: Vestigial Viscera
1HDagger_QST_Hawe_Bog_Kres_03_Reward.flavor: The swamp wins. The swamps always wins...

Ring_QST_Kehj_LowDesert_LadyoftheOasis_0.name: Seal of the Vizjerei
Ring_QST_Kehj_LowDesert_LadyoftheOasis_0.flavor: A mage’s ring for binding spirits. Etched along the outside are the true names of angels, demons and other mysterious entities, compelled to bestow power upon the ring’s wielder.

2HCrossbow_QST_Hawe_Coast_DropGift_Lyndo.name: Rea
2HCrossbow_QST_Hawe_Coast_DropGift_Lyndo.flavor: The swamp has crept into every crevice of this intricate crossbow. "Rea" is carved onto the handle.

Helm_QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_03_Reward.name: Helm of Embalming
Helm_QST_Hawe_Delta_Zurke_03_Reward.flavor: A battered helmet marked with a glyph of the Tree of Whispers. The inside of this helmet reeks of embalming fluid as if it is meant to preserve the head of one who dies within it.

Dagger_QST_Hawe_Coast_Lyndon_03_Reward.name: Skeleton Key
Dagger_QST_Hawe_Coast_Lyndon_03_Reward.flavor: With enough finesse, a simple dagger will open virtually any lock.

Polearm_QST_Kehj_Penitent_04_Reward.name: Edgar's Penance
Polearm_QST_Kehj_Penitent_04_Reward.flavor: Once a weapon of zealous fury, then one of righteous vengeance. Its former owner may walk the path of true redemption, but this polearm is stained with blood that will never wash off.

Ring_QST_Step_FateRetreat_FetchMinor_07_.name: Demoniac’s Boon
Ring_QST_Step_FateRetreat_FetchMinor_07_.flavor: A foul yet ornate ring originally crafted to channel stygian magics. On closer inspection, it appears someone has recently inscribed the inside of the band with sigils of the Angiris Council.

World_SecretCellar_Relic_1.name: Bloody Wooden Shard
World_SecretCellar_Relic_1.desc: A worn, bloodstained chunk of wood with tattered leather straps. The letter "W" has been crudely carved on one side.
World_SecretCellar_Relic_1.flavor: Though its purpose is lost to time, this was once an object of great significance.

Rarespawn_Reward_1HDagger_Scorpion_cappe.name: Broodmother's Stinger
Rarespawn_Reward_1HDagger_Scorpion_cappe.flavor:
"The scorpion Nine-Eyes is known as "The Terror of the Sands" for good reason. Her tail can pierce the strongest armor, and her poison melts flesh in seconds."
- Field Notes of an Unknown Iron Wolf

Rarespawn_Reward_1HFocus_Succubus_capped.name: Qin's Captivating Eye
Rarespawn_Reward_1HFocus_Succubus_capped.flavor: Even removed from the demon's body, the eye continues to weave its hypnotic patterns.

Rarespawn_Reward_1HMace_BanditMelee_capp.name: Mace of Blazing Furor
Rarespawn_Reward_1HMace_BanditMelee_capp.flavor: The handle of this white-hot mace bears soot marks in the shape of a clenched fist.

Rarespawn_Reward_1HSword_KnightMelee_cap.name: Darkblade
Rarespawn_Reward_1HSword_KnightMelee_cap.flavor:
"While the origins of this accursed blade are lost to time, there is no question that wielding its dark power leaves an indelible stain on one's soul." 
- Barrett's Book of Implements

World_SecretCellar_Relic_2.name: Musty Tome
World_SecretCellar_Relic_2.desc: The tattered leather binding of an old tome. The deep blue dye has faded with age, and all of the pages have been torn out.
World_SecretCellar_Relic_2.flavor: Though its purpose is lost to time, this was once an object of great significance.

World_SecretCellar_Relic_3.name: Intricate Metallic Fragment
World_SecretCellar_Relic_3.desc: A metallic fragment of unknown origin, still humming with magical energies. It appears to be part of some ancient device.
World_SecretCellar_Relic_3.flavor: Though its purpose is lost to time, this was once an object of great significance.

QST_Scos_TheAnthropomancer_Item_Entrails.name: Goatman Entrails
QST_Scos_TheAnthropomancer_Item_Entrails.flavor: Plump, stinking goatman innards. What might the old seer divine from these?

Rarespawn_Reward_1HWand_Ghost_capped.name: Wand of Abe-Mari
Rarespawn_Reward_1HWand_Ghost_capped.flavor:
"So skilled was Abe-Mari at divination, they predicted the date of their own death; a skill that proved so ruinous that no mage since has attempted the feat."
- Excerpt from Secrets of the Mage-Clans

Rarespawn_Reward_2HSword_MegaDemon_cappe.name: Infernal Edge
Rarespawn_Reward_2HSword_MegaDemon_cappe.flavor: This massive sword's edge grows keener and its promises of power grow louder with each life taken.

Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_DrownedSpecial_c.name: Blind Man's Bell
Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_DrownedSpecial_c.flavor:
"Even after he was put to death, some children swore they could still hear his bell ringing softly in the breeze on moonless nights."
- Greenslade's Tales, Chapter 5: "The Myth of Blind Odwyn"

Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_GoatmanMelee_cap.name: Necklace of Inevitability
Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_GoatmanMelee_cap.flavor: This vile necklace of charred goat's teeth paradoxically contains both the power to extend life as well as cut it short.

Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_SnakeCaster_capp.name: Eye of Enkil
Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_SnakeCaster_capp.flavor:
"A foul spell of desire was woven into the statue's stone. Its idolaters were helpless as their souls were ripped from their bodies to animate its writhing form."
- Field Notes of Brother Darmont

Rarespawn_Reward_Boots_SkeletonMelee_cap.name: Captain's Ragged Boots
Rarespawn_Reward_Boots_SkeletonMelee_cap.flavor:
"The Captain was bleeding from at least three bite wounds, sweating from the poison and barely able to walk, but he never stopped searching for his lost comrades."
- Eulogy for Captain Willcocks

Rarespawn_Reward_Chest_CannibalBrute_cap.name: Gur's Freezing Armor
Rarespawn_Reward_Chest_CannibalBrute_cap.flavor:
"Favored by Pitiless Gur, this heavy armor remains painfully cold to the touch, even in the hottest of climates."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

Rarespawn_Reward_Crossbow_GhostMelee_cap.name: Haunted Crossbow
Rarespawn_Reward_Crossbow_GhostMelee_cap.flavor:
"Those who came before shall bear witness to your deeds."
- Inscription on the hilt

Rarespawn_Reward_Gloves_OmniMonk_capped.name: Outcast's Handwraps
Rarespawn_Reward_Gloves_OmniMonk_capped.flavor: Those foolish few Monks who abuse their training for personal gain are banished from the Floating Sky Monastery and forced to wander the harsh and unforgiving lands beyond.

Rarespawn_Reward_Helm_BarbarianGhost_cap.name: Bloodspiller's Helm
Rarespawn_Reward_Helm_BarbarianGhost_cap.flavor:
"There is nothing better in life than to stand alone, painted red, atop a hill made from the bodies of your enemies."
- Zarozar the Mighty

Rarespawn_Reward_Pants_WerewolfMelee_cap.name: Manhunter's Breeches
Rarespawn_Reward_Pants_WerewolfMelee_cap.flavor: Wearing these gore-drenched leggings fills your mind with a single overwhelming desire: to hunt.

Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_BloodLord_capped.name: Blood-Cursed Band
Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_BloodLord_capped.flavor:
"Unhand me, filth! A single drop of my blood is worth an ocean of yours! Within it churns a power you could never hope to understand!"
- Lord Eònan, last words

Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_FlyHost_capped.name: Trembling Ring
Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_FlyHost_capped.flavor:
"Dearest Will, this ring is like my love for you. Both have no end. May this ring keep you safe and help keep me in your heart during your travels. - Lucya"
- Inscription on the band

Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_WoodWraith_capped.name: Ring of Splintered Wood
Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_WoodWraith_capped.flavor: Even the slightest touch leaves painful splinters burrowed in the flesh.

Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_ZombieBrute_capped.name: Grotesque Loop
Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_ZombieBrute_capped.flavor: A malformed collection of bone, flesh and a strange, hardened ichor, this ring-shaped object almost seems to have been grown, rather than crafted.

Rarespawn_Reward_Staff_CultistCaster_cap.name: Staff of Elemental Command
Rarespawn_Reward_Staff_CultistCaster_cap.flavor: A powerful relic once belonging to Jazreth the Summoner, this staff was thought lost forever.

Amulet_QST_Class_Necro_Golem_Reward.name: Ossified Prayer Beads
Amulet_QST_Class_Necro_Golem_Reward.flavor: A set of prayer beads made of human teeth and attached to a long, flexible tendon. Each tooth is inscribed with a symbol holy to Rathma, which a worshiper can meditate upon before moving to the next.

MountReins_DecayHorse.name: Reins of the Decaying Steed
MountReins_DecayHorse.desc: Use reins to add the Decaying Steed to your stable.

Amulet_QST_Hawe_Verge_S05_DesperateRemed.name: Purified Amulet of Aldara
Amulet_QST_Hawe_Verge_S05_DesperateRemed.flavor: This amulet once belonged to Aldara and was used to inflict harm upon many before it was purified by Elder Lau of Weijinhani, who gave his life in the process.

Amulet_QST_Hawe_Bog_Kres_03_Reward.name: Vestigial Viscera
Amulet_QST_Hawe_Bog_Kres_03_Reward.flavor: A shriveled organ wrapped in vines worn around one’s neck. A constant reminder that the swamp wins. The swamps always wins.

SMP_LuckyCoin.name: Lucky Coin
SMP_LuckyCoin.flavor: Hopefully it brings better luck for you than it did its previous owner

World_SecretCellar_Key.name: Strange Key
World_SecretCellar_Key.desc: A large metal key. Though it appears ordinary, you feel that it has some kind of power.
World_SecretCellar_Key.flavor: Who knows what this could unlock?

SMP_WishingWell_Ring.name: Ring of Misfortune
SMP_WishingWell_Ring.flavor: A seemingly ordinary ring, but wearing it fills you with dread

QST_Hawe_Taissa_QuestReward.name: Mark of the Conclave
QST_Hawe_Taissa_QuestReward.flavor:
"Healing is a journey. A series of steps. Some days you may stumble, but so long as you continue to put one foot in front of the other, you will reach your destination."
- Recently carved inscription

QST_Scos_Hills_Strand_Breadcrumb_Item.name: Bag of Foodstuffs
QST_Scos_Hills_Strand_Breadcrumb_Item.flavor: A burlap sack filled with loaves of bread, meats, cheese, and other food. Whoever filled this sack did so with love for its intended recipients.

Lorebook_Item_ErimansPyre_02.name: Anonymous Letter
Lorebook_Item_ErimansPyre_02.desc: A few scraps of parchment, charred around the edges

QST_Scos_LochRaeth_MessageinaBottle_Bott.name: Bundled Heirloom with Letter
QST_Scos_LochRaeth_MessageinaBottle_Bott.desc: A family heirloom found with a letter in a bottle on the shores of the Jagged Shoals

QST_Kehj_Infection_01_CurePlant_CellarBo.name: Ghost Palm Flower
QST_Kehj_Infection_01_CurePlant_CellarBo.flavor: The small, fragile flower of a Kehjistan palm tree. Despite its beautiful colors, it has a pungent aroma like rotting flesh.

QST_Step_HungerforaNewLife_ContainerEmpt.name: Empty Tea Infuser
QST_Step_HungerforaNewLife_ContainerEmpt.flavor: Empty container from Zolaya, to be filled with herbs. Zolaya would often brew herbal teas for Oyuun, and hopes that one of these familiar brews will calm her.

QST_Step_HungerforaNewLife_ContainerFill.name: Filled Tea Infuser
QST_Step_HungerforaNewLife_ContainerFill.flavor: A container from Zolaya, filled with medicinal herbs from her hideout. Perhaps a familiar scent from happier times will soothe Oyuun's nerves.

Potion_Generic_Template_01.name: [PH]Lorebook
Potion_Generic_Template_01.flavor: [PH]This is a placeholder Lorebook entry. 200 Characters Max!

Potion_Generic_Template_02.name: [PH]Lorebook
Potion_Generic_Template_02.flavor: [PH]This is a placeholder Lorebook entry. 200 Characters Max!

Potion_Generic_Template_03.name: [PH]Lorebook
Potion_Generic_Template_03.flavor: [PH]This is a placeholder Lorebook entry. 200 Characters Max!

DGN_Hawe_schewTestDungeon_Key.name: Blood Key
DGN_Hawe_schewTestDungeon_Key.flavor: Key dropped from the Mega Skeleton

QST_Kehj_LadyoftheOasis_Gem_Flippy.name: Yellow Lotus
QST_Kehj_LadyoftheOasis_Gem_Flippy.flavor: The Yellow Lotus leaves are covered in a sticky clear film.

QST_Step_WeightofSin_Bracelet02.name: Naraa's Bracelet
QST_Step_WeightofSin_Bracelet02.flavor: A hand-carved bracelet tarnished by ash. Eagle wings span the underside of the bangle. "Naraa" is carved beneath the wings.

QST_Step_HungerforaNewLife_Lorebook.name: Oyuun's Journals
QST_Step_HungerforaNewLife_Lorebook.desc: Written by Oyuun while held captive in Guulrahn

DGN_Hawe_schewTestDungeon_McGuffin.name: McGuffin
DGN_Hawe_schewTestDungeon_McGuffin.flavor: McGuffin dropped from the Mega Skeleton

LE_AWhetton_Key.name: Jailer's Key
LE_AWhetton_Key.flavor: This key keeps traitors of the faith and demon worshipers locked away to rot in their cells.

QST_Class_Sorc_Item_Codex.name: The Forgotten Codex
QST_Class_Sorc_Item_Codex.flavor: This mouldering volume is filled with cramped lines of spidery handwriting and drawings of obscure mystic symbols.

Gloves_Unique_Druid_100.name: Unsung Ascetic's Wraps
Gloves_Unique_Druid_100.flavor:
"The storm caller returns, day after day, demanding to meet the Tree. He beats his chest and demonstrates his powers, refusing to believe that he will never be chosen."
- Excerpt from Gulyas' Diary

1HWand_Unique_Sorc_101.name: The Oculus
1HWand_Unique_Sorc_101.flavor:
"The rhythm of the orb, which had pulsed steadily for five centuries, quickened as its owner took his final ragged breaths. It were as if some intelligence within reveled in the sight."
- Master Eos

2HBow_Unique_Rogue_100.name: Eaglehorn
2HBow_Unique_Rogue_100.flavor:
"Scholars have been unable to decipher the runes carved into this bow, however all agree they are related to its uncanny ability to bend arrows towards their targets."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

1HShield_Unique_Necro_100.name: Lidless Wall
1HShield_Unique_Necro_100.flavor: Initially an unpopular choice to replace Mendeln as Deathspeaker, Daros quickly proved his worth with the creation of this masterpiece.

QST_S01_Main_02_Step_DSQ_Records.name: Faded Entry
QST_S01_Main_02_Step_DSQ_Records.flavor: "Cages of Binding. 1236: Found in Hawezar, distributed among our Zakarum outposts there. Confiscated by order of—"

MountReins_Cat.name: Reins of the Nahantu Panther
MountReins_Cat.desc: Use reins to add the Nahantu Panther to your stable.

LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT2.name: Midwinter Spoils
LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT2.desc: A cache containing a collection of valuable rewards such as Armor, Gem Fragments, and a potential dose of Gileon's Brew.
LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT2.flavor: The people of Kyovashad thank you and, with this, make a request: Continue to stave off the Blight.

LTE_Hibernal_Gold_Cache.name: Midwinter Purse
LTE_Hibernal_Gold_Cache.desc: A cache containing a bounty of Gold as a testament to your triumph over the Midwinter Blight.
LTE_Hibernal_Gold_Cache.flavor: The gold shimmers against the lights of the Midwinter Square.

TEST_QST_rohlendorf_onBoarding_Letter.name: A letter to a travelling orator
TEST_QST_rohlendorf_onBoarding_Letter.flavor: 'Dear Fabian, please make haste to meet us in the village of Morden. Without you, we will not be able to lay Alisha's soul to rest. Travel carefully - Your friend Quentin

QST_Frac_LilithBlood_Petal.name: Blood Petal
QST_Frac_LilithBlood_Petal.flavor: "Lilith's blood is soft to the touch, warm despite the cold. It reacts to you."

QST_Frac_LilithBlood_02_HolyRelic.name: The Child's Caul
QST_Frac_LilithBlood_02_HolyRelic.flavor: A blanket made of fine satin. It shimmers in the light.

S01_Crafting_Cache_RandomHeart.name: Uncertain Heart
S01_Crafting_Cache_RandomHeart.desc: Contains a random Caged Heart, with a chance at a Wrathful Heart.
S01_Crafting_Cache_RandomHeart.flavor: By mulching malignant hearts, and mixing them into an awful slurry before purifying them, powers both strange and terrible can be had.

S01_Crafting_Cache_RandomKey.name: Uncertain Invoker
S01_Crafting_Cache_RandomKey.desc: Contains a random Malignant Invoker, with a chance at a Wrathful Invoker.
S01_Crafting_Cache_RandomKey.flavor: Cormond hasn't exactly explained why making these requires essences of other Malignant Hearts, but once thrust into a pustule, a more powerful Malignant is brought forth.

S01_Malignant_Key_Offensive.name: Vicious Malignant Invoker
S01_Malignant_Key_Offensive.desc: Invokes a powerful Vicious Malignant foe from the xanthous Malignant Pustules found within Tunnels.
S01_Malignant_Key_Offensive.flavor: The perfect tool for remedying a boil.

S01_Malignant_Key_Defensive.name: Brutal Malignant Invoker
S01_Malignant_Key_Defensive.desc: Invokes a powerful Brutal Malignant foe from the indigo Malignant Pustules found within Tunnels.
S01_Malignant_Key_Defensive.flavor: The perfect tool for remedying a boil.

S01_Malignant_Key_Utility.name: Devious Malignant Invoker
S01_Malignant_Key_Utility.desc: Invokes a powerful Devious Malignant foe from the amaranth Malignant Pustules found within Tunnels.
S01_Malignant_Key_Utility.flavor: The perfect tool for remedying a boil.

S01_Malignant_Key_Universal.name: Wrathful Malignant Invoker
S01_Malignant_Key_Universal.desc: Invokes a powerful Wrathful Malignant foe from the most powerful Malignant Pustules found within Tunnels.
S01_Malignant_Key_Universal.flavor: The perfect tool for remedying a boil.

S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Orang.name: Vicious Malignant Ichor
S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Orang.desc: A xanthous substance refined from Malignant Hearts. Used by Cormond to create new Hearts or Invokers.
S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Orang.flavor: The orange ichor lends itself well to aggressive, offensive properties.

S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Pink.name: Devious Malignant Ichor
S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Pink.desc: An amaranth substance refined from Malignant Hearts. Used by Cormond to create new Hearts or Invokers.
S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Pink.flavor: The pinkish ichor lends itself well to effects best described as neither aggressive nor defensive, but useful.

S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Blue.name: Brutal Malignant Ichor
S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Blue.desc: An indigo substance refined from Malignant Hearts. Used by Cormond to create new Hearts or Invokers.
S01_CraftingMaterial_MalignantDust_Blue.flavor: The indigo ichor lends itself well to defensive or restorative properties.

S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan.name: Invoker of Varshan
S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan.desc: Invokes an Echo of Varshan from the most powerful Malignant Pustules found within Tunnels.
S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan.flavor: Would this work? Varshan is dead, isn't he?

LTE_Hibernal_Elixir.name: Gileon's Brew
LTE_Hibernal_Elixir.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.
LTE_Hibernal_Elixir.flavor:
You may only have one Elixir active at a time.

During activities that do not normally drop items, rewards will appear on completion.

QST_Kehj_Reward_PinchOfPoison_Cache.name: Curative Cache
QST_Kehj_Reward_PinchOfPoison_Cache.desc: Contains Curative Elixirs and the knowledge to make more.
QST_Kehj_Reward_PinchOfPoison_Cache.flavor: One of the oldest forms of magic is the brewing of potions. In this case, a tonic versus poisons and other hazardous conditions.

1HShield_QST_Hawe_ZakFort_Carthas_01.name: Paladin Lord's Bulwark
1HShield_QST_Hawe_ZakFort_Carthas_01.flavor: A simple kite shield once belonging to the Paladin Carthas, who perished protecting his land from hatred. Despite the many years it has lain forgotten, its luster remains undimmed.

Pants_Unique_Generic_101.name: Tassets of the Dawning Sky
Pants_Unique_Generic_101.flavor:
“May the Light of Father Inarius shine down upon all weary travelers of this holy land. Turn your face toward his radiance and find your strength renewed.”
- Statue Inscription

LTE_Hibernal_SkullShard.name: Blighted Fragment
LTE_Hibernal_SkullShard.desc: Found in Fractured Peaks during the Midwinter Blight. Recovered from Blightfiend corpses.
LTE_Hibernal_SkullShard.flavor: Shattered remnants of the Blightfiends twisted skull masks.

LTE_Hibernal_Heirloom.name: Lost Heirloom
LTE_Hibernal_Heirloom.desc: Found in Fractured Peaks during the Midwinter Blight. Recovered from Frigid Husks.
LTE_Hibernal_Heirloom.flavor: The last vestige of a victim lost to the Midwinter Blight.

LTE_Hibernal_Cloak.name: Red-Cloaked Trophy
LTE_Hibernal_Cloak.desc: Found in Fractured Peaks during the Midwinter Blight. Recovered from the bloodied corpse of the Red-Cloaked Horror.
LTE_Hibernal_Cloak.flavor: The decapitated head of the Red-Cloaked Horror itself, wrapped in a bundle of its own cloak for easy transport.

LTE_Hibernal_Proof.name: Midwinter Proof
LTE_Hibernal_Proof.desc: Use these to purchase Midwinter Rewards from Gileon at the Midwinter Square in Kyovashad.

Recipe_Elixir_CheatDeath.name: Recipe: Elixir of Death Evasion
Recipe_Elixir_CheatDeath.desc: Charred and stained, the text is no longer readable. Could be valuable for a collector, but is has no other use.

QST_S02_Main_05_Skull.name: Profane Vampire Skull
QST_S02_Main_05_Skull.flavor: The skull of a powerful vampire.

S01_Journey_Cache_Hearts.name: Cache of Caged Hearts
S01_Journey_Cache_Hearts.desc: Contains a number of Malignant Hearts.

S01_Cache_Test_AllKeys.name: Every Invoker
S01_Cache_Test_AllKeys.flavor: All of them! Every single one!

RDC_Khazra_MirroredRooms_SoulResonance_K.name: [PH] Soul Resonance
RDC_Khazra_MirroredRooms_SoulResonance_K.flavor: A remnant of soul energy that empowers you

Item_S01_Journey_Cache_Prisms.name: Cache of Scattered Prisms
Item_S01_Journey_Cache_Prisms.desc: Contains a number of Scattered Prisms.

Item_S01_Journey_Cache_LegMats.name: Cache of Legendary Materials
Item_S01_Journey_Cache_LegMats.desc: Contains an amount of each type of legendary salvage.

WOTD_VarshanSummon_UpperBody.name: Trembling Hand
WOTD_VarshanSummon_UpperBody.desc:
This object has lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Use this item or bring it to an  {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a  {icon:Icons_MalignantOrb_Black,2} {c_pickups}Malignant Heart{/c}.
WOTD_VarshanSummon_UpperBody.flavor: Pus oozes from under its fingernails.

WOTD_VarshanSummon_Head.name: Gurgling Head
WOTD_VarshanSummon_Head.desc:
This object has lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Use this item or bring it to an  {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a  {icon:Icons_MalignantOrb_Black,2} {c_pickups}Malignant Heart{/c}.
WOTD_VarshanSummon_Head.flavor: Some turbid liquid dribbles from its mouth.

WOTD_VarshanSummon_Malignant.name: Malignant Heart
WOTD_VarshanSummon_Malignant.desc:
This object has temporarily lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Bring it to an {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a {icon:Icons_Quest_Keys_WornMedium_001,2} {c_rare}Lair Key{/c}.

WOTD_VarshanSummon_LowerBody.name: Blackened Femur
WOTD_VarshanSummon_LowerBody.desc:
This object has lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Use this item or bring it to an  {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a  {icon:Icons_MalignantOrb_Black,2} {c_pickups}Malignant Heart{/c}.
WOTD_VarshanSummon_LowerBody.flavor: It stinks of sulfur and rot.

Helm_Unique_Barb_100.name: Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty
Helm_Unique_Barb_100.flavor: As he fought with side by side with Raekor to liberate the labor camp, Joritz claimed this dented helm from a fallen foe. As his legend grew, its unique shape became synonymous with his great deeds.

S01_Journey_Cache_NightmareSigils.name: Cache of Nightmare Sigils
S01_Journey_Cache_NightmareSigils.desc: Contains a number of Nightmare Sigils, to pursue greater heights and challenges.

Item_S01_Journey_Cache_LateGameResources.name: Cache of High-Level Resources
Item_S01_Journey_Cache_LateGameResources.desc: Contains materials crucial to high-level crafting.

QST_S02_Main_06_Note01.name: [PH] Blood Seeker Note
QST_S02_Main_06_Note01.flavor: [PH] Optional Flavor Note from Unique Elite, can add Lore or just use flavor text.

BossSummoning_InfernalSteel.name: Living Steel
BossSummoning_InfernalSteel.desc:
This object has temporarily lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Bring it to an {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a {icon:Icons_Quest_Keys_WornMedium_001,2} {c_rare}Lair Key{/c}.

USZ_InfernalEssence.name: Infernal Essence
USZ_InfernalEssence.desc: Sacrifice this to the {c_red}Inferno Altar{/c} in a Helltide affected region to trigger a Tier 1 Event.

S01_Journey_Cache_CH01.name: First Journey Cache
S01_Journey_Cache_CH01.desc: Contains a number of herbs, as well as jewelry.

S01_Journey_Cache_CH02.name: Second Journey Cache
S01_Journey_Cache_CH02.desc: Contains a number of Scattered Prisms, as well as jewelry.

S01_Journey_Cache_CH03.name: Third Journey Cache
S01_Journey_Cache_CH03.desc: Contains Legendary Salvage, as well as jewelry.

S01_Journey_Cache_CH04.name: Fourth Journey Cache
S01_Journey_Cache_CH04.desc: Contains a number of Malignant Hearts and Forgotten Souls, as well as jewelry.

S01_Journey_Cache_CH05.name: Fifth Journey Cache
S01_Journey_Cache_CH05.desc: Contains a number of late game resources and Nightmare Sigils, to pursue greater heights and challenges, as well as jewelry.

S01_Journey_Cache_CH06.name: Sixth Journey Cache
S01_Journey_Cache_CH06.desc: Contains a number of late game resources and Nightmare Sigils, to pursue greater heights and challenges, as well as jewelry.

USZ_CorruptedEssence.name: Corrupted Essence
USZ_CorruptedEssence.desc: Sacrifice this to the {c_red}Inferno Altar{/c} in a Helltide affected region to trigger a Tier 2 event.

USZ_BlackenedEssence.name: Blackened Essence
USZ_BlackenedEssence.desc: Sacrifice this to the {c_red}Inferno Altar{/c} in a Helltide affected region region to trigger a Tier 3 Event.

World_SecretCellar_Trinket.name: Stamina Potion
World_SecretCellar_Trinket.desc: What little remains inside of the vial has long since desiccated into powder.
World_SecretCellar_Trinket.flavor: The thought of consuming this turns your stomach.

S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan_T3.name: Foul Invoker of Varshan
S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan_T3.desc: Invokes an intense Echo of Varshan from the most powerful Malignant Pustules found within Tunnels.
S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan_T3.flavor: The invoker is cold to the touch, and raises the hairs on the back of your neck.

S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan_T4.name: Tormented Invoker of Varshan
S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan_T4.desc: Invokes the strongest Echo of Varshan from the most powerful Malignant Pustules found within Tunnels.
S01_Malignant_Key_Varshan_T4.flavor: The invoker itself emanates a foul aura and seems to tremble.

S01_MalignantOrb_Universal_QST_S01_Main_.name: Varshan's Heart
S01_MalignantOrb_Universal_QST_S01_Main_.flavor: The caged corruption of Varshan, former priest of Velkhova. From this heart, the malignancy spread to the creatures of Sanctuary. Now, like Varshan, they may all be laid to rest.

BossSummoning_NightmareDungeon.name: Distilled Fear
BossSummoning_NightmareDungeon.desc:
This object has temporarily lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Bring it to an {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a {icon:Icons_Quest_Keys_WornMedium_001,2} {c_rare}Lair Key{/c}.

S01_Journey_Cache_CH07.name: Seventh Journey Cache
S01_Journey_Cache_CH07.desc: Contains jewelry, a number of late game resources, and a Scroll of Amnesia, which refunds all allocated Skill Points and Paragon Points.

BossSummoning_VampireLord.name: Exquisite Blood
BossSummoning_VampireLord.desc:
This object has temporarily lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Bring it to an {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a {icon:Icons_Quest_Keys_WornMedium_001,2} {c_rare}Lair Key{/c}.

S2_SME_Vampzone_SeekerKey.name: Seeker Key
S2_SME_Vampzone_SeekerKey.flavor: Only Lord Zir's most powerful servants are entrusted with access to his vast treasure hoard.

BossSummoning_UberDuriel_A.name: Mucus-Slick Egg
BossSummoning_UberDuriel_A.desc:
This object has lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Bring this item to an  {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a  {icon:Icon_Tooltip_MiscTrinkets_CrustyGem_Red_001,2.3} {c_pickups}Shard of Agony{/c}.
BossSummoning_UberDuriel_A.flavor: A powerful, nascent being wriggles within.

BossSummoning_UberDuriel_B.name: Shard of Agony
BossSummoning_UberDuriel_B.desc:
This object has temporarily lost its connection to a powerful entity.

Bring it to an {c_important}Alchemist{/c} to convert it into a {icon:Icons_Quest_Keys_Basic_RedLeather_001,2} {c_legendary}Greater Lair Key{/c}.

Example_ZigIn_Kurast_Key.name: Ornate Key
Example_ZigIn_Kurast_Key.flavor: An ornate key obtained within Example ZigIn Kurast

Cache_MalignantHeartRefine.name: Malignant Body Cache
Cache_MalignantHeartRefine.desc: Contains a Gurgling Head, Blackened Femur, or Trembling Hand used for summoning a powerful enemy beneath the Tree of Whispers within Malignant Burrow.

S02_PactScroll_AddFerocity.name: Pact of Ferocity
S02_PactScroll_AddFerocity.desc:
Adds a{icon:Vampire_Pact_Red_Icon, 2.3}Pact of Ferocity to Helm, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, or Boots. 

Has no effect if the armor piece already has maximum Pacts.

QST_S02_Main_06_BookOfNames.name: Ascended Blood Seekers Tome
QST_S02_Main_06_BookOfNames.flavor: A list of especially powerful Blood Seekers. They must be killed.

SME_S2_Vampzone_BloodLure.name: Blood Lure
SME_S2_Vampzone_BloodLure.flavor: A swatch of dried congealed blood. Strangely warm to the touch.

Helm_Unique_Generic_003.name: Godslayer Crown
Helm_Unique_Generic_003.flavor:
"The Sahptev faithful believe in a thousand and one gods. If it takes me as many lifetimes, I will find and kill them all."
- Gaspar Stilbian, Veradani Outcast

S02_PactScroll_RemoveFerocity.name: Cleansing Acid - Ferocity
S02_PactScroll_RemoveFerocity.desc: Removes two{icon:Vampire_Pact_Red_Icon, 2.3}Pacts of Ferocity from a piece of armor.

S02_PactScroll_AddEternity.name: Pact of Eternity
S02_PactScroll_AddEternity.desc:
Adds a{icon:Vampire_Pact_Green_Icon, 2.3}Pact of Eternity to Helm, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, or Boots. 

Has no effect if the armor piece already has maximum Pacts.

S02_PactScroll_RemoveEternity.name: Cleansing Acid - Eternity
S02_PactScroll_RemoveEternity.desc: Removes two{icon:Vampire_Pact_Green_Icon, 2.3}Pacts of Eternity from a piece of armor.

Gloves_Unique_Generic_004.name: Paingorger's Gauntlets
Gloves_Unique_Generic_004.flavor: Crafted from fragments of Duriel's carapace, wearing these gloves, or being struck by them, causes an agonizing sensation akin to pushing one's hands through a thousand shards of glass.

Pants_Unique_Generic_102.name: Tibault's Will
Pants_Unique_Generic_102.flavor:
"The younger apprentices think wearing heavy plate in the swamps is foolish. They fail to understand that our armor is our legacy, and without it we are nothing."
- Crusader Pembroke

Ring_Unique_Generic_102.name: X'Fal's Corroded Signet
Ring_Unique_Generic_102.flavor: Skulking in the shadows of the Realm of Destruction, the Scarred Baron plots the downfall of the mortal who banished him there.

Chest_Unique_Generic_101.name: Soulbrand
Chest_Unique_Generic_101.flavor:
"To create such an artifact would require an impossible mastery over alchemy, transmutation and the subtle magics of the soul. By all rights, it should not exist, yet it does."
- Artisan Callas

Amulet_Unique_Generic_101.name: Banished Lord's Talisman
Amulet_Unique_Generic_101.flavor:
"His name has been lost to history, but to have been exiled from a land as cursed as Hawezar, his deeds must have been truly depraved."
- Scholar's Notes

CraftingMaterial_ShieldBearer_Stone_Comm.name: Wolfram Ore
CraftingMaterial_ShieldBearer_Stone_Comm.desc: [PH] Raheir's Bartering material. Acquired from his mercenary event or purchased from the Traveling Merchant in the Mercenary Hideout.

QST_S02_VampTide_Intro.name: Fresh Blood Lure
QST_S02_VampTide_Intro.flavor: This swatch of blood does not thicken or tarnish in the air. I should show this to those taking up arms against the vampires.

LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT3.name: Midwinter Spoils
LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT3.desc: A cache containing a collection of valuable rewards such as Armor, Gem Fragments, and a potential dose of Gileon's Brew.
LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT3.flavor: The people of Kyovashad thank you and, with this, make a request: Continue to stave off the Blight.

LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT4.name: Midwinter Spoils
LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT4.desc: A cache containing a collection of valuable rewards such as Armor, Gem Fragments, and a potential dose of Gileon's Brew.
LTE_Hibernal_Loot_Cache_WT4.flavor: The people of Kyovashad thank you and, with this, make a request: Continue to stave off the Blight.

Helm_Rare_QST_S02_Main_06_Reward.name: Blood Seeker's Helm
Helm_Rare_QST_S02_Main_06_Reward.flavor: Worn as a sign of loyalty by Lord Zir's most merciless lieutenants.

Gloves_Rare_QST_S02_Main_12_Reward.name: Hunter's Gloves
Gloves_Rare_QST_S02_Main_12_Reward.flavor: Tough leather protects the hands from puncture wounds.

QST_Naha_Lingering_Stone.name: Tenebrous Opal
QST_Naha_Lingering_Stone.flavor: The stone shines with a beautiful, iridescent light. However, a barely-perceptible shadow hides deeper within.

QST_Naha_Lingering_TreeBark.name: Ancient Banyan Bark
QST_Naha_Lingering_TreeBark.flavor: Touching this flexible bark leaves your hands stained with rich aromatic oils.

QST_Naha_Lingering_DregsDrop.name: Insect Toxin
QST_Naha_Lingering_DregsDrop.flavor: The Dregs of Nahantu have taken to consuming a toxin from rare insects, causing violent hallucinations as well as frighteningly heightened predatory instincts.

S03_Activity_Gather_Item.name: Shattered Stone
S03_Activity_Gather_Item.desc: Used to craft new Governing and Tuning Stones.
S03_Activity_Gather_Item.flavor: Slate sharp enough to cut your finger.

S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Small.name: Proof of Might
S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Small.desc: Collect Proof of Might to increase your score

Ring_Magic_QST_S02_Main_03.name: Magistrate's Ring
Ring_Magic_QST_S02_Main_03.flavor: Under the caked-on blood, a red stone glints dimly.

Chest_Rare_QST_S02_Main_05.name: Forgotten Acolyte's Cuirass
Chest_Rare_QST_S02_Main_05.flavor: Unholy runes are barely visible among the dents from ancient battles.

1HDagger_Rare_QST_S02_Main_07.name: Vampiric Assassin's Dagger
1HDagger_Rare_QST_S02_Main_07.flavor: This hollow weapon drains the blood of its victims.

Amulet_Rare_QST_S02_Main_11.name: Lord Zir's Amulet
Amulet_Rare_QST_S02_Main_11.flavor: This ruby-and-gold necklace pulses with unholy power.

S03_VaultBonusWing_Key.name: Pearl of Warding
S03_VaultBonusWing_Key.desc: Offer this to the Statue of Zoltun Kulle to receive Zoltun's Warding.
S03_VaultBonusWing_Key.flavor: "You cannot hide an idea from others without also hiding it from yourself." - Ayuzhan of Caldeum

S03_LBD_Rift_01_SmallKey.name: Small Keys
S03_LBD_Rift_01_SmallKey.flavor: [ph] A small set of keys. Surely it opens somethings.

BloodSeal_Upgrade.name: Potent Blood
BloodSeal_Upgrade.desc:
Used to upgrade or unlock Vampiric Powers in the Seasonal tab of your Inventory, available after completing or skipping the Campaign and progressing the Seasonal Quest.

Often obtained from Blood Harvest, Blood Seekers, and Opulent Coffins.
BloodSeal_Upgrade.flavor: This substance, distilled by an occult process from the blood of human victims, enables the enhancement of Vampiric Powers.

QST_Naha_Kurast_Key.name: Kurast Sewers Key
QST_Naha_Kurast_Key.flavor: A key of ancient and curious design, worn smooth by the touch of hundreds of hands.

mnt_amor01_cat.name: Kurast Undercity Barding
mnt_amor01_cat.desc: Armor scavenged from the depths of Kurast's Undercity.

Food_CriticalStrikeChance.name: Charred Demon Heart
Food_CriticalStrikeChance.desc: Increases Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}1%{/c} for {c_number}[30*(1+Elixir_Duration_Bonus)||]{/c} minutes. This bonus increases to {c_number}5%{/c} while Makhni's Massacre bonus is active.
Food_CriticalStrikeChance.flavor: You may only have one Food effect active at a time.

Food_AttackSpeed.name: Spicy Paletongue
Food_AttackSpeed.desc: Increases Attack Speed by {c_number}1%{/c} for {c_number}[30*(1+Elixir_Duration_Bonus)||]{/c} minutes. This bonus increases to {c_number}5%{/c} while Makhni's Massacre bonus is active.
Food_AttackSpeed.flavor: You may only have one Food effect active at a time.

QST_S02_Reward_Cache.name: Potent Blood Cache
QST_S02_Reward_Cache.desc: Contains a quantity of Potent Blood.
QST_S02_Reward_Cache.flavor: This substance, distilled by an occult process from the blood of human victims, enables the enhancement of Vampiric Powers.

S02_PactScroll_AddDivinity.name: Pact of Divinity
S02_PactScroll_AddDivinity.desc:
Adds a{icon:Vampire_Pact_Purple_Icon, 2.3}Pact of Divinity to Helm, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, or Boots. 

Has no effect if the armor piece already has maximum Pacts.

S02_PactScroll_RemoveDivinity.name: Cleansing Acid - Divinity
S02_PactScroll_RemoveDivinity.desc: Removes two{icon:Vampire_Pact_Purple_Icon, 2.3}Pacts of Divinity from a piece of armor.

S02_PactScroll_RemoveAll.name: Cleansing Acid - All
S02_PactScroll_RemoveAll.desc:
Removes all Pacts present on a piece of armor.

Can be altered at the Alchemist to remove only specific Pacts.

S03_LBD_Rift_BossKey_01.name: Golden Key
S03_LBD_Rift_BossKey_01.desc: Opens the way to a deadly foe.

S03_UnearthedMachinations_LightningCompo.name: Elemental Core
S03_UnearthedMachinations_LightningCompo.desc: Destroy this in a Brazier to summon a Herald of Malphas.
S03_UnearthedMachinations_LightningCompo.flavor: A concentrated mote of elemental energy woven by the Loom.

S03_UnearthedMachinations_FireComponent.name: Igneous Core
S03_UnearthedMachinations_FireComponent.desc: Use at the Corrupted Altar found inside the Vault of the Loom in World Tier 4: Torment to unseal the path to the Echo of Malphas. Requires {c_number}7{/c}. Acquired from Vault Heralds and the Son of Malphas.
S03_UnearthedMachinations_FireComponent.flavor: A concentrated mote of fire. It scorches your palm.

S03_UnearthedMachinations_ColdComponent.name: Gelid Core
S03_UnearthedMachinations_ColdComponent.desc: Destroy this in a Gelid Brazier to summon a Herald of Malphas.
S03_UnearthedMachinations_ColdComponent.flavor: A concentrated mote of frost. The cold sends aches down your arm.

SME_S2_Vampzone_GlowingBloodStone.name: Glowing Blood Stone
SME_S2_Vampzone_GlowingBloodStone.flavor: Waves of dancing red light seem to flow through this stone's matrix.

QST_Merc_X1_BerserkerCrone_Clue.name: Hand of Invitation
QST_Merc_X1_BerserkerCrone_Clue.flavor: A bloody, dismembered hand adorned with paint and ash. The palm has been tattooed with an intricate map.

QST_S03_Main_01_Kehj_01_ControlRune.name: Mysterious Runestone
QST_S03_Main_01_Kehj_01_ControlRune.flavor: Slate and onyx. The runes look almost Horadric but older, more refined.

QST_Naha_TeganzePlateau_Heart.name: Heart of Ah Bulan
QST_Naha_TeganzePlateau_Heart.flavor: The massive heart is covered with dark tendrils, and beats with a rhythm that is slowly but surely weakening.

Amulet_Unique_Druid_100.name: Dolmen Stone
Amulet_Unique_Druid_100.flavor: As the hateful mob beat on his door, he gripped the pulsing shard tightly and screamed for calm. When he opened his eyes, all that greeted him was silence and the blood-smeared ruins of his cottage.

QST_Merc_X1_BerserkerCrone_Candles.name: [PH] Putrid Tallow Candle
QST_Merc_X1_BerserkerCrone_Candles.flavor: [PH] A stinking candle made from the congealed fat of an unknown animal.

QST_Naha_Item_CursedChild_Toy.name: Ragged Toy
QST_Naha_Item_CursedChild_Toy.flavor: A hand-stitched toy, speckled with dirt. It looks well-loved.

Chest_Unique_Rogue_100.name: Scoundrel's Leathers
Chest_Unique_Rogue_100.flavor:
"Rumor has it he lost them in a game of Skull & Anchor, but the boss is a devil with the dice. I think he wanted to give the poor sod something to keep him warm without wounding his pride."
- Elstir

trophy_bar001_hibernal_lte.name: Periapt of the Long Night Moon

trophy_dru001_hibernal_lte.name: Zemi of the Long Night Moon

trophy_nec001_hibernal_lte.name: Veil of the Long Night Moon

trophy_rog001_hibernal_lte.name: Masque of the Long Night Moon

trophy_sor001_hibernal_lte.name: Domino of the Long Night Moon

GemMaterial_Ruby.name: Ruby Fragment
GemMaterial_Ruby.flavor: Even the smallest sparks can ignite the brightest flames.

GemMaterial_Skull.name: Skull Fragment
GemMaterial_Skull.flavor: The pieces are too fractured to see what creature suffered such a fate.

GemMaterial_Emerald.name: Emerald Fragment
GemMaterial_Emerald.flavor: Broken and weak, but not without the potential for greatness.

GemMaterial_Sapphire.name: Sapphire Fragment
GemMaterial_Sapphire.flavor: Scattered parts of a greater whole, watching and waiting.

GemMaterial_Amethyst.name: Amethyst Fragment
GemMaterial_Amethyst.flavor: Like staring into a boundless void that sears your very soul.

GemMaterial_Topaz.name: Topaz Fragment
GemMaterial_Topaz.flavor: Like glittering gold scattered to the winds and brought together once more.

GemMaterial_Diamond.name: Diamond Fragment
GemMaterial_Diamond.flavor: Shining bright, these shards are eager to become whole.

Helm_Rare_QST_S02_Main_01_Reward.name: Forgotten Hero's Helm
Helm_Rare_QST_S02_Main_01_Reward.flavor: This battle-scarred pot helm clearly saved the life of a powerful warrior on many occasions. Why was it abandoned here?

Gloves_Rare_QST_S02_Main_09_Reward.name: Blood Magus Gloves
Gloves_Rare_QST_S02_Main_09_Reward.flavor: Elite Vampire Mages wear these unnaturally smooth gloves when handling human-forged objects tainted by the Light.

CraftingMaterial_BerserkerCrone_Meat_Com.name: Fresh Meat
CraftingMaterial_BerserkerCrone_Meat_Com.desc: [PH] Varyana's Bartering material. Acquired from her mercenary event or purchased from the Traveling Merchant in the Mercenary Hideout.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_2HWeapons.name: Hunting Party Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_2HWeapons.desc: A collection of second-hand weapons used by the Vampire Hunters.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_2HWeapons.flavor: These weapons are nearly broken, rusted, and covered in several types of blood. Hopefully you'll have better luck than their former owner.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Rings.name: Hunters' Insignia Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Rings.desc: A set of rings used to signify membership with the Vampire Hunters.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Rings.flavor: Heavy, corroded, and poorly crafted, these rings nevertheless show dedication to the Vampire Hunters.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Helms.name: Hunters' Livery Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Helms.desc: An assortment of second-hand caps and helmets used by the Vampire Hunters.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Helms.flavor: These helms have all been enhanced with leather gorgets, useful for keeping the heat in and the vampires out.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Amulets.name: Sack of Skeleton Chokers
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Amulets.desc: Various magic imbued amulets formerly worn by Blood Skeletons.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Amulets.flavor: An aura of dark magick lingers on these amulets.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampireSpoi.name: Sack of Vampire Spoils
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampireSpoi.desc: A collection of items and gold retrieved from the Vampires.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampireSpoi.flavor: A leather sack filled to the brim with armor, gold and Murmuring Obols.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAlc.name: Vampiric Alchemy Supplies
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAlc.desc: An assortment of herbs and elixirs taken from the Vampires.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAlc.flavor: The stench of death and dark magicks lingers on these herbs. You wonder how the Vampires perform alchemy at all.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodLordsA.name: Blood Lord's Armory
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodLordsA.desc: High quality weapons taken from a Blood Lord.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodLordsA.flavor: The exceptional lifespans of the Vampire Lords grant them ample time to acquire ancient items of immense power.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricFoo.name: Pile of Vampiric Footwear
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricFoo.desc: Several sets of previously worn boots.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricFoo.flavor: These boots are covered in mud and several kinds of blood, but are surprisingly well cared for.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodSeeker.name: Blood Seekers Personal Effects
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodSeeker.desc: A collection of items stripped from a Blood Seeker.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodSeeker.flavor: These items carry the stains of countless evil acts. Lets hope they find better use in your hands.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_GrandVampir.name: Crate of Vampire Spoils
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_GrandVampir.desc: A large pile of items and gold retrieved from the Vampires.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_GrandVampir.flavor: A wooden crate filled to the brim with armor, gold and Murmuring Obols.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricRin.name: Vampiric Signet Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricRin.desc: A set of rings worn by Vampire Magi.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricRin.flavor: Gifts from Lord Zir himself, these rings remain in immaculate condition.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricCra.name: Vampiric Crafting Supplies
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricCra.desc: An assortment of materials taken from the Vampires.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricCra.flavor: Vampires are known to collect and hoard objects with any semblance of power, these goods are no exception.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Gloves.name: Pack of Ghoul-Skin Gloves
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Gloves.desc: A collection of gloves used by Blood Lords.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Gloves.flavor: You can't help but wonder if there was a less disgusting material available to the Vampires.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricLeg.name: Blood Bone Leg Reinforcements
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricLeg.desc: Several pairs of pants reinforced with Blood Bone.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricLeg.flavor: Bone imbued with Blood Magic becomes as durable as steel while remaining lightweight.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricWea.name: Blood Seeker's Weapon Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricWea.desc: An assortment of weapons once belonging to a Blood Seeker.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricWea.flavor: In return for their eternal fealty, Blood Seekers are trusted with Zir's most powerful arms and artifacts.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_ZirsPersona.name: Lord Zir's Personal Stash
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_ZirsPersona.desc: Valuable items pilfered from Lord Zir himself.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_ZirsPersona.flavor: A bulging crate filled with armor, gold and Murmuring Obols.

LTE_Hibernal_NMD_Reward_Cache.name: Midwinter Nightmare Spoils
LTE_Hibernal_NMD_Reward_Cache.desc: A collection of Blighted Fragments and Lost Heirlooms, salvaged from the darkest depths.
LTE_Hibernal_NMD_Reward_Cache.flavor: Necklaces, scarves, pottery, rings... Remnants of the lost crowd, this cache. They can be remembered.

S03_DGN_Hawe_Vault_Key.name: Corroded Vault Key
S03_DGN_Hawe_Vault_Key.desc: Opens a door in the Vault of Ink.
S03_DGN_Hawe_Vault_Key.flavor: Slick with scum. Even the Vaults can't resist the swamp's influence.

S02_EGD_Dungeon_01_BossKey_01.name: Boss Key
S02_EGD_Dungeon_01_BossKey_01.desc: Bound to Pantheon of the Adventurer
S02_EGD_Dungeon_01_BossKey_01.flavor: A metal key forged with demonic runes. It keeps the unworthy out of the Inner Sanctum.

PactArmor_Any_Generic_001_Gambling.name: Pact Armor
PactArmor_Any_Generic_001_Gambling.desc:
Randomly provides a Helm, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, or Boots with several Pacts.

Pact variants have an equal chance of appearing on items obtained in this way.

S03_Attunement_Key.name: [PH] Harmonious Key
S03_Attunement_Key.desc: [PH] Unlocks Sealed Vault Coffers. Concentrated from residual energy after navigating hazard chambers.
S03_Attunement_Key.flavor: [PH] The energy fragment hums against your hands.

QST_S02_Main_05_Efficacious_Blood.name: Potent Blood
QST_S02_Main_05_Efficacious_Blood.flavor: "This potent vampire blood feels thick and viscous inside the large jar."

QST_Naha_FiveHills_AkaratShrineKey.name: Strange Stone
QST_Naha_FiveHills_AkaratShrineKey.flavor: A broken, flat stone with a dulled gem set in the center.

LTE_Hibernal_Rep_Reward_Cache.name: Greater Midwinter Spoils
LTE_Hibernal_Rep_Reward_Cache.desc: A cache containing a collection of highly valuable rewards such as Armor, Gem Fragments, and a dose of Gileon's Brew.
LTE_Hibernal_Rep_Reward_Cache.flavor: A reminder that dawn’s light comes even to the longest nights.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Legs.name: Patchwork Leggings
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Legs.desc: Several pairs of hastily repaired pants.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Legs.flavor: Years of use are carefully concealed by layers of patches.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAmu.name: Sack of Vampiric Torques
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAmu.desc: Various amulets formerly worn by Blood Lords.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAmu.flavor: Despite their violent tendencies, Vampires are able craftsmen with a keen eye for aesthetics.

Raid_Khazra_Currency.name: Citadel Coin
Raid_Khazra_Currency.desc:
Used to purchase items from
the{icon:Marker_Raid_Vendor,2.5}{c_important}Citadel Vendor{/c}.

Earned from the {icon:marker_raid_entrance, 1.8} {c_highlight}Dark Citadel{/c}.
Raid_Khazra_Currency.flavor: A highly guarded currency hoarded by inhabitants of the Dark Citadel.

S03_QST_Main_07_Runestone.name: Hell-Blessed Runestone
S03_QST_Main_07_Runestone.flavor: The culmination of your efforts to save the Loom. The glow of the runes stings your eyes.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_2HWeapons_I.name: Hunting Party Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_2HWeapons_I.desc: A collection of second-hand weapons used by the Vampire Hunters.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_2HWeapons_I.flavor: These weapons are nearly broken, rusted, and covered in several types of blood. Hopefully you'll have better luck than their former owner.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Rings_Icon.name: Hunters' Insignia Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Rings_Icon.desc: A set of rings used to signify membership with the Vampire Hunters.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Rings_Icon.flavor: Heavy, corroded, and poorly crafted, these rings nevertheless show dedication to the Vampire Hunters.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Legs_Icon.name: Patchwork Leggings
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Legs_Icon.desc: Several pairs of hastily repaired pants.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Legs_Icon.flavor: Years of use are carefully concealed by layers of patches.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Helms_Icon.name: Hunters' Livery Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Helms_Icon.desc: An assortment of second-hand caps and helmets used by the Vampire Hunters.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Helms_Icon.flavor: These helms have all been enhanced with leather gorgets, useful for keeping the heat in and the vampires out.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Amulets_Ico.name: Sack of Skeleton Chokers
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Amulets_Ico.desc: Various magic imbued amulets formerly worn by Blood Skeletons.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Amulets_Ico.flavor: An aura of dark magick lingers on these amulets.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodLordsA.name: Blood Lord's Armory
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodLordsA.desc: High quality weapons taken from a Blood Lord.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodLordsA.flavor: The exceptional lifespans of the Vampire Lords grant them ample time to acquire ancient items of immense power.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricFoo.name: Pile of Vampiric Footwear
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricFoo.desc: Several sets of previously worn boots.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricFoo.flavor: These boots are covered in mud and several kinds of blood, but are surprisingly well cared for.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodSeeker.name: Blood Seekers Personal Effects
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodSeeker.desc: A collection of items stripped from a Blood Seeker.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_BloodSeeker.flavor: These items carry the stains of countless evil acts. Lets hope they find better use in your hands.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricRin.name: Vampiric Signet Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricRin.desc: A set of rings worn by Vampire Magi.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricRin.flavor: Gifts from Lord Zir himself, these rings remain in immaculate condition.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Gloves_Icon.name: Pack of Ghoul-Skin Gloves
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Gloves_Icon.desc: A collection of gloves used by Blood Lords.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_Gloves_Icon.flavor: You can't help but wonder if there was a less disgusting material available to the Vampires.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricLeg.name: Blood Bone Leg Reinforcements
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricLeg.desc: Several pairs of pants reinforced with Blood Bone.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricLeg.flavor: Bone imbued with Blood Magic becomes as durable as steel while remaining lightweight.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricWea.name: Blood Seeker's Weapon Cache
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricWea.desc: An assortment of weapons once belonging to a Blood Seeker.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricWea.flavor: In return for their eternal fealty, Blood Seekers are trusted with Zir's most powerful arms and artifacts.

S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAmu.name: Sack of Vampiric Torques
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAmu.desc: Various amulets formerly worn by Blood Lords.
S02_Vampzone_ReputationCache_VampiricAmu.flavor: Despite their violent tendencies, Vampires are able craftsmen with a keen eye for aesthetics.

S02_Journey_Cache_CH07.name: Braggart's Cache
S02_Journey_Cache_CH07.desc: Contains an enormous amount of Potent Blood, and nothing else.

X1_Raid_BoostItem.name: Raid Boost
X1_Raid_BoostItem.desc: Use this item to boost to a level 55 pre-built character.

Potion_PowerLevel.desc: Grants a large amount of experience.

S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Medium.name: Proof of Might
S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Medium.desc: Collect Proof of Might to increase your score

S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Large.name: Proof of Might
S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Large.desc: Collect Proof of Might to increase your score

QST_Hawe_BountyHunter_Acquisition_Mercen.name: Mercenary Helm
QST_Hawe_BountyHunter_Acquisition_Mercen.flavor: A pristine, skillfully crafted piece of armor. The helm bears the white hand of the Mercenaries.

QST_Merc_ShieldBearer_UnfinishedShield.name: Unfinished Shield
QST_Merc_ShieldBearer_UnfinishedShield.flavor: Though unfinished, this massive tower shield still appears to be quite durable.

S03_QST_Main_06_Runestone.name: Runecarving Tools
S03_QST_Main_06_Runestone.flavor: Chisels, chalk, and an inert runestone ready for carving.

S03_DGN_InfernalDevice_Vault_Key.name: [PH] Vault Key
S03_DGN_InfernalDevice_Vault_Key.flavor: A metal key forged with demonic runes. It keeps the unworthy out of the Inner Sanctum.

QST_Naha_Akarat_Perseverance_Incense.name: Necahual's Incense
QST_Naha_Akarat_Perseverance_Incense.flavor: A potent combination of fragrant resins, herbs, and spices. Pungent sourness along with savory sweetness momentarily obscure the dark corners of your heart.

QST_Naha_GoNative1_Scroll.name: Account of Captain Kharov's Madness
QST_Naha_GoNative1_Scroll.flavor: Kharov's madness spread to his men. Those able to fight are driven by malice. Some even call the monstrous Dregs kin. All who drink their juice are damned. Such sin... we should never have come here.

Boots_Unique_Rogue_100.name: Beastfall Boots
Boots_Unique_Rogue_100.flavor:
"Genai grew proud and fond of boasting of her hunting prowess. She claimed she was fast enough to catch even the spirit Leraye, who cursed her for such an insult."
- Fable of Genai's Twenty Trials

Ring_Unique_Barb_100.name: Ring of Red Furor
Ring_Unique_Barb_100.flavor:
"Anger brings strength but clouds the mind. You must learn to focus your fury, direct it with purpose. Keep our sacred duty at the forefront of your mind, always."
- Talic, to Madawc

Ring_Unique_Druid_100.name: Airidah's Inexorable Will
Ring_Unique_Druid_100.flavor:
"When I was born, I breathed in the wind and the storm and they gave me life. When I die, I will breath out, and return that gift to the skies."
- Journal excerpt

Ring_Unique_Rogue_100.name: Writhing Band of Trickery
Ring_Unique_Rogue_100.flavor: The ring shifts and spins on your finger as the forces within desperately attempt to escape.

Ring_Unique_Necro_101.name: Ring of the Sacrilegious Soul
Ring_Unique_Necro_101.flavor: The mere proximity of a practitioner of such dark arts can rouse the dead and disturb those souls who have earned their rest.

QST_Naha_GiantBloodHawks_Item.name: Calcified Heart
QST_Naha_GiantBloodHawks_Item.flavor: Hard as stone and cold as ice. A humid, musky odor radiates from it. Hard to believe the Bloodhawk didn't choke on this...

Ring_Unique_Barb_101.name: Ring of the Ravenous
Ring_Unique_Barb_101.flavor: "The hunger, it starts so small, like a tickle in the back of your mind. You believe the lie that you still have control until you're so far gone you can't even recognize yourself." -Varyana

Helm_Unique_Sorc_100.name: Starfall Coronet
Helm_Unique_Sorc_100.flavor:
"The elders say they saw a star falling from the sky many years ago. A sign from the heavens that the end times were nigh. A rallying cry to take up arms and protect Sanctuary!"
- Crusader Hamilton

S03_Journey_Cache_CH01.name: First Journey Cache
S03_Journey_Cache_CH01.desc: Contains a number of Governing Stones, Tuning Stones, Shattered Stone and Iron Chunks.

S03_Journey_Cache_CH02.name: Second Journey Cache
S03_Journey_Cache_CH02.desc: Contains a number of Governing Stones, Tuning Stones and Scattered Prisms.

S03_Journey_Cache_CH03.name: Third Journey Cache
S03_Journey_Cache_CH03.desc: Contains Pearls of Warding, Governing Stones, Tuning Stones and Legendary Salvage.

S03_Journey_Cache_CH04.name: Fourth Journey Cache
S03_Journey_Cache_CH04.desc: Contains a number of Pearls of Warding, Governing Stones and Tuning Stones.

S03_Journey_Cache_CH05.name: Slayer's Cache
S03_Journey_Cache_CH05.desc: Contains a number of late game resources, Governing Stones, Tuning Stones, Pearls of Warding, and 780 Item Power Ancestral Legendary Items.

S03_Journey_Cache_CH06.name: Champion's Cache
S03_Journey_Cache_CH06.desc: Contains a number of late game resources, Scattered Prisms, Shattered Stone, Pearls of Warding and 925 Item Power Ancestral Legendary Items.

S03_Journey_Cache_CH07.name: Destroyer's Cache
S03_Journey_Cache_CH07.desc: Contains an amount of Shattered Stone, and Pearls of Warding.

S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Tiny.name: Proof of Might
S03_LBD_ScoreItem_Tiny.desc: Collect Proof of Might to increase your score

S03_LBD_ScoreItem_ExtraLarge.name: Proof of Might
S03_LBD_ScoreItem_ExtraLarge.desc: Collect Proof of Might to increase your score

QST_Merc_Hideout_DeadMercJournal.name: Teabryn's Journal
QST_Merc_Hideout_DeadMercJournal.desc: A journal written by the mercenary Teabryn
QST_Merc_Hideout_DeadMercJournal.flavor: I heard it again last night, the whispering one.

Amulet_Unique_Generic_102.name: Blood-Mad Idol
Amulet_Unique_Generic_102.flavor: "The relic was fashioned for the broken-hearted and the battle-mad, for those whose rage has nowhere left to dwell." - Notes from Sister Octavia on the Burnt Knights

S03_Crafting_Cache_Common_Governing_Ston.name: Uncertain Governing Stone Cache
S03_Crafting_Cache_Common_Governing_Ston.desc: Use to reveal a single Governing Stone.

QST_Naha_SevenStones_Micro_01_Egg.name: Rayuhuk's Egg
QST_Naha_SevenStones_Micro_01_Egg.flavor: A large, peculiar egg that's larger than almost two hands. Delicate etchings are inscribed upon the surface. Luckily, it remains warm to the touch.

QST_Naha_GardenOfGods_Artifact.name: Wasipotsu Ceremonial Skull
QST_Naha_GardenOfGods_Artifact.flavor: A skull carved from geode, covered in a thin layer of plaster, and delicately decorated with feathers and gold.

CraftingMaterial_CursedChild_DemonPart_R.name: Demon Horn
CraftingMaterial_CursedChild_DemonPart_R.desc: [PH] Aldkin's Bartering material. Acquired from her mercenary event or purchased from the Traveling Merchant in the Mercenary Hideout.
CraftingMaterial_CursedChild_DemonPart_R.flavor: [PH] A Pristine Horn, radiating demonic power.

CraftingMaterial_Mercenary_Generic.name: Pale Mark
CraftingMaterial_Mercenary_Generic.desc:
Used to {icon:Marker_Bartering, 2.4} {c_important}Barter{/c} in The Den.

{icon:Marker_Bartering, 2.4} {c_important}Bartering{/c} becomes available upon reaching Character level 15 and Rank 5 Rapport with any Mercenary.

QST_Naha_EverythingOld_WoodenRod.name: Rod of Living Hazel Wood
QST_Naha_EverythingOld_WoodenRod.flavor: A roughly-hewn rod of living wood. Said to entrap the demon Beleth when used to inscribe the shape of a triangle.

QST_Naha_EverythingOld_SwordReward.name: Beleth's Bane
QST_Naha_EverythingOld_SwordReward.flavor: Blessed by the spirits and handed down from father to son. The blade that proved anathema to the demon Beleth and broke the curse placed upon Dian and his family, now entrusted to you.

mnt_stor171_trophy.name: [ ph old asset item, new >> uniq97_trophy ] Shield Crest of Exile

QST_S03_Main_01_Kehj_01_Buddy.name: Inert Construct
QST_S03_Main_01_Kehj_01_Buddy.flavor: The metal armature folds into itself neatly. You can strap it to your waist without issue.

QST_Naha_Lacuni_Eye.name: Giant Jeweled Eye
QST_Naha_Lacuni_Eye.flavor: A cat's eye gem - the light reflects a cold fluorescence. The damage suggests it was hewn from its original base. Scavengers are known to pilfer such stones from religious idols in Lower Kurast.

CraftingMaterial_BountyHunter_Intel_Comm.name: Intel
CraftingMaterial_BountyHunter_Intel_Comm.desc: [PH] Subo's Bartering material. Acquired from his mercenary event or purchased from the Traveling Merchant in the Mercenary Hideout.

QST_ITM_Naha_BestialSoulofTeganze_Blosso.name: Dahmu Blossom
QST_ITM_Naha_BestialSoulofTeganze_Blosso.flavor: A rare blossom found on corpses and blood-stained battlefields. It is used in lacuni and native rituals to swell blood in the heart.

x1_Ring_Unique_Rogue_128.name: Pitfighter's Gull
x1_Ring_Unique_Rogue_128.flavor: "Ploughin' told you already! Hidden weapons are out – Yes, especially grenades! Behave yourself, or Morrick will skin you lot."- Purveyor of the Gea Kul fighting pits, on the eve of Morrick's murder

S03_Reward_Cache_Obols.name: Murmuring Cache
S03_Reward_Cache_Obols.flavor: Eerie, ancient, possibly cursed: The murmuring obol is largely used in trade among collectors and occultists. So, naturally, an adventurer should carry plenty.

S03_Governing_Stone_Cache.name: Uncertain Governing Stone Cache
S03_Governing_Stone_Cache.desc: Use to reveal a single Governing Stone.

MountReins_NahantuLion_Cat.name: Reins of the Nahantu Lion
MountReins_NahantuLion_Cat.desc: Use reins to add the Nahantu Lion to your stable.

S03_Crafting_Cache_Generic_Seneschal_Sto.name: Uncertain Seneschal Stone Cache
S03_Crafting_Cache_Generic_Seneschal_Sto.desc: Use to reveal a single Governing or Tuning Stone.

S03_Quest_Cache_Seneschal_Stone.name: Seneschal Stone Cache
S03_Quest_Cache_Seneschal_Stone.desc: Contains an assortment of Governing and Tuning Stones.

S03_Buddy_Unlock_Cache.name: Seneschal Stone Cache
S03_Buddy_Unlock_Cache.desc: Use to reveal a collection of Governing and Tuning Stones.

QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Scroll.name: Moldy Scroll Fragment
QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Scroll.flavor: A ancient scrap of parchment. Most of the archaic words were difficult to understand even before the ravages of time faded them.

QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Armor.name: Shadowclaw Armor
QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Armor.flavor: Ancient Ennead armor, crafted to fit the nangari. It's clear from its age that the creatures have been scavenging and reusing the same pieces for millennia.

QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Eye.name: Magus Eye
QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Eye.flavor: The eye continually weeps a dark, oily ichor. Tiny motes of gold flitter within the iris, giving it an eerie semblance of life.

QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Heart.name: Spitter Heart
QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Heart.flavor: The strange heart of an even stranger nangari. It is covered in veins that bend and curve into unnatural shapes reminiscent of magical runes.

QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Ring.name: Mage Clan Signet
QST_Naha_ScalesOfHistory_Ring.flavor: Despite its age, the quality of its craftsmanship is clear. The signet's image has been worn down to the point of illegibility, rendering its clan identity lost to time.

S03_QST_Reward_Main_05_Cache.name: Seneschal Stone Cache
S03_QST_Reward_Main_05_Cache.desc: Use to reveal a collection of Governing and Tuning Stones.

S03_QST_Reward_Main_09_Cache.name: Seneschal Stone Cache
S03_QST_Reward_Main_09_Cache.desc: Use to reveal a collection of Governing and Tuning Stones.

S03_QST_Reward_Main_10_Cache.name: Seneschal Stone Cache
S03_QST_Reward_Main_10_Cache.desc: Use to reveal a collection of Governing and Tuning Stones.

Helm_Unique_Barb_101_x1.name: Ugly Bastard Helm
Helm_Unique_Barb_101_x1.flavor: "Ah, Burning Hells. You look like one of Zolmog's inbred bastards." -Varyana
