Chest_Unique_Generic_127.name: Tyrael's Might
Chest_Unique_Generic_127.flavor:
"Thus Tyrael, a perfect aspect of Justice, came to be. None were more vehement against the forces of hell. All demonic entities learned to shudder at Justice's might." 
-The Books of Jarl, Volume I

Pants_Unique_Barb_100.name: Arreat's Bearing
Pants_Unique_Barb_100.flavor: "Rise clansmen and reclaim our trampled honor! Ancients' blood runs through us all! We are storms: earth breaking, maelstrom wielding. The fire of the gods burn still! They are with us!" -Ealda

Gloves_Unique_Barb_100.name: Twin Strikes
Gloves_Unique_Barb_100.flavor: "When hitting it once doesn't kill it, hit it twice." -Bear Tribe Proverb

Boots_Unique_Druid_100.name: Wildheart Hunger
Boots_Unique_Druid_100.flavor: Do not seek comfort in the shapes of the moon, beastwalker. Its pallid light awakens a yawning hunger. Call the beast, but do not tarry. Lest you never return to your own skin.

Gloves_Unique_Necro_101.name: Cruor's Embrace
Gloves_Unique_Necro_101.flavor:
In the blood dancer's grasp, a victim lies,
A vessel dried 'neath darkened skies.
Their life extinguished, veins burst and drained,
In Cruor's embrace, forever enchained.

Amulet_Unique_Necro_101.name: Ebonpiercer
Amulet_Unique_Necro_101.flavor: This talisman was the life's work of Deathspeaker Jurdann. Following his premature demise, Jurdann's successor wore the amulet in tribute as they trialed against the Temple of the Deathspeaker.

Ring_Unique_Rogue_102.name: Saboteur's Signet
Ring_Unique_Rogue_102.flavor: "The element of surprise is the starting point. In this moment, be sure to finish it." - Kashya

QST_Naha_SinProxy3_Ritual_Horn.name: Iron Horn
QST_Naha_SinProxy3_Ritual_Horn.flavor: Hard as steel, this legendary beast could pierce boulders as readily as flesh when this adornment was still attached to its skull.

QST_Naha_SinProxy3_Blessed_Horn.name: Consecrated Horn
QST_Naha_SinProxy3_Blessed_Horn.flavor: The horn is still wet with Supa's blood.

Amulet_Unique_Barb_101.name: Unbroken Chain
Amulet_Unique_Barb_101.flavor: After the warmaster Raekor freed her people, the Oxen tribe continued to wear their collars and chains to honor those who died in thralldom under the Samauren Empire.

Chest_Unique_Rogue_101.name: Shroud of Khanduras
Chest_Unique_Rogue_101.flavor: "In fairer times, the Emperor gifted Prince Aidan a gilded shroud. Still a boy, not yet full height, it dwarfed poor Aidan. Briefly, Leoric's growing madness abated from laughter." -Deckard Cain

Boots_Unique_Necro_101.name: Path of Trag'Oul
Boots_Unique_Necro_101.flavor: "Essence flows endlessly, shifting between vessels. It is through Trag'Oul, keeper of all known and unknown, that we serve as custodians, directing essence to travel new paths." -Mendeln ul-Diomed

Pants_Unique_Sorc_101.name: Axial Conduit
Pants_Unique_Sorc_101.flavor: "Do not confuse your manipulation of lightning as control. The azure flame is its own master and needs no hand to wield it. You are merely a conduit for its chaos." -Ascribed to the mage Woh

S05_QST_Rep_Main_01_Reputation_Experienc.name: Mother's Gift
S05_QST_Rep_Main_01_Reputation_Experienc.flavor: A mote of focused hellfire. Your blood boils as you hold it in your hand, though there is no pain. Only power.

S05_QST_Rep_Main_01_Components.name: Fetid Khazra Liver
S05_QST_Rep_Main_01_Components.flavor: Goatman hearts, intestines, and lungs. Collected for unknown, but undoubtedly forbidden, rituals and magics.

X1_QST_2HScythe_FiveHills_Legendary_13.name: Crook of the Grinning Shaman
X1_QST_2HScythe_FiveHills_Legendary_13.flavor: "She hides among the trees, with eyes that never cease. A grin that spreads from cheek to cheek. If you're caught, you're hers to keep."

X1_Consumable_RaidBanner_CriticalDamage.desc: [PH] When applied to a raid banner receptacle, gives clicers a bonus 10% Critical Strike Damage.

X1_Consumable_RaidBanner_ResourceGenerat.desc: [PH] When applied to a raid banner receptacle, gives clickers a bonus 10% Resource Generation.

X1_Consumable_RaidBanner_Resistance.name: [PH] Tonic of Resistance
X1_Consumable_RaidBanner_Resistance.desc: [PH] When applied to a raid banner receptacle, gives clickers a bonus 10% to all Resistances.

X1_Consumable_RaidLevelIncrease.name: Scroll of Khazra Shards
X1_Consumable_RaidLevelIncrease.desc: Use to Increase the level of monsters by 10 and rewards in the Rise of the First Khazra Dark Citadel.

S04_Journey_Cache_CH01_Gear.name: First Journey Equipment Cache
S04_Journey_Cache_CH01_Gear.desc: Contains a Legendary Weapon, Gloves, and Amulet for your class.

S05_BSK_Gloves_Unique_Generic_001.name: Endurant Faith
S05_BSK_Gloves_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Despite the Light's blessings, countless Knights Penitent were hewn apart by the infernal hordes. Remnants of their steel lie scattered through the Hells – dwindling lights in the chaos.

S05_BSK_Helm_Unique_Generic_001.name: Crown of Lucion
S05_BSK_Helm_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: The prince of Hatred, fair as maggots over carrion. He claims no throne, crafts no realms, reigning over only a blackened, bitter heart. Some legends name him banished, while others dread his return.

S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: Shard of Verathiel
S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: This blade once bore divine purpose wielded by the angel Verathiel. Like its keeper, the sword fell to Infernal depths. Yet beneath this corruption, is a heartbeat of a past memory, holding steadfast.

S05_BSK_Boots_Unique_Generic_001.name: Rakanoth's Wake
S05_BSK_Boots_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Tread carefully on the plains of Hell, for each step sunders the soul and shatters the mind.

S05_BSK_Amulet_Unique_Generic_001.name: Locran's Talisman
S05_BSK_Amulet_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.

S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Sorcerer_001.name: Vox Omnium
S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Sorcerer_001.flavor: Your incantations are echoed by a chorus of the damned. Wield their torment, their vengeance, their pain against the Hellborne that tortured them.

S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Barbarian_001.name: The Third Blade
S05_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Barbarian_001.flavor: "Restraint, mercy, honor...these are shackles, forged by the weak and the conquered." -Hephasto, the Armorer

S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Druid_001.name: The Basilisk
S05_BSK_2HStaff_Unique_Druid_001.flavor: "Well did she feed her children, and well did her children feed her." -Scosglen folktale

S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.name: The Umbracrux
S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Bitter voices whisper from the blade.

S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Necro_001.name: The Mortacrux
S05_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Necro_001.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Nearby corpses shudder in its presence.

QST_Hell_Intro_02_Ear.name: Ears of Sankekur
QST_Hell_Intro_02_Ear.flavor: "Light seal the ears that delighted in our cries. Let them hear only silence." - Paladin's prayer

QST_Hell_Intro_02_Tongue.name: Tongue of Sankekur
QST_Hell_Intro_02_Tongue.flavor: "Light bind the tongue that poisoned our Faith. Let it speak for Hatred no more." - Paladin's prayer

Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_001_x1.name: Wound Drinker
Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_001_x1.flavor: The inner curve of this band is lined with thorns that tear the skin whenever it is unbound.

Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_002_x1.name: Ring of Writhing Moon
Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_002_x1.flavor: "Within this corpse-bound carapace we writhe. Chaotic winds converge to churn your bones. Our beat and breath a ceaseless war to break. The wretched cyclone black beyond the bounds." - Balazan's Dream

Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_003_x1.name: Band of First Breath
Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_003_x1.flavor: A gentle whisper glides upon the winds. The words elude the grasp of mortal ken. They weave through the soul like a melody forgotten, and from this arises a name: Adarja, the First-Breather.

Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_004_x1.name: Peacemonger's Signet
Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_004_x1.flavor: "In Natsalarwaka, no blood shall mar the earth. Even bitter enemies must forgo their blades before entering the haven. Breaking this accord will invoke Wasipotsu's wrath." - Oral Oaxazi Scripture

Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_005_x1.name: Ring of the Midday Hunt
Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_005_x1.flavor: "At midday thundered the first brother, Nyamoyo, lord of predators. Survival is his blessing, hunting is his prayer. Honor him and prowess shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse IV

Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_006_x1.name: Ring of the Midnight Sun
Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_006_x1.flavor: "At midnight laughed the second brother, Nebahayomo, spirit of cunning. Trickery is his blessing, suffering is his prayer. Honor him and shrewdness shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse V

mnt_amor04_cat.name: Undercity Temple Barding
mnt_amor04_cat.desc: Armor looted from Golden Snakes was melted down and refashioned into this lavish barding.

X1_2HBow_QST_Teganze_Reward_15.name: Echoing Whisper
X1_2HBow_QST_Teganze_Reward_15.flavor: Each twang of the bowstring emits a faint sound resembling either a chant of thanksgiving, a scream, a bitter accusation, or pious prayer.

X1_Raid_Weekly_Cache_Chaos.name: Dark Citadel Challenger's Cache
X1_Raid_Weekly_Cache_Chaos.desc: A collection of rewards for defeating the Rise of the Khazra, Dark Citadel. Contains gear including Ancestrals, Legendaries, and Uniques, as well as crafting materials, gems, and various currencies.

rune.desc: {c_RuneCondition}Cast Evade.{/c}
{c_RuneCondition}Cast a non-{c_important}Channeled{/c} {c_important}Core{/c} Skill.{/c}

Boots_Unique_Spiritborn_008_x1.name: Scorn of the Earth
Boots_Unique_Spiritborn_008_x1.flavor: "Sky Spirits weave the winds. Thunder is their laughter and auroras their crowns. Those they bless learn to scorn the earth, for from above, it is but a distant memory." - Lintel VII

Gloves_Unique_Spiritborn_007_x1.name: Craze of the Dead God
Gloves_Unique_Spiritborn_007_x1.flavor: T'an seized a spear and drove it thrice into his mad brother Tan. Alas, the craftier of the twin gods wove one last cunning snare. In place of blood, the wound wept venom and consumed all in its wake.

Chest_Unique_Spiritborn_013_x1.name: Jacinth Shell
Chest_Unique_Spiritborn_013_x1.flavor: This ceremonial armor was once adorned during the He Sutsar Puchē, where sacred blood is drawn by jacinth lancets and offered to flames. It retains the scents of incensed smoke and scorched copper.

rune.desc: {c_RuneEffect}Invoke the Sorcerer's {c_important}Frost Nova{/c} Skill, {c_important}{u}Freezing{/u}{/c} enemies.{/c}
{c_RuneEffect}Invoke the Barbarian's {c_important}War Cry{/c} Skill, increasing your damage dealt by {c_number}7.5%{/c} for {c_number}{s1}{/c} seconds.{/c}

X1_QST_2HAxe_ShroudOfWrath_Legendary_Gen.name: Heretic's Executioner
X1_QST_2HAxe_ShroudOfWrath_Legendary_Gen.flavor: This repurposed Zakarum battle-axe was once weilded by the Zealots of Kurast. Now it bears the blood and ashes of those who drew to close to the Burnt Knights.

X1_QST_2HGlaive_Legendary_Spiritborn_010.name: Realmwarden's Scepter
X1_QST_2HGlaive_Legendary_Spiritborn_010.flavor: "As you journey in the Spirit Realm, you will be guided as you cull the spirits that seek to devour you."  - Tarka, the Emissary

BSK_Sigil_UpgradeItem.name: Abyssal Scroll
BSK_Sigil_UpgradeItem.desc: This scroll has no power left. Using it will drop resources for crafting a Nightmare Dungeon Sigil.
BSK_Sigil_UpgradeItem.flavor: A forbidden rite of the Triune used to inscribe an Infernal Compass with special instructions for the journey to Hell.

QST_Naha_ShroudofWrath_TeunisJournal.name: Teunis's Journal
QST_Naha_ShroudofWrath_TeunisJournal.flavor: An ash-stained journal sharing Teunis's plans for Eoric.

mnt_chal005_trophy.name: Abyssal Bastion
mnt_chal005_trophy.desc: Rewards from appearing in the first 20 places in any of the Trial leaderboards.

cmp_base001_bird.name: Dorian
cmp_base001_bird.desc: Using this item adds Dorian to your Companion collection in the Wardrobe.

mnt_amor06_cat.name: Scion of Hatred Barding
mnt_amor06_cat.desc: The Hollow ichor that lines this barding has been magically tamed and frozen in time, both a warning and a threat to all who see it.

Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_014_x1.name: Nesekem, the Herald
Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_014_x1.flavor: In the days when Ajaw Y'ishich ruled Nahantu, the phoenix constellation's crown fell in burning glory. From it was forged a blade that withered valor, heralding an age of despair.

rune.desc: {c_RuneEffect}Invoke the Barbarian's {c_important}Earthquake{/c}, dealing damage to enemies within.{/c}

Merc_TradeAgreement_PlaceholderTooltip_B.name: Trade Agreement: Baleful Fragment
Merc_TradeAgreement_PlaceholderTooltip_B.desc: (PH) There will be a  20% chance an Aspect of Baleful Fragment will appear when Bartering with Raheir.
Merc_TradeAgreement_PlaceholderTooltip_B.flavor: (PH) Baleful Fragments? Treasures in mountains of scrap. You wouldn't believe the junk I've sifted. If boredom had weight, I'd be bench pressing it. - Raheir, the Blacksmith

X1_Raid_ZagraalHead_Cache.desc: Contains various rewards, including a special Mount Trophy.

Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_012_x1.name: Sepazontec
Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_012_x1.flavor: To the silent skies, the hunter Etzlek raised his staff and then smote the numen. "Release her!" came his cries as he desecrated the hallowed ground. On the third strike, the spirit answered...

Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_009_x1.name: Harmony of Ebewaka
Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_009_x1.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.

Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_011_x1.name: Loyalty's Mantle
Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_011_x1.flavor: During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.

SMP_Staff.desc: The cracked and splintered remnants of an old staff. It clearly had magical properties once.
SMP_Staff.flavor: Though its purpose is lost to time, this was once an object of great significance.

SMP_Gem.name: Jabbering Gemstone
SMP_Gem.desc: A cloudy gemstone of unknown origin. Holding it makes you want to talk to someone.
SMP_Gem.flavor: Though its purpose is lost to time, this was once an object of great significance.

SMP_Bell.name: Rusted Old Bell
SMP_Bell.desc: A worn, bloodstained bell. The letter "W" has been crudely carved on one side.
SMP_Bell.flavor: Though its purpose is lost to time, this was once an object of great significance.

S05_QST_Rep_Main_Reward_Focus.name: Istel's Grimoire
S05_QST_Rep_Main_Reward_Focus.flavor: "Remember the power in your own free will, and let no one, angel or demon, take it away from you." – The Gospel of the Mother; Birthrights, Verse 4

QST_Hell_Intro_Talisman.flavor: A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.

QST_Hell_Intro_03_DemonHeart.name: Demonic Heart
QST_Hell_Intro_03_DemonHeart.flavor: Fresh from the chest of a slain demon, still hot to the touch.

Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_010_x1.name: Wushe Nak Pa
Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_010_x1.flavor: "Fear not the limits of your flesh, Spiritborn!  As our ancestors said: wushe nak pa! Transcend your being!" - Maka

Ring_Unique_Druid_102.name: Mjölnic Ryng
Ring_Unique_Druid_102.flavor: A singed wedding band, faintly crackling. It evokes an old rhyme where a bride receives a ring from her beloved, causing them to be struck thrice by lightning. Only the bride was unscathed.

Pants_Unique_Spiritborn_015_x1.flavor: "To commune with spirits, listen to whispers unseen. Root yourself unto the earth and let its pulse still the mind. Hear the ancient guardians – they rise to aid you." -Ysevete, the First Spiritborn

MountReins_Albino_Cat.desc: Use reins to add the Leucistic Panther to your stable.

X1_QST_Boots_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.name: Hatred's March
X1_QST_Boots_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.flavor: "Bruises bloomed over its ribs and burst into hues of wet scarlet when the meat inside came pouring out over my boot. I had sense enough in my frenzy to ensure the thing was dead, at least."

X1_QST_Gloves_Legendary_Generic_HatredSe.name: Hatred's Grasp
X1_QST_Gloves_Legendary_Generic_HatredSe.flavor: "I squeezed and squeezed and squeezed until my knuckles turned white and his breath shuddered to silence at last. I gave him a good death. Bloodless, in the arms of a friend."

X1_QST_Helm_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.name: Hatred's Gaze
X1_QST_Helm_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.flavor: "Our eyes met. I could tell he needed help. I could have given it. I walked away, and savored his screams for mercy."

X1_QST_Pants_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.name: Hatred's Seat
X1_QST_Pants_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.flavor: "I cradled the foal above my knee and held her close as she shook and bled. I told them she would've slowed us down, would've died soon anyway. I did not tell them how sweet her killing was."

X1_QST_Chest_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.name: Hatred's Heart
X1_QST_Chest_Legendary_Generic_HatredSet.flavor: "Hate begets Destruction and Destruction begets Terror, as Terror begets Hate and Hate begets..."

S05_Cultist_Helltide_Reputation_Cache_Mi.desc: Contains an assortment of powerful items and common crafting mats.

Totem_Unique_Druid_101_x1.name: Stone of Vehemen
Totem_Unique_Druid_101_x1.flavor: Long ago, the Stone Clan laid the foundations of Old Kurast. They shaped earthen marvels, but wars with the Vizjerei turned chisel into spear. Now the only stone they wield is when cast against foe.

S05_BSK_1HSword_uniq16_TransmogItem.name: Shard of Verathiel / The Third Blade

S06_RealmwalkerMaterial.name: Seething Shard
S06_RealmwalkerMaterial.desc: Collected during a Seething Breach. Needed to open chests and activate the Portal Altar inside a Realm of Hatred.
S06_RealmwalkerMaterial.flavor: Crystallized hatred coiled in thick tendrils of putrid ichor. The mere sight of it imposes malevolent thoughts.

X1_Undercity_PQ_02_Item_Dagger.name: Snake Fang Dagger
X1_Undercity_PQ_02_Item_Dagger.flavor: This dagger, carved from a fang, is embossed with peculiar runes.

Boots_Unique_Sorc_96.name: Bucrani's Tread
Boots_Unique_Sorc_96.flavor:
"Changing, consuming, becoming: this is the way of all life.
I give myself to you, my children, so that you may live."
Low of Bo'a, Verse 112-113

Chest_Unique_Sorc_96.name: Bucrani's Will
Chest_Unique_Sorc_96.flavor: The leather feels warm to the touch, as through life clings to it. A divine purpose still trembles in each fold.

Gloves_Unique_Sorc_96.name: Bucrani's Grip
Gloves_Unique_Sorc_96.flavor:
"Kin of Bo'a, beloved of Bucrani,
Whose path led into the wine-dark pasture.
The victor's sword swings for this alone,
To lop off all thought and memory–a final mercy."
Low of Bo'a, Verse 50-54

Pants_Unique_Sorc_96.name: Bucrani's Resolve
Pants_Unique_Sorc_96.flavor: "...In those days, the children of Bucrani were known to many. Great was their sway, and mighty was their squall! How could any realm hold such strong souls?" -Oxridge, Common Histories, fragment II

TheUndercityCurrency_01.name: Undercity Currency
TheUndercityCurrency_01.desc: An ancient token used by the Horadrim to enter {c_rare}The Undercity{/c}.
TheUndercityCurrency_01.flavor: A surprisingly light material that glows faintly.

Gem_Diamond_06.flavor: It banishes doubt and compels action.

Gem_Skull_06.name: Royal Skull
Gem_Skull_06.flavor: The dead grant the wisdom they lacked in life.

rune.desc: {c_RuneEffect}Casting a Skill other than a {c_important}Basic{/c} or {c_important}Defensive{/c} Consumes all of your Primary Resource to increase your damage up to {c_number}{s1}%{/c} for {c_number}1{/c} second.{/c}

Helm_Unique_Generic_004.name: Heir of Perdition
Helm_Unique_Generic_004.flavor: Beware false prophets donned as sheep yet bearing the stench of wolves. Thou shalt know them by their fruits. For a tree of good cannot produce evil, nor thorns yield a harvest sweet and fair.

Chest_Unique_Generic_103.name: Shroud of False Death
Chest_Unique_Generic_103.flavor: "Auriel alone saw past Lucion's guise. With Al'maiesh aloft, she smote the vile prince. Hatred's seed feigned death and waited, loath to enter the Abyss again." - The Great Conflict, Tome I

Boots_Unique_Barb_101.name: Hooves of the Mountain God
Boots_Unique_Barb_101.flavor:
Break their bones beneath your weight, 
Fell their walls and breach their gate. 
In his halls we'll boast and sing, 
And praise our honored mountain king!

Gloves_Unique_Rogue_101.name: Wilted Potential
Gloves_Unique_Rogue_101.flavor: A relic of Yorin's ill-starred tempering. Regardless of success, Donan proudly displayed them all upon the mantelpiece... in fairer days.

2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_001.name: Shattered Vow
2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Malthael's last and only gift to mankind - a vow that our suffering shall end.

{c_RuneCondition}Cast {c_number}5{/c} Skills then become exhausted for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{/c}
{c_RuneEffect}Reduce your active Cooldowns by {c_number}{s1}{/c} seconds.

X1_Citadel_CommunityChallenge_BossHead.name: Severed Head of Zagraal
X1_Citadel_CommunityChallenge_BossHead.desc: Travel to Kurast and place the head on the altar to claim the spoils of war.
X1_Citadel_CommunityChallenge_BossHead.flavor: The severed head of the Dark Citadel's ruler, Zagraal.

{c_RuneCondition}Avoid health damage while fighting for 2 seconds.{/c}

X1_Undercity_PQ_01_Scroll.name: [PH] Zakarum Scroll
X1_Undercity_PQ_01_Scroll.flavor: [PH] These scrolls record logistics, inventory, troop orders, and arguments of military philosophy from the days of the Zakarum assault on Kurast. Alia's name is mentioned often, in praise and fear.

X1_Undercity_PQ_02_Blood.name: Golden Snake Blood
X1_Undercity_PQ_02_Blood.flavor: The blood of the magically altered Nangari swirls with oily patterns.

X1_Undercity_PQ_03_Bug.name: Bug Husk
X1_Undercity_PQ_03_Bug.flavor: Patches of a strange fungal material are growing over these chitinous remains.

S06_RealmWalker_Bonus_Cache_00.flavor: Lingering distortion from the seething realmwalker covers your hand on the slightest touch.

X1_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Masterworki.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Earn {c_rare}Obducite{/c} and {c_important}Forgotten Souls{/c} at Attunement Rank 1.

Found from Nightmare Dungeons and The Infernal Hordes.

X1_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_GreaterAffi.desc:

S07_SeasonalCurrency.name: Witch Currency
S07_SeasonalCurrency.desc: Use these to purchase Witch Powers from Altars.

S07_QST_Mind_01_Ritual.name: Ritual of the Mind
S07_QST_Mind_01_Ritual.flavor: Instead, only try to realize the truth... There is no spoon.

Gloves_Unique_Barb_101.name: Bane of Ahjad-Den
Gloves_Unique_Barb_101.flavor: Before Baal's hosts blighted Daken-Shar, the outnumbered northmen clad themselves in barbed mail so that even in death, the demons still bled.

Helm_Unique_Druid_102.name: Gathlen's Birthright
Helm_Unique_Druid_102.flavor: 'Twas Gathlen, most tender warden of the elder realm, who reigneth o'er grove and glade. Whosoever he favors shall inherit the wilds. Utter his name, and be embraced.

Chest_Unique_Barb_101.name: Mantle of Mountain's Fury
Chest_Unique_Barb_101.flavor: "What you feel is the Ancients high on the mountain, my son. When they stomp their feet, the earth trembles! But fear not—it's our enemies they mean to warn." -Chieftess Naarah

Amulet_Unique_Druid_101.name: Malefic Crescent
Amulet_Unique_Druid_101.flavor: "Túr Dúlra sat empty and the Cathedral sent forth two units. The full moon was thought to be a fair omen from the Heavens. They soon learned what else drew from its power." - History of Scosglen VI

1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_100.name: Strike of Stormhorn
1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_100.flavor: The height of the Moon Clan's power brought a beast that instilled dread upon Khanduras. More demon than Khazra, the one dubbed the Stormhorn left charred brands where cities once stood.

Helm_Unique_Sorc_101.name: Hail of Verglas
Helm_Unique_Sorc_101.flavor: "Ere the age of mage and king, storms raged so dread and fell that men named it the wrath of gods. Its hail smote the earth till mountains were wrought..." -Tome recovered from Kasama

Pants_Unique_Necro_101.name: Kessime's Legacy
Pants_Unique_Necro_101.flavor: "Too soon she was taken, yet Rathma let Kessime rest in death, for they both had found peace in the cycle. Upon the hill where she lay, Rathma poured forth his blood and no evil trod thereafter..."

2HSword_Unique_Necro_100.name: Sanguivor, Blade of Zir
2HSword_Unique_Necro_100.flavor: The parched blade keens, longing to serve its master.

Boots_Unique_Rogue_101.name: Assassin's Stride
Boots_Unique_Rogue_101.flavor: The Viz-Jaq'taar descended on the mages indiscriminately and silently as a plague. The wise took flight, whilst the foolish fortified their dwellings as if walls or wards protected from shadow.

Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_100.name: Sunbird's Gorget
Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_100.flavor: Long ago, the Sunbird swallowed the sun whole. In the dark, the Spiritborn Xipil crawled to its nest and tore the sun free from the bird's gullet. Since, its throat was scorched red for its folly.

mnt_amor05_cat.name: Khazra Barding
mnt_amor05_cat.desc: This dark and elegant barding looks to be crafted by the Khazra of the Dark Citadel.

X1_Raid_VendorCache_Gems.desc: Contains random Gems and Gem Fragments.

S07_QST_Mind_01_Reagent.name: Oracle Eye
S07_QST_Mind_01_Reagent.flavor: Even after being separated from its host, the magical eye of the Nangari Oracle continues to silently watch you.

{icon:bullet} Barbarian - Slayer
{icon:bullet} Druid - Werewolf
{icon:bullet} Necromancer - Bone
{icon:bullet} Paladin - Disciple

treasuregoblin_variants_socketable_cache.desc: Contains a large collection of Gem Fragments and Runes.

treasuregoblin_variants_gelatinous_cache.name: Syrus's Heaping Bag

X2_Fish_Generic_Common_01.name: Saltfin
X2_Fish_Generic_Common_01.desc: A Common fish found throughout Sanctuary.
X2_Fish_Generic_Common_01.flavor: Saltfins are a lean, yet reliable staple food, tolerated in meals from Scosglen to Skovos.

X2_Fish_Generic_Common_02.name: Bluescale
X2_Fish_Generic_Common_02.desc: A Common fish found throughout Sanctuary.
X2_Fish_Generic_Common_02.flavor: Its tough, azure skin may draw the eye but it makes for poor fillets. Better to stew them or mount them on the wall.

X2_Fish_Generic_Common_03.name: Glimmer
X2_Fish_Generic_Common_03.desc: A Common fish found throughout Sanctuary.
X2_Fish_Generic_Common_03.flavor: Often seen as flickers of light just below the surface, Glimmers travel in large schools. Easy prey for a well-cast lure.

X2_Fish_Generic_Magic_01.name: Silverbelly
X2_Fish_Generic_Magic_01.desc: A Magic fish found throughout Sanctuary.
X2_Fish_Generic_Magic_01.flavor: A fine catch for a professional fisher, the Silverbelly fetches a high price at any market.

X2_Fish_Generic_Magic_02.name: Darkling
X2_Fish_Generic_Magic_02.desc: A Magic fish found throughout Sanctuary.
X2_Fish_Generic_Magic_02.flavor: An elusive bottom-feeder, rarely tempted to the surface, the Darkling's meat is fatty and rich...even "sinful" by some standards.

X2_Fish_Scosglen_Legendary_A1.name: Tiny Drakonbeard
X2_Fish_Scosglen_Legendary_A1.desc: A Legendary fish found in Scosglen.
X2_Fish_Scosglen_Legendary_A1.flavor: For many young Glenfolk, it is a rite of passage to dive into the Frozen Sea and wrestle a Drakonbeard back to shore. Scars gouged by its bony spines are badges of high honor.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.name: Ector's Gift
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.desc:
{c_label}Item:{/c} Receive Ector's Bag of Materials, a Goblin Cache containing a large collection of Crafting Materials. 

{c_label}Upgrade:{/c} Also slightly increases the chance for Treasure Goblins to drop Treasure Bags during March of the Goblins.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.name: Murl's Gift
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.desc:
{c_label}Item:{/c} Receive Murl's Bag of Obols, a Goblin Cache containing a large collection of Murmuring Obols. 

{c_label}Upgrade:{/c} Also slightly increases the chance for Treasure Goblins to drop Treasure Bags during March of the Goblins.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.name: Prym's Gift
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.desc:
{c_label}Item:{/c} Receive Prym's Bag of Shiny, a Goblin Cache containing a large collection of Gem Fragments and Runes. 

{c_label}Upgrade:{/c} Also slightly increases the chance for Treasure Goblins to drop Treasure Bags during March of the Goblins.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.name: Fedric's Gift
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Ba.desc:
{c_label}Item:{/c} Receive Fedric's Masterpiece, a Goblin Cache containing a Resplendent Spark and several Runes. 

{c_label}Upgrade:{/c} Also slightly increases the chance for Treasure Goblins to drop Treasure Bags during March of the Goblins.

LTE_Goblin_Cache_X1_Legendary.name: Greater Treasure Bag
LTE_Goblin_Cache_X1_Legendary.desc: A bag packed full of treasure left behind by a slain Treasure Goblin.

DungeonAffix_TreasureHunt_RewardCache.name: Horadric Reward Cache
DungeonAffix_TreasureHunt_RewardCache.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Repeat_Ca.name: Unceasing Goblin Gift
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Repeat_Ca.desc: A cache containing a collection of highly valuable rewards such as Runes and an Ancestral Item in Torment Difficulty Levels.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Repeat_Le.name: Goblin's Unceasing Rune Cache
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Repeat_Le.desc: A random assortment of Legendary, Rare, and Magic Runes retrieved from Goblins.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Repeat_Le.name: Goblin's Unceasing Kurast Undercity Tributes
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Repeat_Le.desc: An assortment of Legendary Tributes to use at the altar in Kurast, with a chance for a Tribute of Ascendance.

S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Em.name: March of the Goblins Emblem
S07_LTE_MOTG_Reputation_Reward_Goblin_Em.desc: If not earned from a previous March of the Goblins event, receive a March of the Goblins Emblem equippable in your profile.

Archetype_Cache_Mystery.name: Mystery Archetype Cache
Archetype_Cache_Mystery.desc: Grants a random archetype cache of your class.
Archetype_Cache_Mystery.flavor: The path to Hell will be paved with the blood of demons. How they are to be slaughtered is yet to be written.

Resplendent_Cache.name: Resplendent Cache {icon:AttributeBullet_GreaterAffix,1.5}
Resplendent_Cache.desc: Contains a wondrous assortment of items, currencies, and a resplendent spark.
Resplendent_Cache.flavor: Inside lies the spoils of those bound for glory.

Currency_Cache.name: Currency Cache
Currency_Cache.desc: Contains gold, murmuring obols, gem fragments, and various common crafting materials.
Currency_Cache.flavor: An assortment of odds and ends that would pique only the interest of an adventurer.

S08_Reputation_Cache_Lair.name: Lair Cache
S08_Reputation_Cache_Lair.desc: Contains lesser Lair Boss summoning materials, as well as Unique items as if you had defeated one.
S08_Reputation_Cache_Lair.flavor: Stolen from the bowels of maleficence itself.

S08_Reputation_Cache_Lair_Greater.name: Greater Lair Cache
S08_Reputation_Cache_Lair_Greater.desc: Contains greater Lair Boss summoning materials, as well as Unique items as if you had defeated one.
S08_Reputation_Cache_Lair_Greater.flavor: Born of the most vile darkness and wrapped in lies.

Masterwork_Cache.name: Masterwork Cache
Masterwork_Cache.desc: Contains a trove of materials necessary to masterwork gear, such as obducite.
Masterwork_Cache.flavor: Shiny baubles gathered from all over Sanctuary have somehow made their way into this receptacle.

S08_Reputation_Cache_Spectral.name: Spectral Cache
S08_Reputation_Cache_Spectral.desc: Contains elixirs, gear, and spectral ash.
S08_Reputation_Cache_Spectral.flavor: Eerie waves dance across the surface of this reliquary.

QST_Skov_Celestia_Recipe_Item_01.name: [PH] Ibenian Focus
QST_Skov_Celestia_Recipe_Item_01.flavor: [PH] A small, multi-paned mirror bound within a brass frame. The frame is inscribed with countless, impossibly precise sigils.

S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_01_CelestialS.name: Celestial Surge
S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_01_CelestialS.desc: Grants or upgrades the Catalyst Celestial Surge.

S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_02_Disintegra.name: Disintegrate
S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_02_Disintegra.desc: Grants or upgrades the Catalyst Disintegrate.

S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_03_Propulsion.name: Propulsion
S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_03_Propulsion.desc: Grants or upgrades the Catalyst Propulsion.

S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_04_SolarFlare.name: Solar Flare
S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_04_SolarFlare.desc: Grants or upgrades the Catalyst Solar Flare.

S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_05_CosmicAber.name: Cosmic Anomaly
S09_HoradricPower_Catalyst_05_CosmicAber.desc: Grants or upgrades the Catalyst Cosmic Anomaly.

cmp_base000_catDomestic.name: Iris
cmp_base000_catDomestic.desc: Using this item adds Iris to your Companion collection in the Wardrobe.
cmp_base000_catDomestic.flavor: "Maybe she'll eat my entrails one day. Maybe not. It's just nice having a companion around." -Lyndon

2HMace_Unique_Druid_100.name: Rotting Lightbringer
2HMace_Unique_Druid_100.flavor: "The Cathedral fled south, leaving sanctums hollow and songs unsung. What was left - stone, silver, and sanctified relics - were claimed and bent to the will of elder root and spirit." - Bryona

Gloves_Unique_Necro_102.name: The Hand of Naz
Gloves_Unique_Necro_102.flavor: Legends say that the Hand of Naz was not made, but cursed into being. Woe to the living who unearth it, for the price is the same regardless of form. The cavity where a gem once lay is empty.

Amulet_Unique_Sorc_102.name: Ophidian Iris
Amulet_Unique_Sorc_102.flavor: "Threefold was the sight of Oriax. He stirred the wrath of his lord Baal, and his eyes were torn and cast into the dust. Lo, the viper now crawls blind, writhing in misery." - Librarius Ex Horadrim

Pants_Unique_Spiritborn_100.name: Balazan's Maxtlatl
Pants_Unique_Spiritborn_100.flavor: "Know the dangers of fang and root. One hides in the leaf, the berry, the still water. The other waits in the bite, the stinger, the wound." - Teachings of Balazan, Verse III

S08_QST_Main_02_FlayedMask.name: Flayed Mask
S08_QST_Main_02_FlayedMask.flavor: The Flayed Mask is made of human skin from a holy man. It was used by cultists to commune with Belial.

X2_PROTOTYPE_Mote_Small.name: [PH] Conviction
X2_PROTOTYPE_Mote_Small.desc: Collect [PH] Conviction to bring desire to reality

X2_PROTOTYPE_Mote_Large.name: [PH] Conviction
X2_PROTOTYPE_Mote_Large.desc: Collect [PH] Conviction to bring desire to reality

Gloves_Unique_Rogue_102.name: Bands of Ichorous Rose
Gloves_Unique_Rogue_102.flavor: From the stump of the Blood Rose oozes a foul and black ichor—bane to flesh and blood. Blade and hide treated in the toxics are worth the fortunes of kings.

S08_Journey_Cache_CH01_Crafting.name: Season Journey Crafting Cache
S08_Journey_Cache_CH01_Crafting.desc: Contains Crafting Materials, such as Herbs and Gem Fragments.

S08_Journey_Cache_CH01_Elixir.name: First Journey Cache
S08_Journey_Cache_CH01_Elixir.desc: Contains Consumables, such as Elixirs and Whispering Keys.

S08_Journey_Cache.name: Journey Cache
S08_Journey_Cache.desc: Contains an assortment of useful goods to aid you on your Journey

S08_Journey_Cache_Greater.name: Greater Journey Cache
S08_Journey_Cache_Greater.desc: Contains an assortment of very useful goods to aid you on your Journey

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_01_FloatyBobble.name: Floaty Bobble
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_01_FloatyBobble.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized blink effect that grants {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c}.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_01_FloatyBobble.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S08_Vendor_Reputation_Scroll.name: Oath Scroll
S08_Vendor_Reputation_Scroll.desc: Awards a small amount of {c_important}Unveiler's Oath Reputation{/c}.
S08_Vendor_Reputation_Scroll.flavor: Shatter the deceiver's illusions to reveal the truth once more.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_02_NightmareOrb.name: Nightmare Orb
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_02_NightmareOrb.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized Fear effect.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_02_NightmareOrb.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_03_FrigidHeart.name: Frigid Heart
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_03_FrigidHeart.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

QST_X2_Lycander_Sightless_02_Honey.name: Mad Honey
QST_X2_Lycander_Sightless_02_Honey.flavor: The crimson-gold nectar produced by wasps and wild bees that drink from the azaleas native to Skovos. To the tongue, it burns like vinegar and creates a tingling numbness.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_04_PressurizedS.name: Pressurized Steam
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_04_PressurizedS.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized Stun effect.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_04_PressurizedS.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_Starter_Reputation_Cache.name: Horadric Spellcraft
S09_Starter_Reputation_Cache.desc: Claim to unlock the Celestial Surge Catalyst and the Thunderous Particle Infusion as well as obtain a cache with a few simple items.
S09_Starter_Reputation_Cache.flavor: Countless apprentices have begun their training with the secret arts contained within.

S09_Horadric_Reputation_00_IntroWeapon.name: Simple Cache
S09_Horadric_Reputation_00_IntroWeapon.desc: Contains a few simple items to help you on your way.

S09_Reputation_ToxicInfusion.name: Rare Arcana
S09_Reputation_ToxicInfusion.desc: Claiming this allows Rare Arcana to drop from Horadric Strongroom rewards and grants a Random Archetype Cache for your class.
S09_Reputation_ToxicInfusion.flavor: "Magick, open palm of Justice." So says our creed. To protect, we must destroy.

S09_Reputation_RareArcana.name: More Horadric Phials
S09_Reputation_RareArcana.desc: Obtain a Currency Cache and increase the amount of Horadric Phials dropped from all sources.
S09_Reputation_RareArcana.flavor: Power can be wrought from nigh anything, if one knows how to seek it.

S09_Reputation_FrostInfusion.name: [PH] Gloom Infusion
S09_Reputation_FrostInfusion.desc: [PH] Grants the Gloom Infusion for use with your Horadric Power and more Seasonal Currency now drops.
S09_Reputation_FrostInfusion.flavor: [PH] Some secrets are so dark, so hidden, you must access the coldest, loneliest reaches to find them.

S09_Reputation_LegendaryArcana.name: Legendary Arcana
S09_Reputation_LegendaryArcana.desc: Obtain a Currency Cache and allow Legendary Arcana to start dropping from Horadric Strongroom rewards.
S09_Reputation_LegendaryArcana.flavor: Delve ever deeper into the mysteries of the Horadrim's power.

S09_Reputation_FlameInfusion.name: Smoldering Ember
S09_Reputation_FlameInfusion.desc: Grants a random Archetype Cache for your class and unlocks the Smoldering Ember Infusion for use with your Horadric Spellcraft.
S09_Reputation_FlameInfusion.flavor: A dark enough secret can burn your soul from the inside out.

S09_Reputation_GloomInfusion.name: Nebulous Extract
S09_Reputation_GloomInfusion.desc: Grants the Nebulous Extract Infusion for use with your Horadric Spellcraft and a random Archetype Cache for your class.
S09_Reputation_GloomInfusion.flavor: A secret kept in the shadows, unseen by all.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_05_BloodyCharm.name: Bloody Charm
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_05_BloodyCharm.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized Execute effect for non-Boss enemies.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_05_BloodyCharm.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

QST_Temis_Fighters_02_Heart.name: Hemlock Heart
QST_Temis_Fighters_02_Heart.flavor: A misshapen lump of wood, still pulsing and oozing sap.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_06_GleamingCond.name: Gleaming Conduit
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_06_GleamingCond.desc: The effect size of your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} is increased.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_06_GleamingCond.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_07_FracturedCor.name: Fractured Core
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_07_FracturedCor.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} deactivates monster {c_important}Damage Resistance Aura{/c} effects for a time, but you take stacking damage for the same duration.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_07_FracturedCor.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

X2_Prototype_APS_Infinite.name: APS Infinite Quest
X2_Prototype_APS_Infinite.desc: Starts an Infinite quest to help us prototype APS

X2_Prototype_APS_Choice.name: APS Planned Choice
X2_Prototype_APS_Choice.desc: Starts a quest to help us prototype APS where you choose your activities

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_08_SappingCrux.name: Sapping Crux
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_08_SappingCrux.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_09_PotentAlloy.name: Potent Alloy
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_09_PotentAlloy.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} destroys enemy {c_important}{u}Barriers{/u}{/c} and Knocks them Down for a time after the removal.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_09_PotentAlloy.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_10_SiphoningGiz.name: Siphoning Gizmo
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_10_SiphoningGiz.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} has a chance to consume Damage-Over-Time effects and deal a percent of their damage instantly.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_10_SiphoningGiz.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_11_TendrilousBu.name: Tendrilous Bundle
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_11_TendrilousBu.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damage from your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} has a chance to Immobilize for a time.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_11_TendrilousBu.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_Horadric_Currency.name: Horadric Phial
S09_Horadric_Currency.desc: Use it to upgrade your Horadric Spells, craft Arcana, or assemble Horadric Jewels.
S09_Horadric_Currency.flavor: Each contains magical bits and bobs, thrumming with potential.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_12_TranquilSton.name: Tranquil Stone
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_12_TranquilSton.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for a time.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_12_TranquilSton.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_13_ShiftingPowd.name: Shifting Powder
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_13_ShiftingPowd.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} increases your Movement Speed during its effect and for a time after it ends.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_13_ShiftingPowd.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

X2_EA_DungeonSigil.name: [PH] Echoing Abyss Key
X2_EA_DungeonSigil.desc: [PH] Use to activate the Echoing Abyss.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_14_LuminousGem.name: Luminous Gem
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_14_LuminousGem.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} will {c_important}{u}Daze{/u}{/c} enemies it damages for a time.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_14_LuminousGem.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_15_MurkyEssence.name: Murky Essence
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_15_MurkyEssence.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} for a time.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_15_MurkyEssence.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_16_Invigorating.name: Invigorating Helix
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_16_Invigorating.desc: Once per enemy, every few seconds, damage from your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} will {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} and Heal you for a percent of your Maximum Life.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_16_Invigorating.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.name: Elemental Finesse - Day
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.desc: Affixes can be applied to Weapons, Gloves, Rings, and Amulets.
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.name: Elemental Finesse - Day
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.desc: Affixes can be applied to Weapons, Gloves, Rings, and Amulets.
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.name: Elemental Finesse — Day
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.desc: Affixes can be applied to Weapons, Gloves, Rings, and Amulets.
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.name: Elemental Finesse - Night
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.desc: Affixes can be applied to Weapons, Gloves, Rings, and Amulets.
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.name: Elemental Finesse - Night
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.desc: Affixes can be applied to Weapons, Gloves, Rings, and Amulets.
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.name: Elemental Finesse — Night
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.desc: Affixes can be applied to Weapons, Gloves, Rings, and Amulets.
Tempering_Generic_Offensive_Damage_Eleme.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_17_BottledWind.name: Bottled Wind
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_17_BottledWind.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} equal to a percent of your Maximum Life for a time. It can reflect projectiles.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_17_BottledWind.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_18_JaggedBrambl.name: Jagged Bramble
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_18_JaggedBrambl.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damage from your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} has a chance to deal a percent of your Thorns damage.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_18_JaggedBrambl.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

X2_Fish_AddOn_01.name: Molten Martyr
X2_Fish_AddOn_01.desc: A Mythic Unique fish found in pools of lava.
X2_Fish_AddOn_01.flavor: Legend has it the Triune once captured a Zakarum elder and held him over the cauldron's edge. When he refused to renounce the Light, they cast him down – to burn until the Light came to save him.

MountReins_AcolyteBoss_chimera.name: Reins of the Huntsman's Basilisk
MountReins_AcolyteBoss_chimera.desc: Use these reins to add the Huntsman's Basilisk to your stable.
MountReins_AcolyteBoss_chimera.flavor: Basilisks do not bow their heads to the kind or the pure of heart; they only show loyalty to the powerful.

X2_Fish_AddOn_02.name: Ghoulworm
X2_Fish_AddOn_02.desc: A Mythic Unique fish found in pools of blood.
X2_Fish_AddOn_02.flavor: For generations, folk have warned their children to avoid bloodied waters, lest the Ghoulworm snatch them away. Most deem this a fable, told to keep the young safe from disease. Others know better.

X2_Fish_AddOn_03.name: Fang of Tathamet
X2_Fish_AddOn_03.desc: A Mythic Unique fish found in Helltides.
X2_Fish_AddOn_03.flavor: All manner of infernal creatures have been rising with the Tides. Some had never before seen the light of Sanctuary, drawing them out of their abyssal depths for the very first time.

X2_Fish_AddOn_04.name: Dune Thresher Hatchling
X2_Fish_AddOn_04.desc: A Mythic Unique fish found in sandy dunes.
X2_Fish_AddOn_04.flavor: "Soft-headed scholars call them beasts, but they're demons I tell you! Summoned straight from Hell! Think about it. Have you ever seen a baby Dune Thresher? No one has!" - Meshif

X2_Fish_AddOn_05.name: Vivid Whimsy
X2_Fish_AddOn_05.desc: A Mythic Unique fish found somewhere in Sanctuary.
X2_Fish_AddOn_05.flavor: Such a glimpse of color and life is the stuff of legend in Sanctuary. It is said that to catch a Whimsy is to be granted a wish – the kind that children make and adults tend to forget.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_19_ReactiveOoze.name: Reactive Ooze
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_19_ReactiveOoze.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants Maximum Resource Generation per second for a time.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_19_ReactiveOoze.flavor: This only unlocks this Arcana. Attempting to craft an already unlocked Arcana will be refunded.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_20_VolatileCrys.name: Volatile Crystal
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_20_VolatileCrys.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants Resistance and Maximum Resistance to the Element of your {c_important}Infusion{/c} for a time.

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic01_01.name: Phoba of Slaughter
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic01_01.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

X2_Fish_Junk_SeaWeed.name: Clump of Seaweed
X2_Fish_Junk_SeaWeed.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_SeaWeed.flavor: Boil it for a few hours, it could almost be edible.

X2_Fish_Junk_Stick.name: Stick
X2_Fish_Junk_Stick.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_Stick.flavor: One could wield it... but should one?

X2_Fish_Junk_Journal.name: Waterlogged Journal
X2_Fish_Junk_Journal.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_Journal.flavor: The pages have long since turned to pulp. Whatever secrets they contained are lost forever – safe from prying eyes.

X2_Fish_Junk_LostAmulet.name: Lost Amulet
X2_Fish_Junk_LostAmulet.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostAmulet.flavor: The face on the pendant stares out in sadness. It is as though she knows she is lost.

X2_Fish_Junk_LostTrinkets.name: Cheap Bangles
X2_Fish_Junk_LostTrinkets.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostTrinkets.flavor: A few tangled bracelets of iron and tin.

X2_Fish_Junk_LostKey.name: Useless Key
X2_Fish_Junk_LostKey.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostKey.flavor: What is a key without a lock?

X2_Fish_Junk_LostChalice.name: Holy Chalice
X2_Fish_Junk_LostChalice.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostChalice.flavor: Hardly the cup of a carpenter. Perhaps a king?

X2_Fish_Junk_LostScroll.name: Faded Scroll
X2_Fish_Junk_LostScroll.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostScroll.flavor: It could have been a demonic incantation or a dinner invitation. We will never know.

X2_Fish_Junk_LostAxe.name: Old Hatchet
X2_Fish_Junk_LostAxe.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostAxe.flavor: It's quite a feat to catch a hatchet with a fish hook. Well done.

X2_Fish_Junk_CrackedStone.name: Rock
X2_Fish_Junk_CrackedStone.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_CrackedStone.flavor: It felt heavy enough to be a rather large fish. Shame.

X2_Fish_Junk_BrokenBottle.name: Broken Bottle
X2_Fish_Junk_BrokenBottle.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_BrokenBottle.flavor: No message. No moonshine. Just a broken bottle.

X2_Fish_Junk_LostShield.name: Ruined Shield
X2_Fish_Junk_LostShield.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostShield.flavor: A scarred relic of a forgotten battle.

X2_Fish_Junk_LostRing.name: Engagement Ring
X2_Fish_Junk_LostRing.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostRing.flavor: Perhaps it wasn't meant to be.

X2_Fish_Junk_LostKnife.name: Lost Dagger
X2_Fish_Junk_LostKnife.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostKnife.flavor: Why would anyone throw a perfectly good, blood-stained dagger into a body of water?

X2_Fish_Junk_LostSailor.name: Sailor's Head
X2_Fish_Junk_LostSailor.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_LostSailor.flavor: A nameless victim, cast to the deep. There is no way to notify their loved ones... but the gold teeth may be worth something to someone.

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic02_01.name: Phoba of Lethality
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic02_01.flavor: "The Ancients have much to say on the subject of killing. Its impact on the heart. If one must do it, it is best done quickly. Phoba intent on mercy." -Jered Cain

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic03_01.name: Phoba of Cruel Fate
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic03_01.flavor: "'Fer' is easier said than mastered. The Ammuit teach us that the Mind plays tricks most often on itself. It's a bastard of a problem." -Iben Fahd

X2_Fish_Junk_WornNet.name: Torn Net
X2_Fish_Junk_WornNet.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_WornNet.flavor: A bitter irony, to catch a net.

X2_Fish_Junk_BrokenFishingPole.name: Broken Fishing Pole
X2_Fish_Junk_BrokenFishingPole.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_BrokenFishingPole.flavor: Whether snapped by a big fish or broken in anger, this was a bad day on the water.

X2_Fish_Junk_CowBell.name: Rusty Cow Bell
X2_Fish_Junk_CowBell.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.
X2_Fish_Junk_CowBell.flavor: One might wonder what happened to the cow.

X2_Fish_Junk_OldBoot.name: Old Boot
X2_Fish_Junk_OldBoot.desc: This can be sold to a vendor for Gold.

X2_TSE_Mote_Major.name: [PH] Conviction
X2_TSE_Mote_Major.desc: Collect [PH] Conviction to bring desire to reality

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic04_01.name: Phoba of Deceptive Insight
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic04_01.flavor: "Linta. The Voice is one's Phoba and Fer, projected from Mlor to carry their intention. Be certain what you intend, and deceive only your opponent. Never yourself." -Tal Rasha

S10_Helm_Unique_Druid_100_Chest.name: Tempest Roar
S10_Helm_Unique_Druid_100_Chest.flavor:
"Listen, child, to the music of the storm. It has its own rhythm. Its own melody. Hear how beautifully it sings, and perhaps one day you will be able to join in its harmony."
– Airidah

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic05_01.name: Phoba of Bone Breaking
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic05_01.flavor: "Mlor. The Body. A mage must learn to govern each reflex, each fiber, each bone in themselves. Then, with empathy, they may govern it in others." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic06_01.name: Phoba of Dark Pact
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic06_01.flavor: "Berú... The purest, strongest, and most perilous aspect of the mage is their Soul. Our work demands that we risk it for the greater good. When and how is your choice." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic07_01.name: Phoba of Survival
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic07_01.flavor: "We high-minded mages like to think of ourselves as enlightened. But put the screws to any one of us, and Mlor takes over. The body's animal imperative to live." -Iben Fahd

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic08_01.name: Phoba of Adept Action
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic08_01.flavor: "Phoba, Fer. Emotion and Mind. These form the root of a mage's intention, no matter the medium. Focus first upon these, and put all ambition aside." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic09_01.name: Phoba of Mastery
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic09_01.flavor: "Phoba, Fer. Emotion and Mind. These form the root of a mage's intention, no matter the medium. Focus first upon these, and put all ambition aside." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic10_01.name: Phoba of Practiced Technique
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic10_01.flavor: "Phoba, Fer. Emotion and Mind. These form the root of a mage's intention, no matter the medium. Focus first upon these, and put all ambition aside." -Tal Rasha

S10_Helm_Unique_Druid_101_Chest.name: Vasily's Prayer
S10_Helm_Unique_Druid_101_Chest.flavor:
"Roots from the Great Oak growing at the seaward statue of Vasily will, on rare occasions, be found twisted back upon themselves, suffused with ferocious magic."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

S09_Main_01_ Horadric_WF_Item.name: Horadric Wayfinder
S09_Main_01_ Horadric_WF_Item.flavor: Magic pulses through rivulets carved into the stone of the device. You recognize it to be Horadric.

Found randomly in Sanctuary.

S09_Socketable_14.name: Elemental Brand
S09_Socketable_14.desc: Can be inserted into {c_important}Jewelry{/c} with Sockets.

S09_Socketable_15.name: The Starflux
S09_Socketable_15.desc: Can be inserted into {c_important}Jewelry{/c} with Sockets.
S09_Socketable_15.flavor: No power stronger. No burden greater. The weight of the sky falls upon your shoulders.

S09_HoradricSecrets_01_C_ClueItem.name: Bandit's Scrawl
S09_HoradricSecrets_01_C_ClueItem.flavor: Looted this stone off that dead Horadrim rotting in Kor Valar. It felt valuable. Thing is worthless in the end. Should've taken the damn shield...

S09_HoradricSecrets_02_B_ClueItem.name: Torn Scroll
S09_HoradricSecrets_02_B_ClueItem.flavor: The letter we found is astonishing! I wouldn't believe it if I hadn't seen it myself. I've sent it to our colleagues at the library near Caldeum for proper archiving.

X2_Boots_Legendary_Generic_base15.flavor: "Without a weapon, I am still a deadly warrior. Without armor, I can still take a fatal blow. But without a pair of quality boots? I am merely a man with bloody feet." -Philios

X2_Chest_Legendary_Generic_base15.name: Plackart of Hefaetrus
X2_Chest_Legendary_Generic_base15.flavor: "She is a mountain—strong and beautiful, with a fury that rains fire. But, navigate that fury, and you may find she has treasures to share, like the armor I wear on my chest." -Hefaetrus

X2_Gloves_Legendary_Generic_base15.name: Bracers of Athulua
X2_Gloves_Legendary_Generic_base15.flavor: "Nothing phases Athulua. During a terrible storm, with brutal hail and thunder clapping all around, I saw her stand in the open. Arms spread. Laughing. It was a divine sight." -Kethryes

X2_Helm_Legendary_Generic_base15.name: Helm of Askarra
X2_Helm_Legendary_Generic_base15.flavor: "Early in our courtship, Philios gifted me a dress of satin. I tore it in half before his eyes. The next day, he gifted me the helmet I wear now. That's when I knew he understood me." -Askarra

X2_Pants_Legendary_Generic_base15.name: Leggings of Karcheus
X2_Pants_Legendary_Generic_base15.flavor: "For all his talk of mirrors, I never see Karcheus gaze at his own reflection. I once asked him about this and he said, 'It shows too much.'" -Philios

PTR_CheatVendor_NightmareEscalation.name: PTR Cache - Nightmare Escalation Sigils
PTR_CheatVendor_NightmareEscalation.desc: Contains a few Nightmare Escalation Sigils.
PTR_CheatVendor_NightmareEscalation.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_LairKeys.name: PTR Cache - Lair Keys
PTR_CheatVendor_LairKeys.desc: Contains a great deal of Lair Keys to claim rewards at the Lair Hoard of each Lair Boss.
PTR_CheatVendor_LairKeys.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_Tributes.name: PTR Cache - Tributes
PTR_CheatVendor_Tributes.desc: Contains a great deal of Tributes to delve into the Kurast Undercity.
PTR_CheatVendor_Tributes.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_InfernalCompasses.name: PTR Cache - Infernal Compasses
PTR_CheatVendor_InfernalCompasses.desc: Contains a great deal of Infernal Horde Compasses.
PTR_CheatVendor_InfernalCompasses.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

1HFocus_Unique_Necro_100.name: Gospel of the Devotee
1HFocus_Unique_Necro_100.flavor: "Tremble not before the one who has mastered a thousand incantations. Tremble before the one who has made a single spell his gospel, his body, his breath." -One Who Never Sleeps

1HSword_Unique_Barb_103.name: Sabre of Tsasgal
1HSword_Unique_Barb_103.flavor: A foul blizzard trapped the clans after the Battle of Nine Winters. Then came a pale stallion born of the peaks, and the storm parted before him. Tsasgal, they named him - chief of all horses.

Gloves_Unique_Spiritborn_100.name: Hesha e Kesungi
Gloves_Unique_Spiritborn_100.flavor: Wreathed in bark and bone, these gauntlets carry the strength of old simian spirits - wardens of root and canopy.

Pants_Unique_Druid_002.name: Kilt of Blackwing
Pants_Unique_Druid_002.flavor: "The moors once belonged to the raven-changelings, child. They came with the full moon and read fate through the eyes of the dead. But that time has withered. Their songs are stilled." - Airidah

Ring_Unique_Sorc_102.name: Galvanic Azurite
Ring_Unique_Sorc_102.flavor: "This gem acts as a conduit for aetheric filaments, enabling the wielder to summon atmospheric discharge at will." - Excerpt from Volatus Arcanum: Of Skybinding and Stormcraft

X2_Fish_AddOn_QST_Fish.name: The Red-Eyed Fish
X2_Fish_AddOn_QST_Fish.flavor: Even dead, its eyes glow a menacing red, just as Shi Yugong described from his dream. It feels as though it wants something...a hunger that will never be satisfied.

QST_Skov_Temis_Jaws_01_QuestItem.name: Chewed Arm
QST_Skov_Temis_Jaws_01_QuestItem.flavor: An arm, chewed and bloodied. Sailor tattoos run up and down the remaining skin.

Recipe_Elixir_Mad_Honey.name: [PH] Recipe: Elixir of Mad Honey
Recipe_Elixir_Mad_Honey.desc: [PH] Bring to an Alchemist to teach them to craft Mad Honey

Elixir_Mad_Honey.name: [PH] Mad Honey
Elixir_Mad_Honey.desc: This elixir has no power left but has a high sell value.

S09_Socketable_16.name: Willbreaker
S09_Socketable_16.desc: Can be inserted into {c_important}Jewelry{/c} with Sockets.
S09_Socketable_16.flavor: Nothing can stand against you—there's nothing that strong.

S09_SocketableRecipe_16.name: Willbreaker Tome
S09_SocketableRecipe_16.desc: Contains knowledge required to craft the Jewel {c_important}Willbreaker{/c} at the {c_important}Horadric Lapidary{/c}.

mnt_uniq81_trophy.name: Monstrosity's Head
mnt_uniq81_trophy.flavor: "I see a lion, a dog, and—is that a ferret? Still, I will only pay you for one head. S'only fair." -Merchant in Temis

mnt_uniq84_trophy.name: Dangerous Catch
mnt_uniq84_trophy.flavor: "Killed one beast. Got two heads. Good deal." -Artok the Barbarian

Tempering_Druid_Utility_Bear_Tier1.name: Werebear Innovation
Tempering_Druid_Utility_Bear_Tier1.desc: Affixes can be applied to Helms, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, Boots, Shields, and Amulets.
Tempering_Druid_Utility_Bear_Tier1.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

Tempering_Druid_Utility_Bear_Tier2.name: Werebear Innovation
Tempering_Druid_Utility_Bear_Tier2.desc: Affixes can be applied to Helms, Chest Armor, Gloves, Pants, Boots, Shields, and Amulets.
Tempering_Druid_Utility_Bear_Tier2.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

Tempering_Druid_Utility_Bear_Tier3.flavor: Use this item to unlock a new recipe

S09_Horadric_Cache.name: Horadric Cache
S09_Horadric_Cache.desc: Contains a large amount of gold, murmuring obols, gem fragments, and various Horadric materials.
S09_Horadric_Cache.flavor: An assortment of odds and ends that would pique only the interest of an adventurer.

S09_Horadric_Cache_UI_Item.name: Horadric Cache
S09_Horadric_Cache_UI_Item.desc: Contains an assortment of useful materials and enables Horadric Jewel Tomes to drop from Horadric Strongrooms in Torment Difficulty.
S09_Horadric_Cache_UI_Item.flavor: An assortment of odds and ends that would pique only the interest of an adventurer.

QST_Skov_Temis_Jaws_02_QuestItem.name: Kraken Parasites
QST_Skov_Temis_Jaws_02_QuestItem.flavor: No beast, no matter how great, can escape the hunger of other beings.

QST_Skov_Temis_Jaws_03_QuestItem.name: Flesh of the Red Eel
QST_Skov_Temis_Jaws_03_QuestItem.flavor: Red flesh still steaming. Streaks of dark grey accentuate the slab of meat like veins of iron ore.

S10_Ring_Unique_Druid_100_Chest.name: Airidah's Inexorable Will
S10_Ring_Unique_Druid_100_Chest.flavor:
"When I was born, I breathed in the wind and the storm and they gave me life. When I die, I will breath out, and return that gift to the skies."
- Journal excerpt

S10_Helm_Unique_Druid_100_Gloves.name: Tempest Roar
S10_Helm_Unique_Druid_100_Gloves.flavor:
"Listen, child, to the music of the storm. It has its own rhythm. Its own melody. Hear how beautifully it sings, and perhaps one day you will be able to join in its harmony."
– Airidah

S10_Helm_Unique_Druid_101_Boots.flavor:
"Roots from the Great Oak growing at the seaward statue of Vasily will, on rare occasions, be found twisted back upon themselves, suffused with ferocious magic."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

S10_Ring_Unique_Druid_101_Chest.name: Earthbreaker
S10_Ring_Unique_Druid_101_Chest.flavor: When Arreat was sundered, the world quaked. The Druid Aglainn journeyed far to chronicle the aftermath. Grief-stricken by the great mountain king's fall, he rent the earth anew.

S10_Ring_Unique_Druid_101_Helm.name: Earthbreaker
S10_Ring_Unique_Druid_101_Helm.flavor: When Arreat was sundered, the world quaked. The Druid Aglainn journeyed far to chronicle the aftermath. Grief-stricken by the great mountain king's fall, he rent the earth anew.

TWR_ProgressOrb.name: Animus
TWR_ProgressOrb.desc: Collect Animus to empower its Urn

MountReins_WarPlans_Chimera.name: Reins of the Athuluan War Mount
MountReins_WarPlans_Chimera.desc: Use these reins to add the Athuluan War Mount to your stable.
MountReins_WarPlans_Chimera.flavor: Rare in this modern age, the basilisks of Athulua once carried many an Amazon into battle. They are as fierce as they are temperamental, requiring a firm grip in the saddle.

S10_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_003_x1_Helm.name: Band of First Breath
S10_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_003_x1_Helm.flavor: A gentle whisper glides upon the winds. The words elude the grasp of mortal ken. They weave through the soul like a melody forgotten, and from this arises a name: Adarja, the First-Breather.

S10_Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_009_x1_Gloves.name: Harmony of Ebewaka
S10_Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_009_x1_Gloves.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.

S10_Chest_Unique_Spiritborn_013_x1_Helm.name: Jacinth Shell
S10_Chest_Unique_Spiritborn_013_x1_Helm.flavor: This ceremonial armor was once adorned during the He Sutsar Puchē, where sacred blood is drawn by jacinth lancets and offered to flames. It retains the scents of incensed smoke and scorched copper.

S10_Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_011_x1_Chest.name: Loyalty's Mantle
S10_Helm_Unique_Spiritborn_011_x1_Chest.flavor: During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.

S10_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_004_x1_Helm.flavor: "In Natsalarwaka, no blood shall mar the earth. Even bitter enemies must forgo their blades before entering the haven. Breaking this accord will invoke Wasipotsu's wrath." - Oral Oaxazi Scripture

S10_Ring_Unique_Spiritborn_005_x1_Boots.flavor: "At midday thundered the first brother, Nyamoyo, lord of predators. Survival is his blessing, hunting is his prayer. Honor him and prowess shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse IV

S10_Quarterstaff_Unique_Spiritborn_016_x.flavor: "Beyond the world disc doth lie the keeper serpent Kepeleke. Ceaseless the serpent grows, and thus must ever consume his own tail, lest the world be overtaken." - Lintel XII

1HShield_Unique_Paladin_002.name: Bastion of Sir Matthias
1HShield_Unique_Paladin_002.flavor: ...And when the enemy pressed too near, his bulwark became a hammer.

Ring_Unique_Paladin_001.name: Argent Veil
Ring_Unique_Paladin_001.flavor: "And the moon looked upon the pilgrims and wept a path of light. Through her tears they walked unseen, and night remembered them no more." - Orison XVII: Creed of the Dove

1HShield_Unique_Paladin_003.name: Ward of the White Dove
1HShield_Unique_Paladin_003.flavor: "Of the world's first light she was borne - the White Dove, our most radiant Lady. Her visage none may behold, yet all warmed by dawn may call her friend." - Sir Morna, Order of the Dove

Boots_Unique_Paladin_001.name: March of the Stalwart Soul
Boots_Unique_Paladin_001.flavor: "...and though he marched through shadow and storm, his flame never waned. On the thirtieth day, he arrived to spread the word of Akarat's passing." - Scrolls of Yaerius

1HSword_Unique_Paladin_001.name: Supplication
1HSword_Unique_Paladin_001.flavor: The scroll's words are known to the knight alone. He supplicates to his sworn oath, lest his faith and blade find no purchase.

mnt_uniq91_trophy.name: Pyre's Warmth
mnt_uniq91_trophy.flavor: "The dead may want for nothing, but they deserve respect. A warm pyre is a sign of goodwill." -Sehrei

mnt_uniq94_trophy.name: Father's Visage
mnt_uniq94_trophy.flavor: With this banner, we remember that we are born of angels, and like them, we can fall.

QST_Skov_Voyagers_02_Blood.name: Vermin Blood
QST_Skov_Voyagers_02_Blood.flavor: Viscous and filthy, drained from still-twitching rat corpses.

2HSword_Unique_Paladin_002.name: Red Sermon
2HSword_Unique_Paladin_002.flavor: "Thus spake Que-Hegan Sankekur the righteous: when prayer fails man, let the blade be our psalm. May the blood of unbelievers be the ink which we write our faith anew." -Excerpt from Brother Ismail

Helm_Unique_Paladin_002.name: Judicant's Glaivehelm
Helm_Unique_Paladin_002.flavor: "Let the righteous spear judge what man cannot. Its point unmasks the heretic, its edge silences their defiance." - Judicator Moseph of the Fourth Inquisition

{c_highlight}Usable in all Difficulty Levels.{/c}

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic01_02.name: Fer of Slaughter
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic01_02.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic01_03.name: Mlor of Slaughter
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic01_03.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic02_02.name: Fer of Lethality
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic02_02.flavor: "The Ancients have much to say on the subject of killing. Its impact on the heart. If one must do it, it is best done quickly. Phoba intent on mercy." -Jered Cain

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic02_03.name: Mlor of Lethality
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic02_03.flavor: "The Ancients have much to say on the subject of killing. Its impact on the heart. If one must do it, it is best done quickly. Phoba intent on mercy." -Jered Cain

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic03_02.name: Fer of Cruel Fate
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic03_02.flavor: "'Fer' is easier said than mastered. The Ammuit teach us that the Mind plays tricks most often on itself. It's a bastard of a problem." -Iben Fahd

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic03_03.name: Mlor of Cruel Fate
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic03_03.flavor: "'Fer' is easier said than mastered. The Ammuit teach us that the Mind plays tricks most often on itself. It's a bastard of a problem." -Iben Fahd

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic04_02.name: Fer of Deceptive Insight
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic04_02.flavor: "Linta. The Voice is one's Phoba and Fer, projected from Mlor to carry their intention. Be certain what you intend, and deceive only your opponent. Never yourself." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic04_03.name: Mlor of Deceptive Insight
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic04_03.flavor: "Linta. The Voice is one's Phoba and Fer, projected from Mlor to carry their intention. Be certain what you intend, and deceive only your opponent. Never yourself." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic05_02.name: Fer of Bone Breaking
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic05_02.flavor: "Mlor. The Body. A mage must learn to govern each reflex, each fiber, each bone in themselves. Then, with empathy, they may govern it in others." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic05_03.name: Mlor of Bone Breaking
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic05_03.flavor: "Mlor. The Body. A mage must learn to govern each reflex, each fiber, each bone in themselves. Then, with empathy, they may govern it in others." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic06_02.name: Fer of Dark Pact
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic06_02.flavor: "Berú... The purest, strongest, and most perilous aspect of the mage is their Soul. Our work demands that we risk it for the greater good. When and how is your choice." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic06_03.name: Mlor of Dark Pact
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic06_03.flavor: "Berú... The purest, strongest, and most perilous aspect of the mage is their Soul. Our work demands that we risk it for the greater good. When and how is your choice." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic07_02.name: Fer of Survival
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic07_02.flavor: "We high-minded mages like to think of ourselves as enlightened. But put the screws to any one of us, and Mlor takes over. The body's animal imperative to live." -Iben Fahd

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic08_02.name: Fer of Adept Action
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic08_02.flavor: "Phoba, Fer. Emotion and Mind. These form the root of a mage's intention, no matter the medium. Focus first upon these, and put all ambition aside." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic09_02.name: Fer of Mastery
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_Generic09_02.flavor: "Phoba, Fer. Emotion and Mind. These form the root of a mage's intention, no matter the medium. Focus first upon these, and put all ambition aside." -Tal Rasha

S10_Amulet_Unique_Druid_100_Boots.flavor: As the hateful mob beat on his door, he gripped the pulsing shard tightly and screamed for calm. When he opened his eyes, all that greeted him was silence and the blood-smeared ruins of his cottage.

Boots_Unique_Spiritborn_001.name: Path of the Emissary
Boots_Unique_Spiritborn_001.flavor: "The path remembers the feet that tread it often. It bends its course to those who never stray." - Tarka, the Emissary

1HMace_Unique_Sorc_100.name: Orsivane
1HMace_Unique_Sorc_100.flavor: Lo, its strike is thunder, its sting a dirge. Those smote are unmade, scattered as chaff before the breath of ancients.

Boots_Unique_Druid_101.name: Khamsin Steppewalkers
Boots_Unique_Druid_101.flavor: Once worn by the lost druids who sang the sandy gales to sleep. When their line was broken, the desert rose in mourning, staining the sky blood-red as Kehjistan choked beneath fifty years of dust.

mnt_uniq98_trophy.name: Memory of Seneschal
mnt_uniq98_trophy.flavor: A loyal friend. Partner to the end.

QST_Skov_DiluvianBlade_Item.name: Diluvian Blade
QST_Skov_DiluvianBlade_Item.flavor: An ancient Firstborn blade preserved in time by unnatural forces.

cmp_base000_crab.name: The Crab with the Knife
cmp_base000_crab.desc: Using this item adds the Crab with the Knife to your Companion collection in the Wardrobe.
cmp_base000_crab.flavor: Where did it come from? Is it even real? The knife seems real.

1HMace_Unique_Necro_100.name: Mace of King Leoric
1HMace_Unique_Necro_100.flavor: "Listen, no Skeleton is gonna be my King. Leoric is King. King, so you hear me? Hail to the King!" -Farnham

1HFlail_Unique_Paladin_003.name: Light's Rebuke
1HFlail_Unique_Paladin_003.flavor: "Stand tall, for on this day we bring the Light of Inarius to a land consumed by darkness!" - Urivar, before the Battle for Scosglen

1HSword_Unique_Paladin_002.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.
