OWCSMP_Crown.flavor: "We need just wait for the final decade to pass. By three, they come. By three thy pen opens. With the cud of the willing, we call thee home." - The Cow King, Hoof of Moophisto

Ring_Unique_Generic_103.name: Wendigo Brand
Ring_Unique_Generic_103.flavor: In the first winters, a desperate spirit awoke within the hearts of men. Where famine walked, the spirit strengthened. When men consumed one another, it found its name.

Gloves_Unique_Generic_005.name: Wyrdskin
Gloves_Unique_Generic_005.flavor: Each touch dulls pain. Enemies feel their vigor unravel as the poison withers their marrow and drinks deep of their strength.

1HAxe_Unique_Generic_003.name: Thousand-Eye Reaver
1HAxe_Unique_Generic_003.flavor: No falsehood could endure the Thousand-Eyed King's reaver nor its countless eyes. Their gaze was bright and terrible, consumed with a world-eating hunger.

Helm_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.name: Amazon Training Helm
Helm_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.flavor: Part of an Amazon trainee's panoply.

Chest_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.name: Amazon Training Tunic
Chest_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.flavor: Part of an Amazon trainee's panoply.

Pants_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.name: Amazon Training Pants
Pants_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.flavor: Part of an Amazon trainee's panoply.

Gloves_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.name: Amazon Training Gloves
Gloves_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.flavor: Part of an Amazon trainee's panoply.

Boots_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.name: Amazon Training Boots
Boots_Normal_Generic_OWCSMP.flavor: Part of an Amazon trainee's panoply.

X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq19.name: Soul Taker
X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq19.flavor: The blade hums faintly in your hands. It seems to be asking, no, begging for you to draw blood with it.

X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq21.name: Hatred's Prize
X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq21.flavor: "Let this be a lesson to us all! This is what happens when we let Hatred consume us." -Excerpt from Akarat's Sermon

X2_1HMace_Legendary_Generic_uniq16.name: Ward-Hammer
X2_1HMace_Legendary_Generic_uniq16.flavor: Protection is more than defending those dear to you. It is also pummeling those who wish them harm.

X2_2HMace_Legendary_Generic_uniq18.name: Doorknocker
X2_2HMace_Legendary_Generic_uniq18.flavor: "If they don't open the door, then we open it ourselves. Are we ready?" -Unknown Askari Guard

X2_1HFocus_Legendary_Generic_uniq20.name: Dawnbreaker
X2_1HFocus_Legendary_Generic_uniq20.flavor: "We turn to the light of the dawn to guide our way out of the darkness." -Agmali

X2_1HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq25.name: Fatecarver
X2_1HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq25.flavor: "Those who misprize my sisters' sacrifice deserve anathema. A fate befitting the flippant." -Achaia

X2_1HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq26.name: Justiciar's Brand
X2_1HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq26.flavor: "Kill only to save innocent lives, and live only to stand between the innocent and death." -Valeria

X2_2HAxe_Legendary_Generic_uniq13.name: Mischief Maker
X2_2HAxe_Legendary_Generic_uniq13.flavor: "Every good trickster has a reliable sidesplitter. It's guaranteed to cut through a crowd!" -Kakkos

X2_2HPolearm_Legendary_Generic_uniq17.name: Scepter of Queen Tharra I
X2_2HPolearm_Legendary_Generic_uniq17.flavor: A gift from Queen Tharra of Skovos, first of her name. Inscribed it reads: "To my friend who is peerless in valor, may your arm never falter."

X2_2HPolearm_Legendary_Generic_uniq18.name: Kleos, Spear of Athulua
X2_2HPolearm_Legendary_Generic_uniq18.flavor:
The Amazons saw that Death had come, but showed no fear. They fought with weapons if they had them; if not, with their hands and teeth. Many Valkyries were born that day.
-Battle Hymn of Athulua

X2_2HPolearm_Legendary_Generic_uniq19.name: Lorath's Polearm
X2_2HPolearm_Legendary_Generic_uniq19.flavor: "I used to pretend to be a Horadric hero when I was a boy. Fighting monsters with my wooden sword. Feels like a long time ago." -Lorath Nahr

X2_2HStaff_Legendary_Sorcerer_uniq20.name: Pilgrim's Staff
X2_2HStaff_Legendary_Sorcerer_uniq20.flavor: A humble walking staff given by Bnatros. Many names are etched into the shaft, including "Ahul," "Kor," "Kela," and "Devrik."

X2_2HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq21.name: Anointing Edge
X2_2HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq21.flavor: "I can't call it art, but there is some design in the way the Morlu mangle themselves. Fascinating, if horrifying." -Scholar Reyvard's Writings

QST_Class_Warlock_DGN_03_Tome.name: Abyssal Grimoire
QST_Class_Warlock_DGN_03_Tome.flavor: A tome that contains part of the spell.

OWCSMP_Cache.name: Trophy of the Faithful
OWCSMP_Cache.desc: Though decades old, it is in pristine condition.
OWCSMP_Cache.flavor: As you pick it up, you can hear something move inside.

QST_Class_Warlock_DGN_03_Tome_B.name: Book of Binding
QST_Class_Warlock_DGN_03_Tome_B.flavor: A tome that contains part of the spell.

QST_Class_Warlock_DGN_03_Tome_C.name: Lost Tome
QST_Class_Warlock_DGN_03_Tome_C.flavor: A tome that contains part of the spell.

Ring_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Lurid Pact
Ring_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "It glows because it is pleased." -Author Unknown, blood used as inscription

1HSword_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Elegy
1HSword_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: Weave a song from the damned. Pluck their sorrows like harp strings, for there is fuel in the tears of the profane.

2HSword_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Anathema of the Primes
2HSword_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: Hatred begins the first cut. Terror holds the wound. Destruction comes at last, patient and certain, to devour what remains.

2HAxe_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Dirge of Odium
2HAxe_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "I am the voice of vengeance unsated. Brandish me and my enmity shall walk with thine. Thy grief is thy tithe. My dirge, the dread reward."

1HMace_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Spine of Tathamet
1HMace_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "...Tathamet's blackened, smoldering husk spiraled into the lower darkness of reality. From his putrid flesh grew the realms of the Burning Hells." -The Black Book of Lam Esen

2HMace_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Scepter of the Three
2HMace_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "The Primes warred, but not for glory. They did so for the joy of mayhem. How many legions of demons died simply to delight the lords of Hell?" -Tal Rasha

1HDagger_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Litany of Sable
1HDagger_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "Adiya shrouded herself in shadow and walked amongst men. From her countless mouths poured the song of the abyss. Its sound drowned the mind in fog as she came to feed." -Annals of Hadal

1HFocus_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Infernal Homunculus
1HFocus_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: It grows restless in silence, thrashing against its bindings. Though the body is small, it dreams of carnage unimaginable.

1HFlail_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Scourge of Duriel
1HFlail_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "Whereas Andariel relishes the anticipation of pain and the fear it creates, Duriel only cares of the existence and propagation of agony." -Book of Adria

2HStaff_Unique_AF_001.name: Cluckonomicon
2HStaff_Unique_AF_001.flavor: One touch and you understand... behind their vacant gaze is a fiendish hunger, patient and unreasoning.

2HBow_Unique_AF_001.name: Cluckeye
2HBow_Unique_AF_001.flavor: This bow has been tainted by some strange magic indeed.

Ring_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Sire of Sin
Ring_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "Azmodan has plied the honeyed lures of sin. Where terror and hatred break the soul, temptation bends the faithful knee for use." -Of Primes and Lesser Evils, Volume I

Ring_Unique_Warlock_003.name: Hecaton Chasm
Ring_Unique_Warlock_003.flavor: "The creatures of Hell are craven, wretched things, clawing at scraps like mongrels. Hells' hundred hands do not fight. They clamber forward like cowards in the dark." -Tal Rasha

Ring_Unique_Warlock_004.name: Seal of the Ophanim
Ring_Unique_Warlock_004.flavor: Upon the seal was graven the Name of the Ophanim. And though they were not demon, their will bent the same.

Ring_Unique_Warlock_005.name: The Fecund Seal
Ring_Unique_Warlock_005.flavor: "The apprentice called for one. Two answered. Then the third crawled out afterward, unfinished, screaming like it had been torn free too early." -Master Azevera

Ring_Unique_Warlock_006.name: Hellbrand Signet
Ring_Unique_Warlock_006.flavor: "The fire of that realm is not like the fire of our world. It seems alive. Not mindless, but imbued with purpose. As if it were blood flowing through unknowable veins." -Jere Harash

Ring_Unique_Warlock_007.name: The Eightfold Idol
Ring_Unique_Warlock_007.flavor: "There are depths of the Hells, and even deeper still in the Abyss, where the nameless await their appointed hour. They whisper truths forbidden that erode the mind even as they enlighten it." -Elias

Amulet_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Seed of Horazon
Amulet_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "In all dealings with Hells' spawn, names are both key and chain. To speak a demon's true name is to invite its presence, and seize some small dominion over it." -Master Horazon

Helm_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Nails of the Gore-Crowned
Helm_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "Bind them as a sign on your hand, and the fiend shall be as frontlets between your eyes. Nail yourself to your crucibles, for pain is the road where domination is won." -The Magnus

Chest_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Fleshwrit Carapace
Chest_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: "...Our rites are written not with ink, but with blood. Not upon stone, but upon the living flesh..." -Taphya 13:6

Gloves_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Gauntlets of Sheol
Gloves_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: All of Abaddon is unshrouded before you. The denizens of Sheol tremble, for these hands are the touch of those unutterable ruins.

Pants_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Kabraxis' Will
Pants_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor:
In the Sunless Depths, Kabraxis wailed.
No vessel could bare the Imprisoned Lord.
Creation could not sustain the road he traveled, only madness remained.

Boots_Unique_Warlock_001.name: Footfalls of the Waning World
Boots_Unique_Warlock_001.flavor: Step onward, and the living realm shall dim behind thee as the Black Road uncoils, eternal and cold. Even death shall fail to follow thee there.

Boots_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Hellhound's Sabatons
Boots_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "As loyal as we may think they might be, they are still demons. And they will take any chance they can to destroy us." -Book of Adria

Chest_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Ae'grom's Schism
Chest_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "Cut a demon nice and wide. Something rises from inside. Eye and fang, bone and sinew. What was one has become two." -Ravings of a mad Vizjerei

Gloves_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Hand of Apotheosis
Gloves_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "There are certain thresholds one must not cross. Not because the demonologist will lose their way back, but because they will not return the same as they were before." -Grimoire of Reckoning

Gloves_Unique_Warlock_003.name: Thrice-Woven Nightmare
Gloves_Unique_Warlock_003.flavor: Faint screams emanate from the gloves, as if they are imbued with a hundred primal fears.

Gloves_Unique_Warlock_004.name: Hands of the Worldbreaker
Gloves_Unique_Warlock_004.flavor: "For demons whose nature is to destroy, where does it end? If everything around them is brought to ruin, I believe their final act of destruction would be themselves." -Deckard Cain

Helm_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Cowl of Malefic Torment
Helm_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "The doomed do not fall at once. They linger, falter in purpose, and then unravel. Breath shortens. Will erodes. Fortune abandons them. When death finally comes, 'tis merely overdue." -Warlord Bartuc

Helm_Unique_Warlock_003.name: Cage of Madness
Helm_Unique_Warlock_003.flavor: "Sin begets sins as men beget men. Terror begets Hate and Hate begets Destruction. Destruction begets Terror as Terror begets Hate..." -Inscription carved inside the helm

Helm_Unique_Warlock_004.name: Rictus of Terror
Helm_Unique_Warlock_004.flavor: "We found eight corpses, arranged around a summoning circle. No wounds or blood. They were frozen in mid-scream. Whatever had appeared in the circle was gone." -Caldeum guard report

Helm_Unique_Warlock_005.name: Bridle of Tor'Baalos
Helm_Unique_Warlock_005.flavor: "Destruction can be become an addiction, it is said. The first taste of it leaves you wanting more. Something within us craves ruin, yearns for annihilation." -Black Book of Lam Esen

Pants_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Sashes of the Wretched
Pants_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "Though unruly, demons are compelled to abide by certain rules. When a pact is forged, whether by force or choice, it must be upheld." -Deckard Cain

Pants_Unique_Warlock_003.name: Bindings of Attrition
Pants_Unique_Warlock_003.flavor: "What is more perfect than blood? A single drop can consecrate, empower, or curse. Know this: The most potent form is not blood stolen from others, but given from one's self." -Elias

Pants_Unique_Warlock_004.name: Morlu Fleshward
Pants_Unique_Warlock_004.flavor: "The morlu are incredibly resilient. Stories from the Sin War describe them fighting despite heavy wounds." -Book of Adria

Amulet_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Moloch's Beating Flame
Amulet_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "Therefore, behold, the days come that it shall no more be called thine own body, nor thine own heart, but the heart of Moloch, for each heartbeat shall roar with the flames of Hell..." -Taphya 3:26

Amulet_Unique_Warlock_003.name: Night Terror
Amulet_Unique_Warlock_003.flavor:
"Sleep, my child, shut fast thine eyes, 
Keep thee still until sunrise. 
Astrogha's brood will hear thy breath, 
And lull thee close to dreaming death." -Westmarch lullaby

Amulet_Unique_Warlock_004.name: The Hemat Stone
Amulet_Unique_Warlock_004.flavor: The warlock stared into the blood-stone until his eyes were scorched with dread knowledge. He felt an infernal current awaken in his veins—a plague of visions, malice, and command over the occult.

1HFocus_Unique_Warlock_002.name: Eye of Baal
1HFocus_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: "When the moon turns crimson, it is Baal's eye opening. Show him acts of destruction, and he will reward you with power." -Rites of the Triune

S12_Seasonal_Currency.name: Fresh Meat
S12_Seasonal_Currency.desc: Used to gamble for Bloodied items.

VGN_X2_Amulet.name: Amulet of Dark Omens
VGN_X2_Amulet.flavor: A seemingly ordinary amulet, but it breeds malice around you

X2_1HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq24.name: DNS this is using eldriun's appearance

X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq18.name: Athame of the Eye
X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq18.flavor: The ceremonial blade is bare except for a red, open eye engraved into the metal. It is heavier than it appears, as though the dagger carries the weight of every vision ever drawn from a seer's sight.

SMP_FlippableCoin.name: Horadric Coin
SMP_FlippableCoin.desc: One flip may seal your fate.
SMP_FlippableCoin.flavor:
"Knowledge, lifeblood of light. 
Magick, open palm of justice. 
Perseverance, challenger of fate."

- Oath of the Horadrim

BossSummoning_Butcher.name: Pound of Flesh
BossSummoning_Butcher.desc: This object has lost its connection to a powerful entity.

SMP_LuckiestCoin.name: Luckiest Coin
SMP_LuckiestCoin.flavor: From many tempers a single token.

Rarespawn_Reward_Template - DO NOT DROP.name: Necklace of Placeholding
Rarespawn_Reward_Template - DO NOT DROP.flavor: This is a template for rare spawn drops.

PTR_CheatVendor_SlaughterhouseKeys.name: PTR Cache - Slaughterhouse Keys
PTR_CheatVendor_SlaughterhouseKeys.desc: Contains a great deal of Slaughterhouse Keys.
PTR_CheatVendor_SlaughterhouseKeys.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

Currency_LairKey.name: Lair
Currency_LairKey.flavor: Etched runes coil around what otherwise appears be a coarse iron key. It's heavier than you would expect.

BossSummoning_Initiate_LairKey.name: Lair Key
BossSummoning_Initiate_LairKey.flavor: Etched runes coil around what otherwise appears be a coarse iron key. It's heavier than you would expect.

BossSummoning_Greater_LairKey.name: Greater Lair Key
BossSummoning_Greater_LairKey.flavor: Leather scraps attempt to shield the bearer from touching the key directly. Etched runes point you towards its destination in a language you don't remember learning.

PIT_ProgressOrb.name: Animus
PIT_ProgressOrb.desc: Collect Animus to empower its Urn

PIT_ProgressOrb_Small.name: Animus
PIT_ProgressOrb_Small.desc: Collect Animus to empower its Urn

Rarespawn_Reward_1HFlail_MorluMelee.name: Bloodcarver's Torment
Rarespawn_Reward_1HFlail_MorluMelee.flavor: A tool of ritualistic torment, feeding hatred through pain. A wicked implement in stark contrast of the former beauty of the Temple of Life.

Rarespawn_Reward_2HPolearm_AmazonSpear.name: Arm of the Unbroken
Rarespawn_Reward_2HPolearm_AmazonSpear.flavor: This unadorned spear bears the marks of many battles, yet still feels as sturdy as the day it was made.

Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_LavaGolem.name: Blaz's Collar
Rarespawn_Reward_Amulet_LavaGolem.flavor: A scavenged piece of jewelry fashioned with cord to form an oversized collar.

Rarespawn_Reward_Shield_GiantCrab.name: Skar's Bones
Rarespawn_Reward_Shield_GiantCrab.flavor: A collection of bones kept by Skar's Scion, imbued with the great crab's might.

Rarespawn_Reward_1HDagger_RatKing.name: Rat King's Claw
Rarespawn_Reward_1HDagger_RatKing.flavor: A dagger fashioned from the claw of Pariah.

Rarespawn_Reward_2HMace_FingerMage.name: Ashworn Finger
Rarespawn_Reward_2HMace_FingerMage.flavor: A heavy mace torn from the body of a Finger Mage, still thrumming as if to an unnatural heartbeat.

Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_Water.name: Waterlogged Ring
Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_Water.flavor: This nondescript ring seems to be perpetually dripping water.

Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_Golem_Bramble.name: Writhing Vine
Rarespawn_Reward_Ring_Golem_Bramble.flavor: A wrapped circle of tiny vines, perpetually growing and decaying as if the golem it came from still clings to life.

Rarespawn_Reward_Totem_Golem_Stone.name: Living Stone Tablet
Rarespawn_Reward_Totem_Golem_Stone.flavor: Pulled free from the remains of a strange stone golem, this tablet has some measure of natural power still bound within it.

QST_Skov_ARealOne_Skull.name: Lorath's Skull
QST_Skov_ARealOne_Skull.flavor: Recovered from the ashes of the Tree of Whispers. It belongs with the rest of him.

Helm_Unique_Druid_100_x2.name: Will of Stone
Helm_Unique_Druid_100_x2.flavor: "You Vizjerei believe your magic is greater than ours, so you come here seeking to become the master of this land? But I am a druid. I am the land!" -Druid Saoirse, at the defeat of Mage Lord Emre

1HSword_Unique_Warlock_002.name: The Blade of Sight Aflame
1HSword_Unique_Warlock_002.flavor: The third lord of Hashir hungered to see all beneath his rule. A Warlock obliged and bound a demon into steel. The king bore the blade and beheld how his realm was cast down before him.

Helm_Unique_Druid_101_x2.name: Autumnal Crown
Helm_Unique_Druid_101_x2.flavor: "Lo, Éirin has departed, she wanders with us no longer. May her peace be everlasting under the branches of Glór-an-Fháidha." -Inscription at Túr Dúlra

S12_BloodyLairSigil.name: Lair Boss Sigil
S12_BloodyLairSigil.desc: Transform this place into a{icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossSummon, 2}{c_highlight}Bloodied Lair{/c} with {c_red}greater challenge{/c} and greater reward.

QST_Athu_TowerofSil_Resin_02.name: Resin
QST_Athu_TowerofSil_Resin_02.desc: A hard and sticky yellow sap.
QST_Athu_TowerofSil_Resin_02.flavor: A hard and sticky yellow sap.

QST_Athu_TowerofSil_Resin_03.name: Resin
QST_Athu_TowerofSil_Resin_03.desc: A hard and sticky yellow sap.
QST_Athu_TowerofSil_Resin_03.flavor: A hard and sticky yellow sap.

PTR_CheatVendor_SeasonalActivityKeys.name: PTR Cache - Seasonal Activity Keys
PTR_CheatVendor_SeasonalActivityKeys.desc: Contains a great deal of Seasonal Activity Keys.
PTR_CheatVendor_SeasonalActivityKeys.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Armor.name: PTR Cache - Bloodied Armor - Rampage
PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Armor.desc: Contains several pieces of Armor with Rampage Bloodied Affixes.
PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Armor.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Jewelry.name: PTR Cache - Bloodied Jewelry - Hunger
PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Jewelry.desc: Contains several pieces of Jewelry with Hunger Bloodied Affixes.
PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Jewelry.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Weapons.name: PTR Cache - Bloodied Weapons - Feast
PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Weapons.desc: Contains several Weapons with Feast Bloodied Affixes.
PTR_CheatVendor_BloodiedItems_Weapons.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

Collection_Item_Andariel_B.name: Pincushioned Doll

Collection_Item_UberDuriel_B.name: Shard of Agony

Collection_Item_HarbingerOfHatred.name: Abhorrent Heart

Collection_Item_Grigoire.name: Living Steel

Collection_Item_BeastInTheIce.name: Distilled Fear

Collection_Item_Urivar.name: Judicator's Mask

Collection_Item_LordZir.name: Exquisite Blood

Collection_Item_Varshan.name: Malignant Heart

S12_BloodyNMDSigil.name: Nightmare Sigil
S12_BloodyNMDSigil.desc: Transform this place into a {icon:Icon_Tooltip_NightmareDungeonEntrance,1.5} {c_highlight}Bloodied Nightmare Dungeon{/c} with {c_red}greater challenge{/c} and greater reward.

Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_101.name: Echo of Kwatli
Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_101.flavor: "Strike once to expose weakness, strike again to exploit it." -Teachings of Ysevete, the First Spiritborn

Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_102.name: Protean Heart
Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_102.flavor: "Nahantu is everchanging. Nahantu is everlasting. When the Burning Hells become ash and soot, and when the High Heavens come crashing down, Nahantu will remain." -Excerpt from Defiance of Enkasi

Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_103.name: Widow's Web
Amulet_Unique_Spiritborn_103.flavor: "One touch is all it took. She looked into my eyes, and I understood her hunger, endless and painful. I will start with the taverns and find a strong one, with strong blood." -Jios, Sarat's Servant

OWCSMP_PrimeMeat.name: Prime Rib
OWCSMP_PrimeMeat.desc: A royal cut of beef, with perfect marbling, a majestic texture, and a regal flavor.
OWCSMP_PrimeMeat.flavor: Such a prime cut would be a worthy offering to anyone, even to a god.

Gloves_Unique_Druid_01_x2.name: Dark Howl
Gloves_Unique_Druid_01_x2.flavor: "They who live by fang and claw forget the feeling of human feet on soil. Of cold air on bare skin. Man and beast...thoughts, desires...merge together like blood spilled in a stream." -Nafain

Boots_Unique_Druid_01_x2.name: Greenwalker's Oath
Boots_Unique_Druid_01_x2.flavor: Ciódan was known to be a true friend of the Deep Forest. In gratitude, he was protected fiercely by nature itself.

S12_DungeonSigil_BSK_SpecialButcher.name: Infernal Hordes Compass
S12_DungeonSigil_BSK_SpecialButcher.desc: Transform this place into a {icon:Marker_BSK_Entrance,2}{c_highlight}Bloodied Infernal Hordes{/c} with {c_red}greater challenge{/c} and greater reward.

1HTotem_Unique_Druid_01_x2.name: Ifeh's Dire Totem
1HTotem_Unique_Druid_01_x2.flavor: Fiacla-Géar's druids lived in harmony with nature. The Talons of Ifeh walked a different path. They surrendered their souls to the wilds, becoming more beast than man.

2HScythe_Unique_AF_001.name: Eggcecutioner
2HScythe_Unique_AF_001.flavor: Each soul it severs returns as an omen of renewal, cradled in bone-white curve.

2HScythe_Unique_AF_001_Powerup.name: Egg
2HScythe_Unique_AF_001_Powerup.desc: Use this egg to open it.

Chest_Unique_Druid_97_x2.name: Heart of Azgar
Chest_Unique_Druid_97_x2.flavor: "You kept us from harm. Forever will you hold a place of honor. We will always look up to you...brother." -Grey of Clan Skeld

cmp_base000_goatman.name: Bloody Billy
cmp_base000_goatman.desc: Using this item adds Bloody Billy to your Companion collection in the Wardrobe.
cmp_base000_goatman.flavor: The creature bleats innocently, but its hands tremble with pent-up anger. It wants blood, and it will have it...one way or another.

Warplans_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Ances.name: Ancestral Tribute of Armaments
Warplans_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Ances.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Complete with Attunement Rank 1 or higher for a chance to earn {c_legendary}Ancestral Legendary{/c} equipment.
{icon:bullet,1.2} Enhanced {c_white}Bargains{/c} that allow specific item type rewards are available.

Only usable in Torment Difficulties.

Ring_Unique_Druid_01_x2.name: Dirge of Airidah
Ring_Unique_Druid_01_x2.flavor: "I saw her climb to the peak of the mountains. She played a song on her talharpa, so sad it made the sky darken and rumble with thunder." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IV

twoHandSword_uniq11.name: Bitter Flamberge
twoHandSword_uniq11.flavor: Wielded for centuries of grim tyranny, as evinced by innumerable nicks and stains.

Ring_Unique_Druid_02_x2.name: Greenwalker's Signet
Ring_Unique_Druid_02_x2.flavor:
"Do not speak to nature. Listen to it. Learn from it. That is the only true path of knowledge."
-Code of the Scéal Fada

2HPolearm_Unique_AF_001.name: Coop de Grâce
2HPolearm_Unique_AF_001.flavor: Mercy ends where the flock begins.

Ring_Unique_Druid_03_x2.name: Fractured Runestone
Ring_Unique_Druid_03_x2.flavor: "The runestones in Scosglen are fascinating. Some act as wards, but others are conduits. They tap into the deepest power of the earth itself." -Donan

Ring_Unique_Druid_04_x2.name: Accord of the Wilds
Ring_Unique_Druid_04_x2.flavor: You do not see your reflection on the ring's polished surface. Instead, you see other forms: creatures of fur and feather, of fang and claw.

1HShield_Unique_AF_001.name: Eggis
1HShield_Unique_AF_001.flavor: The Eggis was not forged, but laid by a beast most fowl.

Ring_Unique_Druid_05_x2.name: Mark of the Old Wolf
Ring_Unique_Druid_05_x2.flavor: "The tales spoke of a one-eyed wolf, a creature so cunning that it outsmarted the greatest trappers in the world. It makes you wonder if it was a wolf at all." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IX

Helm_Cosmetic_Paladin_186_stor.name: Crown of Hatred
Helm_Cosmetic_Paladin_186_stor.desc: Remnants of the Prime Evil, Mephisto, now bound as a crown, claimed by those who dared stand against Hatred itself.

Helm_Cosmetic_Sorcerer_272_stor.name: Crown of Hatred
Helm_Cosmetic_Sorcerer_272_stor.desc: Remnants of the Prime Evil, Mephisto, now bound as a crown, claimed by those who dared stand against Hatred itself.

Helm_Cosmetic_Spiritborn_215_stor.name: Crown of Hatred
Helm_Cosmetic_Spiritborn_215_stor.desc: Remnants of the Prime Evil, Mephisto, now bound as a crown, claimed by those who dared stand against Hatred itself.

Helm_Cosmetic_Warlock_170_stor.name: Crown of Hatred
Helm_Cosmetic_Warlock_170_stor.desc: Remnants of the Prime Evil, Mephisto, now bound as a crown, claimed by those who dared stand against Hatred itself.

QST_Skov_Voyagers_Reward_Item.name: Bitter Flamberge
QST_Skov_Voyagers_Reward_Item.flavor: Wielded for centuries of grim tyranny, as evinced by innumerable nicks and stains.

Warplans_CursedRituals_ChoronsBlood.name: Choron's Blood
Warplans_CursedRituals_ChoronsBlood.desc: A flower with petals of blood, brimming with strange power...

Warplans_CursedRituals_ChoronsTears.name: Choron's Tears
Warplans_CursedRituals_ChoronsTears.desc: A handful of blue crystalline slivers, brimming with strange power...

Warplans_CursedRituals_ChoronsFlesh.name: Choron's Flesh
Warplans_CursedRituals_ChoronsFlesh.desc: A peculiar formation of stone, brimming with strange power...

Ring_Unique_Druid_06_x2.name: Fury of the Wilds
Ring_Unique_Druid_06_x2.flavor: The ring pulses with primal power, but its design is delicate. Perhaps its main purpose is to remind the wearer that they are still human.

Ring_Unique_Druid_07_x2.name: Might of the Ursine
Ring_Unique_Druid_07_x2.flavor: "To speak the tongue of a beast is more than just trading words. It changes how you see the world. It changes how you know fear, strength, and tenacity." -Greenwalker Ciórdan

2HMace_Unique_Druid_100_x2.name: Purified Lightbringer
2HMace_Unique_Druid_100_x2.flavor: "The Cathedral fled south, leaving sanctums hollow and songs unsung. What was left—stone, silver, and sanctified relics—were claimed and bent to the will of elder root and spirit." -Bryona

LTE_LNY_Rep_MarkingReward_2026.name: Avatar of Trag'Oul
LTE_LNY_Rep_MarkingReward_2026.desc: Grants markings if not earned in a previous Lunar Awakening event.

S12_QST_Main_01_Demon_Blood.name: Demon Blood
S12_QST_Main_01_Demon_Blood.flavor: "This demon blood clings to the sides of the jar with an unnatural, tar-like grip."

S12_Reputation_Cache_Bloodied.name: Bloodied Cache
S12_Reputation_Cache_Bloodied.desc: Contains gold, Fresh Meat, Bloodied Items, a Slaughterhouse Key, and a Bloodied Nightmare Dungeon Sigil.
S12_Reputation_Cache_Bloodied.flavor: It seems as if the box itself sheds its own blood.

S12_Reputation_Cache_Bloodied_Greater.name: Greater Bloodied Cache {icon:AttributeBullet_GreaterAffix,1.5}
S12_Reputation_Cache_Bloodied_Greater.desc: Contains gold, Fresh Meat, Pounds of Flesh, Ancestral Bloodied Items, a Slaughterhouse Key, a Bloodied Nightmare Dungeon Sigil, and a Bloodied Lair Boss Key.
S12_Reputation_Cache_Bloodied_Greater.flavor: Caked in the viscera of foes slaughtered without mercy.

CheatVendor_SlaughterhouseKeys.name: PTR Cache - Slaughterhouse Keys
CheatVendor_SlaughterhouseKeys.desc: Contains a great deal of Slaughterhouse Keys.
CheatVendor_SlaughterhouseKeys.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

2HBow_Unique_Rogue_002_x2.name: Cassia's Grace
2HBow_Unique_Rogue_002_x2.flavor: "Tell us, Oracle Queen, of our great Amazon Sister, who wandered far from her home into the Heart of Terror." -Ode to the Warmatron

Gloves_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.name: Fist of the Iron Rose
Gloves_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.flavor: "She wished only to protect her sister. She journeyed far to Ivgorod. After years of training she returned home, being the only outsider to ever master the six techniques." -Legends of the Iron Rose

X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.name: Greater Tribute of Refinement
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Earn {c_legendary}Neathiron{/c}, {c_rare}Obducite{/c}, {c_rare}Scrolls of Restoration{/c}, and {c_important}Forgotten Souls{/c} at Attunement Rank 1.

Only usable in Torment Difficulties.
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.flavor: Found from Nightmare Dungeons and The Infernal Hordes.

Gloves_Unique_Rogue_002_x2.name: Sea Lord's Fine Gloves
Gloves_Unique_Rogue_002_x2.flavor: Pirates rarely gather under a single Captain, but when they do, they raid from Skovos to Xiansai. The last was known as the Scourge of the Twin Seas, and left a crimson wake for decades.

1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_003_x2.name: Etna's Lost Dagger
1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_003_x2.flavor: "Prepare thoroughly before approaching any warlock. Fill your elixirs, replenish your arrows. Oil and sheath your blades before you depart." -Arts of the Viz-Jaq'taar

1HSword_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.name: Misericorde
1HSword_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.flavor: A trapped prey only awaits a swift death. Sisters of the Sightless Eye will grant them this mercy.

X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Talisman_Gr.name: Greater Tribute of the Horadrim
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Talisman_Gr.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Earn Horadric Charms and a Horadric Seal at Attunement Rank 1.

Only usable in Torment Difficulties.

X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Talisman_Le.name: Lesser Tribute of the Horadrim
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Talisman_Le.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Earn Horadric Charms and a chance for a Horadric Seal at Attunement Rank 1.
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Talisman_Le.flavor:
Found randomly in Sanctuary.

{icon:Cube_TooltipIcon, 1.5} {c_important}The Horadric Cube{/c} can {c_important}Amalgamate{/c} this item.

X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.name: Greater Tribute of Ingenuity
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Earn Horadric Cube Materials at Attunement Rank 1.

Only usable in Torment Difficulties.

Boots_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.name: Desperate March
Boots_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.flavor:
"My feet do not ache—there is no greater pain than stopping.
Into the Abyss I go. I will find her. I will bring her home. 
Hell cannot keep me from her, but it is welcome to try."
- Unknown

Amulet_Unique_Barb_102_x2.name: Emblem of Staalbreak
Amulet_Unique_Barb_102_x2.flavor: An old mark of office from the town of Staalbreak, in the Dreadlands. The rage of its last owner still emanates from within.

Amulet_Unique_Barb_103_x2.name: Dark Stalker's Medallion
Amulet_Unique_Barb_103_x2.flavor: "Tried dying once. Didn't care for it." -Renit the Dark Stalker

Amulet_Unique_Barb_104_x2.name: Nomad's Longing Heart
Amulet_Unique_Barb_104_x2.flavor:
"O Crane, what news do you bring from our mountain?
Long have I been away, in strange lands.
I yearn for home, for the highland snows,
Why silent, Crane? Have you no news from Arreat?"

Amulet_Unique_Barb_105_x2.name: The Open Eye of Gorgorra
Amulet_Unique_Barb_105_x2.flavor: Ever watchful were the Patriarchs, as the Unclean slowly made their way out of the Dreadlands.

X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.name: Tribute of Ingenuity
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Earn Horadric Cube Materials at Attunement Rank 1.

Only usable in Torment Difficulties.
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.flavor:
Found randomly throughout Sanctuary.

{icon:Cube_TooltipIcon, 1.5} {c_important}The Horadric Cube{/c} can {c_important}Amalgamate{/c} this item.

X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_CraftingMat.desc:

X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Runes_Great.name: Greater Tribute of Harmony
X2_Undercity_TributeKeySigil_Runes_Great.desc:
Offer to the{icon:Marker_Brazier_Exterior, 2.6}{c_white}Undercity Spirit Brazier{/c} to enhance its rewards:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Earn Legendary Runes at Attunement Rank 1.

Only usable in Torment Difficulties.

Pants_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.name: Shrouded Gift
Pants_Unique_Rogue_001_x2.flavor: "Deep in the Labyrinth, I found true darkness. The Hidden became my shadow, their attacks sudden and relentless. But I studied them, and found I too can enter the ether." -Moreina's Journals

1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_004_x2.name: The Maestro
1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_004_x2.flavor: "I am a symphony of blades at your disposal. No need to get your hands dirty, I will deal with any blood or body work. So, how much gold do you have?" -Mouse, Assassin for Hire

Chest_Unique_Barb_102_x2.name: The Relentless Heart
Chest_Unique_Barb_102_x2.flavor: "Though he was stuck with a dozen arrows, the barbarian charged Rakkis' lines and swept away any who stood before him. The more he bled, the more ferocious were his blows." -The Chronicles of Rakkis

Gloves_Unique_Barb_102_x2.name: Might of Qual-Kehk
Gloves_Unique_Barb_102_x2.flavor: "Even as a boy, Qual-Kehk's strength was the stuff of legend. It was said he could split oak trees in two with one throw of his blade." -Feats of Arreat, Vol. IV

S12_Butcher_Helltide_StaticSMP_EventToke.name: Meaty Offering
S12_Butcher_Helltide_StaticSMP_EventToke.desc: A collection of body parts to offer at a {c_highlight}Shrine of Slaughter{/c} found in Helltide.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Druid_.flavor: "I saw her climb to the peak of the mountains. She played a song on her talharpa, so sad it made the sky darken and rumble with thunder." -A History of Scosglen, Chapter IV

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HAxe_Unique_Gener.name: The Butcher's Cleaver
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HAxe_Unique_Gener.flavor: A nightmarish amalgam of blood, bone and steel, this axe is as horrific, and as deadly, as its creator.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HAxe_Unique_Gener.name: Thousand-Eye Reaver
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HAxe_Unique_Gener.flavor: No falsehood could endure the Thousand-Eyed King's reaver nor its countless eyes. Their gaze was bright and terrible, consumed with a world-eating hunger.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Ge.name: Rustbitten Dirk
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Ge.flavor: This blade favors the unguarded, the unmourned, the straggler.  For it knows that all bonds weaken in time, and that even kings may be found unguarded if patience is infinite.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.name: Azurewrath
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.flavor: The ancient runeblade of the angel Izual, Azurewrath was miraculously spared the corruption that consumed its master.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Gene.name: Banished Lord's Talisman
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Gene.flavor:
"His name has been lost to history, but to have been exiled from a land as cursed as Hawezar, his deeds must have been truly depraved."
- Scholar's Notes

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Gene.name: Blood-Mad Idol
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Gene.flavor: "The relic was fashioned for the broken-hearted and the battle-mad, for those whose rage has nowhere left to dwell." - Notes from Sister Octavia on the Burnt Knights

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Gener.name: Penitent Greaves
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Gener.flavor: Remorseful devotees of the Cathedral of Light must undertake a grueling pilgrimage, journeying across the frigid glacier known as the Serac Rapture. Only then may their gravest sins be forgiven.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Gener.name: Flickerstep
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Gener.flavor:
"Considered a failure by their creator, it wasn't until the assassination of an "untouchable" Caldeum noble that these boots' true power was understood."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Gener.name: Yen's Blessing
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Gener.flavor: These greaves are imbued with the divine blessing of Yen, the Veradani goddess of restoration. They bestow the wearer a revitalizing strength that enhances their own.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.name: Razorplate
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.flavor: Crafted by the cannibal Armoda, each piece of this interlocking armor has been sharpened into a knife's edge. Even a century after death, the plate remained on her corpse, unable to be removed safely.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.name: Soulbrand
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.flavor:
"To create such an artifact would require an impossible mastery over alchemy, transmutation and the subtle magics of the soul. By all rights, it should not exist, yet it does."
- Artisan Callas

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.name: Fists of Fate
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.flavor:
"Will you let fear cheat you, or will you risk everything to find understanding? After all, death is simply the coin with which we purchase life."
- Zurke

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.name: Frostburn
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.flavor: A touch so frigid it stops the heart and chills the very soul.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.name: Paingorger's Gauntlets
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.flavor: Crafted from fragments of Duriel's carapace, wearing these gloves, or being struck by them, causes an agonizing sensation akin to pushing one's hands through a thousand shards of glass.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.name: Wyrdskin
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.flavor: Each touch dulls pain. Enemies feel their vigor unravel as the poison withers their marrow and drinks deep of their strength.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.name: Godslayer Crown
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.flavor:
"The Sahptev faithful believe in a thousand and one gods. If it takes me as many lifetimes, I will find and kill them all."
- Gaspar Stilbian, Veradani Outcast

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Gener.name: Temerity
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Gener.flavor:
"The revelation that master tailor Callas was in fact a witch only served to further fuel the desire for her uniquely enchanted legwraps."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Gener.name: Tassets of the Dawning Sky
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Gener.flavor:
“May the Light of Father Inarius shine down upon all weary travelers of this holy land. Turn your face toward his radiance and find your strength renewed.”
- Statue Inscription

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Gener.name: Tibault's Will
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Gener.flavor:
"The younger apprentices think wearing heavy plate in the swamps is foolish. They fail to understand that our armor is our legacy, and without it we are nothing."
- Crusader Pembroke

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.name: Mother's Embrace
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.flavor:
"Every tome, every scroll, every book in this temple produces the same answer. The only being willing to stand against the Eternal Conflict, against the Prime Evils, was Lilith."
- Elias

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.name: X'Fal's Corroded Signet
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.flavor: Skulking in the shadows of the Realm of Destruction, the Scarred Baron plots the downfall of the mortal who banished him there.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.name: Wendigo Brand
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.flavor: In the first winters, a desperate spirit awoke within the hearts of men. Where famine walked, the spirit strengthened. When men consumed one another, it found its name.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HSword_Un.name: Shard of Verathiel
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HSword_Un.flavor: This blade once bore divine purpose wielded by the angel Verathiel. Like its keeper, the sword fell to Infernal depths. Yet beneath this corruption, is a heartbeat of a past memory, holding steadfast.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Amulet_Uni.name: Locran's Talisman
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Amulet_Uni.flavor: A single petal of the Mother's own blood, slowly wilting under glass.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Boots_Uniq.name: Rakanoth's Wake
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Boots_Uniq.flavor: Tread carefully on the plains of Hell, for each step sunders the soul and shatters the mind.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Gloves_Uni.name: Endurant Faith
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Gloves_Uni.flavor: Despite the Light's blessings, countless Knights Penitent were hewn apart by the infernal hordes. Remnants of their steel lie scattered through the Hells – dwindling lights in the chaos.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Helm_Uniqu.name: Crown of Lucion
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_Helm_Uniqu.flavor: The prince of Hatred, fair as maggots over carrion. He claims no throne, crafts no realms, reigning over only a blackened, bitter heart. Some legends name him banished, while others dread his return.

TWR_Cache_Tier07.desc: Contains gear and Tempering and Masterworking materials.
TWR_Cache_Tier07.flavor: Items contained may have unique dyed looks. Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

TWR_Cache_Tier18.desc: Contains gear and Horadric Cube reagents. Contains a Resplendent Spark.
TWR_Cache_Tier18.flavor: Items contained may have unique dyed looks. Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

1HDagger_Unique_Sorc_100_x2.name: Fang of the Vipermagi
1HDagger_Unique_Sorc_100_x2.flavor: The venom from these fangs was known to cause severe blisters and burns - forever. The Zann Esu were known to use them to fashion blades, supplementing their own abilities.

1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_102_x2.name: Shanar's Resonance
1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_102_x2.flavor: Mage halls across Sanctuary boast of their prodigious alumni, trained from an early age. However, one might argue that these talented children would have become powerful Wizards in their own right.

Ring_Unique_Generic_104_x2.name: Thundergod's Blessing
Ring_Unique_Generic_104_x2.flavor: The Unclean burned the Monastery, and all knowledge within. They beheaded the monks, and kept their tongues. All artifacts were lost - save for this.

Helm_Unique_Sorc_102_x2.name: Vision of the Firestorm
Helm_Unique_Sorc_102_x2.flavor: "From the Judgement of Inarius, the Firstborn faced suffering of all kinds. As the land of Atanos sank, the land of Skartara erupted..." -Tome recovered from Kasama

Amulet_Legendary_QST_Rathma_Reward.name: Rathma's Amulet
Amulet_Legendary_QST_Rathma_Reward.flavor:
"I saw my corpse, and from my mouth crawled Hatred"
- Rathma's Prophecy

X2_Talisman_CraftingMaterial_HoradricRes.name: {icon:Cube_TooltipIcon, 2} Infused Horadric Resin
X2_Talisman_CraftingMaterial_HoradricRes.desc:
A sticky substance used to craft {c_important}Charms{/c} and {c_important}Seals{/c} in the {icon:Cube_TooltipIcon, 1.5} {c_important}Horadric Cube{/c}

Obtained from salvaging Talisman Charms and Seals.
X2_Talisman_CraftingMaterial_HoradricRes.flavor: Considered foundational to the study of alchemy, herbs serve to bond and enhance other elixirs.

2HStaff_Unique_Sorc_101_x2.name: Staff of Zerae
2HStaff_Unique_Sorc_101_x2.flavor: "To walk the Path of Zerae, do not seek to control the storm within. Lose yourself to it, let it leave your body and become your shroud. Then you will see yourself as its master." -Queen Xaera

1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.name: Onyx Soul
1HFocus_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.flavor: Many adventurers have sailed the Frozen Sea, but most are lost to the depths. Legend has it the first to return spoke of a vast treasure. Alas, he could not carry it alone. Save for one relic.

Ring_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.name: Molten Band
Ring_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.flavor: Pillaged from the charred remains of Lord Bareen. It still feels hot to the touch.

Ring_Unique_Generic_105_x2.name: Signet of Pelghain
Ring_Unique_Generic_105_x2.flavor: Ksathra's strike roiled the seas, swallowing the land. The sky raged, unleashing devastating storms. In a moment, their empire gone. Their bond forever broken. Her sister, no more.

Amulet_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.name: Emberfury
Amulet_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.flavor: The greatest power is often the shortest lived.

Ring_Unique_Sorc_104_x2.name: Drognan's Anguish
Ring_Unique_Sorc_104_x2.flavor: Made from the finger of a silver-haired mage

twoHandAxe_uniq16.name: Messerschmidt's Reaver
twoHandAxe_uniq16.flavor: They say this axe has tasted the blood of Diablo himself. Unfortunately, the blood of countless demons now stains its edge, making it impossible to distinguish evil from Prime Evil.

twoHandMace_uniq21.name: The Furnace
twoHandMace_uniq21.flavor: "I think back to when I used this hammer to burn the bodies. I have no memory of screams during my work, but I have yet to have a restful night. Is this penance? Or punishment?" -General Arenton

sword_uniq29.name: In-Geom
sword_uniq29.flavor: "Housed in its steel were four tiger spirits. I put my ear to its edge, and I hear four beautiful voices crying out. Do you think they'd fancy me?" -Covetous Shen

twoHandPolearm_uniq21.name: Arioc's Needle
twoHandPolearm_uniq21.flavor: They took Arioc's fangs. What good was a spider without fangs? She jumped, thrashed, and crushed their bodies beneath her bulk. Yet, when they stabbed her belly with her own teeth, she felt...peace.

offHandFocus_uniq22.name: Henri's Perquisition
offHandFocus_uniq22.flavor: "There was no greater joy than when I sank my teeth into the mouse's body, proving that I was the apex predator. Now I have a new goal. The perfect napping place." -Henri the Cat

Gloves_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.name: Rimeblood
Gloves_Unique_Sorc_103_x2.flavor:
"We passed through the Fields of Judgement. The cold there...it chills your bones, and freezes your soul. Only I made it to the summit. The rest sit in prayer for eternity."
- The Pilgrimage of Agoa

Gloves_Unique_Sorc_102_x2.name: Levin Grasp
Gloves_Unique_Sorc_102_x2.flavor: The bandit lay on the floor, as a bolt of lightning arced between his friends. He watched the Sorceress walk away calmly as his friends fell to the floor, one by one.

treasuregoblin_variants_seasonal_cache.name: Junktooth's Bag of Oddities
treasuregoblin_variants_seasonal_cache.desc: Contains a large collection of seasonal items.
treasuregoblin_variants_seasonal_cache.flavor: The threadbare cloth has been patched with exotic fabrics, stained countless colors by unknowable substances. Where has this creature been? What does it want? Everywhere and anything, it seems...

Gloves_Unique_Necro_103.name: Hangman's Hand
Gloves_Unique_Necro_103.flavor: "The executioner's hands are imprinted with the essence of every life they have taken. They do not understand this, though. But we who seek Balance do." -Books of Kalan

Chest_Unique_Sorc_100_x2.name: Raiment of the Sea
Chest_Unique_Sorc_100_x2.flavor: The Firstborn sorrow is not forgotten, but sleeps in the sea, and in time wakes again.

Gloves_Unique_Necro_104.name: Deathgrip
Gloves_Unique_Necro_104.flavor: "There is something akin to desire that I have sensed in the dead. A longing to serve, to be of purpose in their new state of being. Do not deny them that purpose." -Books of Kalan

Helm_Unique_Necro_101.name: The Undercrown
Helm_Unique_Necro_101.flavor: "There is no true death. There is only the movement from one world to another. I stand in both of these worlds." -Necromancer Zayl

Ring_Unique_Necro_100_x2.name: Pact of Bone
Ring_Unique_Necro_100_x2.flavor: "Can one befriend the dead? What loyalty is earned or granted in the act of reanimation? On this subject, there is much I have yet to understand." -Deckard Cain

Boots_Unique_Sorc_101_x2.name: Gift of Frost
Boots_Unique_Sorc_101_x2.flavor: Legend says those who survive the Hall of Mirrors emerge forever changed, able to enchant objects with an innate cold.

Chest_Unique_Necro_101_x2.name: Vengeful Sinew
Chest_Unique_Necro_101_x2.flavor: "There have been tales, though I cannot attest to their veracity, of Necromancers drawing power from their anger, from their belief that the world has shifted far out of Balance." -Deckard Cain

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Palad.name: Mantle of the Grey
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Palad.flavor: The ensign bears the words: 'Beneath Saint Lalszo the Grey's gentle gaze, the cruel laid down their wrath, and the meek rose as lions. By his grace, no lost soul shall tread alone.'

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Pa.name: Herald of Zakarum
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Pa.flavor: "Praise Akarat, His will be done. Lead us to darkness, so our Light may shine and purify." - Zakarum prayer

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Pal.name: Griswold's Opus
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Pal.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Paladi.name: Argent Veil
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Paladi.flavor: "And the moon looked upon the pilgrims and wept a path of light. Through her tears they walked unseen, and night remembered them no more." - Orison XVII: Creed of the Dove

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Paladi.name: Seal of the Second Trumpet
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Paladi.flavor: "So is it written: when the Second Trumpet sounds, the wicked shall fall as stars cast down from their firmament." - Canticle of the Judgement, Verse XII

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Paladi.name: Judicant's Glaivehelm
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Paladi.flavor: "Let the righteous spear judge what man cannot. Its point unmasks the heretic, its edge silences their defiance." - Judicator Moseph of the Fourth Inquisition

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Pala.name: Sanctis of Kethamar
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Pala.flavor: A token wrought from the siege of Kethamar. May the keep's defenders be anointed and borne aloft on hallow'd flame.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HAxe_Unique_Palad.name: Sundered Night
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HAxe_Unique_Palad.flavor: "Heat struck my face and I thought the sun had risen early. Each swing of the hammer cleaved through the hordes, and every man shouted, wild with awe: The night ends!" - Survivor, Battle of Westmarch

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Pa.name: Cathedral's Song
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Pa.flavor: Sing. And so too will they sing. Rejoice. And so too will they rejoice. Fight. And so too will they fight.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Palad.name: Arcadia
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Palad.flavor: No wasteland may weary the bearer of Arcadia. Beneath their path, the soil remembers its first spring, and blades of war soften into petals.

Boots_Unique_Necro_102.name: Blood Wake
Boots_Unique_Necro_102.flavor: "These Priests of Rathma are quite peculiar. Is it possible to dabble in the forbidden yet uphold Balance? Too often, the power of such magic leads to corruption." –The Writings of Abd al-Hazir

Amulet_Unique_Necro_100_x2.name: Red Blessing
Amulet_Unique_Necro_100_x2.flavor: "The spark of life flows through blood, just as the spark of unlife flows through desiccated bone. There is power in both, if one knows how to use it." -Necromancer Zayl

1HShield_Unique_Necro_101.name: The Gloom Ward
1HShield_Unique_Necro_101.flavor: "Necromancers uphold the Balance between Light and Dark, life and death. Yet it is only natural, only human, that an individual might tend toward one or the other." -Deckard Cain

Amulet_Unique_Necro_102.name: Will of Rathma
Amulet_Unique_Necro_102.flavor: "Prey not on innocents, but instill fear in those who would." -Books of Kalan

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.name: Gladiator's Triumph
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.flavor: The Philios Games were said to welcome the prideful, the reckless, and the condemned.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.name: Fist of the Iron Rose
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.flavor: "She wished only to protect her sister. She journeyed far to Ivgorod. After years of training she returned home, being the only outsider to ever master the six techniques." -Legends of the Iron Rose

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.name: Sea Lord's Fine Gloves
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.flavor: Pirates rarely gather under a single Captain, but when they do, they raid from Skovos to Xiansai. The last was known as the Scourge of the Twin Seas, and left a crimson wake for decades.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Ro.name: Condemnation
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Ro.flavor:
"I've never seen such ruthless butchery. He deserves to be shipped off to die in the swamps with the rest of the godless murderers."
- Witness to the murder of Sergeant Walcot

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Rogue_.name: Cowl of the Nameless
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Rogue_.flavor:
"He is banished from the Guild, his name stricken from the Book. His punishment is to never have been." 
- Excerpt from a burned parchment

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Rogue.name: Assassin's Stride
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Rogue.flavor: The Viz-Jaq'taar descended on the mages indiscriminately and silently as a plague. The wise took flight, whilst the foolish fortified their dwellings as if walls or wards protected from shadow.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Ro.name: Etna's Lost Dagger
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HDagger_Unique_Ro.flavor: "Prepare thoroughly before approaching any Warlock. Fill your elixirs, replenish your arrows. Oil and sheath your blades before you depart." -Arts of the Viz-Jaq'taar

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Rogue.name: Scoundrel's Leathers
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Rogue.flavor:
"Rumor has it he lost them in a game of Skull & Anchor, but the boss is a devil with the dice. I think he wanted to give the poor sod something to keep him warm without wounding his pride."
- Elstir

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Rogue_.name: Saboteur's Signet
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Rogue_.flavor: "The element of surprise is the starting point. In this moment, be sure to finish it." - Kashya

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Rog.name: Misericorde
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Rog.flavor: A trapped prey awaits only a swift death. Sisters of the Sightless Eye will grant them this mercy.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Rogue.name: Beastfall Boots
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Rogue.flavor:
"Genai grew proud and fond of boasting of her hunting prowess. She claimed she was fast enough to catch even the spirit Leraye, who cursed her for such an insult."
- Fable of Genai's Twenty Trials

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Rogue_.name: Writhing Band of Trickery
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Rogue_.flavor: The ring shifts and spins on your finger as the forces within desperately attempt to escape.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HDagger_U.name: The Umbracrux
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HDagger_U.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Bitter voices whisper from the blade.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.name: Sunbird's Gorget
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.flavor: Long ago, the Sunbird swallowed the sun whole. In the dark, the Spiritborn Xipil crawled to its nest and tore the sun free from the bird's gullet. Since, its throat was scorched red for its folly.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Spiri.name: Jacinth Shell
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Spiri.flavor: This ceremonial armor was once adorned during the He Sutsar Puchē, where sacred blood is drawn by jacinth lancets and offered to flames. It retains the scents of incensed smoke and scorched copper.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Glaive_Unique_Spir.name: Wushe Nak Pa
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Glaive_Unique_Spir.flavor: "Fear not the limits of your flesh, Spiritborn!  As our ancestors said: wushe nak pa! Transcend your being!" - Maka

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Spirit.name: Harmony of Ebewaka
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Spirit.flavor: Only Ebewaka has walked amid a dozen Guardians. In death, they waged war for his spirit, yet none prevailed. Thus, the Guardians shared dominion, granting Ebewaka to roam freely amid all their realms.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Spirit.name: Loyalty's Mantle
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Spirit.flavor: During a Trial of Mists, a small spirit noticed an unclaimed boy. In pity, it spared him. "I will follow you always," vowed the boy. He remained true even after Ah Bulan called the spirit home.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Spiri.name: Protection of the Prime
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Spiri.flavor: "To commune with spirits, listen to whispers unseen. Root yourself unto the earth and let its pulse still the mind. Hear the ancient guardians – they rise to aid you." -Ysevete, the First Spiritborn

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Spiri.name: Balazan's Maxtlatl
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Spiri.flavor: "Know the dangers of fang and root. One hides in the leaf, the berry, the still water. The other waits in the bite, the stinger, the wound." - Teachings of Balazan, Verse III

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Uniqu.name: Sunstained War-Crozier
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Uniqu.flavor: "A relic of an old, forgotten religion lost to time and expansion. The staff retains a faint warmth as if still blessed by the dead god it once served." - Ser Paget's notes from the Tiklan excavation

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Uniqu.name: Sepazontec
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Uniqu.flavor: To the silent skies, the hunter Etzlek raised his staff and then smote the numen. "Release her!" came his cries as he desecrated the hallowed ground. On the third strike, the spirit answered...

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Uniqu.name: Rod of Kepeleke
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Quarterstaff_Uniqu.flavor: "Beyond the world disc doth lie the keeper serpent Kepeleke. Ceaseless the serpent grows, and thus must ever consume his own tail, lest the world be overtaken." - Lintel XII

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.name: Wound Drinker
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.flavor: The inner curve of this band is lined with thorns that tear the skin whenever it is unbound.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.name: Ring of Writhing Moon
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.flavor: "Within this corpse-bound carapace we writhe. Chaotic winds converge to churn your bones. Our beat and breath a ceaseless war to break. The wretched cyclone black beyond the bounds." - Balazan's Dream

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.name: Ring of the Midnight Sun
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.flavor: "At midnight laughed the second brother, Nebahayomo, spirit of cunning. Trickery is his blessing, suffering is his prayer. Honor him and shrewdness shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse V

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.name: Echo of Kwatli
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.flavor: "Strike once to expose weakness, strike again to exploit it." -Teachings of Ysevete, the First Spiritborn

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.name: Protean Heart
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.flavor: "Nahantu is everchanging. Nahantu is everlasting. When the Burning Hells become ash and soot, and when the High Heavens come crashing down, Nahantu will remain." -Excerpt from Defiance of Enkasi

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.name: Widow's Web
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Spir.flavor: "One touch is all it took...she looked into my eyes. I understood her hunger, endless and painful. I will start with the taverns and find a strong one, with strong blood." -Jios, Sarat's Servant

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.name: Band of First Breath
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.flavor: A gentle whisper glides upon the winds. The words elude the grasp of mortal ken. They weave through the soul like a melody forgotten, and from this arises a name: Adarja, the First-Breather.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.name: Peacemonger's Signet
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.flavor: "In Natsalarwaka, no blood shall mar the earth. Even bitter enemies must forgo their blades before entering the haven. Breaking this accord will invoke Wasipotsu's wrath." - Oral Oaxazi Scripture

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.name: Ring of the Midday Hunt
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Spirit.flavor: "At midday thundered the first brother, Nyamoyo, lord of predators. Survival is his blessing, hunting is his prayer. Honor him and prowess shall be your reward." - The Nitī Sē, Verse IV

Ring_Unique_Necro_102.name: Omen of Pain
Ring_Unique_Necro_102.flavor: "I have lost, more than I can put into words. Perhaps there are better ways to express loss than words...." -Rathma

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Barb_1.name: Tuskhelm of Joritz the Mighty
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Barb_1.flavor: As he fought with side by side with Raekor to liberate the labor camp, Joritz claimed this dented helm from a fallen foe. As his legend grew, its unique shape became synonymous with his great deeds.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Barb_.name: Rage of Harrogath
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Barb_.flavor: Harrogath, the final bastion of resistance against Baal's assault on Mt. Arreat was destroyed along with the Worldstone. The survivors never forgave the betrayal that led to the loss of their home.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Bar.name: Ramaladni's Magnum Opus
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Bar.flavor:
"Without him the wine is less sweet, the hearth less warm, and our blades less keen. Our blood brother is gone, but Bul-Kathos willing, we will meet again one day."
- Sorrowsong for Ramaladni

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Bar.name: Sabre of Tsasgal
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Bar.flavor: A foul blizzard trapped the clans after the Battle of Nine Winters. Then came a pale stallion born of the peaks, and the storm parted before him. Tsasgal, they named him - chief of all horses.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Barb_.name: Arreat's Bearing
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Barb_.flavor: "Rise clansmen and reclaim our trampled honor! Ancients' blood runs through us all! We are storms: earth breaking, maelstrom wielding. The fire of the gods burn still! They are with us!" -Ealda

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Barb_.name: Chainscourged Mail
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Barb_.flavor: To chain the kin of Bul-Kathos is to gift them a weapon.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Barb_.name: Hooves of the Mountain God
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Barb_.flavor:
Break their bones beneath your weight, 
Fell their walls and breach their gate. 
In his halls we'll boast and sing, 
And praise our honored mountain king!

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Barb_1.name: Ring of Red Furor
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Barb_1.flavor:
"Anger brings strength but clouds the mind. You must learn to focus your fury, direct it with purpose. Keep our sacred duty at the forefront of your mind, always."
- Talic, to Madawc

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.name: Emblem of Staalbreak
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.flavor: An old mark of office from the town of Staalbreak, in the Dreadlands. The rage of its last owner still emanates from within.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.name: Dark Stalker's Medallion
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.flavor: "Tried dying once. Didn't care for it." -Renit the Dark Stalker

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.name: Nomad's Longing Heart
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.flavor:
"O Crane, what news do you bring from our mountain?
Long have I been away, in strange lands.
I yearn for home, for the highland snows,
Why silent, Crane? Have you no news from Arreat?"

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.name: The Open Eye of Gorgorra
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Barb.flavor: Ever watchful were the Patriarchs, as the Unclean slowly made their way out of the Dreadlands.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HSword_Unique_War.name: Anathema of the Primes
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HSword_Unique_War.flavor: Hatred begins the first cut. Terror holds the wound. Destruction comes at last, patient and certain, to devour what remains.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HMace_Unique_Warl.name: Scepter of the Three
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HMace_Unique_Warl.flavor: "The Primes warred, but not for glory. They did so for the joy of mayhem. How many legions of demons died simply to delight the lords of Hell?" -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HAxe_Unique_Warlo.name: Dirge of Odium
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HAxe_Unique_Warlo.flavor: "I am the voice of vengeance unsated. Brandish me and my enmity shall walk with thine. Thy grief is thy tithe. My dirge, the dread reward."

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.name: Seed of Horazon
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.flavor: "In all dealings with Hells' spawn, names are both key and chain. To speak a demon's true name is to invite its presence, and seize some small dominion over it." - Master Horazon

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.name: Moloch's Beating Flame
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.flavor: "Therefore, behold, the days come that it shall no more be called thine own body, nor thine own heart, but the heart of Moloch, for each heartbeat shall roar with the flames of Hell..." -Taphya 3:26

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.name: Night Terror
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.flavor:
"Sleep, my child, shut fast thine eyes, 
Keep thee still until sunrise. 
Astrogha's brood will hear thy breath, 
And lull thee close to dreaming death." -Westmarch lullaby

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Warlo.name: Morlu Fleshward
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Warlo.flavor: "The morlu are incredibly resilient. Stories from the Sin War describe them fighting despite heavy wounds." -Book of Adria

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Warlo.name: Fleshwrit Carapace
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Warlo.flavor: "...Our rites are written not with ink, but with blood. Not upon stone, but upon the living flesh..." – The Forbidden Ledger

cmp_base000_woodwraith.name: Loathroot
cmp_base000_woodwraith.desc: Using this item adds Loathroot to your Pet Collection in the Wardrobe.
cmp_base000_woodwraith.flavor: "Hate doesn't just die when you cut it down. It crops up again and again, like a bleedin' forest!"

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Ne.name: The Gloom Ward
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HShield_Unique_Ne.flavor: "Necromancers uphold the Balance between Light and Dark, life and death. Yet it is only natural, only human, that an individual might tend toward one or the other." -Deckard Cain

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HScythe_Unique_Ne.name: Bloodless Scream
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HScythe_Unique_Ne.flavor: "My companion swung her odd weapon in a wide arc, and our pursuer stopped short. The look of horror on his face as his body fell to pieces will haunt me forever." -The Ebon Pages, Canto II, Verse XI

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Necr.name: Red Blessing
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Necr.flavor: "The spark of life flows through blood, just as the spark of unlife flows through desiccated bone. There is power in both, if one knows how to use it." -Necromancer Zayl

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Necr.name: Will of Rathma
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Necr.flavor: "Prey not on innocents, but instill fear in those who would." -Books of Kalan

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Necro.name: Blood Moon Breeches
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Pants_Unique_Necro.flavor: A naturally occurring curiosity, the blood moon persists as a sign of woe for the most superstitious Zakarum faithful. Children born under it are often considered cursed and cast out, lest it spread.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Necro_.name: Pact of Bone
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Necro_.flavor: "Can one befriend the dead? What loyalty is earned or granted in the act of reanimation? On this subject, there is much I have yet to understand." -Deckard Cain

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Necro_.name: Omen of Pain
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Necro_.flavor: "I have lost, more than I can put into words. Perhaps there are better ways to express loss than words...." -Rathma

Gloves_Unique_Necro_105.name: Gravewalker's Hand
Gloves_Unique_Necro_105.flavor: "There is a point one can reach, a oneness with the Balance, when a single, silent gesture is enough to summon an army of bone to your command." -Necromancer Mehtan

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Necr.name: Gravewalker's Hand
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Necr.flavor: "There is a point one can reach, a oneness with the Balance, when a single, silent gesture is enough to summon an army of bone to your command." -Necromancer Mehtan

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HMace_Unique_Sorc.name: Orsivane
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HMace_Unique_Sorc.flavor: Lo, its strike is thunder, its sting a dirge. Those smote are unmade, scattered as chaff before the breath of ancients.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Sorc.name: Emberfury
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Sorc.flavor: The greatest power is often the shortest lived.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Sorc_1.name: Molten Band
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Sorc_1.flavor: Pillaged from the charred remains of Lord Bareen. It still feels hot to the touch.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Sorc_1.name: Drognan's Anguish
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Sorc_1.flavor: Made from the finger of a silver-haired mage

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Sorc_1.name: Tal Rasha's Iridescent Loop
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Sorc_1.flavor:
"Fool said he dug it out of the sands near Lut Gholein with a few other 'worthless trinkets'. I hid my delight at receiving such a treasure in exchange for a meager handful of coins."
- Rakhaan

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Sorc_.name: Esu's Heirloom
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Sorc_.flavor:
"While scholars have proven these boots were not created by Esu herself, it is noteworthy that they have been passed down since the formation of the Mage Clans."
- Barrett's Book of Implements

PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_Seals.name: PTR Cache - Seals
PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_Seals.desc: Contains a great deal of Seals for the Talisman.
PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_Seals.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_SetCharms.name: PTR Cache - Set Charms
PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_SetCharms.desc: Contains a great deal of Set Charms for the Talisman.
PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_SetCharms.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_UniqueCharms.name: PTR Cache - Unique Charms
PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_UniqueCharms.desc: Contains a great deal of Unique Charms for the Talisman.
PTR_CheatVendor_Talisman_UniqueCharms.flavor: Likely useful to be by a Stash before opening.

QST_Skov_Temis_BIA_Medallion.name: Steadfast Insignia
QST_Skov_Temis_BIA_Medallion.flavor: A medallion signifying high rank among the Knights Penitent. A true Knight would never part with it.

BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos_Bloodied.name: Stay Fresh Meat Box
BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos_Bloodied.desc: A collection of Bloodied items as a reward for your efforts. Contains a random assortment and amount of items from all the other available collections.
BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos_Bloodied.flavor: The Tree leaves no debt unsettled. Some of the items inside smell faintly of decay, but the whispers assure you their value is undiminished.

BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos_Bloodied_Upgraded.name: Greater Stay Fresh Meat Box
BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos_Bloodied_Upgraded.desc: A cache of Bloodied items as a reward for your efforts. Contains a random assortment and amount of items from all the other available collections.
BountyMeta_Cache_Chaos_Bloodied_Upgraded.flavor: The Tree leaves no debt unsettled. Some of the items inside smell faintly of decay, but the whispers assure you their value is undiminished.
