Collection_Item_Butcher.name: Fresh Meat

QST_Skov_Philios_MadHoney_Honey.name: Mad Honey
QST_Skov_Philios_MadHoney_Honey.flavor: The crimson-gold nectar produced by wasps and wild bees that drink from the azaleas native to Skovos. To the tongue, it burns like vinegar and creates a tingling numbness.

S12_DungeonSigil_BSK_SpecialButcher_Tier.name: Infernal Hordes Compass
S12_DungeonSigil_BSK_SpecialButcher_Tier.desc: Transform this place into a {icon:Marker_BSK_Entrance,2}{c_highlight}Bloodied Infernal Hordes{/c} with {c_red}greater challenge{/c} and greater reward.

S12_BloodyLairSigil_Bloodsoaked.name: Lair Boss Sigil
S12_BloodyLairSigil_Bloodsoaked.desc: Transform this place into a{icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossSummon, 2}{c_highlight}Bloodied Lair{/c} with {c_red}greater challenge{/c} and greater reward.

S12_BloodyNMDSigil_Bloodsoaked.name: Nightmare Sigil
S12_BloodyNMDSigil_Bloodsoaked.desc: Transform this place into a {icon:Icon_Tooltip_NightmareDungeonEntrance,1.5} {c_highlight}Bloodied Nightmare Dungeon{/c} with {c_red}greater challenge{/c} and greater reward.

S12_1HSword_Unique_Barb_101.name: Ramaladni's Magnum Opus (Crucible)
S12_1HSword_Unique_Barb_101.flavor:
"Without him the wine is less sweet, the hearth less warm, and our blades less keen. Our blood brother is gone, but Bul-Kathos willing, we will meet again one day."
- Sorrowsong for Ramaladni

S12_1HSword_Unique_Barb_103.name: Sabre of Tsasgal (Crucible)
S12_1HSword_Unique_Barb_103.flavor: A foul blizzard trapped the clans after the Battle of Nine Winters. Then came a pale stallion born of the peaks, and the storm parted before him. Tsasgal, they named him - chief of all horses.

S12_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: Doombringer (Crucible)
S12_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Whenever this ancient sword has reappeared throughout history, it portends a time of great strife, as well as a devastating loss of life.

S12_1HSword_Unique_Generic_100.name: Azurewrath (Crucible)
S12_1HSword_Unique_Generic_100.flavor: The ancient runeblade of the angel Izual, Azurewrath was miraculously spared the corruption that consumed its master.

S12_1HSword_Unique_Paladin_001.name: Supplication (Crucible)
S12_1HSword_Unique_Paladin_001.flavor: The scroll's words are known to the knight alone. He supplicates to his sworn oath, lest his faith and blade find no purchase.

S12_1HSword_Unique_Paladin_002.name: Griswold's Opus (Crucible)
S12_1HSword_Unique_Paladin_002.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.

S12_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Barbarian_001.name: The Third Blade (Crucible)
S12_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Barbarian_001.flavor: "Restraint, mercy, honor...these are shackles, forged by the weak and the conquered." -Hephasto, the Armorer

S12_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: Shard of Verathiel (Crucible)
S12_BSK_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: This blade once bore divine purpose wielded by the angel Verathiel. Like its keeper, the sword fell to Infernal depths. Yet beneath this corruption, is a heartbeat of a past memory, holding steadfast.

S12_1HAxe_Unique_Druid_100.name: Waxing Gibbous (Crucible)
S12_1HAxe_Unique_Druid_100.flavor: The nights preceding the full moon are sometimes far more dangerous than the event itself. The frenzy has begun to rise, yet the night is just dark enough to obscure a hunter from their prey's sight.

S12_1HAxe_Unique_Generic_001.name: The Butcher's Cleaver (Crucible)
S12_1HAxe_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: A nightmarish amalgam of blood, bone and steel, this axe is as horrific, and as deadly, as its creator.

S12_1HAxe_Unique_Generic_003.name: Thousand-Eye Reaver (Crucible)
S12_1HAxe_Unique_Generic_003.flavor: No falsehood could endure the Thousand-Eyed King's reaver nor its countless eyes. Their gaze was bright and terrible, consumed with a world-eating hunger.

S12_2HSword_Unique_Barb_002.name: Fields of Crimson (Crucible)
S12_2HSword_Unique_Barb_002.flavor:
"We've been fighting these flesh-eaters for so long, been soaked in so much blood, that after a while it's difficult to tell what side you're truly on."
- Daelyr, Crane Tribe warrior

S12_2HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: The Grandfather (Crucible)
S12_2HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.

S12_2HSword_Unique_Necro_100.name: Sanguivor, Blade of Zir (Crucible)
S12_2HSword_Unique_Necro_100.flavor: The parched blade keens, longing to serve its master.

S12_2HSword_Unique_Paladin_002.name: Red Sermon (Crucible)
S12_2HSword_Unique_Paladin_002.flavor: "Thus spake Que-Hegan Sankekur the righteous: when prayer fails man, let the blade be our psalm. May the blood of unbelievers be the ink which we write our faith anew." -Excerpt from Brother Ismail

S12_2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_001.name: Shattered Vow (Crucible)
S12_2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Malthael's last and only gift to mankind - a vow that our suffering shall end.

S12_1HDagger_Unique_Generic_001.name: Rustbitten Dirk (Crucible)
S12_1HDagger_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: This blade favors the unguarded, the unmourned, the straggler.  For it knows that all bonds weaken in time, and that even kings may be found unguarded if patience is infinite.

S12_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.name: Condemnation (Crucible)
S12_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.flavor:
"I've never seen such ruthless butchery. He deserves to be be shipped off to die in the swamps with the rest of the godless murderers."
- Witness to the murder of Sergeant Walcot

S12_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_002.name: Asheara's Khanjar (Crucible)
S12_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_002.flavor: When Caldeum's gates closed, Asheara led her Iron Wolves out of the city knowing full well they would never return. Instead they roamed Kehjistan pledging their blades to any who were in need.

S12_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Necro_001.name: The Mortacrux (Crucible)
S12_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Necro_001.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Nearby corpses shudder in its presence.

S12_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.name: The Umbracrux (Crucible)
S12_BSK_1HDagger_Unique_Rogue_001.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Bitter voices whisper from the blade.

QST_Skov_DiluvianBlade_BladeReward.name: Diluvian Blade
QST_Skov_DiluvianBlade_BladeReward.flavor: An ancient Firstborn blade preserved in time by unnatural forces.

1HSword_Unique_Generic_002.name: El'Druin, Sword of Justice
1HSword_Unique_Generic_002.flavor: You hold Justice itself in your hands.

X2_2HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq13.name: The Stillblade
X2_2HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq13.flavor: A thousand eyes peer through the Void. Their silence is the drawing of breath.

S15_Khalims_Heart.name: Khalim's Heart
S15_Khalims_Heart.flavor:
"You have found Khalim's Heart, and it still bears the courage to face Mephisto." 
- Deckard Cain

S15_Khalims_Brain.name: Khalim's Brain
S15_Khalims_Brain.flavor:
"This is most fortunate... Khalim's Brain knows Mephisto's weakness." 
- Deckard Cain

S15_Khalims_Eye.name: Khalim's Eye
S15_Khalims_Eye.flavor:
"Ah... Khalim's Eye... Only it can reveal the true path to Mephisto." 
- Deckard Cain

S15_Khalims_Flail.name: Khalim's Flail
S15_Khalims_Flail.flavor:
"Once properly imbued, Khalim's Flail can destroy the Compelling Orb and reveal the way to Mephisto." 
- Deckard Cain

X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq20_War.name: Soul Taker
X2_1HDagger_Legendary_Generic_uniq20_War.flavor: The blade hums faintly in your hands. It seems to be asking, no, begging for you to draw blood with it.

X2_1HMace_Legendary_Generic_uniq17_Warpl.name: Ward-Hammer
X2_1HMace_Legendary_Generic_uniq17_Warpl.flavor: Protection is more than defending those dear to you. It is also pummeling those who wish them harm.

X2_1HSword_Legendary_Generic_uniq27_Warp.name: DNS this is using eldriun's appearance

X2_Chest_Legendary_Generic_base16_Warpla.name: Plackart of Hefaetrus
X2_Chest_Legendary_Generic_base16_Warpla.flavor: "She is a mountain—strong and beautiful, with a fury that rains fire. But, navigate that fury, and you may find she has treasures to share, like the armor I wear on my chest." -Hefaetrus

X2_Helm_Legendary_Generic_base16_Warplan.name: Helm of Askarra
X2_Helm_Legendary_Generic_base16_Warplan.flavor: "Early in our courtship, Philios gifted me a dress of satin. I tore it in half before his eyes. The next day, he gifted me the helmet I wear now. That's when I knew he understood me." -Askarra

X2_Pants_Legendary_Generic_base16_Warpla.name: Leggings of Karcheus
X2_Pants_Legendary_Generic_base16_Warpla.flavor: "For all his talk of mirrors, I never see Karcheus gaze at his own reflection. I once asked him about this and he said, 'It shows too much.'" -Philios

X2_Fish_RandomCache.name: Waterlogged Cache
X2_Fish_RandomCache.desc: Contains an unknown assortment of items, and lots of water.

BossSummoning_Mephisto.name: Crux of the False Prophet
BossSummoning_Mephisto.flavor: "Let all illusions burn from your eyes."

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.name: Doombringer
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.flavor: Whenever this ancient sword has reappeared throughout history, it portends a time of great strife, as well as a devastating loss of life.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HPolearm_Unique_G.name: Shattered Vow
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HPolearm_Unique_G.flavor: Malthael's last and only gift to mankind - a vow that our suffering shall end.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HSword_Unique_Gen.name: The Grandfather
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HSword_Unique_Gen.flavor: An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Gene.name: Melted Heart of Selig
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Gene.flavor:
"Do not allow your passions to become obsessions. Fuel the fire that burns within you, but it is madness to allow yourself to become ash to please an uncaring universe."
- Last words of Master Selig

S15_StaffOfKings.name: Staff of Kings
S15_StaffOfKings.flavor:
"The Staff of Kings! You astound me, my friend. You have discovered the shaft portion of a Horadric Staff."
-Deckard Cain

S15_ViperAmulet.name: Amulet of the Viper
S15_ViperAmulet.flavor:
"The Viper Amulet you bear is actually the headpiece of a Horadric Staff!
Yes... You have an uncanny knack for finding rare and valuable artifacts."
-Deckard Cain

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.name: Shroud of False Death
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.flavor: "Auriel alone saw past Lucion's guise. With Al'maiesh aloft, she smote the vile prince. Hatred's seed feigned death and waited, loath to enter the Abyss again." - The Great Conflict, Tome I

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.name: Tyrael's Might
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.flavor:
"Thus Tyrael, a perfect aspect of Justice, came to be. None were more vehement against the forces of hell. All demonic entities learned to shudder at Justice's might." 
-The Books of Jarl, Volume I

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Glaive_Unique_Spir.name: Nesekem, the Herald
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Glaive_Unique_Spir.flavor: In the days when Ajaw Y'ishich ruled Nahantu, the phoenix constellation's crown fell in burning glory. From it was forged a blade that withered valor, heralding an age of despair.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.name: Andariel's Visage
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.flavor: The horrific whispers of the Maiden of Anguish flicker through your mind, pushing you ever closer to madness...

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.name: Harlequin Crest
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.flavor:
"This headdress was once worn by an assassin disguised as a court mage. Her treachery was unveiled, but not before she used its magic to curse the king's entire lineage."
- The Fall of House Aston

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.name: Heir of Perdition
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Generi.flavor: Beware false prophets donned as sheep yet bearing the stench of wolves. Thou shalt know them by their fruits. For a tree of good cannot produce evil, nor thorns yield a harvest sweet and fair.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.name: Ring of Starless Skies
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.flavor:
"Yours is the power to pluck the stars from the heavens with the ease of a child gathering fruit from the bough."
- Unknown

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.name: El'Druin, Sword of Justice
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.flavor: You hold Justice itself in your hands.

X2_1HDagger_Generic_NeyrellesDagger.name: Neyrelle's Defiance
X2_1HDagger_Generic_NeyrellesDagger.flavor: A tiny message from Vhenard to Neyrelle is carved near the pommel: "The search for knowledge is never safe, Magpie. Keep your talons sharp."

S15_HoradricStaff.name: Horadric Staff
S15_HoradricStaff.flavor:
"Be prepared for a fight - you'll likely have to kill Tal Rasha to destroy Baal."
-Deckard Cain

BountyMeta_Cache_Warplans_Mystery_Upgrad.name: Greater Collection of Mysteries
BountyMeta_Cache_Warplans_Mystery_Upgrad.desc: A collection of items as a reward for your efforts. Each collection is different from the last, and the value of what is inside varies to an extraordinary level.
BountyMeta_Cache_Warplans_Mystery_Upgrad.flavor: The Tree of Whispers is a capricious being. None can predict what it will offer, what it means...or who paid the price for it.

BountyMeta_Cache_Warplans_Mystery_Ancest.name: Ancestral Collection of Mysteries {icon:AttributeBullet_GreaterAffix,1.5}

BountyMeta_Cache_Warplans_Mystery_Ancest.flavor: The Tree of Whispers is a capricious being. None can predict what it will offer, what it means...or who paid the price for it.

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.name: Phoba of Slaughter
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.name: Fer of Slaughter
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.name: Mlor of Slaughter
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.name: Phoba of Practiced Technique
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Phoba, Fer. Emotion and Mind. These form the root of a mage's intention, no matter the medium. Focus first upon these, and put all ambition aside." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Phoba, Fer. Emotion and Mind. These form the root of a mage's intention, no matter the medium. Focus first upon these, and put all ambition aside." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Life can be most often characterized as meat ruled by instinct. Dumb flesh, Mlor alone. Disassembly is the most efficient, I find." -Zoltun Kulle

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.name: Phoba of Dark Pact
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Berú... The purest, strongest, and most perilous aspect of the mage is their Soul. Our work demands that we risk it for the greater good. When and how is your choice." -Tal Rasha

Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.name: Fer of Dark Pact
Talisman_Charm_Set_Small_PreTorment_Gene.flavor: "Berú... The purest, strongest, and most perilous aspect of the mage is their Soul. Our work demands that we risk it for the greater good. When and how is your choice." -Tal Rasha

X2_Cache_Greater.desc: Contains an assortment of Seals, Charms, Horadric Cube Materials and other useful goods to aid you on your journey.

S15_MinorTemporalRift_Key.flavor: A vivid account of horrors long past, penned by a trembling hand.

A valuable key to a locked chest, but it's also covered in mucus. 

Gross.

S14_Seasonal_Currency.name: Pandemonium Fragment
S14_Seasonal_Currency.desc: A piece of the fractured realm at the center of creation. It quivers with restless anima — that of angels, demons, and mortals long passed.

mnt_uniq47_trophy.desc: The tattered cowl hangs empty, yet still glows with a cold, sickening aura.

S14_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: Doombringer
S14_1HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Whenever this ancient sword has reappeared throughout history, it portends a time of great strife, as well as a devastating loss of life.

S14_1HSword_Unique_Generic_002.name: El'Druin, Sword of Justice
S14_1HSword_Unique_Generic_002.flavor: You hold Justice itself in your hands.

S14_2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_001.name: Shattered Vow
S14_2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Malthael's last and only gift to mankind - a vow that our suffering shall end.

S14_2HStaff_Unique_Generic_100.name: Ahavarion, Spear of Lycander
S14_2HStaff_Unique_Generic_100.flavor:
"The angel Lycander left us a portion of her power in this spear. It is all the proof I need that she watches over us still."
- Oracle Argoysni

S14_2HSword_Unique_Generic_001.name: The Grandfather
S14_2HSword_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.

S14_Amulet_Unique_Generic_100.name: Melted Heart of Selig
S14_Amulet_Unique_Generic_100.flavor:
"Do not allow your passions to become obsessions. Fuel the fire that burns within you, but it is madness to allow yourself to become ash to please an uncaring universe."
- Last words of Master Selig

S14_Chest_Unique_Generic_103.name: Shroud of False Death
S14_Chest_Unique_Generic_103.flavor: "Auriel alone saw past Lucion's guise. With Al'maiesh aloft, she smote the vile prince. Hatred's seed feigned death and waited, loath to enter the Abyss again." - The Great Conflict, Tome I

S14_Chest_Unique_Generic_127.name: Tyrael's Might
S14_Chest_Unique_Generic_127.flavor:
"Thus Tyrael, a perfect aspect of Justice, came to be. None were more vehement against the forces of hell. All demonic entities learned to shudder at Justice's might." 
-The Books of Jarl, Volume I

S14_Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_014_x1.name: Nesekem, the Herald
S14_Glaive_Unique_Spiritborn_014_x1.flavor: In the days when Ajaw Y'ishich ruled Nahantu, the phoenix constellation's crown fell in burning glory. From it was forged a blade that withered valor, heralding an age of despair.

S14_Helm_Unique_Generic_001.name: Andariel's Visage
S14_Helm_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: The horrific whispers of the Maiden of Anguish flicker through your mind, pushing you ever closer to madness...

S14_Helm_Unique_Generic_002.name: Harlequin Crest
S14_Helm_Unique_Generic_002.flavor:
"This headdress was once worn by an assassin disguised as a court mage. Her treachery was unveiled, but not before she used its magic to curse the king's entire lineage."
- The Fall of House Aston

S14_Helm_Unique_Generic_004.name: Heir of Perdition
S14_Helm_Unique_Generic_004.flavor: Beware false prophets donned as sheep yet bearing the stench of wolves. Thou shalt know them by their fruits. For a tree of good cannot produce evil, nor thorns yield a harvest sweet and fair.

S14_OWCSMP_Crown.name: The Cow King's Crown
S14_OWCSMP_Crown.desc: Yup, that's a crown all right!
S14_OWCSMP_Crown.flavor: "We need just wait for the final decade to pass. By three, they come. By three thy pen opens. With the cud of the willing, we call thee home." - The Cow King, Hoof of Moophisto

Helm_Unique_Generic_005.name: Leoric's Crown
Helm_Unique_Generic_005.flavor: "Heavy, isn't it?" Leoric said, fussing with his new crown, "The weight alone might topple me from the throne." Archbishop Lazarus only smiled, calm and cold. "It catches the Light well, your grace."

Chest_Unique_Generic_104.name: Squirt's Blouse
Chest_Unique_Generic_104.flavor: It looks like the blouse of a street urchin with a crude stone pendant. But the inside is lined with hidden pockets and sinister sheathes. And on the back of the pendant? A old runic word: "Kantwirt."

Gloves_Unique_Generic_006.name: Nemesis Bracers
Gloves_Unique_Generic_006.flavor: Though tarnished by centuries, the bright steel is unmarked by battle. It inspires courage until one sees the padding, stained black with old blood. The names of bygone owners fade in the leather.

2HAxe_Unique_Generic_001.name: Messerschmidt's Reaver
2HAxe_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: Before the ashes of Old Tristram had cooled, the scavengers crept in—down into the crumbling cathedral to snatch anything of value. The late Prince Aidan's greataxe would fetch a fine price indeed.

1HSword_Unique_Generic_103.name: In-Geom
1HSword_Unique_Generic_103.flavor: "Ahh, the In-Geom! The royal smiths of Xiansai folded the spirits of not one—but four tigers into the steel! Come! Put your ear to its edge. You can almost hear them... Meow!" -Covetous Shen

2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_002.name: Arioc's Needle
2HPolearm_Unique_Generic_002.flavor: For decades, the spearhead lay encased in resin, warded with runes, and sealed in a block of granite. So feared was the venom infused in its tip, taken from the fang of a great spider, long extinct.

1HFocus_Unique_Generic_001.name: Henri's Perquisition
1HFocus_Unique_Generic_001.flavor: "It's just a cat," said Ankaj. Her uncle leaned in, "You are spiritborn. Look deeper." In its amber eyes, Ankaj saw the passing of ages, fixed on a single thought: "Mouse." The cat smacked its lips.

Ring_Unique_Generic_108.name: Stone of Jordan
Ring_Unique_Generic_108.flavor: Nine out of ten appraisers would see a dull stone. Crudely cut. Simply set. But a trained eye might see past the illusion placed by its Ammuit craftsman...and marvel at the wellspring of magic within.

S15_SoulSplinter_TriadB_01.flavor: When the Worldstone was destroyed at Arreat, the entropy of the Burning Hells became a part of the surrounding landscape.

S15_SoulSplinter_TriadC_01.desc: Replace your current splinter with the Splinter of Hatred.
S15_SoulSplinter_TriadC_01.flavor: The corrupted Zakarum priests sacrificed anyone passing nearby Travincal, filling the Durance under the temple with discarded offerings to Mephisto.

BossSummoning_Superior_LairKey.name: Superior Lair Key
BossSummoning_Superior_LairKey.desc:
Used to open a {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair, 1.8} {c_important}Superior Lair Boss Hoard{/c}.

Acquired from {icon:Marker_ApparitionIncursionBelial,1.8}{c_important}Belial, Lord of Lies{/c}, who sometimes ambushes after opening a {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair, 1.8}{c_important}Lair Boss's Hoard{/c}. 

Belial will only drop his treasure for those who opened the Hoard that caught his attention.

Only found in Torment difficulties.
BossSummoning_Superior_LairKey.flavor: Masterwork engravings and silver filigree spiral outward from a cluster of etched runes, with intricacies possibly outside the skill of human hands.

S15_WirtsCoins.desc:
"Sometimes, only you will be able to find a purpose for some things."
- Wirt the Peg-Legged Boy

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.name: Squirt's Blouse
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Gener.flavor: It looks like the blouse of a street urchin with a crude stone pendant. But the inside is lined with hidden pockets and sinister sheathes. And on the back of the pendant? A old runic word: "Kantwirt."

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HMace_Unique_Gene.name: The Furnace
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HMace_Unique_Gene.flavor: "What plague has befouled, let fire make clean. What agony these good people have suffered, let it settle quietly in the dust." -General Arenton

S15_StandardOfHeroes.name: Standard of Heroes
S15_StandardOfHeroes.desc: The mark of a true champion.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_Gen.name: Henri's Perquisition
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_Gen.flavor: "It's just a cat," said Ankaj. Her uncle leaned in, "You are spiritborn. Look deeper." In its amber eyes, Ankaj saw the passing of ages, fixed on a single thought: "Mouse." The cat smacked its lips.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.name: In-Geom
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HSword_Unique_Gen.flavor: "Ahh, the In-Geom! The royal smiths of Xiansai folded the spirits of not one—but four tigers into the steel! Come! Put your ear to its edge. You can almost hear them... Meow!" -Covetous Shen

Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HPolearm_Unique_G.name: Arioc's Needle
Talisman_Charm_Unique_2HPolearm_Unique_G.flavor: For decades, the spearhead lay encased in resin, warded with runes, and sealed in a block of granite. So feared was the venom infused in its tip, taken from the fang of a great spider, long extinct.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.name: Nemesis Bracers
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Gene.flavor: Though tarnished by centuries, the bright steel is unmarked by battle. It inspires courage until one sees the padding, stained black with old blood. The names of bygone owners fade in the leather.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.name: Stone of Jordan
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.flavor: Nine out of ten appraisers would see a dull stone. Crudely cut. Simply set. But a trained eye might see past the illusion placed by its Ammuit craftsman...and marvel at the wellspring of magic within.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_Nec.name: Gospel of the Devotee
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_Nec.flavor: "Tremble not before the one who has mastered a thousand incantations. Tremble before the one who has made a single spell his gospel, his body, his breath." -One Who Never Sleeps

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_War.name: Infernal Homunculus
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_War.flavor: It grows restless in silence, thrashing against its bindings. Though the body is small, it dreams of carnage unimaginable.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_War.name: Eye of Baal
Talisman_Charm_Unique_1HFocus_Unique_War.flavor: "When the moon turns crimson, it is Baal's eye opening. Show him acts of destruction, and he will reward you with power." -Rites of the Triune

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.name: The Hemat Stone
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Amulet_Unique_Warl.flavor: The warlock stared into the blood-stone until his eyes were scorched with dread knowledge. He felt an infernal current awaken in his veins—a plague of visions, malice, and command over the occult.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Warlo.name: Hellhound's Sabatons
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Boots_Unique_Warlo.flavor: "As loyal as we may think they might be, they are still demons. And they will take any chance they can to destroy us." -Book of Adria

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Warlo.name: Ae'grom's Schism
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Chest_Unique_Warlo.flavor: "Cut a demon nice and wide. Something rises from inside. Eye and fang, bone and sinew. What was one has become two." -Ravings of a mad Vizjerei

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.name: Grasp of Shadow
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Rogu.flavor: Dark wisps creep hungrily across these gloves, like an assassin's blade seeking a life to steal on a moonless night.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Warl.name: Hand of Apotheosis
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Gloves_Unique_Warl.flavor: "There are certain thresholds one must not cross. Not because the demonologist will lose their way back, but because they will not return the same as they were before." -Grimoire of Reckoning

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Warloc.name: Rictus of Terror
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Helm_Unique_Warloc.flavor: "We found eight corpses, arranged around a summoning circle. No wounds or blood. They were frozen in mid-scream. Whatever had appeared in the circle was gone." -Caldeum guard report

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.name: Thundergod's Blessing
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.flavor: The Unclean burned the Monastery, and all knowledge within. They beheaded the monks, and kept their tongues. All artifacts were lost - save for this.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.name: Signet of Pelghain
Talisman_Charm_Unique_Ring_Unique_Generi.flavor: Ksathra's strike roiled the seas, swallowing the land. The sky raged, unleashing devastating storms. In a moment, their empire gone. Their bond forever broken. Her sister, no more.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HDagger_U.name: The Mortacrux
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HDagger_U.flavor: One of a pair of twin daggers, forbidden from ever meeting. Nearby corpses shudder in its presence.

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HSword_Un.name: The Third Blade
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_1HSword_Un.flavor: "Restraint, mercy, honor...these are shackles, forged by the weak and the conquered." -Hephasto, the Armorer

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_2HStaff_Un.name: The Basilisk
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_2HStaff_Un.flavor: "Well did she feed her children, and well did her children feed her." -Scosglen folktale

Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_2HStaff_Un.name: Vox Omnium
Talisman_Charm_Unique_S05_BSK_2HStaff_Un.flavor: Your incantations are echoed by a chorus of the damned. Wield their torment, their vengeance, their pain against the Hellborne that tortured them.

S15_Playhouse_Portal_Potion.desc: The colors swirl and twist in hypnotic patterns.
S15_Playhouse_Portal_Potion.flavor:
"This is no time to be silly. The level of sparkling happiness and rainbows awaits you!"
- Ghost of the Cow King

OPAL_Amulet_Unique_Generic_100.name: Bell of the Bovine
OPAL_Amulet_Unique_Generic_100.flavor: "The fever racks my body. It dances... rhythmless, endless! I fear there is but one remedy. MORE! I must hear more..." -Lester the Farmer

Elixir_OPAL.name: Udder's Milk
Elixir_OPAL.desc:
Grants the following benefits to those who drink it:
{icon:bullet} Bonus damage against the deadliest creatures of Sanctuary.
{icon:bullet} Moove with udder urgency after communing with the all powerful ones.
Elixir_OPAL.flavor: A delicacy reserved for only the most udderly Bovine.

OPAL_Mythic_Cache.name: Blessings of the Bovine {icon:AttributeBullet_GreaterAffix,1.5}
OPAL_Mythic_Cache.flavor: "Humble thyself before the Horned Lord, for he is definitely real, and from his blessed udders you shall be rewarded!"

SMR_Map.name: Map of the Stars
SMR_Map.flavor:
An indecipherable set of astrological symbols and charts.

In the margin, a message in fresh ink--
"Oh for hell's sake, what now?!"

S15_Fish_AddOn_06.name: Theodore's Head
S15_Fish_AddOn_06.flavor:
"Didja find him? You gotta find Theodore, please! He's just little. He can't take care of himself! Please!"
-Celia

X2_Fish_Tristram_Rare.name: Red Herring
X2_Fish_Tristram_Rare.desc: A rare fish found in Khanduras.
X2_Fish_Tristram_Rare.flavor: "I know as much about Black Mushrooms as I do about Red Herrings." - Deckard Cain

S15_BlackMushroom.name: Black Mushroom
S15_BlackMushroom.desc: Now that is a big mushroom.
S15_BlackMushroom.flavor: "It sounds like a... why, a huge, gargantuan, swollen, bloated mushroom!" - Griswold

S15_GodlyPlateOfTheWhale.name: Godly Plate of the Whale
S15_GodlyPlateOfTheWhale.flavor: "Seen a whale once. Big thing. Bigger'n Ogden's whole damned inn! And this plate - you put it on, nothin' can hurt you! Nothin'! 'Cept...maybe the whale. Don't go fightin' the whale." -Farnham

SoJ_FakeGem_Emerald.name: Royal Emerald
SoJ_FakeGem_Emerald.flavor: It yearns to join you on the hunt.

SoJ_FakeGem_Topaz.name: Royal Topaz
SoJ_FakeGem_Topaz.flavor: Plans within plans unfold within its fractal gleam.

SoJ_FakeGem_Amethyst.name: Royal Amethyst
SoJ_FakeGem_Amethyst.flavor: Within its shadow lies a thousand sorrows.

SoJ_FakeGem_Skull.name: Royal Skull
SoJ_FakeGem_Skull.flavor: The dead grant the wisdom they lacked in life.

SoJ_FakeGem_Diamond.name: Royal Diamond
SoJ_FakeGem_Diamond.flavor: It banishes doubt and compels action.

Archetype_Cache_Curated_Variant1.desc:

{icon:bullet} Barbarian - Berserker
{icon:bullet} Druid - Storm
{icon:bullet} Necromancer - Shadow
{icon:bullet} Paladin - Zealot
{icon:bullet} Rogue - Alchemist
{icon:bullet} Sorcerer - Frost
{icon:bullet} Spiritborn - Gorilla
{icon:bullet} Warlock - Ritualist
Archetype_Cache_Curated_Variant1.flavor: The path to Hell will be paved with the blood of demons. How they are to be slaughtered is yet to be written.

types.name: Skirmishers
types.desc:
Skirmishers slice up enemies, dealing high damage to a single target.

{c_important}Skeleton Warrior{/c} is also a {c_important}Bone{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_WarriorSpec1_Icon, 2} Skirmisher

types.name: Defenders
types.desc:
Defenders are durable protectors, dealing less damage but retaining strong survivability.

{c_important}Skeleton Warrior{/c} is also a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_WarriorSpec2_Icon, 2.0} Defender

types.desc:
Reapers wield a powerful cleaving scythe and have a wind-up attack that deals heavy damage every {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Skeleton Warrior{/c} is also a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_WarriorSpec3_Icon, 2.0} Reaper

types.name: Shadow
types.desc:
Shadow Mages wield power from the beyond, firing bursting shadow bolts.

{c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} is also a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_MageSpec1_Icon, 2.0} Shadow

types.name: Cold
types.desc:
Cold Mages attacks will chill enemies, eventually freezing them in their tracks.

{c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} is also a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_MageSpec2_Icon, 2.0} Cold

types.name: Bone
types.desc:
Bone Mages use their own bodies as piercing projectiles, dealing heavy damage at the cost of their own Life.

{c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} is also a {c_important}Bone{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_MageSpec3_Icon, 2.0} Bone

types.name: Bone
types.desc:
Bone Golem taunts enemies, forcing them to attack it and retaliating with deadly Thorns.

{c_important}Golem{/c} is also a {c_important}Bone{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_GolemSpec1_Icon, 2.0} Bone

types.name: Blood

Blood Golem drains Life from nearby enemies, healing and bolstering itself.

{c_important}Golem{/c} is also a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_GolemSpec2_Icon, 2.0} Blood

types.name: Iron
types.desc:
Iron Golem wields immense weight and power, Stunning and controlling enemies.

{c_important}Golem{/c} is also a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill.
types.label: {icon:NecroArmy_GolemSpec3_Icon, 2.0} Iron

paladinOaths.name: Zealot
paladinOaths.subtitle: Let No One Doubt
paladinOaths.desc: Attacking with your {c_important}Devotion Core{/c} and {c_important}Ultimate{/c} skills grants {c_important}Zealot{/c} stacks that make those skills hit an additional time per stack.  {c_important}Basic{/c} skills refresh these stacks.

paladinOaths.name: Juggernaut
paladinOaths.subtitle: I Will Never Bend
paladinOaths.desc:
Casting a {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skill consumes a stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} to deal {c_number}20%{/c} more damage.

Gain a {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} stack every {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

paladinOaths.name: Judicator
paladinOaths.subtitle: May Justice Fall Upon All
paladinOaths.desc:
Your {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} marks now also explode for additional damage around the judged character and can be set off early with your {c_important}Divine Core{/c} skills.

Your {c_important}Divine Basic{/c} skills now apply {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}.

paladinOaths.name: Disciple
paladinOaths.subtitle: I Will Balance the Scales
paladinOaths.desc: Casting an {c_red}[PH]{/c}{c_important}Angelic{/c} skill will grant {c_important}{u}Arbiter{/u}{/c} for {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

Sorcerer_Spark.name: Spark

mods.name: Additional Hits
mods.desc: {c_important}Spark{/c} shocks {c_number}1{/c} additional time.

mods.name: Crackling Energy

mods.name: Electric Blast
mods.desc: {c_important}Spark{/c} combines all shocks into one blast in an area, dealing {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage and gaining {c_number}25%{/c} increased Size per shock.

mods.desc: {c_important}Spark{/c} gains {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Chance.

Sorcerer_Fireball.name: Fireball

mods.name: Size Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Fireball's{/c} Size is increased by {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Fireball{/c} deals {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage, but its Mana cost is increased by {c_number}15{/c}.

mods.name: Damage Over Time
mods.desc: {c_important}Fireball's{/c} direct damage deals an additional {c_number}30%{/c} damage over {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Critical Strike Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Fireball{/c} deals {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage.

mods.name: Illumination

mods.name: Instantaneous Destruction
mods.desc: {c_important}Fireball{/c} travels {c_number}200%{/c} faster and deals {c_number}75%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.

mods.desc:
{c_important}Fireball{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that deals Cold damage.

Sorcerer_Enchantment_FireBall.desc: Your Damage Over Time effects cause slain enemies to explode in a {c_important}Fireball{/c} that deals {c_number}[0.4*(1+Sorc_Enchantment_Potency)*100|%|]{/c} of its damage.

Sorcerer_IceShards.name: Ice Shards

mods.name: Barrier
mods.desc: {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} launches {c_number}1{/c} additional shard while you have a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u}.

mods.name: Hit Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} deals {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to an enemy each time it hits them in the same cast.

mods.name: Pierce Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} deals {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage after piercing once.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Ice Shards'{/c} Mana cost is reduced by {c_number}3{/c}.

mods.name: Piercing Cold
mods.desc:
{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} deals {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage and will pierce {c_number}1{/c} additional time. 

{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} will additionally pierce up to {c_number}3{/c} {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} enemies.

mods.name: Glacial Spike
mods.desc: {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} combines all shards into a massive spike, dealing {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage per shard. The spike explodes on impact and {c_important}{u}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}50%{/c}.

mods.name: Thunderbolt
mods.desc:
{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage.

{c_important}Ice Shards{/c} launches a large thunderbolt that explodes on impact into {c_number}5{/c} smaller seeking thunderbolt shards, dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact_damage_normal}|2?|]{/c} damage each.

Sorcerer_Enchantment_IceShards.desc: {c_important}Ice Shards{/c} automatically conjure and fly towards {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c} enemies.

Sorcerer_ChainLightning.name: Chain Lightning

mods.name: Critical Strike Chance
mods.desc:
{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} forms a {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} whenever it Critically Strikes.

{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} gains {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Chance.

mods.name: Ramping Damage
mods.desc: Every Second, {c_important}{u}Chain Lightning{/c}{/u} gains {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} damage, up to {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}. This bonus is reset when you damage an enemy with a Skill Cast other than {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c}.

mods.name: Additional Chains
mods.desc: {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} gains {c_number}1{/c} additional chains.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} deals {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to the first enemy hit.

mods.name: Chain of Cold
mods.desc:
{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that deals Cold damage.

{c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} by {c_number}25%{/c} and deals up to {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage based on how {c_important}{u}Chilled{/u}{/c} the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Chain Whipping
mods.desc: {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} gains {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Cast Speed and its number of chains is doubled.

mods.name: Power Flux
mods.desc: {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} alternates between chaining to an enemy and to you. When it chains to you, it gains {c_number}45%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage, up to {c_number}180%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}, and does not use a chain.

Sorcerer_Enchantment_ChainLightning.desc: {c_important}Chain Lightning{/c} forms automatically after spending {c_number}[100*(1/(1+Sorc_Enchantment_Potency))|2?|]{/c} Mana.

mods.name: Flash

mods.name: Duration Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Flame Shield's{/c} duration is increased to {c_number}1.5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Overpower
mods.desc: {c_important}Flame Shield{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {u}{c_important}Overpower{/c}{/u}.

mods.name: Cooldown Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Flame Shield's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Healing
mods.desc: While {c_important}Flame Shield{/c} is active, you heal for {c_number}12%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.12||]){/c} per second.

Sorcerer_Enchantment_FlameShield.desc: Losing {c_number}30%{/c} of your Maximum life within {c_number}2{/c} seconds automatically activates {c_important}Flame Shield{/c}. Can only happen once every {c_number}[30-30*Sorc_Enchantment_Potency|2?|]{/c} seconds.

Sorcerer_Enchantment_FrostNova.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}[10*(1+Sorc_Enchantment_Potency)|%|]{/c} chance to unleash a {c_important}Frost Nova{/c} after hitting an enemy.

mods.desc: {c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} heals you for {c_number}2%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.02||]){/c} when it hits the first enemy.

mods.name: Resource Generation

mods.name: Overpower
mods.desc: {c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.

mods.desc: {c_important}Fire Bolt{/c} launches an additional parallel bolt, dealing {c_number}[{payload:damage}|2?|]{/c} Fire damage.

mods.name: Firefly

mods.name: Weaken
mods.desc:
{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} {u}{c_important}Weakens{/c}{/u} enemies for {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

mods.desc:
{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} deals {c_number}15%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to Close enemies.

mods.name: Movement Speed
mods.desc:
Each time you cast {c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} it gains {c_number}4%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} bolt speed and you gain {c_number}4%{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}[{buffduration:upgrade4_speed}|2?|]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Cast Speed
mods.desc:
Each time you cast {c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} it gains {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Cast Speed, up to {c_number}15%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}. Moving removes this effect.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} releases {c_number}1{/c} additional bolt.

mods.name: Overload
mods.desc:
Casting {c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} now also discharges {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} in an electric wave, dealing its damage to all enemies caught in it.

{u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} will no longer automatically pulse its last {c_number}3{/c} charges.

mods.name: Burn Through
mods.desc:
{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill, deals Fire damage, and costs {c_number}30{/c} Mana.

mods.name: Surging Charge
mods.desc: {c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} releases {c_number}1{/c} additional bolt, plus {c_number}1{/c} additional bolt per stack of {u}{c_important}Ferocity{/c}{/u}.

Sorcerer_FrostBolt.name: Frost Bolt

mods.name: Vulnerable
mods.desc: {c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Pierce
mods.desc: {c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} pierces {c_number}1{/c} time.

mods.name: Resource Generation
mods.desc: {c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} generates {c_number}2{/c} Mana when it hits the first enemy, or {c_number}4{/c} Mana if the target is already {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Barrier
mods.desc: {c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}2%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.02||]){/c} up to {c_number}6%{/c} for {c_number}6{/c} seconds when it hits the first enemy.

mods.name: Relentless Bolt
mods.desc: {c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} launches an additional projectile after the first. Each projectile deals {c_number}[{payload:upgradea_following_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Shatter
mods.desc: {c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} shatters when it hits a {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c} enemy, exploding for {c_number}[{payload:upgradeb_shattered_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage and {c_important}{u}Chilling{/u}{/c} for {c_number}40%{/c}.

mods.name: Static Shock

{c_important}Frost Bolt{/c} becomes a {c_important}Shock{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage.

mods.name: Blood Runs Cold
mods.desc:
{c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} deals {c_number}[{payload:damage_cold}|2?|]{/c} Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Freezes{/c}{/u} enemies for {c_number}[{buffduration:freeze}|2?|]{/c} seconds. An enemy can be {c_important}{u}Frozen{/c}{/u} this way once every {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

If {c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} hits an enemy already {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}, it has an additional {c_number}50%{/c} chance to form a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Soul Rip
mods.desc:
{c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}[{payload:damage_shadow}|2?|]{/c} Shadow damage.

Instead of forming a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u}, {c_important}Hemorrhage{/c} Summons a {c_important}Volatile Skeleton{/c} that deals {c_number}[{payload:volatile_skeleton}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Necromancer_ArmyoftheDead.name: Army of the Dead

mods.name: Corpse Generation
mods.desc: {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} has a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to form a Corpse.

mods.name: Passive Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} passively summons a {c_important}Volatile Skeleton{/c} every {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Cooldown Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Army of the Dead's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}20{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} deals {c_number}2%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for each {c_important}Minion{/c} you have.

mods.name: Unyielding Commander
mods.desc: While {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} is active, your {c_important}Minions{/c} take {c_number}90%{/c} reduced damage and deal {c_number}[0.3*Table(34,sLevel)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

mods.name: Pile the Bodies
mods.desc: {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} will converge on your target. Each time a {c_important}Volatile Skeleton{/c} explodes on an enemy, they take {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c}, up to {c_number}300%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Dead Cold
mods.desc: {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} now deals {c_number}[{payload:explosion_damage_cold}|2?|]{/c} Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Freezes{/c}{/u} enemies instead of Stunning them.

Necromancer_BoneStorm.name: Bone Storm

mods.name: Duration Increase
mods.desc: {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} consumes up to {c_number}4{/c} corpses to increase its duration by {c_number}2{/c} seconds per corpse.

mods.name: Damage Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} increases your Damage Reduction by {c_number}[(0.1+Necro_BoneStorm_DamageReduction)*100|%|]{/c}.

mods.name: Barrier
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u} for {c_number}50%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax()*0.5)|0|]){/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:barrier}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Vulnerable
mods.desc: {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Hungry Cyclone
mods.desc: {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} is cast at the target location and seeks enemies. Its Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[20*Table(37,sLevel)||]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Shadow And Bone
mods.desc:
{c_important}Bone Storm{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Enemies damaged by it suffer an additional {c_number}[{payload:tooltip_dot_damage}|2?|]{/c} Corrupting damage over {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Roll The Bones
mods.desc: {c_important}Bone Storm{/c} increases your Critical Strike Chance and Cast Speed by {c_number}[0.15*Table(34,sLevel)*100|+%|]{/c}.

Necromancer_BloodLance.name: Blood Lance

mods.name: Overpower
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} consumes {c_number}2{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} to throw an additional lance, dealing {c_number}50%{/c} of normal damage.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Lance's{/c} Essence cost is reduced by {c_number}3{/c}.

mods.name: Festering Wound
mods.desc:
{c_important}Blood Lance{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill and deals Shadow damage.

Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals {c_number}[{dot:tooltip_darkness_dot}|2?|]{/c} Corrupting damage per second to them.

mods.name: Gore Quills
mods.desc:
Every {c_number}3rd{/c} cast of {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} forms a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u} under the first enemy hit.

Casting {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} will pick up a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u} around you and conjure an additional lance from it, dealing {c_number}125%{/c} of normal damage.

mods.name: Blood Seeker
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} deals {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage per lanced enemy, and an additional {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to the first enemy hit.

mods.name: Fortify
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/c}{/u} you for {c_number}4%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:mod_fortify})|0|]){/c} if it hits an enemy already lanced.

mods.name: Ricochet
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} ricochets to {c_number}1{/c} additional enemy.

Necromancer_BloodWave.name: Blood Wave

mods.name: Damage Reduction
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Blood Wave{/c} grants {c_number}10%{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}[{buffduration:buff_damage_reduction}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Wave{/c} deals {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage while you are {c_important}{u}Fortified{/c}{/u}.

mods.name: Overpower
mods.desc: {if:Mod(582507896)}{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} and increases your Maximum {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} by{c_number}2{/c}.{else}Casting {c_important}Blood Wave{/c} overfills your {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} by {c_number}2{/c}.{/if}

mods.name: Blood Orb
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Wave{/c} forms up to {c_number}2{/c} {c_important}{u}Blood Orbs{/u}{/c} as it travels.

mods.name: Hematolagnia
mods.desc:
{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs {c_number}70{/c} Essence.

{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} conjures a shorter wave that deals {c_number}[{payload:damage_core}|2?|]{/c} damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.

mods.name: Path of Darkness
mods.desc:
{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals Shadow damage.

{c_important}Blood Wave{/c} leaves behind a trail of {c_important}{u}Desecrated Ground{/c}{/u} as it travels that deals {c_number}[{dot:tooltip_dot}|2?|]{/c} Corrupting damage.

mods.name: Tides of Blood
mods.desc: {c_important}Blood Wave{/c} launches {c_number}1{/c} additional wave, dealing {c_number}[{payload:damage_echo}|2?|]{/c} damage.

X1_Necromancer_Ultimate4.name: Soulrift

mods.name: Movement Speed
mods.desc:
While {c_important}Soulrift{/c} is active you are {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} and gain {c_number}1%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} increased Movement Speed for every soul absorbed, up to {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}.

This bonus persists for {c_number}5{/c} seconds after {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends.

mods.name: Barrier
mods.desc:
Every soul absorbed by {c_important}Soulrift{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u} for {c_number}0.5%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax()*0.005)|0|]){/c}. 

This {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u} persists for {c_number}5{/c} seconds after {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends.

mods.name: Vulnerable and Crowd Control
mods.desc:
When {c_important}Soulrift{/c} absorbs an enemy's soul it makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds. 

After {c_important}Soulrift{/c} ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by {c_number}85%{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Ferocity
mods.desc: Every {c_number}30{/c} souls absorbed by {c_important}Soulrift{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/c}{/u}.

mods.name: Distilled Anima
mods.desc: While {c_important}Soulrift{/c} is active, your {c_important}Darkness{/c} damage is increased by {c_number}[0.3*Table(34,sLevel)*100|x%|]{/c}.

mods.name: Soul Vortex
mods.desc: {c_important}Soulrift{/c} is cast at the target location and its Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}15{/c} seconds. Absorbing an enemy's soul deals {c_number}[{payload:soul_absorb_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage and Pulls them in.

mods.name: Frozen Wasteland
mods.desc:
{c_important}Soulrift{/c} deals Frostbite damage and {c_important}{u}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}30%{/c} every second. 

If {c_important}Soulrift{/c} absorbs the soul of a {c_important}{u}Frozen{/c}{/u} enemy, they shatter and explode for {c_number}[{payload:frozen_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage.

buffs.name: Movement Speed
buffs.desc: Your Movement Speed is increased by 1%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c} per stack.

Necromancer_SkeletonMage.name: Skeleton Mage

mods.name: Duration Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} deal {c_number}15%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage. This bonus increases by {c_number}1%{/c} every second that the skeletal mage is alive, up to {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Critical Strike Chance
mods.desc: You gain an additional {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Chance against enemies damaged by {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c}.

mods.name: Coven
mods.desc: {c_important}Skeleton Mage's{/c} maximum number of mages is increased by {c_number}2{/c}.

mods.name: Gift of Death
mods.desc:
{c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} is also a {c_important}Corpse{/c} Skill and requires a Corpse to be raised.

Each active skeletal mage increases your Essence Regeneration by {c_number}[0.5*Table(34,sLevel)*100|%x|]{/c}.

mods.name: Singularity
mods.desc:
{c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast to raise a more powerful but temporary mage.

The skeletal mage deals {c_number}3%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage and lasts for {c_number}0.1{/c} seconds for each point of Essence consumed.

mods.name: Crowd Control Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} deal {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

mods.name: Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower
mods.desc: {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} have a {c_number}5%{/c} chance to grant {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/c}{/u}, {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u}, or {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} whenever they attack based on whether your {c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} type is Shadow, Cold, or Bone respectively.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior.desc:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}[{cooldown time}|2?|]{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{combat effect chance}|%|]{/c}
{/if}{c_label}Passive:{/c} Raise a skeletal warrior from a nearby Corpse every {c_number}2{/c} seconds, up to a maximum of {c_number}[Floor((4+(NecroPetPassiveIsActive(931558)?2:0)+(Mod(582507894)?3:0)+Affix_Value_2(2587892)+(AffixIsEquipped(2587975)?4:0))*(NecroPetPassiveIsActive(931560)?0.5:1)*(NecroPetPassiveIsActive(931563)?0.5:1)*(NecroPetPassiveIsActive(931566)?0.5:1))|2?|]{/c} warriors. Skeletal warriors deal {c_number}[{payload:tooltip_sword}|2?|]{/c} with each attack.

{c_label}Active:{/c} Command your skeletal warriors to leap at an enemy and attack.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: Commanding your {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} causes them to deal {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Healing
mods.desc: {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} heal you for {c_number}2%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.02||]){/c} whenever they attack.

mods.name: Master of Puppets
mods.desc: {c_important}Skeleton Warrior's{/c} maximum number of warriors is increased by {c_number}3{/c}.

mods.name: Service and Sacrifice
mods.desc:
{c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} lose {c_number}25%{/c} of their Maximum Life per second while in combat and explode on death, dealing {c_number}[{payload:death_explosion}|2?|]{/c} damage.

{c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} are now raised from a nearby Corpse every {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Litany of Death
mods.desc:
If all of your skeletal warriors have been Summoned, {c_important}Skeleton Warrior{/c} briefly Summons a {c_important}Skeleton Priest{/c} instead.

{c_important}Skeleton Priest{/c} empowers your {c_important}Minions{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds, increasing their Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}[0.15*Table(37,sLevel)*100|%+|]{/c} and healing them for {c_number}100%{/c} of their Maximum Life over the duration.

mods.name: Vulnerable
mods.desc: {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} have a {c_number}30%{/c} chance to make enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Resolve
mods.desc: Commanding your {c_important}Skeleton Warriors{/c} grants {c_number}3{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u}.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Skirmisher_P.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Skirmisher_P.desc:
You can raise {c_number}2{/c} additional Skirmishers.

Whenever a Skirmisher is Summoned, you automatically command them to leap at a nearby enemy and attack.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Skirmisher_P.name: Upgrade B
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Skirmisher_P.desc: Skirmishers slice up enemies, making them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} and Slowing them by {c_number}50%{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Skirmisher_P.name: Sacrifice
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Skirmisher_P.desc:
Your Critical Strike Chance is increased by {c_number}[0.05*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100)*100|%+|]{/c}, but the amount of Skirmishers you can Summon is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}. {if:ParagonNodeIsPurchased(681465)}

Your Golem gains {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.{/c}{/if}

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Defender_Pas.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Defender_Pas.desc:
Defenders gain {c_number}[Max((0.0007377*Pow(Level-1,3.6292)+2+(1+Round(Level*0.1))*SkillRank(439912))*Table(34,SkillRank(439912)),1)|2?|]{/c} Thorns. Whenever they are damaged, their bones splinter and deal {c_number}50%{/c} of their Thorns to nearby enemies.

Commanding your Defenders causes them to Taunt nearby enemies for {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Defender_Pas.name: Upgrade B
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Defender_Pas.desc: Defenders have a {c_number}10%{/c} chance to form a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u} when they deal damage.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Defender_Pas.name: Sacrifice
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Defender_Pas.desc:
You gain {c_number}[0.4*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100)*100|+%|]{/c} Resistance to All Elements, but the amount of Defenders you can Summon is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}. {if:ParagonNodeIsPurchased(681465)}

Your Golem gains {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.{/c}{/if}

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Reaper_Passi.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Reaper_Passi.desc: Reaper's wind-up attacks now reduce one of your active Cooldowns by {c_number}3{/c} seconds and form a Corpse.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Reaper_Passi.name: Upgrade B
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Reaper_Passi.desc: Reapers deal {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage and have a {c_number}15%{/c} chance to Stun enemies for {c_number}1{/c} second.

Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Reaper_Passi.name: Sacrifice
Necromancer_SkeletonWarrior_Reaper_Passi.desc:
You deal {c_number}[0.15*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage, but the amount of Reapers you can Summon is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}. {if:ParagonNodeIsPurchased(681465)}

Your Golem gains {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.{/c}{/if}

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Shadow_Passive_.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Shadow_Passive_.desc: Shadow Mages deal an additional {c_number}[{payload:tooltip_corrupting_damage}|2?|]{/c} Corrupting damage over {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Shadow_Passive_.name: Upgrade B
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Shadow_Passive_.desc: Shadow Mages' bolts grant you and the Shadow Mage a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[0.03*Table(37,SkillRank(440313))*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax()*(0.03*Table(37,SkillRank(440313))))|0|]){/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[0.03*Table(37,SkillRank(440313))*100*2*5|%|]{/c}.

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Shadow_Passive_.name: Sacrifice
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Shadow_Passive_.desc:
Your Essence Regeneration is increased by {c_number}[0.2*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100)*100|+%|]{/c} and your maximum Essence is increased by {c_number}[Round(20*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100))|2?|]{/c}, but the amount of Shadow Mages you can Summon is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}.{if:ParagonNodeIsPurchased(681465)}

Your Golem gains {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.{/c}{/if}

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Cold_Passive_Up.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Cold_Passive_Up.desc:
Cold Mages' initial projectile forks into {c_number}2{/c} projectiles on impact.

Enemies damaged by Cold Mages are {c_important}{u}Weakened{/c}{/u} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Cold_Passive_Up.name: Upgrade B
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Cold_Passive_Up.desc:
Cold Mages occasionally cast a blizzard that deals {c_number}[{payload:blizzard}|2?|]{/c} Cold damage over {c_number}6{/c} seconds and {c_important}{u}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}6%{/c} every second.

Enemies damaged by Cold Mages are made {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Cold_Passive_Sa.name: Sacrifice
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Cold_Passive_Sa.desc:
You deal {c_number}[0.2*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to Vulnerable enemies, but the amount of Cold Mages you can Summon is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}.{if:ParagonNodeIsPurchased(681465)}

Your Golem gains {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.{/c}{/if}

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Sacrifice_Passi.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Sacrifice_Passi.desc: Bone Mages fire {c_number}2{/c} additional projectiles that deal {c_number}75%{/c} of normal damage.

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Sacrifice_Passi.name: Upgrade B
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Sacrifice_Passi.desc:
Bone Mages' attacks {c_important}{u}Fortify{/c}{/u} you for {c_number}[0.03*Table(34,SkillRank(440313))*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:fortify})|0|]){/c}.

Bone Mages form a Corpse when they die.

Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Sacrifice_Passi.name: Sacrifice
Necromancer_SkeletonMage_Sacrifice_Passi.desc:
You deal {c_number}[0.2*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage while you have a stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u}, but the amount of Bone Mages you can Summon is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}.{if:ParagonNodeIsPurchased(681465)}

Your Golem gains {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.{/c}{/if}

Necromancer_Golem_Bone_Passive_UpgradeA.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_Golem_Bone_Passive_UpgradeA.desc: Commanding your Bone Golem causes it to form {c_number}5{/c} corpses.

Necromancer_Golem_Bone_Passive_UpgradeB.name: Upgrade B
Necromancer_Golem_Bone_Passive_UpgradeB.desc:
When your Bone Golem takes damage, it unleashes bone spikes dealing {c_number}[{payload:damage}|2?|]{/c} damage. This effect can occur once every {c_number}3{/c} seconds.  

Enemies damaged by Bone Golem are made {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

Necromancer_Golem_Bone_Passive_Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Necromancer_Golem_Bone_Passive_Sacrifice.desc: You gain {c_number}[0.1*(1+Affix_Value_1(1222268)/100)*100|%+|]{/c} increased Attack Speed, but your Golem does {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} less damage.

Necromancer_Golem_Blood_Passive_UpgradeA.name: Upgrade A
Necromancer_Golem_Blood_Passive_UpgradeA.desc: Commanding your Blood Golem also causes it to drain Life from your other {c_important}Minions{/c}, increasing its Maximum Life by {c_number}5%{/c} and damage by {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} per {c_important}Minion{/c} drained for {c_number}20{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}50%{/c} increased Maximum Life and {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.

Necromancer_Golem_Blood_Passive_UpgradeB.name: Upgrade B
