{c_important}The Seeker{/c} is also a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skill. 

The Jaguar Spirit aids {c_important}The Seeker{/c}, granting you {c_number}4{/c} {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} and slashing {c_number}3{/c} times dealing {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_c_damage}|2?|]{/c} Fire Damage. {c_important}The Seeker{/c} gains {c_number}2{/c} additional Charges.

Spiritborn_Jaguar_Ultimate.name: The Hunter

mods.name: Vigor Generation
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}The Hunter{/c} generates {c_number}25{/c} Vigor.

mods.name: Size Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}The Hunter{/c} strikes a {c_number}50%{/c} larger area.

mods.name: Execute
mods.desc: {c_important}The Hunter's{/c} landing damage will {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} enemies.

mods.name: Healing
mods.desc: {c_important}The Hunter{/c} restores {c_number}3%{/c} of your Maximum Health per strike.

mods.name: Push and Pounce
mods.desc:
{c_important}The Hunter{/c} is also a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill. 

The Gorilla Spirit knocks enemies towards {c_important}The Hunter's{/c} landing spot, dealing {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_c_damage}|2?|]{/c} Physical damage and Knocking Down enemies on landing for {c_number}2{/c} seconds. Each enemy you damage with {c_important}The Hunter{/c} grants {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, which can overfill your {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} by {c_number}4{/c} stacks.

mods.name: Shredder
mods.desc: {c_important}The Hunter{/c} strikes an additional {c_number}5{/c} times and consumes all of your {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} to deal {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage per {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Relentless Pursuit
mods.desc: {c_important}The Hunter{/c} overfills your {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} by {c_number}2{/c} stacks. Killing enemies while with it active has a {c_number}40%{/c} chance to instantly reset its Cooldown. This chance is halved after each consecutive reset.

Spiritborn_Centipede_Ultimate.name: The Devourer

mods.name: Healing
mods.desc: {c_important}The Devourer{/c} Heals you for {c_number}5%{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.05||]){/c} per second.

mods.name: Thorns
mods.desc: {c_important}The Devourer{/c} grants you {c_number}50%{/c} increased Thorns for {c_number}15{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Instant Kill
mods.desc: While {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is active, if a Non-Boss enemy's remaining Life becomes Poisoned, they die instantly.

mods.name: Poisoning Duration
mods.desc: While {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is active, your Poisoning effects have {c_number}20%{/c} increased duration.

mods.name: Sky and Soil
mods.desc:
{c_important}The Devourer{/c} is also an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill.

The Eagle Spirit aids {c_important}The Devourer{/c}, creating a Lightning Storm that Sparks enemies for {c_number}[{dot:upgrade_c_dot}|2?|]{/c} damage each second and makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}. Gain {c_number}[0.2*Table(34,sLevel)*100|%|]{/c} Movement Speed while {c_important}The Devourer{/c} is active.

mods.name: Spew Putrefaction
mods.desc: As it emerges, {c_important}The Devourer{/c} launches {c_number}10{/c} toxic globs that apply {c_number}[{dot:upgrade_poison_dot}|2?|]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}[6*(1+Per_Damage_Type_Buff_Duration_Bonus_Percent(4))||]{/c} seconds wherever they land. Enemies affected by toxic globs also take {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased Poison Damage.

mods.name: Blast of Bile
mods.desc:
{c_important}The Devourer{/c} now only blasts enemies in a line once, dealing {c_number}[{payload:spit_payload_b_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} damage, before leaving. 

{c_important}The Devourer{/c} is now also a {c_important}Potency{/c} Skill and has a {c_number}18{/c} second cooldown.

spiritborn_jaguar_sun_passive.desc:
Every {c_number}15th{/c} time you deal direct damage with a {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skill, unleash a Beat Strike dealing {c_random}[{payload:impact}|2?|]{/c} damage, increasing all damage you deal by {c_number}3%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} and doubling each subsequent Beat Strike's damage, stacking {c_number}5{/c} times. You lose all stacks when you stop attacking for {c_number}1{/c} second.

All Skills are now also {c_important}Jaguar{/c} Skills.

buffs.name: Beat Strike
buffs.desc: Damage is increased by {c_number}3%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} and Beat Strike damage is doubled for each stack.

spiritborn_jaguar_moon_passive.desc:
Maximum {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} increased by {c_random}[(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861322))||]{/c}.

Gain {c_random}[(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861322))||]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} whenever you kill an enemy or damage a Boss.

spiritborn_eagle_sun_passive_alternate.desc:
Casting an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill or {c_important}Evading{/c} shoots {c_number}[2*(1+Level/70+0.5*Floor(Level/70)*(Min(200,Paragon_Level)/100))||]{/c} {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c}, each dealing {c_random}[{payload:vulnerable_payload_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} Lightning damage and applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds. Can only occur once every {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds. The {c_important}{u}Storm Feathers{/u}{/c} Movement Speed bonus is doubled and always active. 

All Skills are now also {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skills.

spiritborn_eagle_moon_passive_alternate.desc: Gain {c_random}[0.2*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1971989))*100|%x|]{/c} {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} Damage and {c_random}[0.05*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1971989))*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance.

spiritborn_gorilla_sun_passive.desc:
Attacking with a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill deals {c_random}[1.5*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861301))*100|%|]{/c} Thorns to enemies you hit and grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}2.5%{/c} of Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.025||]){/c} for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

All Skills are now also {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skills.

spiritborn_gorilla_moon_passive.desc:
Maximum {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} increased by {c_random}[2*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861320))||]{/c}.

When you have at least {c_number}5{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, you are {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} and gain {c_random}[0.5*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861320))*100|%+|]{/c} Armor.

spiritborn_centipede_sun_passive.desc:
Hitting an enemy with a {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skill reduces their Damage by {c_number}4.0%{/c}, Slows them by {c_number}10%{/c}, and deals {c_random}[{dot:poison_dot_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}8{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}8{/c} times.

All Skills are now also {c_important}Centipede{/c} Skills.

spiritborn_centipede_moon_passive.desc: Heal for {c_random}[0.02*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861326))*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*(0.02*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861326)))||]){/c} per second for every Nearby enemy you've Poisoned in the last {c_number}3{/c} seconds, up to {c_random}[0.1*(1+Spiritborn_Spirit_Bonus(1861326))*100|%|]{/c}.

Paladin_BlessedShield.name: Blessed Shield

mods.name: Shield of Justice
mods.desc:
{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} detonates {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} and ricochets {c_number}5{/c} additional times.

Whenever {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} detonates {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}, it empowers your next throw to deal {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage, up to a maximum of {c_number}5{/c} times and it increases your {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} damage by {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Shield of the Revenant
mods.desc:
{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} now boomerangs and pierces instead of ricocheting, dealing {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_b_impact}|2?|]{/c} damage. 

Hitting enemies with {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}5%{/c} for {c_number}6{/c} seconds up to {c_number}5{/c} times.

mods.name: Shield of Retribution
mods.desc:
{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} becomes a {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} travels straight without returning, pulsing {c_number}[0.7*Table(34,sLevel)*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns damage for {c_number}3{/c} seconds before bursting for {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_c_final_dmg}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} deals {c_number}75%{/c} of your shield's Block Chance as additional damage.

mods.name: Armor and Block Chance Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} increases your Armor by {c_number}2%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} and Block Chance by {c_number}2%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} for {c_number}6{/c} seconds each time it hits an enemy.

mods.name: Cast Speed
mods.desc: {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} gains {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} increased Cast Speed.

mods.name: Faith Generation
mods.desc: When {c_important}Blessed Shield{/c} hits a Crowd Controlled enemy, gain {c_number}5{/c} Faith.

buffs.name: Blessed Shield: Empowered
buffs.desc: Empower your next throw by {c_number}40%{/c} damage per stack.

buffs.name: Armor and Block Chance Bonus
buffs.desc: Increase your Armor by {c_number}2%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} and Block Chance by {c_number}2%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}

Paladin_ShieldBash.name: Shield Bash

mods.name: Breach
mods.desc: Hits with {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} grant you {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} {c_important}{u}Retribution{/u}{/c} Chance for {c_number}5{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}5{/c} times.

mods.name: Smite
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} smites the first enemy it hits, dealing {c_number}[{payload:shieldbash_payload_main_b}|2?|]{/c} damage, Stunning for {c_number}[{buffduration:upgrade_b_stun}|2?|]{/c} second, and Knocking Back enemies behind for {c_number}[{payload:charge_knockback_b}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Lay Siege
mods.desc:
Whenever you have {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} increases impact size by {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} and deals {c_number}[{payload:shieldbash_payload_a}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Gain {c_number}1{/c} Resolve per enemy hit.

mods.name: Size Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} gains {c_number}40%{/c} increased size.

mods.name: Hits Are Blocks
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Bash's{/c} hits counts as Blocks. This effect can trigger once per Cast.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} deals {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} more damage to its primary target.

mods.name: Distance
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Bash{/c} now travels farther.

Paladin_Punish.name: Clash

mods.name: Faith Generation
mods.desc: {c_important}Clash{/c} generates {c_number}10{/c} additional Faith.

mods.name: Resolve
mods.desc: Striking an enemy with {c_important}Clash{/c} grants {c_number}2{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Seize Them
mods.desc:
Your {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} empowers {c_important}Clash{/c}, dealing {c_number}8%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, up to {c_number}16{/c} stacks.

Every 3rd strike, enemies are Pulled in.

mods.name: Skirmish
mods.desc:
{c_important}Clash{/c} becomes a {c_important}Zealot{/c} Skill and cleaves in an area for {c_number}[{payload:melee_damage_b}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Crusaders March no longer grants Block Chance or {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}, instead granting {c_number}[0.1*(Mod(2686060764)?1.25:1)*100|+%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance up to {c_number}[0.1*(Mod(2686060764)?1.25:1)*3*100|+%|]{/c}.

mods.name: Punishment
mods.desc:
You are emboldened during Crusader's March, granting:
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_number}[0.3*(Mod(2686060764)?1.25:1)*100|+%|]{/c} {c_important}{u}Retribution{/u}{/c} Chance
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_number}[0.0007377*Pow(Level-1,3.6292)+2+(1+Round(Level*0.1))*sLevel||]{/c} Thorns
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_number}[0.2*(Mod(2686060764)?1.25:1)*100|%x|]{/c} Thorns damage

mods.name: Damage Increase
mods.desc: {c_important}Clash{/c} deals {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage

mods.name: Crusader's March Effectiveness
mods.desc: Increase the effect of Crusader's March by {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}

Paladin_SpearOfTheHeavens.name: Spear of the Heavens

mods.name: Cooldown Reduction
mods.desc: Consuming {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} reduces {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} active cooldown by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Judgement Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} deals {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage against enemies affected by {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Projectiles
mods.desc: {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} releases {c_number}3{/c} additional projectiles after its 1st impact.

mods.name: Vulnerable
mods.desc: {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} to enemies for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Fist of the Heavens
mods.desc:
{c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} becomes a {c_Important}Core{/c} Skill and is now pure Holy energy that crashes down from the sky.

On impact it deals {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_c_fist_impact}|2?|]{/c} damage and breaks into {c_number}[5+(Mod(2686060763)?3:0)|2?|]{/c} projectiles, dealing {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_c_proj_payload}|2?|]{/c} additional damage to enemies in their path.

mods.name: Part the Heavens
mods.desc: {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} now drops {c_number}[3+(Mod(2686060763)?3:0)+5|2?|]{/c} spears along the path toward your target.

mods.name: Pronouncement of Heaven
mods.desc: {c_important}Spear of the Heavens{/c} gains {c_number}3{/c} initial spears that deal {c_number}[{payload:spear_burst_impact}|2?|]{/c} damage per second for {c_number}12{/c} seconds. These spears can be marked with {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c}.

Paladin_BlessedHammer.name: Blessed Hammer

mods.name: Cast Speed
mods.desc: {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} gains {c_number}15%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} increased Cast Speed and its hammers travel {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} faster.

mods.name: Slow
mods.desc: {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} now Slows enemies by {c_number}50%{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Mortar Combat
mods.desc: {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} mortars {c_number}3{/c} hammers to the ground, dealing {c_number}[{payload:payload_lobbed}|2?|]{/c} damage in an area.

mods.name: Disciple's Halo
mods.desc:
{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} becomes a {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} follows and orbits around you, dealing {c_number}[{payload:orbit_impact_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage and attacking {c_number}20%{/c} faster.

mods.name: Shattering Blow
mods.desc: {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} deals {c_number}[{payload:impact_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage and shatters into {c_number}3{/c} small explosions on impact, dealing {c_number}[{payload:shrapnel_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage each.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: Hitting enemies with {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} up to {c_number}5{/c} times, for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Blessed Hammer{/c} reduces its cost by {c_number}5%{/c} for {c_number}2{/c}  seconds, up to {c_number}5{/c} times.

Paladin_ShieldCharge_Channel_Short.name: Shield Charge

mods.name: Phalanx Charge
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Charge{/c} surges forward in a wave of energy and Knocks enemies Back, dealing {c_number}[{payload:end_burst_c}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Virtuous Charge
mods.desc:
{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} becomes a {c_important}Judicator{/c} Skill and consumes {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} on impact, increasing the ending nova damage by {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} for each {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} consumed up to {c_number}100%{/c}.

When {c_important}Shield Charge{/c} ends you release a Holy nova, dealing {c_number}[{payload:end_burst_b}|2?|]{/c} damage and Stunning enemies for {c_number}[{buffduration:stun}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Relentless Charge
mods.desc:
{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}[{payload:charge_knockback_a}|2?|]{/c} damage.

{c_important}Shield Charge{/c} now costs {c_resource}20{/c} Faith to Cast and an additional {c_resource}1{/c} Faith per second.

mods.name: Hit Count As Blocking
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Charge's{/c} hits count as Blocks.

mods.name: Retribution
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Charge{/c} grants {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} {c_important}{u}Retribution{/u}{/c} chance while charging when you hit an enemy up to {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Charge's{/c} damage increases by {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} when it hits an enemy for {c_number}6{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Resolve
mods.desc: {c_important}Shield Charge{/c} grants {c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} whenever it hits an enemy.

Paladin_Impale.name: Divine Lance

mods.name: Tip of the Spear
mods.desc:
{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} flurries, stabbing {c_number}2{/c} additional times and deals {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_a_flurry_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage each.

Killing {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies with {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} increases its Attack Speed by {c_number}5%{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}30%{/c}.

mods.name: Zealous Joust
mods.desc:
{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} becomes a {c_important}Zealot{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} now stabs with {c_number}2{/c} additional spears in a wider area, dealing {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_b_trident_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage each and has {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage.

mods.name: Divine Javelin
mods.desc:
Throw {c_important}Divine Lance{/c}, dealing {c_number}[{payload:projectile_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage to the first enemy hit and bursting for an additional {c_number}[{payload:projectile_burst_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage.

The first time an enemy is hit by a {c_important}Divine Lance{/c}, they are impaled and dragged with it.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: Killing enemies with {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} reduces the cost of your next {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} by {c_number}10%{/c} up to {c_number}50%{/c}

mods.name: Damage Bonus
mods.desc:
{c_important}Divine Lance{/c} deals {c_number}15%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage. 

Double this bonus against {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemies.

mods.name: Cast Speed
mods.desc: {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} gains {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} increased Cast Speed.

mods.name: Stacking Damage
mods.desc: Successive hits on the same target with {c_important}Divine Lance{/c} deal {c_number}5%{/c} more damage up to {c_number}30%{/c}.

Paladin_PreTrailZeal.name: Zeal

mods.name: Zealot's Legacy
mods.desc: {c_important}Zeal{/c} extends its assault, randomly seeking surrounding enemies and striking {c_number}4{/c} additional times.

mods.name: Death or Glory
mods.desc:
{c_important}Zeal{/c} costs {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} Maximum Life instead of Faith and strikes around you in a circle. 

Whenever you lose Life, {c_important}Zeal's{/c} damage increases by  {c_number}60%{/c} and Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}20%{/c} for {c_number}6{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Cull the Wicked
mods.desc: {c_important}Zeal's{/c} cleave is larger, gains {c_number}2{/c} additional strikes, and deals {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies.

mods.name: Additional Strikes
mods.desc: {c_important}Zeal{/c} gains {c_number}2{/c} additional strikes.

mods.name: Fortify
mods.desc: Critically Striking enemies with {c_important}Zeal{/c} has a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to grant {c_number}1%{/c} of Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:fortify})|0|]){/c} as {u}{c_important}Fortify{/c}{/u}.

mods.name: Weaken
mods.desc: Zeal {c_important}{u}Weakens{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Critical Strike Chance
mods.desc:
{c_important}Zeal{/c} has an additional {c_number}6%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Chance.

Double this bonus against {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies.

mods.name: Additional Targets

Paladin_HeavensFury.name: Heaven's Fury

mods.name: Duration
mods.desc: Increase {c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} duration by {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Slow

mods.name: Judgement
mods.desc: {c_important}Heaven's Fury's{/c} light {c_important}{u}Judges{/u}{/c} enemies.

mods.name: Damage Bonus

mods.name: Triplicate
mods.desc: {c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} splits into {c_number}3{/c} beams, dealing {c_number}[{payload:beam_triple_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage each hit for {c_number}[7+(Mod(2686060764)?4:0)|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Walk With The Light
mods.desc: {c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} splits into {c_number}5{/c} orbiting beams, dealing {c_number}[{payload:projectile_damage_b}|2?|]{/c} damage each hit for {c_number}[7+(Mod(2686060764)?4:0)|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Final Justice
mods.desc:
{c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} can Cast anywhere, concentrating the Light as it grows and Pulls enemies in while dealing {c_number}[{payload:nuke_periodic}|2?|]{/c} damage per second before erupting for {c_number}[{payload:nuke_detonation}|2?|]{/c} damage. 

{c_important}Heaven's Fury's{/c} Cooldown is increased by {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

Paladin_Disciple_of_Justice.name: Arbiter of Justice

mods.name: Cooldown Reduction
mods.desc: Reduce {c_important}Arbiter of Justice's{/c} Cooldown by {c_number}20{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Wing Strike Recast

mods.name: Movement Speed

mods.name: Duration

mods.name: Divine Intervention

{c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} ascends for an additional {c_number}2{/c} seconds and rains {c_important}Blessed Spears{/c} on the battlefield.

Upon landing, {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} bombards the battlefield with {c_number}10{/c} additional {c_important}Blessed Spears{/c}, applying {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Seraph's Wings
Reach of the Law
mods.desc: {c_important}{u}Arbiter's{/u}{/c} Wing Strikes now apply {c_important}{u}Judgement{/u}{/c} to enemies.

Paladin_Fortress.name: Fortress
Paladin_Fortress.desc:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c}{c_resource} {if:Mod(2686060810)}{c_resource}60{/c}{else}[{cooldown time}|2?|]{/if}{/c} seconds
{if:Mod(2686060810)}{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{combat effect chance}|%|]{/c}
{/if}{/if}Make your stand, becoming {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:jug_initial_invuln}|1|]{/c} seconds and create a defensive area around you for {c_number}[(8+2.5*(Table(37,sLevel)-1)+(Mod(2686060764)?4:0))*(Mod(2686060809)?0.5:1)|1|]{/c} seconds.

Standing in your {c_important}Fortress{/c} grants you and your allies {c_number}[Min(30,(AffixIsEquipped(2438705)?1:0)>0?3:8+MaxStacks(1843183)+AffixIsEquipped(2340047)*2)/4||]{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} stacks every {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Duration
mods.desc: Increase {c_important}Fortress's{/c} duration by {c_number}[4*(Mod(2686060809)?0.5:1)||]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Resolve Damage Bonus
mods.desc: While inside of your {c_important}Fortress{/c} you gain {c_number}4.0%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Free Cast
mods.desc: While inside of your {c_important}Fortress{/c} your Skills are free to Cast.

mods.name: Unstoppable
mods.desc: While inside of your {c_important}Fortress{/c} you are {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Entrench
mods.desc:
While inside of {c_important}Fortress{/c} your Life cannot be reduced below {c_number}1{/c}.

Fortress duration is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}.

mods.name: Barricade
mods.desc:
Killing enemies inside of your {c_important}Fortress{/c} extends its duration by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds up to {c_number}20{/c} seconds.

You may recast {c_important}Fortress{/c} to move it to your current location.

mods.name: Rampart of Thorns
mods.desc: Enemies inside {c_important}Fortress{/c} are Slowed by {c_number}50%{/c} and take {c_number}500%{/c} of your Thorns damage per second.

Paladin_Sacrifice.name: Rally

mods.name: Words of Rejuvenation
mods.desc: {c_important}Rally{/c} generates {c_number}20{/c} more Faith and gains {c_number}1{/c} additional Charge.

mods.name: Words of Inspiration
mods.desc: {c_important}Rally{/c} spends all available Charges, reducing all active {c_important}Justice{/c} Skill Cooldowns by {c_number}3{/c} seconds per Charge.

mods.name: Words of Sacrifice
mods.desc: {c_important}Rally{/c} now costs {c_number}[(Mod(2686060763)?0.2975:0.35)*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax()*(Mod(2686060763)?0.2975:0.35))||]){/c} and can stack up to {c_number}3{/c} times.

mods.name: Duration Bonus
mods.desc: Increases {c_important}Rally's{/c} duration by {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Critical Strike Chance
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Rally{/c} increases your Critical Strike Chance by {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} while active.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Rally's{/c} Cooldown and Costs are reduced by {c_number}15%{/c}.

mods.name: Unhindered and Movement Speed
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Rally's{/c} increases your Movement Speed by an additional {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} and grants {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c} while active.

Paladin_Trinity.name: Zenith
Paladin_Trinity.desc:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}[{cooldown time}|2?|]{/c_resource} seconds
{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{combat effect chance}|2?|]%{/c}
Summon a divine sword that cleaves the battlefield for {c_number}[{payload:impact}|2?|]{/c} damage. 

Casting {c_important}Zenith{/c} again cuts through the battlefield for {c_number}[{payload:last_hit_tool}|2?|]{/c} damage and Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}[{buffduration:tooltip_knockdown}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Weaken
mods.desc: Killing {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies with {c_important}Zenith{/c} reduces its cooldown by {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Unstoppable
mods.desc: While {c_important}Zenith{/c} is active, you are {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Critical Strike Chance
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Zenith{/c} increases your {c_number}5%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Chance for {c_number}[{buffduration:upgrade3_crit_chance}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Weaken
mods.desc: {c_important}Zenith{/c} applies {c_important}{u}Weaken{/u}{/c} to enemies.

mods.name: Sunder
mods.desc:
{c_important}Zenith{/c} sunders a rift in the ground with a single strike, Knocking Down enemies and dealing {c_number}[{payload:tooltip_c_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage.

After {c_number}0.75{/c} second, the rift detonates for {c_number}[{payload:tooltip_c_final_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Sermon of Steel
mods.desc:
{c_important}Zenith{/c} unleashes your wrath, dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact_b}|2?|]{/c} damage and can be cast indefinitely for {c_number}[{buffduration:upgrade_b_recast_attk1}|2?|]{/c} seconds before starting its Cooldown.

Instead of Knocking Down enemies, {c_important}Zenith's{/c} 2nd strike extends this duration by {c_number}0.5{/c} second.

mods.name: Empyrean Edge
mods.desc:
{c_important}Zenith{/c} is now also a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill that:
{icon:bullet,1.2}Dashes to enemies
{icon:bullet,1.2}Gains {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Damage

Warlock_Summon_Lunatic.name: Command Fallen

mods.name: Damage Per Demon
mods.desc: {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} deals {c_number}1%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for every Demon you have active, up to {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Wrath
mods.desc: {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} generates {c_number}1{/c} additional Wrath for every Demon or Enemy you have killed in the last {c_number}2{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}5{/c} additional Wrath.

mods.name: Dominance
mods.desc: Every {c_number}15{/c} times you hit enemies with {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} you gain {c_number}1{/c} Dominance.

mods.name: Lifetime Damage
mods.desc: Your Demons summoned by {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} deal {c_number}8%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for every second they are alive, up to {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Mega Lunatic
mods.desc: {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} summons a Mega Lunatic which deals {c_number}[{payload:explosion_mega}|2?|]{/c} damage and bursts into {c_number}3{/c} Mini Lunatics which each deal {c_number}[{payload:explosion_mini}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Meat Shields
mods.desc: {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and passively summons a Lunatic every {c_number}[Max(1,8*Max(0.25,1/PowerFinalizedAttackSpeed)-3)|1|]{/c} |4second:seconds; that follows you around and detonates when enemies get close, up to {c_number}5{/c} Lunatics. Summon rate is based on your Attack Speed.

mods.name: Fallen Rush
mods.desc: {c_important}Command Fallen{/c} is also an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and now summons up to {c_number}3{/c} Fallen Grunts for {c_number}30{/c} seconds which deal {c_number}[{payload:grunt_swipe}|2?|]{/c} damage and generate {c_number}[10+Bonus_Flat_Resource_Per_Power(2212801)|2?|]{/c} Wrath per hit. Recasting while all are active will direct them to move or target on your command.

Warlock_BrimstoneOrb.name: Molten Bomb

mods.name: Ranged Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} deals up to {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage based on how far it travels.

mods.name: Wrath
mods.desc: {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} generates {c_number}1{/c} additional Wrath on each impact.

mods.name: Knock Down
mods.desc: {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} has a {c_number}15%{/c} chance to Knock Down enemies for {c_number}2{/c} seconds. mods.name: Area Bonus
mods.desc: {c_important}Molten Bomb's{/c} impact area is increased by {c_number}30%{/c} and does {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to enemies at its center.

mods.name: Demon Turret
mods.desc: {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} becomes a {c_important}Demonology Summon{/c} Skill and creates a turret demon on impact for {c_number}5{/c} seconds that spits lava at surrounding enemies, each dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact_turret}|2?|]{/c} damage. You can have up to {c_number}6{/c} turrets active at a once.

mods.name: Cluster Bomb
mods.desc: {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and now lobs a cluster of {c_number}6{/c} smaller shadow orbs which each deal {c_number}[{payload:impact_mini}|2?|]{/c} damage. If the cluster is not split it instead creates a shadow zone for {c_number}7{/c} seconds that grants {c_number}4{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} every second.

mods.name: Brimstone Mortar
mods.desc: {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} creates a {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c} at the impact location which deals {c_number}[{payload:bs_payload_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} damage when it explodes.

Warlock_HexCast.name: Doom

mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Doom{/c} against a {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c}, or Slowed enemy assimilates the effects, causing {c_important}Doom{/c} to also apply those effects for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Doom{/c} echoes {c_number}10%{/c} of its damage to all Nearby {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies.

mods.name: Jailer

mods.name: Contagion
mods.desc: Whenever you kill a {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemy, {c_important}Doom{/c} spreads the {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} to another enemy and deals {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_a_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage to them.

mods.name: Doomfire Ritual
mods.desc: {c_important}Doom{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and your {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} is applied with Maximum Stacks for {c_number}15{/c} seconds but you can only have one {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} target at a time. When {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} expires or is removed, {c_important}Doom{/c} deals {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_c_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage split amongst all enemies in the area as a {c_important}Sigil{/c} Skill.

mods.name: Wrath
mods.desc: {c_important}Doom{/c} generates {c_number}1{/c} Wrath every {c_number}2{/c} seconds for each {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemy.

mods.name: Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Doom{/c} deals {c_number}2%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to enemies for each second they have been {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c}, up to {c_number}200%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

Warlock_TailWhip.name: Hellion Sting

mods.name: Eviscerate
mods.desc: {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} has {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} chance against your primary target.

mods.name: Fortify
mods.desc: When you strike an {c_important}{u}Eviscerated{/u}{/c} enemy with {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} you are {c_important}{u}Fortified{/u}{/c} for {c_number}1%{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.01||]){/c}.

mods.name: Wrath
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} increases your Wrath Regeneration by {c_number}10%{/c} for {c_number}3{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}30%{/c}.

mods.name: Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} deals {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to enemies for {c_number}3{/c} seconds after you first strike them with it.

mods.name: Multi-Strike
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} within {c_number}1.5{/c} seconds of the last will increase the number of strikes, up to {c_number}2{/c} total hits per cast.

mods.name: Tail Spikes
mods.desc: {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} launches a wave of spikes forward a long distance dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact_spike}|2?|]{/c} damage per hit.

mods.name: Demonic Swipe
mods.desc: {c_important}Hellion Sting{/c} becomes a {c_important}Greater Demon Hellfire Archfiend{/c} Skill and its {c_number}4th{/c} attack transforms you into {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}, cleaving a wide area for {c_number}[{payload:impact_swipe}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Warlock_DemonicBombard.name: Bombardment

mods.name: Damage
mods.desc: Each cast of {c_important}Bombardment{/c} deals {c_number}5%{/c} increased damage to each enemy per hit.

mods.name: Additional Demon
mods.desc: {c_important}Bombardment{/c} throws {c_number}1{/c} additional demon.

mods.name: Focused Target
mods.desc: {c_important}Bombardment's{/c} chaotic spread is reduced by {c_number}300%{/c} and it deals {c_number}30%{/c} increased damage when only hitting a single enemy.

mods.name: Telekinesis
mods.desc: Each time {c_important}Bombardment{/c} throws a demon it has a {c_number}100%{/c} chance to also throw a surrounding {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} at your target location.

mods.name: Endless Barrage
mods.desc: {c_important}Bombardment{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and now only slams down demons randomly around yourself but demons continue to rain down around you for {c_number}10{/c} seconds afterward. This effect can stack up to {c_number}5{/c} times.

mods.name: Demon Mangler
mods.desc: Each {c_important}Bombardment{/c} impact now has a {c_number}40%{/c} chance to leave behind mutilated demons for {c_number}8{/c} seconds that attack surrounding enemies, dealing {c_number}[{payload:demon_swipe}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Brutality
mods.desc: Each cast of {c_important}Bombardment{/c} within {c_number}3{/c} seconds of the last calls down more demons, up to {c_number}4{/c} additional.

Warlock_Fissure.name: Hell Fracture

mods.name: Ramp Up
mods.desc: Casting a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill increases the damage of your next {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} by {c_number}40%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} but also increases the Cost by {c_number}25%{/c}, up to {c_number}4{/c} times.

mods.name: Additional Fracture
mods.desc: {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} explodes {c_number}1{/c} additional time.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} reduces its cost by {c_number}25%{/c} until you Cast a different Skill.

mods.name: Volatility
mods.desc: Standing within a {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} explosion grants you {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Eruption
mods.desc: {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} no longer explodes with each cast and instead creates {c_number}[3+Mod(2686060764)|2?|]{/c} smaller fractures in front of you that erupt into {c_number}5{/c} {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} when you enter. mods.name: Lava Fissures
mods.desc: {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} creates lava fissures between each fracture which burst for {c_number}[{payload:fissure_impact}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Ruptured Abyss
mods.desc: {c_important}Hell Fracture{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and now reaches to the abyss, dealing {c_number}[{payload:implode_payload}|2?|]{/c} damage and Pulling {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies inwards.

Warlock_ChainLash.name: Umbral Chains

mods.name: Heavy Harpoon
mods.desc: {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} Knocks Back your primary target and deals {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to them.

mods.name: Wrath Refund
mods.desc: When {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} ends it refunds {c_number}1{/c} Wrath for every enemy hit over its duration.

mods.name: Capture Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} deals {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage when an unchained enemy is first caught by the chain. {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies always take increased damage.

mods.name: Long Range Slow
mods.desc: {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} flies {c_number}50%{/c} farther and its Slow is increased to {c_number}60%{/c}.

mods.name: Chain Burst
mods.desc: {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} explodes for {c_number}[{payload:chain_burst_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} damage when stretched to its maximum or when it expires. If this happens early then any damage the chain would have done is added.

mods.name: Chain Whips
mods.desc: {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and whips around your target, dealing {c_number}[{payload:chain_whip_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} damage per second to surrounding enemies and striking a {c_number}25%{/c} larger area when empowered by {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Epicenter
mods.desc: {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} now always creates a chain link back to you. Additionally, a chain is created between you and each {c_important}Greater Demon Summon{/c} for up to {c_number}30{/c} seconds.

Warlock_BurningSkull.name: Blazing Scream

mods.name: Impact Velocity
mods.desc: {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} gains up to {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage and speed based on your Movement Speed Bonus.

mods.name: Brimstone Hunger
mods.desc: {c_important}Blazing Scream's{/c} primary skulls instantly detonate {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c} as they travel, increasing that skull's damage by {c_number}5%{/c} per {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c}, up to {c_number}50%{/c}.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: Hitting any enemy with {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} reduces its cost by {c_number}25%{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} deals {c_number}3%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage based on how many different enemies it has hit, up to {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Skull Splitter
mods.desc: {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} shoots out smaller Lesser Demon Skulls that seek enemies and deal {c_number}[{payload:impact_mini}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Abyssal Oppression
mods.desc: {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss Recast Summon{/c} Skill, seeking your target location for {c_number}5{/c} seconds and Knocking Down enemies the first time it hits them. Enemies near the skull take {c_number}[{payload:impact_proxy}|2?|]{/c} damage and become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}. Channeling redirects the skull and refreshes the duration.

mods.name: Orbital Scream
mods.desc: {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} is now also a {c_important}Summon{/c} Skill and orbits you for {c_number}10{/c} seconds. The skull deals {c_number}[{payload:impact_orbit}|2?|]{/c} damage and extends {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} when it hits enemies. Channeling increases the orbit speed by {c_number}150%{/c} and refreshes the duration.

Warlock_ShadowShred.name: Dread Claws

mods.name: Ambush
mods.desc: {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} deals {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage with its first claw strike against each enemy. When attacking from {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} all claws gain this bonus.

mods.name: Vulnerable
mods.desc: {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds if it strikes them at least {c_number}2{/c} times.

mods.name: Damage
mods.desc: Every second, gain {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for your next {c_important}Dread Claws{/c}, up to {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: Killing enemies or demons with {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} reduces the cost of your next {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} by {c_number}10%{/c}, up to {c_number}50%{/c}.

mods.name: Ravenous Jaws
mods.desc: {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} becomes a {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skill and is cast in a frontal cone, dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact_jaws}|2?|]{/c} damage and killing up to {c_number}5{/c} {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} it strikes. Each {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} killed grants {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} a {c_number}2%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} chance for {c_number}10{/c} seconds to {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}[{dot:eviscerate_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} damage, up to {c_number}10%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}.

mods.name: Enveloping Terror
mods.desc: {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} are cast around you, each dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact_circle}|2?|]{/c} damage. You consume {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} to also conjure claws around your most recent {c_important}Greater Demon Summon{/c}.

mods.name: Cascading Dread
mods.desc: {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} sends out {c_number}4{/c} additional claws and each set deals {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage than the last.

Warlock_Demon_Wall.name: Wall of Agony

mods.name: Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} deals {c_number}2.0%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage for every point of Maximum Dominance you have.

mods.name: Small Walls
mods.desc: {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} now only spawns {c_number}3{/c} demons but its cost is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Wall of Agony's{/c} cost is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c} but increased by {c_number}10%{/c} for every Demon you have active.

mods.name: Knock Down
mods.desc: Each hit from {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} has a {c_number}20%{/c} chance to Knock Down enemies for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Waller
mods.desc: {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} summons {c_number}10{/c} demons in a cage formation that Pulls enemies inward.

mods.name: Fallen Army
mods.desc: When {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} expires, demon brutes remain for {c_number}8{/c} seconds and attack Nearby enemies. If {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} is killed early then the demon brutes gain its remaining duration.

mods.name: Encircle
mods.desc: {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} is summoned in an encircling formation that Knocks enemies Back. Each active {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} demon grants you {c_number}6%{/c} Damage Reduction, up to {c_number}30%{/c}. {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} now has a {c_number}[20*(1-Mod(2686060764)*0.5)||]{/c} second Cooldown but costs no Dominance.

buffs.name: Damage Reduction
buffs.desc: Take reduced damage while Wall of Agony is active

Warlock_DemonDefender.name: Tortured Wretch

mods.name: Enrage
mods.desc: When enemies attack the {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} they are enraged for {c_number}2{/c} seconds, gaining {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} increased Attack Speed but taking {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_3_dmg}|2?|]{/c} damage when they hit targets.

mods.name: Duration
mods.desc: Enemies and Demons killed Close to the {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} extend its duration by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Cost Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} cost is reduced by {c_number}30%{/c}.

mods.name: Unstoppable
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} makes you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Domination
mods.desc: {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Occult Recast{/c} Skill and now directly dominates a target's mind for up to {c_number}[{buffduration:domination}|2?|]{/c} seconds, forcing it to Taunt your enemies and take {c_number}[{payload:upgrade_c_dmg}|2?|]{/c} damage when hit by them. Recast to command the target around the battlefield.

mods.name: Death Saws
mods.desc: Saws grind up enemies around the {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c}, periodically dealing {c_number}[{payload:saw_impact}|2?|]{/c} damage with a {c_number}5%{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}[{dot:eviscerate_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} damage.

mods.name: Punching Bag
mods.desc: {c_important}Tortured Wretch{/c} no longer Taunts but now lasts for {c_number}12{/c} seconds and you redirect all damage to it so long as you stay in the area. It can absorb up to {c_number}30%{/c} of your Maximum Life before it is killed. When the demon dies it explodes, dealing up to {c_number}[{payload:blast_impact}|2?|]{/c} damage and {c_important}{u}Fortifying{/u}{/c} you for up to {c_number}25%{/c} based on the damage it absorbed.

Warlock_ChainTotem.name: Dark Prison

mods.name: Cooldown Reduction
mods.desc: Enemies killed within {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} reduce its cooldown by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Weaken
mods.desc: Enemies within {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} are {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c}.

mods.name: Missile Slow
mods.desc: Small Missiles that enter {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} are Slowed by {c_number}99%{/c}.

mods.name: Fortify
mods.desc: Hitting enemies within {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}1%{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.01||]){/c}.

mods.name: Tripwire
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} refreshes and creates a link to your last prison, enemies that cross the line will be Pulled into the new prison. {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} gains an additional charge.

mods.name: Chain Aura
mods.desc: {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and now creates an aura of fire chains around you, reducing damage coming from outside by {c_number}45%{/c} and Slowing enemies within by {c_number}80%{/c}.

mods.name: Calamity Cage
mods.desc: {c_important}Dark Prison{/c} is now additionally a {c_important}Recast Sigil{/c} Skill and lasts {c_number}50%{/c} longer but you can only have one at a time. When the prison ends all enemies within take {c_number}[{payload:implosion}|2?|]{/c} damage, increased by {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} per additional enemy within. Non-Elite enemies within the prison cannot die while it is active. Recast to collapse the prison early.

Warlock_WraithStep.name: Nether Step
Warlock_WraithStep.desc:
{if:Mod(2686060762)}{c_label}Charges:{/c} {c_resource}2{/c}
{c_label}Charge Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}[{recharge time}|2?|]{/c} seconds
{else}{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}[{cooldown time}|2?|]{/c} seconds
{/if}Step through the shadows of Hell to emerge at the target location, gaining {c_number}4{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} as well as {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased Movement Speed which decays over {c_number}[4*Table(37,sLevel)*(1+0.5*Mod(2686060764))|1|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Damage Reduction
mods.desc: {c_important}Nether Step{/c} grants {c_number}60%{/c} Damage Reduction that decays alongside its Movement Speed Bonus.

mods.name: Extra Charge
mods.desc: {c_important}Nether Step{/c} gains an additional Charge.

mods.name: Movement Speed
mods.desc: {c_important}Nether Step's{/c} Movement Speed Bonus lasts {c_number}50%{/c} longer.

mods.name: Vacuum Swap
mods.desc: {c_important}Nether Step{/c} sucks enemies into its exit portal and swaps places with them.

mods.name: Portals
mods.desc: {c_important}Nether Step's{/c} portals remain for {c_number}10{/c} seconds and can be re-entered to move back and forth.

mods.name: Gloomwalker
mods.desc: {c_important}Nether Step{/c} now lets you run through the abyss while {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c} for up to {c_number}3{/c} seconds. Cast again to exit early.

mods.name: Shadow Recall
mods.desc: {c_important}Nether Step{/c} brings all your {c_important}Abyss Summons{/c} with you through the shadows and extends their durations by {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

Warlock_DemonicSlash.name: Rampage

mods.name: Demon Masher
mods.desc: {c_important}Rampage{/c} now smashes your {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} to {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} you for {c_number}2%{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax()*0.02||]){/c}.

mods.name: Elite Hit Chance

mods.name: Demonic Smash

mods.name: Abyssal Titan
mods.desc: {c_important}Rampage{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Recast{/c} Skill and summons a larger demon that deals {c_number}50%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage. Warlock_Demonic_Breath.name: Infernal Breath

mods.name: Lesser Demon Volatility
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} infuses your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills to grant {c_number}1{/c} seconds of {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} per hit for {c_number}[5*(1+2*AffixIsEquipped(2559878))|2?|]{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Demonic Breath

mods.name: Explosive Death
mods.desc: At the end of {c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} the demon explodes, dealing {c_number}[{payload:blast_impact}|2?|]{/c} damage. The explosion damage is increased by {c_number}20%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} for each time the demon's breath hit enemies.

mods.name: Abyssal Torrent
mods.desc: {c_important}Infernal Breath{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Recast{/c} Skill and summons a larger demon for {c_number}15{/c} seconds that {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies. Warlock_DemonicGrasp.name: Tyrant's Grasp

mods.name: Grasp Area

mods.name: Knock Down
mods.desc: {c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} Knocks Down enemies for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.

mods.name: Unstoppable Damage
mods.desc: {c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} deals {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage against {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} enemies.

mods.name: Lesser Demon Slow
mods.desc: Casting {c_important}Tyrant's Grasp{/c} commands your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills to Slow enemies by {c_number}60%{/c} for {c_number}[5*(1+2*AffixIsEquipped(2559878))|2?|]{/c} seconds.

Warlock_Demonic_Drain.name: Profane Sentinel

mods.name: Single Target Damage

mods.name: Wide Beam
mods.desc: {c_important}Profane Sentinel's{/c} beam area is {c_number}200%{/c} larger.

mods.name: Narrow Blast
mods.desc: {c_important}Profane Sentinel{/c} deals {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage but its blast area is reduced by {c_number}50%{/c}.

mods.name: Focused Glare

mods.name: Demonic Sight

Warlock_SigilOfSummons.name: Sigil of Summons

{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}[{cooldown time}|2?|]{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{combat effect chance}|2?|]%{/c}

mods.name: Stronger Summons

mods.name: Cooldown

Warlock_SigilOfFlames.name: Sigil of Chaos

Warlock_ArchDemon.name: Metamorphosis

{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c}
