Paladin_Talent_Justice_09.desc: You deal {c_number}[0.07*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controled enemies.

Paladin_Talent_Justice_06.name: [WIP] Faith Spend CDR
Paladin_Talent_Justice_06.desc: Every {c_number}100{/c} Faith you spend reduces the cooldowns of your {c_important}Angelic{/c} Skills by {c_number}[0.5*sLevel|1|]{/c} seconds.

Paladin_Talent_Justice_05.name: Righteousness
Paladin_Talent_Justice_05.desc: You deal {c_number}[0.06*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} increased Holy and Fire damage.

Paladin_Talent_Justice_04.name: Giant Slayer
Paladin_Talent_Justice_04.desc: You deal {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to Elites and {c_number}[0.08*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c} enemies.
Paladin_Talent_Justice_04.rankup:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Damage to Elites {icon:arrow,1.2} {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c}
{icon:bullet, 1.2} Damage to Healthy {icon:arrow,1.2} {c_number}[0.08*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c}

Paladin_Talent_Justice_02.name: Pacify
Paladin_Talent_Justice_02.desc: You gain {c_number}[0.15*sLevel*100|%+|]{/c} increased Crowd Control duration.

Paladin_Talent_Arbiter_01.name: (PH) Arbiter Damage Reduction
Paladin_Talent_Arbiter_01.desc: While an {u}{c_important}Arbiter{/c}{/u}, you gain {c_number}[0.04*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} Damage Reduction.

Paladin_Talent_Arbiter_02.name: (PH) Arbiter CDR
Paladin_Talent_Arbiter_02.desc: While an {u}{c_important}Arbiter{/c}{/u}, you gain {c_number}[0.04*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} Cooldown Reduction.

Paladin_Talent_Arbiter_03.name: (PH) Arbiter Resource
Paladin_Talent_Arbiter_03.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damage against {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} enemies while an {u}{c_important}Arbiter{/c}{/u} has up to a {c_number}20%{/c} chance to restore {c_number}[5*sLevel|2?|]{/c} Faith.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_10.name: Attenuate
Paladin_Talent_Valor_10.desc: Gain {c_number}[0.01*sLevel*100|%+|]{/c} Resource Cost Reduction for every stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} up to {c_number}[0.01*sLevel*5*100|%|]{/c}.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_09.name: Conviction
Paladin_Talent_Valor_09.desc: Gain {c_number}[0.003*sLevel*100|1%+|]{/c} Attack Speed for each stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} up to {c_number}[10*(0.003*sLevel)*100|1%+|]{/c}.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_08.name: Resolute
Paladin_Talent_Valor_08.desc: Gaining a stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} Heals for {c_number}[0.005*sLevel*100|1%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,PlayerHealthMax()*(0.005*sLevel))||]){/c}.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_07.name: [WIP] DR for Resolve
Paladin_Talent_Valor_07.desc: Gain {c_number}[0.005*sLevel*100|%1|]{/c} additional Damage Reduction per stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.

Paladin_Talent_Justice_13.name: Heavyweight
Paladin_Talent_Justice_13.desc: You deal {c_number}[0.06*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage while {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_05.name: Courage
Paladin_Talent_Valor_05.desc: Casting a {c_important}Valor{/c} Skill increases your core skill damage by {c_number}[0.03*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:buff_damage}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_04.name: [WIP] Update needed
Paladin_Talent_Valor_04.desc: Update needed  - - Taking damage grants you {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

Paladin_Talent_Justice_12.name: Press the Advantage
Paladin_Talent_Justice_12.desc: Critically Striking grants you {c_number}[0.03*sLevel*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

Paladin_Talent_Justice_11.name: Break the Line
Paladin_Talent_Justice_11.desc: You have a {c_number}[0.02*sLevel*100|%+|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Chance and deal {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} increased Damage to {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_02.name: Thorns and Thistles
Paladin_Talent_Valor_02.desc: Gain {c_number}20{/c} Thorns and your total Thorns damage is increased by {c_number}[0.15*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c}

Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_05.name: Shake It Off
Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_05.desc: You have a {c_number}[0.08*sLevel*100|%|]{/c} chance to become {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/c}{/u} for {c_number}1{/c} second after being hit by a Crowd Control Effect.

Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_04.name: Master Craftwork
Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_04.desc: Your Armor is increased by {c_number}[0.5*sLevel*100|%|]{/c} of your Shield's Block Chance.

Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_02.name: Sacred Arms
Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_02.desc:
Gain a bonus based on your equipped weapon types:

{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Two Handed:{/c} Gain {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}One Handed and Shield:{/c} {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%|]{/c} chance to ignore damage.
Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_02.rankup:
{icon:bullet,1.2} Two Handed Bonus {icon:arrow,1.2} {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c}
{icon:bullet,1.2} One Handed Bonus {icon:arrow,1.2} {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%|]{/c}

Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_01.name: Shining Armor
Paladin_Talent_Ultimate_01.desc:
Gain a bonus based on your equipped weapon and armor qualities:

{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Unique Weapon or Shield:{/c} Gain {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} Damage. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_label}Unique Helmet, Chest or Pants:{/c} Gain {c_number}[0.05*sLevel*100|%+|]{/c} Armor.

Paladin_Talent_Valor_01.name: (PH) Valor Damage Reduction
Paladin_Talent_Valor_01.desc: Casting a {c_important}Valor{/c} Skill increases your Damage Reduction by {c_number}[0.03*sLevel*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[{buffduration:buff_dr}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

Warlock_Summon_Legion_Demon.name: Summon Ae'grom
Warlock_Summon_Legion_Demon.desc:
{c_label}Dominance Cost:{/c_label} {c_warlockDominance}[{resource cost}|2?|]{/c}
Summon {c_important}Ae'grom{/c}, the Demon of Legions.

Warlock_Summon_Mastermind_Demon.name: Summon Laalish
Warlock_Summon_Mastermind_Demon.desc:
{c_label}Dominance Cost:{/c_label} {c_warlockDominance}[{resource cost}|2?|]{/c}
Summon {c_important}Laalish{/c}, the Abyss Demon.

Warlock_Summon_Ritualist_Demon.name: Summon Valloch
Warlock_Summon_Ritualist_Demon.desc:
{c_label}Dominance Cost:{/c_label} {c_warlockDominance}[{resource cost}|2?|]{/c}
Summon {c_important}Valloch{/c}, the Fallen One.

SorcererCombo_Meteor_1.name: Meteor
SorcererCombo_Meteor_1.desc:
Summon a meteor, dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact}|2?|]{/c} damage and Burning the ground for {c_number}[{dot:tooltip_burning}|2?|]{/c} damage over {c_number}3{/c} seconds. Channeling increases its damage and area at each Stage by:
{c_gold}I:{/c} {c_number}25%{/c} damage and {c_number}50%{/c} area.
{c_gold}II:{/c} {c_number}175%{/c} damage and {c_number}100%{/c} area.
{c_gold}III:{/c} {c_number}400%{/c} damage and {c_number}150%{/c} area.

{c_important}{u}Combo Finishers{/u}{/c} increase Charge Rate by {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}.

SorcererCombo_FireBolt_Phased.name: Fire Bolt
SorcererCombo_FireBolt_Phased.desc:
{c_gold}I:{/c} Hurl {c_number}1{/c} flaming bolt, dealing {c_number}[{payload:combo_1_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage.
{c_gold}II:{/c} Hurl {c_number}2{/c} flaming bolts, dealing {c_number}[{payload:combo_2_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage each.
{c_gold}III:{/c} Hurl {c_number}1{/c} flaming bolt, dealing {c_number}[{payload:combo_3_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage.
{c_gold}IV:{/c} Hurl {c_number}1{/c} flaming bolt that explodes, dealing {c_number}[{payload:combo_4_damage}|2?|]{/c} damage and Burning enemies {c_number}[{dot:combo_4_burning}|2?|]{/c} over {c_number}[{buffduration:combo_4_burning}|2?|]{/c} seconds.

Warplans_BSK_GemBoost.name: Flawless Find
Warplans_BSK_GemBoost.desc: {c_important}Gem Fragments{/c} drop instead of {c_rare}Obducite{/c} in the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c}.

Warplans_BSK_ObduciteBoost.name: Forged in Flame
Warplans_BSK_ObduciteBoost.desc: {c_rare}Obducite{/c} drops instead of {c_important}Gem Fragments{/c} in the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c}.

Warplans_BSK_RuneChest.name: Council Coffers
Warplans_BSK_RuneChest.desc: The {c_important}Chest of Talismans{/c} will appear after defeating either the {c_important}Fell Council{/c} or {c_important}Bartuc{/c}.

Warplans_BSK_SuperChest.name: Infernal Hoard
Warplans_BSK_SuperChest.desc: Defeating either the {c_important}Fell Council{/c} or {c_important}Bartuc{/c} reveals the {c_important}Hoard of Greater Equipment{/c}, which contains a colossal deluge of equipment and other rewards.

Warplans_BSK_Challenges.name: Devil's Deal
Warplans_BSK_Challenges.desc:
At the start of the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c}, gain an {c_important}Infernal Challenge{/c}.

Completing the {c_important}Infernal Challenge{/c} will grant +{c_number}200{/c} {c_important}Aether{/c}.

Warplans_BSK_KillCommand.name: Scale of Tathamet
Warplans_BSK_KillCommand.desc: Once per wave the {c_important}Scale of Tathamet{/c} may appear, a primordial relic that kills all enemies within the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c}.

Warplans_BSK_Omens.name: Cult of Annihilation
Warplans_BSK_Omens.desc:
{c_important}Doomsayers{/c} appear during the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c}.

{c_important}Doomsayers{/c} are dangerous enemies but also drop {c_important}Aether{/c}.

Warplans_BSK_Chaos2.name: Bedlam
Warplans_BSK_Chaos2.desc: When you enter a {c_RuneEffect}Chaos Wave{/c}, gain +{c_number}50{/c} {c_important}Aether{/c} and all enemies in the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c} gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_BSK_Chaos1.name: Total Chaos
Warplans_BSK_Chaos1.desc:
{c_RuneEffect}Chaos Waves{/c} appear more frequently.

However, one less {c_important}Infernal Offering{/c} appears each wave.

Warplans_BSK_Order2.name: Pulse of Aether
Warplans_BSK_Order2.desc:
Suppressing a {c_RuneEffect}Chaos Wave{/c} grants +{c_number}50{/c} {c_important}Aether{/c}.

All enemies in the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c} gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_BSK_Order1.name: Reign in Hell
Warplans_BSK_Order1.desc:
An additional {c_important}Infernal Offering{/c} appears each wave. 

However, you suppress {c_RuneEffect}Chaos Waves{/c} from appearing.

Warplans_BSK_Replicator.name: The Black Pact
Warplans_BSK_Replicator.desc:
An ominous altar appears between waves in the {c_important}Infernal Hordes{/c}. 

It can be invoked only once, and provides an {c_important}Infernal Offering{/c} that shares a category with your previous choice.

Warplans_BSK_EventRush.name: Impending Doom
Warplans_BSK_EventRush.desc: When the current wave has {c_number}10{/c} seconds remaining, {c_important}Aether Events{/c} spawn at all locations.

Warplans_BSK_LikeBargains.name: Method and Madness
Warplans_BSK_LikeBargains.desc: Your {c_important}Infernal Offerings{/c} are more likely to share a category with your previous choice.

Warplans_BSK_BossBoost.name: Exalted Council
Warplans_BSK_BossBoost.desc: {c_important}Bartuc{/c} and the {c_important}Fell Council{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} and drop additional items when slain.

Warplans_Helltide_3B.name: Hell's Prize
Warplans_Helltide_3B.desc:
{c_important}Hell's Prize{/c} chests will now appear in {c_important}Helltide{/c}.

These chests offer a massive torrent of items for {c_number}666{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Aberrant Cinders{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Helltide_3A.name: Night Terrors
Warplans_Helltide_3A.desc:
You have a chance to be ambushed by {c_important}Hellborne{/c} in {c_important}Nightmare Dungeons{/c}.

{c_important}Hellborne{/c} have a small chance to drop a {u}{c_important}Profane Mindcage{/c}{/u} when slain.

Warplans_Helltide_3.name: Fall of the Fell
Warplans_Helltide_3.desc:
{c_important}Harbingers{/c} will emerge from falling meteors twice as often, and drop twice as many {u}{b}{c_important}Aberrant Cinders{/c}{/b}{/u} when slain.

{c_important}Harbingers{/c} in Helltide have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Helltide_2B.name: Undying Embers
Warplans_Helltide_2B.desc: You lose no {u}{b}{c_important}Aberrant Cinders{/c}{/b}{/u} on death.

Warplans_Helltide_2A.name: Ashes to Ashes
Warplans_Helltide_2A.desc:
On death, lose all your {u}{b}{c_important}Aberrant Cinders{/c}{/b}{/u}.

For every {c_number}100{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Aberrant Cinders{/c}{/b}{/u} you pick up, you gain an additional {c_number}10{/c}.

Warplans_Helltide_2.name: Wretched Vermin
Warplans_Helltide_2.desc: {c_important}Demonic Rats{/c} will frequently attack you in {c_important}Helltide{/c}.

Warplans_Helltide_1B.name: Meat Brothers
Warplans_Helltide_1B.desc:
Instead of {c_important}Hellborne{/c}, two {c_important}Butchers{/c} that are connected with flaming chains ambush you.

These {c_important}Butchers{/c} each have a high chance to drop a {u}{b}{c_important}Profane Mindcage{/c}{/b}{/u} when slain.

Warplans_Helltide_1A.name: Infernal Rite
Warplans_Helltide_1A.desc:
Ambushes spawn up to four additional {c_important}Hellborne{/c}.

{c_important}Hellborne{/c} have a higher chance to drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} items when slain.

Warplans_Helltide_1.name: Hellmouth
Warplans_Helltide_1.desc:
When a {c_important}{u}{b}Hellwyrm{/c}{/u}{/b} emerges, it unleashes one of the following:

{icon:bullet,1.2} A {c_important}Chaos Rift{/c}, which releases varied rewards upon collapse.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Maggots{/c}, which burst out {c_important}Experience Orbs{/c} when slain.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_important}Bloodseekers{/c}, which are more likely to drop {c_important}Ancestral{/c} items when slain.

Warplans_Helltide_4.name: Hated Foe
Warplans_Helltide_4.desc: {c_important}Maximum Threat{/c} enemies that ambush you gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Helltide_5.name: Chaotic Echoes
Warplans_Helltide_5.desc: Collapsed {c_important}Chaos Rifts{/c} have a chance to reopen.

Warplans_Helltide_6.name: Planar Tremors
Warplans_Helltide_6.desc:
{c_important}{u}{b}Hellwyrms{/c}{/u}{/b} will always open a {c_important}Chaos Rift{/c}, and enemies that emerge from it gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

The first time a {c_important}Chaos Rift{/c} opens, there is a chance that another will open.

Warplans_Helltide_7.name: Bursting Brood
Warplans_Helltide_7.desc: {c_important}Maggots{/c} and {c_important}Pangs of Duriel{/c} explode when killed and will often drop {c_important}Boss Trophies{/c}.

Warplans_Helltide_8.name: Writhe and Rot
Warplans_Helltide_8.desc:
{c_important}{u}{b}Hellwyrms{/c}{/u}{/b} will always spew {c_important}Maggots{/c} that gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Sometimes, a {c_important}Pang of Duriel{/c} will also crawl forth. {c_important}Lair Keys{/c} often burst out of {c_important}Pangs of Duriel{/c}.

Warplans_Helltide_9.name: Bound by Blood
Warplans_Helltide_9.desc:
{c_important}Bloodseekers{/c} are connected with flaming chains.

When slain, {c_important}Bloodseekers{/c} drop items that match the category of the last opened {c_important}Tortured Gift{/c}.

Warplans_Helltide_10.name: Crimson Scent
Warplans_Helltide_10.desc:
{c_important}{u}{b}Hellwyrms{/c}{/u}{/b} will always call forth {c_important}Bloodseekers{/c} that gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

{c_important}Greater Bloodseekers{/c} may also emerge, which have a high chance to drop {c_legendary}Legendary{/c} items when slain.

Warplans_Helltide_0.name: Tainted Shrines
Warplans_Helltide_0.desc: While empowered by a {c_important}Shrine{/c} in {c_important}Helltide{/c}, slain enemies grant double the progress to your {c_important}{b}{u}Threat Level{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_NMD_0.name: Waking Spoils
Warplans_NMD_0.desc: After completing a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c}, a {c_important}War's Bounty Chest{/c} will spawn that grants additional rewards.

Warplans_NMD_1.name: Gauntlet
Warplans_NMD_1.desc:
While in a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c}, slaying an enemy while empowered by a {c_important}Shrine{/c} traps their soul within you.

When the {c_important}Shrine{/c} buff expires, all trapped souls escape and spawn around you as renewed enemies.

Souls will be {c_important}lost{/c} when moving between dungeons in an {c_important}Escalation Dungeon{/c}.

Warplans_NMD_1A.name: Rewarded Faith
Warplans_NMD_1A.desc: Gain a random additional buff when claiming a {c_important}Shrine{/c} in a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c}.

Warplans_NMD_1B.name: Nemesis
Warplans_NMD_1B.desc: Activating a {c_important}Shrine{/c} in a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c} causes up to {c_number}7{/c} {c_important}Elites{/c} to ambush you.

Warplans_NMD_2.name: Horadric Hunter

Warplans_NMD_2A.name: Altar of Avarice
Warplans_NMD_2A.desc: {c_important}Horadric Altars{/c} are replaced with {c_important}Goblin Altars{/c} that only summon {c_important}Treasure Goblins{/c}.

Warplans_NMD_2B.name: Cipher Maps
Warplans_NMD_2B.desc: Whenever you would reveal a {c_important}Horadric Altar{/c}, you reveal {c_number}2{/c} instead.

Warplans_NMD_3.name: Goblinfall
Warplans_NMD_3.desc: {c_important}Treasure Goblins{/c} have a small chance to drop a {c_important}Nightmare Sigil{/c} with the {c_legendary}Treasure Breach{/c} affix.

Warplans_NMD_3A.name: Branching Pathways
Warplans_NMD_3A.desc: When advancing to the next dungeon in a {c_important}Nightmare Escalation{/c}, {c_number}2{/c} additional {c_important}Horadric Portals{/c} appear.

Warplans_NMD_3B.name: Fearless Conviction
Warplans_NMD_3B.desc:
While in a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c}, killing {c_important}Elites{/c} and {c_important}Champions{/c} grants you stacks of {c_important}Conviction{/c}.

Getting hit by an {c_important}Elite{/c} or {c_important}Champion{/c} causes you to lose a stack of {c_important}Conviction{/c}.

A {c_important}Conviction Chest{/c} appears at the end of the dungeon that grants rewards for each remaining {c_important}Conviction{/c}. This chest has a higher than normal chance to award {c_unique}Attuned Primordial Dust{/c}.

Warplans_NMD_5.name: Dread Revival
Warplans_NMD_5.desc: {c_important}Bosses{/c} in {c_important}Nightmare Dungeons{/c} have a chance to revive when slain.

Warplans_NMD_4.name: Recurring Nightmare
Warplans_NMD_4.desc:
{c_important}Bosses{/c} in {c_important}Nightmare Dungeons{/c} gain +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} and have a chance to drop an {c_legendary}Escalation Sigil{/c} when slain.

{c_legendary}Escalation Sigils{/c} can only appear in Torment+ difficulty.

Warplans_NMD_3C.name: Greed is Good
Warplans_NMD_3C.desc: Killing a {c_important}Treasure Goblin{/c} in a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c} has a small chance to spawn a portal that takes you to the {c_important}Goblin's Retreat{/c}.

Warplans_Whispers_0.name: Simple Gifts
Warplans_Whispers_0.desc: The Tree only offers one {u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u} choice that will always be a {c_important}Material Collection{/c} or a {c_important}Collection of Chaos{/c}.

Warplans_Whispers_1.name: Grim Retribution
Warplans_Whispers_1.desc:
Completing a {c_important}Whisper{/c} has a chance to trigger a {c_important}Whisper Ambush{/c}. 

These enemies have a chance to burst out the contents of a {c_important}Collection of Chaos{/c} when slain.

Warplans_Whispers_1A.name: Colossal Foe
Warplans_Whispers_1A.desc:
{c_important}Whisper Ambushes{/c} sometimes include {c_important}Bosses{/c}. 

These {c_important}Bosses{/c} will always burst out the contents of a {c_legendary}Greater Collection of Chaos{/c} when slain.

Warplans_Whispers_1B.name: Malignant Invasion
Warplans_Whispers_1B.desc:
{c_important}Varshan{/c} can now appear in a {c_important}Whisper Ambushes{/c}. 

Slay {c_important}Varshan{/c} to earn the contents of an {c_legendary}Ancestral Collection of Chaos{/c} {icon:AttributeBullet_GreaterAffix,1.5}.

Warplans_Whispers_2.name: Corrupted Roots
Warplans_Whispers_2.desc:
{u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Caches{/c}{/b}{/u} sometimes contain {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c}.

Plant {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c} to grow an {c_important}Exposed Root{/c}. These will attract nearby enemies, and have a chance to grow larger and summon more fearsome enemies.

The regions of Sanctuary each bear different fruit.

Warplans_Whispers_2B.name: Roots of Power
Warplans_Whispers_2B.desc:
Enemies that are drawn to {c_important}Exposed Roots{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Planting {c_important}Corrupted Roots{/c} in Helltides yields double rewards.

Warplans_Whispers_3.name: Resplendent Favor
Warplans_Whispers_3.desc: Each {u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u} has a chance to drop a {c_mythic}Resplendent Spark{/c}.

Warplans_Whispers_3A.name: Tree of Plenty
Warplans_Whispers_3A.desc: The Tree offers a fourth {u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u} choice.

Warplans_Whispers_3B.name: Headrotten Feast
Warplans_Whispers_3B.desc: {c_important}Headrotten Bosses{/c} that are drawn to {c_important}Exposed Roots{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}, and will always drop a {u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Whispers_3C.name: Fortune or Famine
Warplans_Whispers_3C.desc: {u}{b}{c_important}Whisper Caches{/c}{/b}{/u} from the Tree of Whispers are always at least of {c_important}Greater Quality{/c}... or {c_important}Junk{/c}.

Warplans_Whispers_5.name: Material Wealth
Warplans_Whispers_5.desc: The Tree now only offers {c_important}Material Collections{/c}.

Warplans_Whispers_6.name: Grim Mysteries
Warplans_Whispers_6.desc:
{c_important}Collections of Chaos{/c} are replaced with {c_important}Collections of Mysteries{/c}.

These caches can drop anything.

Warplans_Whispers_7.name: Chaotic Favor
Warplans_Whispers_7.desc: Completing a {c_important}Whisper{/c} has a small chance to award a {c_important}Collection of Chaos{/c}.

Warplans_BossLair_1.name: Two by Two
Warplans_BossLair_1.desc:
After opening a {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}, there is a low chance a Portal will open that will take you to the {c_important}Nemesis Lair{/c}, where you will fight two {c_important}Initiate Lair Bosses{/c} at the same time.

Slaying both will yield great rewards.

You cannot enter a {c_important}Nemesis Lair{/c} from Belial's throne room.

Warplans_BossLair_1A.name: Greater Nemesis
Warplans_BossLair_1A.desc:
After completing a {c_important}Nemesis Lair{/c}, there is a chance that a portal will appear that will take you to a {c_important}Greater Nemesis Lair{/c}. Within this heinous place lies two {c_important}Greater Lair Bosses{/c}.

Slaying both bosses will yield great rewards.

Warplans_BossLair_2.name: Nemesis Tides
Warplans_BossLair_2.desc:
{c_important}Initiate Lair Bosses{/c} have a chance to appear instead of Helltide Commanders after Helltide Events.

Killing {c_important}Lair Bosses{/c} in Helltides while earning the {c_important}Event Mastery{/c} grants many random {c_important}Lair Boss{/c} materials.

This only occurs in {c_important}Torment+{/c} difficulties.

Warplans_BossLair_2B.name: Exotic Armory
Warplans_BossLair_2B.desc: {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chests{/c}{/b}{/u} drop one additional {c_unique}Unique{/c} Item, but it can be for any Class.

Warplans_BossLair_4.name: Lair of Runes
Warplans_BossLair_4.desc:
{c_important}Lair Bosses{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

{c_important}Lair Bosses{/c} have a higher chances of dropping specific {c_rune}Runes{/c}.

Warplans_BossLair_3A.name: Lair of Plenty
Warplans_BossLair_3A.desc:
{c_important}Lair Bosses{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Gain +{c_number}1{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u} when you slay a {c_important}Lair Boss{/c} (excluding Belial).

Warplans_BossLair_3B.name: Infernal Deception
Warplans_BossLair_3B.desc: {c_important}Belial{/c} can now ambush you after completing the Infernal Hordes.

Warplans_BossLair_7.name: Ultimate Nemesis
Warplans_BossLair_7.desc:
After defeating all Bosses within the {c_important}Greater Nemesis Lair{/c}, the {c_important}Call Of Evil{/c} will appear. This altar will accept 3 {c_blue}Superior Lair Keys{/c} and open a Portal that takes you to the {c_unique}Ultimate Nemesis Lair{/c}.

Inside the {c_unique}Ultimate Nemesis Lair{/c}, all enemies gain +5 {c_important}{u}{b}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}. Defeating the Boss Encounter will award you with 10 {c_important}{u}{b}Hoard Chests{/c}{/b}{/u} worth of Items.

Warplans_BossLair_8.name: Golden Hoard
Warplans_BossLair_8.desc: All equipment that would drop from {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chests{/c}{/b}{/u} are converted to {c_important}Gold{/c}, except for {c_unique}Unique{/c} and {c_mythic}Mythic{/c} items.

Warplans_BossLair_16.name: Blood of Bartuc
Warplans_BossLair_16.desc:
The {c_important}Fell Council{/c} in the Infernal Hordes has +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

After defeating the {c_important}Fell Council{/c}, the {c_important}Spoils of Greater Equipment{/c} may drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items associated with {c_important}Bartuc{/c}.

Warplans_BossLair_15.name: Varshan's Vengeance
Warplans_BossLair_15.desc:
{c_important}Varshan{/c} and his minions can now appear in a {c_important}Chaos Wave{/c} within the Infernal Hordes.

After killing {c_important}Varshan{/c} in the Infernal Hordes, the {c_important}Spoils of Greater Equipment{/c} may drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items available from his {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_BossLair_14.name: Dog of Astaroth
Warplans_BossLair_14.desc:
When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the {c_important}Amalgam of Rage{/c} has a chance to appear and attack you.

Killing the {c_important}Amalgam of Rage{/c} in Nightmare Dungeons can drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items associated with {c_important}Astaroth{/c}

Warplans_BossLair_13.name: Out of the Cold
Warplans_BossLair_13.desc:
When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the {c_important}Beast in Ice{/c} has a chance to appear and attack you.

When this occurs, killing the Nightmare Dungeon Boss has a chance to drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items from the {c_important}Beast in Ice's{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_BossLair_12.name: Embers of Anguish
Warplans_BossLair_12.desc:
When exploring the Pit, {c_important}Embers of Anguish{/c} can appear. Activating one drops {u}{b}{c_important}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u}, and causes {c_important}Andariel{/c} to ambush you at the end of the Pit.

Killing {c_important}Andariel{/c} in the Pit can now drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items from her {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_BossLair_11.name: Children of Zir
Warplans_BossLair_11.desc:
When exploring the Pit, {c_important}Lord Zir's{/c} {c_important}Bloodseekers{/c} can now ambush you.

Killing them in the Pit can now drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items from his {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_BossLair_10.name: Duriel's Invasion
Warplans_BossLair_10.desc:
When summoning the {c_important}Blood Maiden{/c} in Helltides, there is a chance {c_important}Duriel{/c} can be summoned instead.

Killing {c_important}Duriel{/c} in Helltides can now drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items from his {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_BossLair_9.name: Grigoire's Gambit
Warplans_BossLair_9.desc:
After opening a {c_important}Tortured Gift{/c} in Helltides, there is a chance {c_important}Grigoire's{/c} knights will ambush you.

When killed in Helltide, they may drop {c_Unique}Unique{/c} Items available from his {b}{c_important}{u}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Undercity_0.name: Endless Swarm
Warplans_Undercity_0.desc:
{c_important}Invasion Portals{/c} now appear in the {c_important}Undercity{/c}.

The enemies that emerge grant {u}{b}{c_important}Attunement{/c}{/b}{/u} when slain.

Warplans_Undercity_1.name: Unfortunate Souls
Warplans_Undercity_1.desc:
{c_important}Invasion Portals{/c} can now summon {c_important}Wisps{/c} that attach to you and vanish if you die.

Each {c_important}Wisp{/c} you save will reward you with {c_legendary}Forgotten Souls{/c} and other {c_important}Crafting Materials{/c} at the end of the run.

Warplans_Undercity_2.name: Gutter Filth
Warplans_Undercity_2.desc:
When you activate any {c_important}Beacon{/c} within the Undercity, there is a small chance to summon a {u}{b}{c_important}Portal Prankster{/c}{/b}{/u}.

{c_important}Invasion Portals{/c} will sometimes summon {c_important}Rats{/c} of varying amounts.

Warplans_Undercity_3.name: Trials and Tributes
Warplans_Undercity_3.desc:
For each {u}{b}{c_important}Portal Prankster{/c}{/b}{/u} you slay within the {c_important}Undercity{/c}, a {c_important}Tribute Chest{/c} appears after killing the {c_important}District Boss{/c}.

{c_important}Tribute Chests{/c} are unlocked by offering a {c_important}{u}{b}Tribute{/b}{/u}{/c}.

Warplans_Undercity_4.name: Last Gasp
Warplans_Undercity_4.desc: {c_important}Time{/c} collected from slain enemies with {c_number}5{/c} seconds or less remaining in the {c_important}Undercity{/c} doubles the {c_important}Time{/c} earned.

Warplans_Undercity_5.name: Bauble Day
Warplans_Undercity_5.desc:
If you slay a {u}{b}{c_important}Portal Prankster{/c}{/b}{/u} within the {c_important}Undercity{/c}, the {c_important}Cabochon Merchant{/c} will appear after killing the {c_important}District Boss{/c}.

The {c_important}Cabochon Merchant{/c} will sell you {c_rune}Runes{/c} and {c_important}Gems{/c} for {c_important}Gold{/c}.

Warplans_Undercity_6.name: Idols of War
Warplans_Undercity_6.desc: {c_legendary}Greater Tributes of Armament{/c} more frequently drop throughout Sanctuary and have an additional {c_important}Bargain{/c} choices.

Warplans_Undercity_7.name: Finely Tuned
Warplans_Undercity_7.desc:
Gain additional {c_important}Tuning Prisms{/c} when completing the {c_important}Undercity{/c} at maximum {c_important}{u}{b}Attunement{/b}{/u}{/c}.

All enemies within the {c_important}Undercity{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Undercity_8.name: Jade Epiphany
Warplans_Undercity_8.desc:
When you gain an {u}{b}{c_important}Attunement{/c}{/b}{/u} level in the {c_important}Undercity{/c}, {c_important}Experience Orbs{/c} appear around you.

All enemies within the {c_important}Undercity{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Undercity_9.name: Pathfinder
Warplans_Undercity_9.desc:
When you reach maximum {u}{b}{c_important}Attunement{/c}{/b}{/u}, a portal to the final floor of the {c_important}Undercity{/c} appears.

All enemies within the {c_important}Undercity{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Undercity_10.name: Initiative
Warplans_Undercity_10.desc:
When you find the {c_important}District Boss{/c} you gain the {c_important}Initiative{/c} buff, which has a duration equal to your remaining {c_important}Time{/c}. {c_important}Initiative{/c} is lost upon death.

If you slay the {c_important}District Boss{/c} with {c_important}Initiative{/c} active, you receive {c_important}{u}{b}Tribute{/b}{/u}{/c} rewards as if your {c_important}{u}{b}Attunement{/b}{/u}{/c} was {c_number}2{/c} higher (max {c_number}6{/c}).

All enemies within the {c_important}Undercity{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Pit_0.name: Damned Thieves
Warplans_Pit_0.desc:
{c_important}Orb Thieves{/c} have a chance to spawn in {c_important}The Pit{/c}.

{c_important}Orb Thieves{/c} drop an immense amount of {u}{b}{c_important}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u} when killed, but leave a trail of Traps in their wake.

Warplans_Pit_1.name: Choron's Haste
Warplans_Pit_1.desc:
{c_important}The Pit{/c} gains the {c_important}Haste Mastery{/c} objective.

When you kill the {u}{b}{c_important}Guardian{/c}{/b}{/u} gain {c_number}+1{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Glyph Upgrade Chance{/c}{/b}{/u} for every {c_number}5{/c} minutes left on the {c_important}Timer{/c}.

Warplans_Pit_2.name: Choron's Shortcut
Warplans_Pit_2.desc:
{c_important}Choron's Portal{/c} randomly appears in {c_important}The Pit{/c}.

When used, it will send you to the entrance to the next {c_important}Pit Floor{/c}, or become {c_important}Unstable{/c} and summon either an {c_important}Elite{/c} or a {c_important}Shrine{/c}.

Warplans_Pit_3.name: Choron's Blessing
Warplans_Pit_3.desc: Gain {c_number}+1{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Glyph Upgrade Chance{/c}{/b}{/u} for completing {c_important}The Pit{/c}.

Warplans_Pit_4.name: Pit Butcher
Warplans_Pit_4.desc:
The {c_important}Butcher{/c} has a chance to appear anywhere in {c_important}The Pit{/c}.

The {c_important}Butcher{/c} is a {u}{b}{c_important}Guardian{/c}{/b}{/u} and killing him will complete the run.

However, you fail the run if he kills any player.

Warplans_Pit_5.name: Heart of Stone
Warplans_Pit_5.desc:
Begin {c_important}The Pit{/c} carrying the {c_important}Heart of Stone{/c}, a fragile relic that is dropped after taking sustained damage and breaks after dropping {c_number}10{/c} times.

While you carry it, enemies can drop bonus {u}{b}{c_important}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u}.

After slaying the {c_important}Guardian{/c}, {c_important}Choron's Pedestal{/c} appears. Deposit the {c_important}Heart of Stone{/c} within to gain {c_number}+1{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Glyph Upgrade Chance{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Pit_6.name: Choron's Wager
Warplans_Pit_6.desc:
{c_important}Choron's Wager{/c} can appear in {c_important}The Pit{/c}. 

Activate it with {u}{b}{c_important}Artificer's Stones{/c}{/b}{/u} to acquire a challenge, which grants a large amount of {u}{b}{c_important}Artificer's Stones{/c}{/b}{/u} when completed.

Warplans_Pit_8.name: Cursed Rituals
Warplans_Pit_8.desc:
Different {c_important}Ritual Sites{/c} now spawn in the Pit, and special Materials can spawn in different environments:

{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_important}Choron's Blood{/c} appears in foliage dense regions
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_important}Choron's Sweat{/c} appears in stony locations
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_important}Choron's Tears{/c} appears in mystical places

Sacrificing these Materials at {c_important}Ritual Sites{/c} may grant Gold, Materials, Items, and more.

Warplans_Pit_9.name: Cursed Merchant
Warplans_Pit_9.desc:
The {c_important}Cursed Merchant{/c} has a chance to appear when completing the Pit.

The {c_important}Cursed Merchant{/c} will sell Equipment for {u}{b}{c_important}Artificers Stones{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Warplans_Pit_10.name: Cursed Offerings
Warplans_Pit_10.desc:
{c_important}Cursed Machines{/c} have a chance to appear while exploring the Pit.

{c_important}Cursed Machines{/c} cost {u}{b}{c_important}Artificers Stones{/c}{/b}{/u} to activate. Activating one will grant you valuable materials and attract vicious enemies.

The more {c_important}Cursed Machines{/c} you find in a single Pit run, the more lucrative the rewards will become.

Warplans_Pit_12.name: Choron's Favor
Warplans_Pit_12.desc: Special events and encounters become more common in higher {u}{b}{c_important}Difficulty Tiers{/c}{/b}{/u} of {c_important}The Pit{/c}.

Warplans_Pit_13.name: Choron's Soul
Warplans_Pit_13.desc:
{c_important}Choron's Soul{/c} now spawns with the {c_important}Awakened Glyphstone{/c}.

{c_important}Choron's Soul{/c} will drop {c_number}1{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Progress Orb{/c}{/b}{/u} per {u}{b}{c_important}Glyph Upgrade Chance{/c}{/b}{/u} offered.

All {u}{b}{c_important}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u} in {c_important}The Pit{/c} now grant {c_important}Experience{/c}.

Warplans_Pit_14.name: Choron's Flesh
Warplans_Pit_14.desc:
{c_important}Choron's Flesh{/c} now spawns with the {c_important}Awakened Glyphstone{/c}.

{c_important}Choron's Flesh{/c} will allow you to get valuable Equipment by consuming one of your {u}{b}{c_important}Glyph Upgrade Chances{/c}{/b}{/u}.

Barbarian_IronMaelstrom_Attack_2.name: Iron Maelstrom: Slashing
Barbarian_IronMaelstrom_Attack_2.desc: Attach a chain to your Slashing weapon and swipe it in front of you, dealing {c_number}[{payload:damage}|2?|]{/c} and {c_number}[{dot:bleed}|2?|]{/c} over 5 seconds.

Barbarian_IronMaelstrom_Attack_3.name: Iron Maelstrom: Dual Wield
Barbarian_IronMaelstrom_Attack_3.desc: Attach a chain to your Dual Wield weapons and swing them around you, dealing {c_number}[{payload:damage}|2?|]{/c} per hit.

buffs.name: Terramote
buffs.desc: Consumed by Landslide to deal a guaranteed Critical Strike for 40% increased damage.

buffs.name: Dark Shroud
buffs.desc: The shadows surround you and grant benefits.

Sorcerer_CracklingEnergy_Passive.name: Crackling Energy
Sorcerer_CracklingEnergy_Passive.desc: Crackling Energy periodically damages nearby enemies when picked up.

Sorcerer_Enchantment_Teleport_Active.name: Teleport - Evade Version
Sorcerer_Enchantment_Teleport_Active.desc: {c_red}Teleport description here - since this is a skill that replaces your Evade button, you should never see this.{/c}

buffs.name: Quaking Hammer
buffs.desc: {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} is dealing increased damage.

Necromancer_RaiseSkeleton.name: Raise Skeleton
Necromancer_RaiseSkeleton.desc:
Summon a Skeleton from a Corpse to fight for you.

If all of your Skeletons have been Summoned, {c_important}Raise Skeleton{/c} briefly Summons a Skeletal Priest to empower your {c_important}Minions{/c} for {c_number}0{/c} seconds instead, increasing their damage by {c_number}[0.15*Table(37,SkillRank(439912))*100|%x|]{/c} and healing them for {c_number}100%{/c} of their Maximum Life.

Rogue_Grenades.name: Stun Grenade
Rogue_Grenades.desc: Drop {c_number}4{/c} Grenades each dealing {c_number}[{payload:grenade}|2?|]{/c} Physical damage.

Rogue_WeaponAttack.name: Attack
Rogue_WeaponAttack.desc: Melee attack an enemy, dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Druid_WeaponAttack.name: Attack
Druid_WeaponAttack.desc: Melee attack an enemy, dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Barbarian_WeaponAttack.name: Attack
Barbarian_WeaponAttack.desc: Melee attack an enemy, dealing {c_number}[{payload:impact}|2?|]{/c} damage.

buffs.name: {c_important}Bash{/c} Two-Hand Criticals
buffs.desc: At 4, your next {c_important}Core{/c} or {c_important}Weapon Mastery{/c} Skill will {c_important}Overpower{/c}.

buffs.name: Stealth
buffs.desc: Cannot be targeted by enemies, removed by attacking or taking damage.

Spiritborn_Plains_Mobility1.name: (PH) Pounce
Spiritborn_Plains_Mobility1.desc:
(PH) {c_label}Cooldown: {/c}{c_resource}[{cooldown time}|2?|]{/c} seconds
Take on the mantle of a pouncing jaguar as you vault to a target location and become {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds. 

Recast within {c_number}[Mod(2686060809)?10:5|2?|]{/c} seconds to {c_important}Pounce{/c} again.

Spiritborn_Plains_Defense.name: (PH) Counterattack

Spiritborn_Soil_Control1.name: (PH) Voracious Maw

Spiritborn_Soil_Defense.name: (PH) Leech Harvest

Spiritborn_Soil_Control2.name: (PH) Dreadful Swarm

buffs.name: (PH) Resolve
buffs.desc:
(PH) {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}
The Gorilla provides retribution and resilience.

Spiritborn_Sky_Offense2_Recast.name: (PH) Bird Swarm
Spiritborn_Sky_Offense2_Recast.desc:
(PH) {c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}[{cooldown time}|2?|]{/c_resource} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{combat effect chance}|2?|]%{/c}
{/if}Fire a slow swarm of birds that burst on impact, dealing {c_number}[{payload:nova}|2?|]{/c} damage and splitting into a piercing spiral of birds that each deal {c_number}[{payload:impact}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Recast to burst early, the Cooldown is reduced the closer the swarm is to you upon Recast, up to {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

Spiritborn_WeaponAttack.name: Attack
Spiritborn_WeaponAttack.desc: Attack enemies in front of you, dealing {c_number}[{payload:damage}|2?|]{/c} damage.

Spiritborn_Talent_Ultimate_1.name: (PH) Sustained Decay
Spiritborn_Talent_Ultimate_1.desc: (PH) While {c_important}Invoke{/c} is active, you gain {c_number}[0.3333333333333333*sLevel*100|+%|]{/c} increased Poisoning Duration and {c_number}[0.3333333333333333*sLevel*100|+%|]{/c} increased Crowd Control Duration.

Rogue_PartingGift_Recast.name: Parting Gift
Rogue_PartingGift_Recast.desc: When activated, set up a Recall Zone at your selected location. Activating Parting Gift a second time drops Grenades at your current location, then teleports you to the Recall Zone. The grenades explode half a second later, dealing damage to close enemies.

buffs.name: Ferocity
buffs.desc:
{c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}
Attack Speed increased by [0.05*(1+Bonus_Percent_Per_Power(1681345))*100|%|] per stack. Stacks up to [4+MaxStacks(1681345)|2?|] times.

buffs.name: Resolve
buffs.desc:

The Seneschal Construct materializes a protective {c_important}Barrier{/c} on the player for {c_number}[(0.4+0.01*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702687))*(1+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1722185,0))*100|1|]%{/c} of their Maximum Life. Lasts for {c_number}[5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds.

S03_Tuning_GainResource.name: Resource Support
S03_Tuning_GainResource.desc: Player gains {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1702844)||]{/c} Primary Resource when the supporting Skill first deals damage.
S03_Tuning_GainResource.modifier: Gain {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1702844)||]{/c} Primary Resource when damage is first dealt.

S03_Tuning_MeleeTeleport.name: Initiative Support
S03_Tuning_MeleeTeleport.desc: The supported Skill will cause the Seneschal Construct to teleport to the target if out of range.{if:Max(10-GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702864),0)>0} Can only occur once every {c_number}[Max(10-GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702864),0)|2?|]{/c} seconds.{/if}

S03_Tuning_Multishot.name: Multishot Support
S03_Tuning_Multishot.desc:
Supported {c_important}Projectile{/c} skills launch {c_number}[1+Floor((GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702882)-1)/3)|2?|]{/c} additional projectiles. {if:1-(1+Floor((GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702882)-1)/3)-(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702882)-1)/3)>0}

{c_number}[(1-(1+Floor((GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702882)-1)/3)-(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702882)-1)/3))*100||]%{/c} chance to instead launch {c_number}[1+Floor((GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1702882)-1)/3)+1||]{/c} additional projectiles.{/if}

S03_Tuning_PierceProjectile.name: Piercing Support
S03_Tuning_PierceProjectile.desc: The supported {c_important}Projectile{/c} Skill will pierce up to {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1703675)||]{/c} enemies.

S03_Tuning_PullEnemies.name: Gripping Support
S03_Tuning_PullEnemies.desc: Damage and effects done by the supporting Skill to Distant enemies pulls them towards the Seneschal Construct. Can only occur once every {c_number}[20-GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1703703)|2?|]{/c} seconds per enemy.
S03_Tuning_PullEnemies.modifier: Enemies hit are pulled in every {c_number}[20-GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1703703)|2?|]{/c} seconds.

S03_Tuning_RegisterDamage.name: Registered Damage Support
S03_Tuning_RegisterDamage.desc: Any damage caused from the supported Skill is registered. The registered damage explodes at {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1703711)*100||]%{/c} effectiveness when the target dies as Fire damage.
S03_Tuning_RegisterDamage.modifier: Damage registered at {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1703711)*100||]%{/c} effectiveness. Explodes on target death.

S03_Tuning_SeekProjectile.name: Seeking Support
S03_Tuning_SeekProjectile.desc: The supported {c_important}Projectile{/c} Skill will auto-seek enemies for {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1703735)|1|]{/c} seconds.

S03_Tuning_TauntEnemies.name: Mockery Support
S03_Tuning_TauntEnemies.desc: Damage done by the supporting Skill Taunts enemies hit for {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1703794)+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds. This can only occur once every {c_number}15{/c} seconds per enemy. Does not work on bosses.

S03_Tuning_AoESize.name: Voluminous Support
S03_Tuning_AoESize.desc: The supported skill's effect size is increased by {c_number}[(0.2+0.03*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1707297))*100||]%{/c}.

S03_Tuning_CritDamage.name: Devastation Support
S03_Tuning_CritDamage.desc: Supported Skill gains a {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1709777)*100|%x|]{/c} Critical Strike Damage bonus.

S03_Tuning_DoT_Shadow.name: Dusk Support
S03_Tuning_DoT_Shadow.desc: {c_number}[0.6*((5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0))/5)*100||]%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage dealt is applied as Shadow damage over {c_number}[5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds. Afflicted enemies who attack have a {c_number}[(0.1+0.005*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1710507))*100|1|]%{/c} chance for the their attacks to be interrupted. Does not interrupt Bosses.
S03_Tuning_DoT_Shadow.modifier: {c_number}60%{/c} of the damage is applied as Shadow damage.

S03_Tuning_DoT_Poison.name: Poison Support
S03_Tuning_DoT_Poison.desc: {c_number}[0.6*((5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0))/5)*100||]%{/c} of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Poison damage over {c_number}[5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds. This poison has a {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1713935)*100||]%{/c} chance each second to spread all Poison damage to an additional enemy.
S03_Tuning_DoT_Poison.modifier: {c_number}60%{/c} of the damage is applied as Poison damage.

S03_Tuning_DoT_Lightning.name: Electrocution Support
S03_Tuning_DoT_Lightning.desc: {c_number}[0.6*((5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0))/5)*100||]%{/c} of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Lightning damage over {c_number}[5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds and has a {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1715803)*100||]%{/c} chance to Stun enemies for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.
S03_Tuning_DoT_Lightning.modifier: {c_number}60%{/c} of the damage is applied as Lightning damage.

S03_Tuning_DoT_Physical.name: Bleeding Support
S03_Tuning_DoT_Physical.desc: {c_number}[0.6*((5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0))/5)*100||]%{/c} of the supported skill's damage dealt is applied as Bleeding damage over {c_number}[5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds. Enemies take {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1715838)*100|%x|]{/c} bonus Bleeding damage from all sources while moving.
S03_Tuning_DoT_Physical.modifier: {c_number}60%{/c} of the damage is applied as Bleeding damage.

S03_Tuning_DoT_Cold.name: Frigid Support
S03_Tuning_DoT_Cold.desc: {c_number}[0.6*((5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0))/5)*100||]%{/c} of the supported Skill's damage dealt is applied as Cold damage over {c_number}[5+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds and applies {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1715954)||]%{/c} Chill.
S03_Tuning_DoT_Cold.modifier: {c_number}60%{/c} of the damage is applied as Cold damage.

S03_Tuning_CritChance.name: Efficiency Support
S03_Tuning_CritChance.desc: When the supporting skill deals damage, you gain a {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1716190)*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance to the same targets hit for {c_number}[3+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds.
S03_Tuning_CritChance.modifier: Enemies hit with this skill have an {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1716190)*100|%+|]{/c} additional chance to be Critically Hit for {c_number}[3+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds.

S03_Tuning_MoreSpread.name: Arcing Support
S03_Tuning_MoreSpread.desc: The supported {c_important}Arcing{/c} Skill can hit {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1716823)||]{/c} additional {if:Collectible_Power_Value_1(1716823)>1}enemies{else}enemy{/if}.
S03_Tuning_MoreSpread.modifier: Maximum number of enemies hit increased by {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1716823)||]{/c}.

S03_Tuning_SlowEnemies.name: Slowing Support
S03_Tuning_SlowEnemies.desc: Damage from the supported Skill Slows enemy movement speed for {c_number}[2+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)||]{/c} seconds. The closer the enemy is to the Seneschal Construct, the greater the Slow amount. From {c_number}30%{/c} up to a maximum of {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1716952)||]%{/c} Slow to Close enemies.

S03_Tuning_Breaking.name: Breaking Support
S03_Tuning_Breaking.desc: Damage from the supported Skill instantly destroys enemy Barrier effects. In addition, there is a {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1717004)||]%{/c} chance to make enemies {c_important}Vulnerable{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.
S03_Tuning_Breaking.modifier: Destroys enemy barrier effects and has a{c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1717004)||]%{/c} chance to make enemies {c_important}Vulnerable{/c}.

S03_Tuning_Duration.name: Duration Support
S03_Tuning_Duration.desc: Supported {c_important}Duration{/c} Skills have their durations increased by {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1718071)|1|]{/c} seconds.

S03_Tuning_DamageReduction.name: Safeguard Support
S03_Tuning_DamageReduction.desc: When used, the supported Skill grants {c_number}[0.015*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1718407)*100|1%x|]{/c} Damage Reduction to you for {c_number}[3+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds.

S03_Tuning_CDR.name: Tactical Support
S03_Tuning_CDR.desc: Decrease the cooldown of the supported Skill by {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1720866)*100|%x|]{/c}.

S03_Tuning_AttackSpeed.name: Swift Support
S03_Tuning_AttackSpeed.desc: The supported Skill gains a {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1(1722162)*100|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed bonus.

S03_Tuning_Genesis.name: Genesis
S03_Tuning_Genesis.source: Acquired by defeating the Echo of Malphas
S03_Tuning_Genesis.desc: Increase the effectiveness of the supported Skill by {c_number}[Collectible_Power_Value_1*100||]%{/c}.

S03_Tuning_CoreSkills.name: Evernight
S03_Tuning_CoreSkills.source: Acquired by defeating the Echo of Malphas
S03_Tuning_CoreSkills.desc: The supported Skill grants you {c_number}+4{/c} to all Skills when used for {c_number}[2+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds.
S03_Tuning_CoreSkills.modifier: Grants you {c_number}+4{/c} to all Skills for {c_number}[2+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(1718071,0)|1|]{/c} seconds.

S03_Tuning_Fortify.name: Fortify Support
S03_Tuning_Fortify.desc: When the Seneschal Construct uses the supported Skill, you gain {c_number}[Max(1,TableHealthToFlat(0.01*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(1723044)*1.005,gLevel))|2?|]{/c} {c_important}Fortify{/c}. Skills with slower attack speeds or skills with cooldowns will increase the amount of {c_important}Fortify{/c} granted.

S07_Witch_Bonus_Rare_001.name: Breath of the Coven
S07_Witch_Bonus_Rare_001.source: Unlocked by finding a Forgotten Altar in one of the many dungeons around Sanctuary.
S07_Witch_Bonus_Rare_001.desc:
Dealing damage or applying Crowd Control with an {c_important}Eldritch{/c}, {c_important}Psyche{/c}, or {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} Effect increases your Attack Speed by {c_random}[(0.05+0.005*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2101379))*100|1+%|]{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, stacking once per category up to {c_random}[(0.05+0.005*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2101379))*100*3|1+%|]{/c}.{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2101379)>7} 

While all three bonuses are active, you gain {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Lucky Hit Chance.{/if}

unlocks.desc: While all three bonuses are active, you gain {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Lucky Hit Chance.

S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_002.name: Hex of Flames
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_002.source: Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_002.desc:
{c_label}Lucky Hit: {/c}Up to a {c_random}[20*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(2131520,0))+(60*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(2131520,0))-20*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(2131520,0)))/20*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2104201)|2?|]%{/c} chance to inflict {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c}. 

When you damage an enemy afflicted with {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c}, you deal {c_number}[0.6*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} additional Fire damage to them. {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2104201)>6}If activated by a Critical Strike, the Fire damage explodes in an area instead.{/if}

unlocks.desc: If you Critically Strike an enemy afflicted with {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c}, the Fire damage explodes in an area instead.

S07_Witch_Eldritch_Rare_002.name: Shaken Soul
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Rare_002.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier V and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Rare_002.desc:
Your {c_important}Eldritch{/c} Effects apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[3*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)+0.3*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2104363)|1|]{/c} seconds. {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2104363)>9} 

Your {c_important}Psyche{/c} and {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} damage apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for half of this duration ({c_random}[(3*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)+0.3*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2104363))/2|1|]{/c} seconds).{/if}

unlocks.desc: Your {c_important}Psyche{/c} and {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} damage also apply {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, for half the normal duration.

S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_001.name: Twilight Warding
S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_001.source: Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_001.desc: Every {c_random}[Round(14.5*(1-Socketable_Potency_Psyche))-0.5*(1-Socketable_Potency_Psyche)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2104374)|1|]{/c} seconds, you gain a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} for {c_number}30%{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}5{/c} seconds. {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2104374)>11}While active, it reflects enemy projectiles.{/if}

unlocks.desc: The barrier now reflects enemy projectiles.

S07_Witch_Psyche_Rare_002.name: Hex of Shattering
S07_Witch_Psyche_Rare_002.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier V and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Psyche_Rare_002.desc:
Your {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Effects' damage inflicts {c_important}Hex of Shattering{/c}, causing enemies to deal {c_random}[(0.105*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(2131520,0))+(0.2*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(2131520,0))-0.105*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche+GetCollectibleAttributeValue(2131520,0)))/19*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2105390)-1))*100|1%|]{/c} reduced damage for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2105390)>7} 

When you {c_important}Hex{/c} a Headrotten, you deal guaranteed Critical Strikes to them for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{/if}

unlocks.desc: When you {c_important}Hex{/c} a Headrotten, you deal guaranteed Critical Strikes to them for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Rare_001.name: Decay Augmentation
S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Rare_001.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier V and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Rare_001.desc:
Your {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Powers deal an additional {c_random}[(0.2*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)+0.01*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2105834))*100|%|]{/c} of their damage over {c_number}5{/c} seconds. This damage is dealt as Bleeding, Burning, Poisoning, or Shadow Damage Over Time depending on your class.{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2105834)>9}

If your damage over time effects exceed {c_number}85%{/c} of a target's total Life, that target is executed.{/if}

unlocks.desc: If your damage over time effects exceed {c_number}85%{/c} of a target's total Life, that target is executed.

S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_003.name: Abyssal Resonance
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_003.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier III and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_003.desc:
After spending {c_number}250{/c} Primary Resource, you explode, dealing {c_random}[(4*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)+(11.6*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)-4*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch))/19*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2106975))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Shadow damage and gaining a stack of {c_important}Abyssal Resonance{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds.{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2106975)>9} The explosion Pulls In enemies while at {c_number}2{/c} stacks of Abyssal Resonance.{/if}

Each stack of {c_important}Abyssal Resonance{/c} increases its Size and damage by {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}, up to {c_number}60%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c}.

unlocks.desc: Every third explosion Pulls In enemies.

S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_003.name: Aura of Misfortune
S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_003.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier III and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_003.desc:
You inflict non-Boss enemies near you with {c_important}Aura of Misfortune{/c}{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2109444)>4}, Slowing them by {c_number}30%{/c}{/if}. When an affected monster would attack, they have a {c_random}[(0.1*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)+(0.3*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)-0.1*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche))/19*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2109444)-1))*100|%|]{/c} chance to stumble and do nothing instead.{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2109444)>4} 

You gain {c_number}15%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Movement Speed.{/if}

unlocks.desc: {c_important}Aura of Misfortune{/c} now increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}15%{/c} and Slows enemies by {c_number}30%{/c}.

S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_004.name: Aura of Lament
S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_004.source: Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Psyche_Magic_004.desc:
The first time you damage an enemy, you contaminate them with {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} for {c_random}[10*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)+(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118064)||]{/c} seconds. Enemies within are Slowed by {c_number}70%{/c} and each grant you {c_number}3{/c} Primary Resource each second. If its host dies, {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} transfers to a new one, retaining its duration.

You can only create an {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} once every {c_number}[10*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)+(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118064)>30?10*(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)+(1+Socketable_Potency_Psyche)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118064):30|2?|]{/c} seconds. Only {c_number}[GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118064)>14?2:1|2?|]{/c} may exist at a time.

unlocks.desc: You can now maintain {c_number}2{/c} {c_important}Auras of Lament{/c} at a time.

S07_Witch_Eldritch_Rare_001.name: Purging Touch
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Rare_001.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier V and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Rare_001.desc: Your {c_important}Eldritch{/c} Effects deal {c_random}[(0.2*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)+0.01*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118127))*100|1%|]{/c} increased damage to {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118127)>9}all enemies{else}Headrotten{/if}.

unlocks.desc: This damage bonus now extends to all monsters.

S07_Witch_Bonus_Unique_001.name: Piranhado
S07_Witch_Bonus_Unique_001.source: Unlocked by finding a Forgotten Altar in one of the many dungeons around Sanctuary.
S07_Witch_Bonus_Unique_001.desc:
When an enemy is afflicted by both a {c_important}Hex{/c} and an {c_important}Aura{/c} Effect, a {c_important}Piranhado{/c} is summoned pulling enemies towards it and dealing {c_number}[100*(1+Socketable_Potency_Unique)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Physical damage over {c_random}[10+GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118346)*2|1|]{/c} seconds.{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2118346)>4} Additionally, {c_important}Piranhado{/c} will seek nearby enemies.{/if}

You can only Summon one {c_important}Piranhado{/c} every {c_number}20{/c} seconds.

unlocks.desc: {c_important}Piranhado{/c} now seek enemies.

S07_Witch_Eldritch_Unique_001.name: Doom Orb
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Unique_001.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier VII and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Eldritch_Unique_001.desc:
An ominous orb of pure Eldritch energy circles you damaging any enemy it touches for {c_random}[(3.6+0.4*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2121649))*(1+Socketable_Potency_Unique)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Fire damage. {c_important}Doom Orb{/c} may launch itself at distant enemies before returning.{if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2121649)>4}

Kills or damage to Bosses empower the orb's damage by {c_number}8%{/c}. After {c_number}160%{/c}, the orb explodes dealing {c_random}[(3.6+0.4*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2121649))*(1+Socketable_Potency_Unique)*2*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Fire damage to nearby enemies before reforming {c_number}3{/c} seconds later.{/if}

unlocks.desc: Kills or damage to Bosses empower the orb's damage by {c_number}8%{/c}. After {c_number}160%{/c}, the orb explodes dealing {c_random}[(3.6+0.4*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2121649))*(1+Socketable_Potency_Unique)*2*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Fire damage to nearby enemies before reforming {c_number}3{/c} seconds later.

S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Unique_001.name: The Cycle
S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Unique_001.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier VII and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Unique_001.desc:
When you deal damage, you have a {c_number}15%{/c} chance to grow a flower that reacts when stepped on. 

{icon:bullet} When activated by an enemy, it deals {c_random}[(5*(1+Socketable_Potency_Unique)+0.5*(1+Socketable_Potency_Unique)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2123834))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Poisoning damage to {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2123834)>4}surrounding enemies{else}them{/if} over {c_number}5{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet} When activated by an ally, it Heals {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2123834)>4}surrounding allies{else}them{/if} for {c_random}[(0.05+0.01*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2123834))*100|1|]%{/c} of their Maximum Life. 

A flower can only activate once and can only grow on a specific enemy every {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

unlocks.desc: The flower now applies its effects in an area.

S07_Witch_Psyche_Unique_001.name: Vengeful Spirit Servant
S07_Witch_Psyche_Unique_001.source: Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier VII and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
S07_Witch_Psyche_Unique_001.desc:

When {c_important}Vengeful Spirit's{/c} Life is fully depleted, it rushes up to {c_number}8{/c} nearby enemies dealing {c_number}[7.5*(1+Socketable_Potency_Unique)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Shadow damage.{/if}

S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_004.name: Wave of Woe

S07_Witch_Eldritch_Magic_004.desc:
Your Skills launch {c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} when they deal damage, dealing an additional {c_random}[(0.3*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)+0.03*(1+Socketable_Potency_Eldritch)*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2126145)-1))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Shadow damage then bouncing {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2126145)>4}at least {c_number}5{/c} times {/if}between Nearby monsters of the same Family. {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2126145)>4}These bounces may target the same enemy multiple times.

Every time it bounces, {c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} deals {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage.{/if}

unlocks.desc: {c_important}Wave of Woe{/c} now always bounces at least {c_number}5{/c} times, dealing {c_number}25%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage each time.

S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Magic_001.name: Poison Frog Servant

You Summon a {c_important}Poison Frog{/c} to {if:GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2128496)>4}accompany you. Its tongue Pulls In enemies, Taunts them for {c_number}1{/c} second, and deals {c_random}[(4*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)+0.9*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2128496))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{else}repeatedly attack enemies, dealing {c_random}[(4*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)+0.9*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2128496))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{/if}

When it dies, the frog explodes violently for {c_random}[(10*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)+1.2*(1+Socketable_Potency_Growth)*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2128496))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)|2?|]{/c} Poison damage that is guaranteed to Critically Strike.

S07_Witch_GrowthRot_Magic_002.name: Aura of Siphoning
