{if:S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Celestial Surge{/c_important} stars Fear unaffected enemies. After the Fear ends, there is a {c_number}50%{/c} chance for another star to fall.{/if}{if:S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Disintegrate{/c_important} Fears unaffected enemies and deals {c_number}100%{c_lightgray}\[x\]{/c}{/c} increased damage to them while they are Feared.{/if}{if:S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Propulsion{/c_important} removes enemy {c_important}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} effects to Fear them. While Feared, those enemies periodically form {c_important}Lesser Mana Blasts{/c_important}.{/if}{if:S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0}Every {c_number}9th{/c} wave from your {c_important}Astral Pillar{/c_important} Fears. Enemies close to it are Taunted and have their Fear removed.{/if}{if:S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Anomalies{/c_important} Fear and apply an {c_number}90%{/c} Slow to unaffected enemies they come into contact with.{/if}{if:(S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0)<1?1:0}{c_red}Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} is not activated.{/if}

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_03_FrigidHeart.name: Frigid Heart
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_03_FrigidHeart.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Legendary Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_03_FrigidHeart.desc:
Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} effect that lasts {c_random}[3+0.4*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2264509)|1|]{/c} seconds:

{if:S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0}The {c_important}Oracular Rune{/c_important} from {c_important}Celestial Surge{/c_important} explodes and {c_important}{u}Freezes{/u}{/c} enemies. A second one forms after the star strikes end.{/if}{if:S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0}Your {c_important}Disintegrate{/c_important} beams {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} all affected enemies for {c_random}[3+0.4*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2264509)|1|]{/c} seconds after you {c_important}Evade{/c} and also grant {c_number}15%{/c} Dodge Chance for double that duration.{/if}{if:S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Propulsion{/c_important} will {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} any enemies that collide with other enemies twice.{/if}{if:S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Astral Pillar{/c_important} {c_important}{u}Freezes{/u}{/c} surrounding enemies when removed. Each successful {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} increases your Lucky Hit Chance by {c_number}5%{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}25%{/c}.{/if}{if:S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Anomalies{/c_important} have a {c_number}30%{/c} chance to preserve themselves instead of imploding and {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} surrounding enemies.{/if}{if:(S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0)<1?1:0}{c_red}Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} is not activated.{/if}

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_04_PressurizedS.name: Pressurized Steam
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_04_PressurizedS.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Legendary Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_04_PressurizedS.desc:
Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized Stun effect that lasts {c_random}[1+0.4*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2271220)|1|]{/c} seconds:

{if:S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Celestial Surge{/c_important} stars have a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to Stun and are guaranteed to Critically Strike Stunned enemies.{/if}{if:S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0}After being invoked, {c_important}Disintegrate{/c_important} Stuns each enemy it damages one time. This Stun applies {c_number}100%{/c} more Stagger to Bosses.{/if}{if:S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0}Enemies slammed into terrain by {c_important}Propulsion{/c_important} are Stunned and have a chance to miss their next {c_number}2{/c} attacks.{/if}{if:S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Astral Pillar{/c_important} waves have a {c_number}30%{/c} chance to Stun and are guaranteed to {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} Stunned enemies.{/if}{if:S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0}The particles from your {c_important}Anomalies{/c_important} deal their damage instantly and have a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to Stun.{/if}{if:(S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0)<1?1:0}{c_red}Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} is not activated.{/if}

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_05_BloodyCharm.name: Bloody Charm
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_05_BloodyCharm.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Legendary Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_05_BloodyCharm.desc:
Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} gains a specialized {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} effect for non-Boss enemies with {c_random}[(0.1+0.02*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2271798))*100|%|]{/c} or less Life:

{if:S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0}The {c_important}Oracular Rune{/c} from {c_important}Celestial Surge{/c} {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies. Successful {c_important}{u}Executions{/u}{/c} reduce your Cooldowns by {c_number}2{/c} seconds.{/if}{if:S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0}The {c_important}Disintegrate{/c} beam {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies with {c_random}[(0.1+0.02*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2271798))*100|%|]{/c} or less Life. This threshold is doubled for non-Elite enemies.{/if}{if:S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0}The {c_important}Mana Blast{/c} from {c_important}Propulsion{/c} {c_important}{u}Executes{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies. Successful {c_important}{u}Executions{/u}{/c} grant {c_random}70%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{/if}{if:S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Astral Pillar{/c} will launch additional waves towards {c_important}{u}Executable{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies to {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} them.{/if}{if:S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0}{c_important}Cosmic Anomaly{/c} will {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} non-Boss enemies with its implosion. Successful {c_important}{u}Executions{/u}{/c} increase your Attack Speed by {c_number}20%{/c} for {c_number}8{/c} seconds.{/if}{if:(S9_CelestialSurge_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Disintegrate_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_Propulsion_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_AstralPillar_Equipped>0?1:0)+(S9_CosmicAnomaly_Equipped>0?1:0)<1?1:0}{c_red}Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} is not activated.{/if}

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_06_GleamingCond.name: Gleaming Conduit
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_06_GleamingCond.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Rare Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_06_GleamingCond.desc: The effect size of your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} is increased by {c_random}[(0.1+0.08*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2277667))*100|%|]{/c}.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_07_FracturedCor.name: Fractured Core
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_07_FracturedCor.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Rare Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_07_FracturedCor.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} deactivates monster {c_important}Damage Resistance Aura{/c} effects for {c_random}[5.5+0.5*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2278076)|1|]{/c} seconds, but you take {c_number}15%{/c} more stacking damage for the same duration.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_08_SappingCrux.name: Sapping Crux
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_08_SappingCrux.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Rare Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_09_PotentAlloy.name: Potent Alloy
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_09_PotentAlloy.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Rare Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_09_PotentAlloy.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} destroys enemy {c_important}{u}Barriers{/u}{/c} and Knocks them Down for {c_random}[1+0.8*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2289879)|1|]{/c} seconds after the removal.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_10_SiphoningGiz.name: Sharpening Gizmo
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_10_SiphoningGiz.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms after acquiring "Rare Arcana" from Horadric Knowledge.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_10_SiphoningGiz.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damage from your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} has up to a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to deal {c_random}[{payload:physical_burst_tooltip}|2?|]{/c} Physical damage. Your {c_important}Catalyst's{/c} Lucky Hit Chance is doubled.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_11_TendrilousBu.name: Tendrilous Bundle
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_11_TendrilousBu.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_11_TendrilousBu.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damage from your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} has up to a {c_random}[35+5*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2291007)|%|]{/c} chance to Immobilize for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_12_TranquilSton.name: Tranquil Stone
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_12_TranquilSton.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_13_ShiftingPowd.name: Shifting Powder
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_13_ShiftingPowd.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_13_ShiftingPowd.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_random}[(0.3+0.08*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2296956))*100|%+|]{/c} during its effect and for {c_number}5{/c} more seconds after it ends.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_14_LuminousGem.name: Luminous Gem
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_14_LuminousGem.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_14_LuminousGem.desc: Your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} will {c_important}{u}Daze{/u}{/c} enemies it damages for {c_random}[1.5+0.5*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2297658)|1|]{/c} seconds.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_15_MurkyEssence.name: Murky Essence
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_15_MurkyEssence.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_16_Invigorating.name: Invigorating Helix
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_16_Invigorating.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_16_Invigorating.desc: Once per enemy every {c_number}5{/c} seconds, damage from your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} will {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} and Heal you for {c_random}[(0.05+0.01*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2299207))*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_17_BottledWind.name: Bottled Wind
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_17_BottledWind.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_17_BottledWind.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} equal to {c_random}[(0.3+0.04*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2300065))*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for {c_number}4{/c} seconds. After it dissipates, its essence is bottled back up.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_18_JaggedBrambl.name: Jagged Bramble
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_18_JaggedBrambl.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_18_JaggedBrambl.desc: {c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damage from your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} has up to a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to deal {c_random}[(1.5+0.3*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2301263))*100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns damage.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_19_ReactiveOoze.name: Reactive Ooze
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_19_ReactiveOoze.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_19_ReactiveOoze.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants {c_random}[(0.05+0.03*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2302493))*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Resource Generation per second for the next {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_20_VolatileCrys.name: Volatile Crystal
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_20_VolatileCrys.source: Has a chance to drop from Horadric Strongrooms.
S09_HoradricPower_Arcana_20_VolatileCrys.desc: Invoking your {c_important}Catalyst{/c} grants {c_random}[(0.1+0.02*GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2304170))*100|%|]{/c} Resistance and Maximum Resistance to the Element of your {c_important}Infusion{/c} for {c_number}10{/c} seconds.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Magic_001.name: Invigorating Attacks
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Magic_001.desc: Every {c_number}5{/c} seconds, your next {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill generates an additional {c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353707)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353707)/10)*0.05)*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Primary Resource when Cast, but your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills deal {c_number}30%{/c} reduced damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Magic_002.name: Accelerating Chaos
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Magic_002.desc:
{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damaging an enemy has up to a {c_number}10%{/c} chance to trigger a {c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c} on the enemy, dealing {c_random}[(2+0.2*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353857)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353857)/10)*0.2)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} damage.

Your {c_important}Chaotic Bursts{/c} that hit an enemy reduce a random active Cooldown by {c_number}0.5{/c} seconds.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Magic_003.name: Unstable Power
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Magic_003.desc: Chaotic magics erupt from your {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills, making them guaranteed to Critically Strike and {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[(0.5+0.05*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353860)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353860)/10)*0.05)*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage, but the power is unstable, giving them a {c_number}3{/c} second Cooldown.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Rare_001.name: Erupting Chaos
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Rare_001.desc:
{c_important}Chaotic Bursts{/c} randomly erupt around you in combat, dealing {c_random}[(2+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353867)-1)*0.2+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353867)/10)*0.2)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} damage of your highest damage type. 

Your {c_important}Chaotic Bursts{/c} additionally deal {c_number}100%{/c} of their initial damage over {c_number}4{/c} seconds.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Rare_002.name: Power Siphon
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Rare_002.desc: Your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[(0.5+0.05*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353870)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353870)/10)*0.05)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage, but also reduce your Maximum Current Resource by {c_number}20{/c} for {c_number}6{/c} seconds. This reduction stacks but does not refresh.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Rare_003.name: Alternating Alterations
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Rare_003.desc: Casting a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill empowers your next Non-{c_important}Channeled{/c} Cast of a different {c_important}Core{/c} Skill, refunding {c_number}50%{/c} of its Resource cost and increasing its damage by {c_random}[(0.4+0.02*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353874)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353874)/10)*0.02)*100|%x|]{/c}.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Legendary_001.name: Marred Guard
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Legendary_001.desc:
You can no longer be healed above {c_number}50%{/c} Life.

You gain {c_random}[(0.05+0.005*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353877)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353877)/10)*0.005)*100|%1|]{/c} Maximum Resistance to All Elements, {c_random}[(0.1+0.01*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353877)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353877)/10)*0.01)*100|%x|]{/c} Armor, and {c_random}[(0.5+0.05*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353877)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353877)/10)*0.05)*100|%|]{/c} increased {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} and {c_important}{u}Fortify{/u}{/c} Generation.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Legendary_002.name: Chaotic Cooldowns
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Legendary_002.desc:
Casting a Skill with a Cooldown will randomly set its Cooldown between {c_number}2{/c} seconds and its base Cooldown. You no longer benefit from Cooldown Reduction.

Using a Cooldown unleashes a {c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c}, dealing {c_random}[(3+0.2*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353881)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353881)/10)*0.2)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} damage of your highest damage type.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Legendary_003.name: Crazy Brew
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Legendary_003.desc: Your Healing Potion is infused with the power of Chaos, granting you {c_number}100%{/c} Resource Cost Reduction, {c_random}[(0.4+0.04*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353884)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353884)/10)*0.04)*100|%+|]{/c} increased Attack Speed and {c_random}[(0.4+0.04*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353884)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353884)/10)*0.04)*100|%+|]{/c} increased Movement Speed for {c_number}5{/c} seconds. Your Healing Potion has a {c_number}15{/c} second Cooldown and you can drink it while at full Life.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_001.name: Chaos Unleashed
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_001.desc:
Killing an enemy generates {c_number}2{/c} stacks of Chaos and dealing direct damage to a Boss generates {c_number}5{/c} stacks of Chaos. At {c_number}100{/c} stacks, unleash a salvo of {c_number}9{/c} {c_important}Chaotic Bursts{/c} that each deal {c_random}[(3+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353886)-1)*0.2+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353886)/10)*0.2)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} damage of your highest damage type.

Your {c_important}Chaotic Bursts{/c} gain {c_number}30%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} Critical Strike Chance and deal {c_random}[(1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353886)-1)*0.1+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353886)/10)*0.1)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_002.name: Brawn Over Brains
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_002.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_002.desc:
Gain the following:
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_random}[(1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353888)-1)*0.1+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353888)/10)*0.1)*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life
{icon:bullet,1.2}+{c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353888)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353888)/10)*0.05)*100|%|]{/c} Healing Received
{icon:bullet,1.2}{c_random}(PH)[(0.75+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353888)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353888)/10)*0.05)*100|%x|]{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} Damage

However, your Maximum Resistances are reduced by {c_number}25%{/c}, and your damage reduction from Armor is capped at {c_number}60%{/c}.

S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_003.name: A Beast Cornered
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_003.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Generic_Unique_003.desc:
For every {c_number}10%{/c} Life you are missing, you gain {c_random}[(0.1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353890)-1)*0.01+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353890)/10)*0.01)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and {c_number}5%{/c} damage reduction.

Each Resource you spend also drains {c_number}0.2%{/c} of your Maximum Life to refund {c_number}40%{/c} of the total Resources spent. This cannot reduce you to below {c_number}10%{/c} Life.

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Magic_001.name: Dual Threat
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Magic_001.desc: Casting a {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill also uses another equipped {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill at the target, dealing {c_random}[(0.5+0.03*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353892)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353892)/10)*0.03)*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Rare_001.name: Raging Chaos
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Rare_001.desc: While you are not {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}, you are {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}, your Skills deal Fire damage, and your Casts create a {c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c} for {c_random}[(1+0.1*(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353895)-1)+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353895)/10)*0.1)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Fire damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Legendary_001.name: Deafening Chorus
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Legendary_001.desc: Your equipped {c_important}Shouts{/c} are now always active with {c_random}[(0.3+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353897)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353897)/10)*0.02)*100|%x|]{/c} increased effect, but your Maximum Current Fury is reduced by {c_number}20%{/c} per Shout equipped.

S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Unique_001.name: Single-Minded Fury
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Barb_Unique_001.desc:
If you only have one Arsenal Weapon type equipped, gain the following:

{icon:bullet}{c_important}Werebear{/c} uses {c_important}Debilitating Roar{/c} and grants {c_random}[(0.1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353907)-1)*0.01+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353907)/10)*0.01)*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction

S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Unique_001.name: Savagery
S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Druid_Unique_001.desc:

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Magic_001.name: Grim Reapers
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Magic_001.desc: Your Skeleton Warriors' attacks have a {c_number}25%{/c} chance to use {c_important}Reap{/c} dealing {c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353913)-1)*0.1+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353913)/10)*0.1)*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage instead of their regular attack.

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Rare_001.name: Decimating Desecration
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Rare_001.desc: Your Damage Over Time effects have a chance equal to your Critical Strike Chance to deal {c_random}[(0.5+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353915)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353915)/10)*0.05)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Legendary_001.name: Defile the Dead
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Legendary_001.desc:
You can consume each Corpse twice. Consuming a Corpse creates a {c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c} dealing {c_random}[(2+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353917)-1)*0.2+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353917)/10)*0.2)*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Shadow damage.

Consuming {c_number}10{/c} Corpses grants you {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Unique_001.name: Alter the Balance
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Necro_Unique_001.desc:
Your base {c_important}Core{/c} Skills are now empowered as {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills, cost no Essence, but have a {c_random}[30-(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353919)-1)-Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353919)/10)||]{/c} second Cooldown.

Your base {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills are now altered to also be {c_important}Core{/c} Skills and have no Cooldown, but cost {c_random}[70-(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353919)-1)*2-Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353919)/10)*2||]{/c} Essence.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Magic_001.name: Unpredictable Alchemy
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Magic_001.desc: {c_important}Imbuements{/c} flow wildly, {c_important}Imbuing{/c} every {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill Cast with a random {c_important}Imbuement{/c}. {c_important}Imbued{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[(0.4+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353921)-1)*0.02+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353921)/10)*0.02)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Rare_001.name: Enervated Strikes
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Rare_001.desc:
You no longer passively generate Energy. 

Your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills deal {c_random}[(1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353923)-1)*0.05+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353923)/10)*0.05)*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Legendary_001.name: Chaotic Grenades
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Legendary_001.desc:
Your {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} also trigger a {c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c}, dealing {c_random}[(1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353925)-1)*0.1+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353925)==10?0.1:0))*(Weapon_Damage_Min_Total+Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total)||]{/c} Physical Damage. When you drop {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c}, you drop {c_number}1{/c} more.

{c_important}Chaotic Burst{/c} generate {c_number}5{/c} Energy if they hit an enemy.

S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Unique_001.name: Hit and Run
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Rogue_Unique_001.desc:

If this bonus is not active, you deal {c_random}30%{/c} reduced damage.

S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Magic_001.name: Explosive Combinations

S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Unique_001.name: Mana Shield
S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Unique_001.source: Earn by defeating Bartuc within the Infernal Hordes in Torment I or higher.
S10_ChaosPerk_Sorc_Unique_001.desc:
You have {c_number}99%{/c} reduced Maximum Life but any damage you would take is dealt to your Mana before your Life. If you have not taken damage in the last {c_number}2{/c} seconds, your Mana Regeneration is increased by {c_number}5000%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c}.

You gain {c_random}[(2+(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353938)-1)*0.2+Floor(GetCollectiblePowerLevel(2353938)/10)*0.2)*100|%|]{/c} increased Maximum Mana and each point of Intelligence also increases your Maximum Mana by {c_number}1{/c}.

S10_ChaosPerk_Spiritborn_Unique_001.desc:

This chance is increased by {c_number}1%{c_lightgray}\[+\]{/c}{/c} of your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skill Damage, up to {c_number}10%{/c}.

Your {c_important}Ultimate{/c} Skills benefit from all of their Upgrades.

Keyword_Berserk.name: Berserking

Keyword_Weaken.name: Weaken

Keyword_Eviscerated.name: Eviscerate

Keyword_Volatility.name: Volatility
Keyword_Volatility.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Volatility{/u}{/b}{/c} randomly empowers Hellfire Skills when you attack with them. Empowered skills deal [50|%|] increased damage on their next cast.

Keyword_Demonform.name: Demonform
Keyword_Demonform.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Demonform{/u}{/b}{/c} increases your Maximum Life by [20|%|] and Demonology Skill damage by [30|+%|].

Keyword_Brimstone.name: Brimstone
Keyword_Brimstone.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/b}{/c} explodes if enemies remain near for 2 seconds, dealing Fire damage around it.

Keyword_Retain.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Retain{/u}{/b}{/c} locks the resource spent on a skill for that skills duration, after which the resource is unlocked and restores as normal.

Keyword_Hex.name: Hex
Keyword_Hex.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Hex{/u}{/b}{/c} increases Abyss Skill damage taken by enemies up to [15|+%|] based on their missing Life. Stacks up to 3 times.

Skill_Primary_Wrath.nodeTip: {c_important}Wrath{/c} Skills unleash powerful effects that alter the battle

Skill_Primary_SoulShard.name: Soul Shard
Skill_Primary_SoulShard.nodeTip: {c_important}Soul Shard{/c} Skills bind demons from Hell

Skill_Primary_Companion.name: Companion
Skill_Primary_Companion.nodeTip: {c_important}Companion{/c} Skills summon allies from nature to aid you in battle

Skill_Primary_Subterfuge.name: Subterfuge
Skill_Primary_Subterfuge.nodeTip: {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skills outwit and debilitate enemies with trickery

Skill_Primary_Justice.name: Justice
Skill_Primary_Justice.nodeTip: {c_important}Justice{/c} Skills control the battlefield with the awesome power of the Light.

Skill_Primary_Valor.name: Valor
Skill_Primary_Valor.nodeTip: {c_important}Valor{/c} Skills strengthens your resolve and makes you an unstoppable force.

Skill_Primary_Aura.name: Aura
Skill_Primary_Aura.nodeTip: {c_important}Aura{/c} Skills passively help you and your allies.

Subpower_StunGrenades.name: Stun Grenade
Subpower_StunGrenades.desc: {c_important}{u}Stun Grenades{/u}{/c} explode after a delay, dealing Physical damage and Stunning enemies for {c_number}1{/c} second.

Subpower_IceSpike.name: Ice Spike
Subpower_IceSpike.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Ice Spikes{/u}{/b}{/c} explode after a short delay, dealing Cold damage and inflicting Chill.

Subpower_DruidDancingBolt.name: Dancing Bolt
Subpower_DruidDancingBolt.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Dancing Bolts{/u}{/b}{/c} skitter along the ground towards enemies dealing Lightning damage.

Keyword_Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Keyword_Earthquake.desc: {c_important}{u}Earthquakes{/u}{/c} deal Physical damage every 0.5 seconds over 4 seconds in an area.

Subpower_DesecratedGround.name: Desecrated Ground
Subpower_DesecratedGround.desc: {c_important}{u}Desecrated Ground{/c}{/u} lasts for {c_number}6{/c} seconds and deals damage over time to enemies in the area.

Keyword_IceSpikes.name: Ice Spike
Keyword_IceSpikes.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Ice Spikes{/u}{/b}{/c} explode after a short delay, dealing Cold damage and inflicting Chill.

Keyword_DustDevils.name: Dust Devil
Keyword_DustDevils.desc: {c_important}{u}Dust Devils{/u}{/c} travel along the ground and deal damage.

Subpower_Tectonic.name: Tectonic Spikes
Subpower_Tectonic.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Tectonic Spikes{/u}{/b}{/c} cause large spikes to erupt from the ground causing Physical damage to enemies.

Subpower_ArrowStorm.name: Arrow Storm
Subpower_ArrowStorm.desc: {c_important}{u}Arrow Storms{/u}{/c} rain down arrows for {c_number}3{/c} seconds, dealing Physical damage every {c_number}0.25{/c} seconds.

Keyword_Meteorite.name: Meteorite
Keyword_Meteorite.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Meteorites{/u}{/b}{/c} fall from the sky and crash into enemies dealing Fire damage.

Keyword_Empower.name: Empowered
Keyword_Empower.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Empowered{/u}{/b}{/c} skills cost no Resource to cast and gain additional effects.

Keyword_Vengeance.name: Vengeance
Keyword_Vengeance.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Vengeance{/u}{/b}{/c} deals 15% of your Thorns to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds.

Keyword_Doom.name: Doom
Keyword_Doom.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Doomed{/u}{/b}{/c} enemies accumulate 30% of Base damage done to them from all sources. {c_important}{b}{u}Doom{/u}{/b}{/c} expires after 3 seconds and deals all accumulated damage to the enemy.

Skill_Primary_Harmony.name: Harmony
Skill_Primary_Harmony.nodeTip: {c_important}Harmony{/c} Skills spend Resource over time to enhance yourself and make your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills free to cast.

Keyword_VolatileSkeleton.name: Volatile Skeleton
Keyword_VolatileSkeleton.desc: {c_important}{u}Volatile Skeletons{/c}{/u} explode around enemies, dealing damage and leaving behind a Corpse.

Keyword_SpiritStorm.name: Spirit Storm
Keyword_SpiritStorm.desc: {c_important}{u}Spirit Storms{/u}{/c} deal Sparking damage to enemies within and last for {c_number}2{/c} seconds.

Keyword_IronShrapnel.name: Iron Shrapnel
Keyword_IronShrapnel.desc: {c_important}{u}Iron Shrapnel{/u}{/c} pierces enemies and deals Physical damage and Bleeding over 5 seconds.

Warplans_Pit_DifficultyTier.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Difficulty Tiers{/c}{/u}{/b} increases the Life, Damage, Experience, and Rewards of everything inside the Pit.

Warplans_Pit_GlyphUpgradeChance.desc: You have a chance to upgrade your {c_important}Glyphs{/c} at the end of a Pit run. The chance depends on the {c_important}Glyph's{/c} rank and the Pit's {c_important}{b}{u}Difficulty Tier{/c}{/u}{/b}.

Warplans_Pit_ProgressOrb.desc: Some enemies or objects may drop {c_important}{b}{u}Progress Orbs{/c}{/b}{/u}. Collecting them will grant bonus objective progress in the Pit.

Warplans_Pit_Guardian.desc: After slaying enough enemies, the Pit will spawn a {c_important}{b}{u}Guardian{/c}{/b}{/u} to ambush you. They must be slain to complete the Pit run.

Warplans_Whisper_Cache.desc: Collecting 10 {c_important}Grim Favors{/c} allows you to select a {c_important}{b}{u}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u} from the {c_important}Tree of Whispers{/c}.

Warplans_HelltideThreat.desc:
Slaying monsters while in Helltide increase your {c_important}{b}{u}Threat Level{/c}{/b}{/u}.

When reaching Maximum Threat, your Threat Bar will drain and powerful enemy monsters will ambush you.

Warplans_BossLair_HoardChest.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Hoard Chests{/b}{/c}{/u} appear after {c_important}Lair Boss{/c} is slain. You must provide a {c_important}Lair Boss Key{/c} to claim your Reward.

Warplans_MonsterPower.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/b}{/c}{/u} increases a Monster's Life, Damage, Experience, and Rewards.

Warplans_Pit_Seals.desc: Earn {c_important}{b}{u}Artificer's Stones{/c}{/u}{/b} in {c_important}The Pit{/c} after defeating the {c_important}Guardian{/c}.

Warplans_Mindcage.desc: A {c_important}{b}{u}Profane Mindcage{/c}{/b}{/u} allows you to increase the {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u} of any monster in the overworld until you die.

Warplans_Cinders.desc:
{icon:Helltide_Currency, 2.5} Aberrant Cinders drop from slain monsters in Helltide. They are used to open {icon:Marker_Helltide_Chest, 2.5} Tortured Gift chests. 

If you die in Helltide, you lose 50% of your {icon:Helltide_Currency, 2.5} Aberrant Cinders.

Warplans_Obducite.desc:
Obducite is used by the {icon:Icon_Tooltip_Marker_Blacksmith, 1.5} {c_important}Blacksmith{/c} to
{icon:Crafting_Blacksmith_Masterworking, 1.5} {c_important}Masterwork{/c} equipment.

Warplans_Attunement.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Attunement{/c}{/b}{/u} determines your rewards at the end of The Undercity and is earned by slaying enemies near Beacons.

Warplans_PortalPrankster.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Portal Pranksters{/c}{/b}{/u} are rare Treasure Goblins that grant additional Rewards in Undercity.

Warplans_Tributes.desc: When entering the Undercity, you can offer a {c_important}{b}{u}Tribute{/c}{/b}{/u}. This will adjust the difficulty and the reward you can earn within the Undercity.

Warplans_Helltide_Hellwyrm.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Hellwyrms{/c}{/b}{/u} are massive demons that are attracted to players with a high {c_important}{b}{u}Threat Level{/c}{/b}{/u}. They emerge to spawn lesser enemies, but do not directly engage in combat.

Warplans_Whisper_Material_Cache.desc: Collecting 10 {c_important}Grim Favors{/c} allows you to select a {c_important}{b}{u}Whisper Cache{/c}{/b}{/u} from the {c_important}Tree of Whispers{/c}.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Human.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Human{/b}{/u}{/c} form grants {c_number}15%{/c} Resource Regeneration and a {c_number}15|%|{/c} Cooldown Reduction.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Wolf.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Werewolf{/b}{/u}{/c} form grants a {c_number}15|%|]{/c} Movement Speed and {c_number}20|%|]{/c} Attack Speed bonus.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Bear.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Werebear{/b}{/u}{/c} form grants {c_number}15|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction and {c_number}20|%|]{/c} bonus to Maximum Life.

Druid_Shapeshift_Tooltip_Versatile.desc: {c_important}{u}{b}Versatile{/b}{/u}{/c} Skills may be cast in any form.

KEYWORD_OPAL_Moo.desc: {c_important}{b}{u}Moos{/u}{/b}{/c} have a baseline 40% chance to trigger {c_important}Lucky Moo{/c} effects.
